example1_en: The hotel offered a taste of luxury for one night.
example1_ja: 这家酒店让我们体验了一晚奢华享受。
example2_en: As household incomes rise, goods once considered a luxury often become part of everyday life.
example2_ja: 随着家庭收入增加，曾被视为奢侈品的商品往往成为日常生活的一部分。
collocations: live in luxury｜过奢华生活 ; luxury goods｜奢侈品 ; luxury hotel｜豪华酒店 ; afford the luxury of｜有条件享受……
tip_ja: 指奢华状态时不可数；指一项享受时可数。

meanings_ja: n. 稻草；麦秆 | n. 吸管
definition_en: Dried cereal stems used for animal bedding and other purposes. | A narrow tube used for drinking liquids.
example1_en: The farmer spread fresh straw across the barn floor.
example1_ja: 农民在谷仓地上铺了一层新鲜的麦秆。
example2_en: Replacing plastic straws with reusable alternatives can reduce waste, although wider changes in consumption remain necessary.
example2_ja: 用可重复使用的替代品取代塑料吸管能减少废物，但仍需更广泛地改变消费方式。
collocations: a bale of straw｜一捆稻草 ; a straw hat｜一顶草帽 ; a drinking straw｜一根饮用吸管 ; the last straw｜令人忍无可忍的最后一击
tip_ja: 作稻草时不可数，作吸管时可数；hay指干草饲料。

meanings_ja: adj. 不能的；无法的
definition_en: Not having the ability or opportunity to do something.
example1_en: I was unable to open the tightly sealed jar.
example1_ja: 我打不开那个封得很紧的罐子。
example2_en: Without affordable internet access, many students are unable to participate fully in online learning programmes.
example2_ja: 如果没有负担得起的网络服务，许多学生就无法充分参与在线学习课程。
collocations: be unable to attend｜无法出席 ; be unable to afford｜负担不起 ; be unable to cope｜无法应付
tip_ja: 用 be unable to do，不用 unable doing。

meanings_ja: n. 祝贺；贺词
definition_en: An expression of pleasure at someone's success or good fortune.
example1_en: We sent our congratulations when she passed her driving test.
example1_ja: 她通过驾驶考试后，我们向她表示祝贺。
example2_en: Offering congratulations to students who achieve personal goals can strengthen their confidence and encourage further learning.
example2_ja: 向实现个人目标的学生表示祝贺，可以增强他们的信心，并鼓励他们继续学习。
collocations: congratulations on｜为……表示祝贺 ; a letter of congratulation｜贺信 ; warm congratulations｜热烈祝贺
tip_ja: 祝贺通常用复数congratulations，后接on加成就。

meanings_ja: n. 十年；十年期
definition_en: a period of ten years
example1_en: They have lived on this street for a decade.
example1_ja: 他们在这条街上已经住了十年。
example2_en: Over the past decade, digital technology has significantly changed how people access education and healthcare.
example2_ja: 过去十年间，数字技术显著改变了人们获取教育和医疗服务的方式。
collocations: over the past decade｜在过去十年间 ; for decades｜数十年来 ; the next decade｜未来十年
tip_ja: a decade是十年；decades常泛指数十年。

meanings_ja: n. 剃须刀；剃刀
definition_en: A tool with a sharp blade used to shave hair.
example1_en: He rinsed his razor and put it beside the sink.
example1_ja: 他冲洗了剃须刀，把它放在洗手池旁。
example2_en: Choosing a reusable razor can reduce the amount of plastic waste generated by daily grooming.
example2_ja: 选择可重复使用的剃须刀，可以减少日常个人护理产生的塑料垃圾。
collocations: electric razor｜电动剃须刀 ; disposable razor｜一次性剃须刀 ; razor blade｜剃须刀片
tip_ja: razor指剃须工具；普通切割用刀叫knife。

meanings_ja: v. 涉及；包含；需要 | v. 使参与
definition_en: to include something as a necessary part | to make someone take part in an activity
example1_en: My new job involves talking to customers all day.
example1_ja: 我的新工作需要整天与顾客交谈。
example2_en: Local authorities should involve residents in planning decisions to ensure that new developments meet community needs.
example2_ja: 地方政府应让居民参与规划决策，确保新的开发项目满足社区需求。
collocations: involve doing something｜需要做某事 ; involve someone in something｜让某人参与某事 ; be closely involved｜密切参与
tip_ja: 表示需要做某事，用involve doing，不用to do。

meanings_ja: n. 影响；影响力 | v. 影响
definition_en: the power to affect how someone thinks or behaves | to affect someone's decisions, behaviour, or development
example1_en: My older sister had a strong influence on me.
example1_ja: 姐姐对我有很大的影响。
example2_en: Advertising can influence children's food preferences, which makes responsible marketing particularly important for public health.
example2_ja: 广告会影响儿童的食物偏好，因此负责任的营销对公众健康尤为重要。
collocations: have an influence on｜对……有影响 ; a positive influence｜积极的影响 ; influence a decision｜影响决定
tip_ja: 名词后常接on；动词直接接宾语。

meanings_ja: n. 材料；原料；布料 | n. 资料；素材 | adj. 物质的；实质性的
definition_en: A substance used to make things, including cloth. | Information or ideas used for study or creative work. | Relating to physical possessions, or significant enough to matter.
example1_en: This bag is made from a strong waterproof material.
example1_ja: 这个包用结实的防水材料制成。
example2_en: Using recycled material in construction can reduce waste and lower demand for newly extracted natural resources.
example2_ja: 在建筑中使用再生材料可以减少废弃物，并降低对新开采自然资源的需求。
collocations: raw materials｜原材料 ; building materials｜建筑材料 ; reading material｜阅读资料 ; material possessions｜物质财富
tip_ja: 资料义通常不可数；多种材料可用materials。

meanings_ja: n. 装饰品 | n. 装饰；装潢 | n. 勋章；奖章
definition_en: An object added to make something look more attractive. | The process or style of making a place look attractive. | An official award worn to honour service or bravery.
example1_en: She hung a bright paper decoration above the kitchen table.
example1_ja: 她在厨房餐桌上方挂了一件鲜艳的纸制装饰品。
example2_en: The decoration of public libraries can create welcoming spaces that encourage residents to spend more time reading.
example2_ja: 公共图书馆的装潢可以营造温馨的空间，鼓励居民花更多时间阅读。
collocations: interior decoration｜室内装饰 ; party decorations｜派对装饰品 ; table decoration｜餐桌装饰品
tip_ja: 指装饰过程时不可数；指单件装饰品时可数。

meanings_ja: n. 拖挂式房车 | n. 结伴旅行的车队或驼队
definition_en: A wheeled home pulled by a car, especially for holidays | A group of people or vehicles travelling together, especially through deserts
example1_en: We parked our caravan beside a quiet lake.
example1_ja: 我们把拖挂式房车停在一个宁静的湖边。
example2_en: Caravan holidays can support rural tourism by bringing visitors to areas without large hotels.
example2_ja: 房车度假可以将游客带到没有大型酒店的地区，从而促进乡村旅游。
collocations: caravan park｜房车营地 ; tow a caravan｜牵引拖挂式房车 ; camel caravan｜骆驼商队
tip_ja: 英式英语指拖挂式房车；美式常用travel trailer。

meanings_ja: n. 管理；经营 | n. 管理层；管理人员
definition_en: The work of organising and controlling activities or resources. | The people responsible for running an organisation.
example1_en: Good time management leaves me free to relax.
example1_ja: 良好的时间管理让我有空放松。
example2_en: Effective waste management requires cooperation between local authorities, businesses, and residents to reduce pollution and conserve resources.
example2_ja: 有效的废物管理需要地方政府、企业和居民合作，以减少污染并节约资源。
collocations: time management｜时间管理 ; waste management｜废物管理 ; senior management｜高层管理人员 ; management skills｜管理技能
tip_ja: 指管理工作时不可数；the management可指管理层。

meanings_ja: adj. 紧的；紧身的 | adj. 紧张的；余地很小的 | adv. 紧紧地；牢牢地
definition_en: Fitting closely or held firmly, with little room to move. | Leaving very little extra time, money, or space. | Firmly and securely, without becoming loose.
example1_en: These shoes are too tight around my toes.
example1_ja: 这双鞋的鞋头太紧，挤着我的脚趾。
example2_en: Schools operating on tight budgets may struggle to provide students with modern equipment and adequate support.
example2_ja: 预算紧张的学校可能难以为学生提供现代化设备和充分的支持。
collocations: tight jeans｜紧身牛仔裤 ; a tight budget｜紧张的预算 ; a tight deadline｜很紧的截止期限 ; hold tight｜紧紧抓住
tip_ja: tight本身可作副词，如hold tight；tightly也表紧紧地。

meanings_ja: n. 水手；海员；帆船运动者
definition_en: Someone who works on ships or sails boats
example1_en: The sailor tied the boat securely to the dock.
example1_ja: 水手把船牢牢地系在码头上。
example2_en: Modern navigation technology helps sailors avoid dangerous waters, but practical experience remains essential for safety at sea.
example2_ja: 现代导航技术帮助海员避开危险水域，但实践经验对海上安全仍至关重要。
collocations: experienced sailor｜经验丰富的海员 ; professional sailor｜职业海员 ; a crew of sailors｜一组船员
tip_ja: 指在船上工作或驾驶帆船的人，不泛指乘客。

meanings_ja: adj. 穿着得体的；衣着考究的
definition_en: Wearing attractive, neat, and appropriate clothes.
example1_en: A well-dressed guest arrived in a neatly pressed suit.
example1_ja: 一位衣着考究的客人穿着熨烫平整的西装到来。
example2_en: Although well-dressed applicants may create positive first impressions, employers should prioritise relevant skills and professional experience.
example2_ja: 尽管衣着得体的求职者可能留下良好的第一印象，雇主仍应优先考虑相关技能和工作经验。
collocations: well-dressed guests｜衣着考究的宾客 ; a well-dressed applicant｜衣着得体的求职者
tip_ja: 强调穿着整洁得体，不一定指衣服昂贵或紧跟潮流。

meanings_ja: n. 成年人；大人 | adj. 成年的；成熟的
definition_en: An adult, especially when described by or to children. | Adult, or behaving in a sensible and responsible way.
example1_en: Ask a grown-up to help you slice the bread.
example1_ja: 请一位大人帮你切面包。
example2_en: Children often develop grown-up attitudes towards responsibility when they participate in age-appropriate household tasks.
example2_ja: 孩子参与适合其年龄的家务时，往往会形成对待责任的成熟态度。
collocations: ask a grown-up｜请教大人 ; grown-up children｜已成年的子女 ; a grown-up attitude｜成熟的态度
tip_ja: 名词多用于儿童语境；正式写作宜用adult。

meanings_ja: adj. 隐藏的；不易察觉的
definition_en: Kept out of sight or not easily noticed.
example1_en: We found a hidden cupboard behind the kitchen door.
example1_ja: 我们在厨房门后发现了一个隐蔽的橱柜。
example2_en: Consumers should consider the hidden costs of online purchases, including delivery fees and charges for returning items.
example2_ja: 消费者应考虑网购的隐性成本，包括运费和退货费用。
collocations: hidden costs｜隐性成本 ; hidden meaning｜隐藏的含义 ; hidden talent｜未显露的才能
tip_ja: 也是hide的过去分词；隐藏不等于肉眼不可见。

meanings_ja: n. 会员身份；成员资格 | n. 全体会员；会员人数
definition_en: the status of belonging to a club or organisation | all members of a group, or the total member count
example1_en: My gym membership includes free swimming lessons every weekend.
example1_ja: 我的健身房会员权益包括每个周末的免费游泳课。
example2_en: Affordable membership fees can encourage more residents to use local sports facilities and improve their health.
example2_ja: 价格合理的会员费可以鼓励更多居民使用当地体育设施，改善健康状况。
collocations: membership fee｜会员费 ; annual membership｜年度会员资格 ; renew your membership｜续办会员资格 ; union membership｜工会会员身份
tip_ja: 表示加入某组织的资格，常用membership of。

meanings_ja: v. 打开行李取出物品 | v. 剖析；详细解释
definition_en: take things out of a bag, box, or other container | examine an idea carefully to explain its different parts
example1_en: I unpacked my suitcase and hung up my shirts.
example1_ja: 我把衣物从行李箱里拿出来，挂好了衬衫。
example2_en: Teachers can help students unpack complex arguments by examining the evidence and assumptions behind each claim.
example2_ja: 教师可以通过审视每个论点背后的证据和假设，帮助学生剖析复杂的论证。
collocations: unpack a suitcase｜取出行李箱中的物品 ; unpack boxes｜打开箱子取出物品 ; unpack an argument｜剖析论证
tip_ja: 既可指取出行李，也可比喻拆解复杂观点。

meanings_ja: n. 工作室；录音室；演播室 | n. 电影制片公司 | n. 单间公寓
definition_en: A room where art, music, or broadcasts are produced | A company that makes films | A flat combining living and sleeping space in one room
example1_en: The artist invited us into her bright upstairs studio.
example1_ja: 那位艺术家邀请我们参观她楼上明亮的工作室。
example2_en: Public funding for affordable studio spaces can help emerging artists contribute to a city's cultural life.
example2_ja: 为价格可负担的工作室提供公共资金，能帮助新兴艺术家丰富城市文化生活。
collocations: recording studio｜录音室 ; art studio｜艺术工作室 ; film studio｜电影制片公司 ; studio flat｜单间公寓
tip_ja: 英式studio flat、美式studio apartment均指单间公寓。

meanings_ja: v. 使害怕；吓唬
definition_en: To make someone feel afraid.
example1_en: Sudden loud noises can frighten our new puppy.
example1_ja: 突然的巨响会吓到我们新养的小狗。
example2_en: Alarming news reports may frighten children, so adults should explain difficult events in an appropriate way.
example2_ja: 令人不安的新闻报道可能吓到儿童，因此成人应以恰当的方式解释复杂事件。
collocations: frighten someone away｜把某人吓跑 ; frighten someone into doing｜吓得某人去做 ; frighten someone to death｜把某人吓坏
tip_ja: frightened指感到害怕的；frightening指令人害怕的。

meanings_ja: n. 摄影；摄影术
definition_en: The activity or skill of taking photographs.
example1_en: My sister enjoys photography and carries her camera everywhere.
example1_ja: 我姐姐喜欢摄影，走到哪儿都带着相机。
example2_en: Digital photography allows researchers to document environmental changes and share visual evidence with a wider audience.
example2_ja: 数码摄影让研究人员能够记录环境变化，并向更广泛的受众分享影像证据。
collocations: digital photography｜数码摄影 ; wildlife photography｜野生动物摄影 ; portrait photography｜人像摄影 ; take up photography｜开始学习摄影
tip_ja: photography不可数；一张照片用a photograph。

meanings_ja: n. 脚后跟 | n. 鞋跟
definition_en: The rounded back part of the foot below the ankle. | The raised part beneath the back of a shoe.
example1_en: These new shoes rub against my left heel.
example1_ja: 这双新鞋磨我的左脚后跟。
example2_en: Shoes that support the heel properly may improve comfort for people who spend long hours standing.
example2_ja: 能适当支撑脚后跟的鞋子，可以让长时间站立的人感觉更舒适。
collocations: heel pain｜足跟疼痛 ; high heels｜高跟鞋 ; low heels｜低跟鞋
tip_ja: heel是脚后跟或鞋跟；heal意为愈合，二者同音。

meanings_ja: n. 买家；购买者 | n. 采购员
definition_en: a person or organisation that purchases something | someone whose job is choosing goods for a business
example1_en: The buyer checked the bicycle before handing over cash.
example1_ja: 买家在付现金前检查了那辆自行车。
example2_en: First-time buyers often struggle to enter the housing market because property prices rise faster than wages.
example2_ja: 由于房价上涨速度超过工资，首次购房者往往难以进入住房市场。
collocations: potential buyer｜潜在买家 ; first-time buyer｜首次购房者 ; a buyer's market｜买方市场
tip_ja: buyer 指买方；customer 更强调店铺或服务的顾客。

meanings_ja: n. 蝙蝠 | n. 球棒；球拍 | v. 用球棒击球
definition_en: A flying mammal usually active at night. | An object used to hit the ball in certain sports. | To hit or try to hit a ball with a bat.
example1_en: A bat flew above our garden at dusk.
example1_ja: 黄昏时，一只蝙蝠从我们花园上方飞过。
example2_en: Protecting bat habitats can benefit agriculture because many species feed on insects that damage crops.
example2_ja: 保护蝙蝠栖息地能使农业受益，因为许多蝙蝠以危害农作物的昆虫为食。
collocations: a cricket bat｜板球拍 ; a baseball bat｜棒球棒 ; bat wings｜蝙蝠翅膀
tip_ja: 网球拍用racket，棒球棒和板球拍用bat。

meanings_ja: v. 识别；辨认 | v. 找出；确定 | v. 产生共鸣；认同
definition_en: To recognize and establish who or what someone or something is. | To discover or establish something through examination. | To feel connected to someone through shared feelings or experiences.
example1_en: Can you identify the bird sitting on our fence?
example1_ja: 你能认出停在我们围栏上的那只鸟吗？
example2_en: Schools should identify learning difficulties early so that students can receive appropriate support before falling behind.
example2_ja: 学校应尽早发现学习困难，让学生在落后之前获得适当的支持。
collocations: identify a problem｜发现问题 ; identify the cause｜确定原因 ; identify someone as｜认出某人是 ; identify with｜与……产生共鸣
tip_ja: identify with某人指产生共鸣，不是辨认对方。

meanings_ja: n. 服务费；学费；酬金
definition_en: Money charged for a service, course, or professional advice.
example1_en: The gym charges a small fee for each class.
example1_ja: 这家健身房每节课收取少量费用。
example2_en: High tuition fees may discourage students from disadvantaged backgrounds from applying to university, even when financial assistance is available.
example2_ja: 高昂的学费可能使家境困难的学生不愿申请大学，即使有经济援助可用。
collocations: tuition fees｜学费 ; entrance fee｜入场费 ; legal fees｜法律服务费 ; pay a fee｜支付费用
tip_ja: fee指服务或入场等费用；小费通常用tip。

meanings_ja: n. 食欲；胃口 | n. 强烈欲望；渴求
definition_en: The desire to eat food. | A strong desire to have or experience something.
example1_en: A long walk always gives me a good appetite.
example1_ja: 走一段长路总能让我胃口大开。
example2_en: The growing public appetite for sustainable products encourages companies to reconsider their materials and manufacturing processes.
example2_ja: 公众对可持续产品日益增长的需求促使企业重新考虑其材料及制造工艺。
collocations: lose your appetite｜失去食欲 ; a healthy appetite｜好胃口 ; work up an appetite｜使胃口大开 ; an appetite for｜对……的渴望
tip_ja: appetite for 除食欲外，也可表示对知识等的渴求。

meanings_ja: n. 新闻标题 | v. 成为头条新闻；领衔演出
definition_en: the title of a news report | to be the main news story or featured performer
example1_en: The headline caught my attention while I ate breakfast.
example1_ja: 我吃早餐时，那个新闻标题吸引了我的注意。
example2_en: Misleading headlines can shape public opinion before readers examine the evidence presented in a news report.
example2_ja: 误导性的标题可能在读者查看新闻报道中的证据之前就影响公众舆论。
collocations: front-page headline｜头版标题 ; make headlines｜成为头条新闻 ; misleading headline｜误导性标题
tip_ja: make headlines指成为新闻焦点，不是制作标题。

meanings_ja: v. 考虑；仔细斟酌 | v. 认为；视为 | v. 顾及；考虑到
definition_en: to think carefully about something before deciding | to have a particular opinion about someone or something | to take someone or something into account
example1_en: We're considering taking the train instead of driving tomorrow.
example1_ja: 我们正在考虑明天坐火车，而不开车。
example2_en: Governments should consider the long-term environmental costs before approving major construction projects in sensitive coastal areas.
example2_ja: 政府在批准生态敏感沿海地区的大型建设项目之前，应考虑其长期环境成本。
collocations: consider doing something｜考虑做某事 ; consider the consequences｜考虑后果 ; consider all options｜考虑所有选择 ; be considered essential｜被认为必不可少
tip_ja: “考虑做”用consider doing，不用consider to do。

meanings_ja: n. 赊购；信贷 | n. 赞扬；认可 | n. 学分
definition_en: An arrangement allowing payment later or borrowing money. | Recognition that someone deserves for an achievement. | A unit earned towards a qualification by completing coursework.
example1_en: We bought our new fridge on credit last month.
example1_ja: 我们上个月赊购了一台新冰箱。
example2_en: Affordable credit can help small businesses invest in equipment and create jobs within local communities.
example2_ja: 成本可负担的信贷能帮助小企业投资设备，并为当地社区创造就业机会。
collocations: buy on credit｜赊购 ; give someone credit｜肯定某人的功劳 ; earn credits｜修得学分 ; credit card｜信用卡
tip_ja: on credit表示赊购；学分义可数，常用复数。

meanings_ja: n. 口罩；面具 | v. 掩盖；掩饰
definition_en: A covering worn over part or all of the face. | To hide something or make it less noticeable.

example1_ja: 她清理满是灰尘的橱柜时戴着口罩。
example2_en: Rapid economic growth can mask serious inequalities in access to education and healthcare.
example2_ja: 经济快速增长可能掩盖教育和医疗机会方面的严重不平等。
collocations: wear a mask｜戴口罩；戴面具 ; face mask｜口罩；面膜 ; mask the smell｜掩盖气味 ; mask the problem｜掩盖问题

meanings_ja: adj. 王室的；国王或女王的 | n. 王室成员
definition_en: Relating to a king, queen, or their family. | A member of a royal family.

example1_ja: 我们度假时参观了王宫。
example2_en: Some royal residences are open to visitors, generating income that helps preserve historic buildings.
example2_ja: 一些王室住所向游客开放，所得收入有助于保护历史建筑。
collocations: the royal family｜王室 ; a royal palace｜王宫 ; royal duties｜王室职责
tip_ja: royal指王室的；loyal指忠诚的，注意首字母。

meanings_ja: n. 气候 | n. 社会环境；风气；氛围
definition_en: The typical weather conditions of a place over many years. | The general attitudes and conditions within a society or organisation.
example1_en: These plants grow well in a warm, dry climate.
example1_ja: 这些植物在温暖干燥的气候中长得很好。
example2_en: A changing climate may force farmers to grow different crops and adopt more efficient irrigation methods.
example2_ja: 气候变化可能迫使农民改种其他作物，并采用更高效的灌溉方法。
collocations: climate change｜气候变化 ; mild climate｜温和的气候 ; political climate｜政治环境
tip_ja: climate指长期气候，weather指具体天气。

meanings_ja: adj. 身体不舒服的；不舒适的 | adj. 不自在的；不安的
definition_en: Causing or feeling physical discomfort. | Feeling worried, embarrassed, or uneasy.

example1_ja: 走了很久以后，这双新鞋穿着很不舒服。
example2_en: Students may feel uncomfortable asking questions in large classes, which can limit their participation and understanding.
example2_ja: 学生在大班课堂上提问时可能感到不自在，这会影响他们的参与和理解。
collocations: an uncomfortable chair｜不舒服的椅子 ; feel uncomfortable｜感到不适 ; an uncomfortable silence｜令人尴尬的沉默
tip_ja: 既可指身体不适，也可指心理上的不自在。

meanings_ja: n. 洞穴；山洞
definition_en: A large natural hollow inside rock or under the ground.
example1_en: We sheltered from the rain inside a small cave.
example1_ja: 我们躲进一个小山洞里避雨。
example2_en: Ancient paintings found in a cave can reveal how early communities understood their surroundings.
example2_ja: 洞穴中发现的古代绘画可以揭示早期群体如何理解周围环境。
collocations: explore a cave｜探索洞穴 ; cave entrance｜洞口 ; cave paintings｜洞穴壁画
tip_ja: cave指洞穴；动词短语cave in表示坍塌或屈服。

meanings_ja: v. 探索；探访 | v. 探讨；研究
definition_en: Travel around a place to discover what it is like | Examine an idea or issue carefully to learn more
example1_en: We spent the afternoon exploring narrow streets near the harbour.
example1_ja: 我们花了一下午探访港口附近的狭窄街巷。
example2_en: Schools should encourage students to explore different career options before choosing subjects for further study.
example2_ja: 学校应鼓励学生在选择深造科目前探索不同的职业方向。
collocations: explore the area｜探访该地区 ; explore possibilities｜探索各种可能性 ; explore an issue｜探讨问题
tip_ja: 作及物动词时直接接地点或问题，不加about。

meanings_ja: v. 削皮；剥皮 | v. 剥落；脱落 | n. 果皮；蔬菜皮
definition_en: To remove the outer skin of fruit or vegetables. | To come off a surface in thin pieces. | The outer skin of a fruit or vegetable.
example1_en: Could you peel these potatoes while I chop the carrots?
example1_ja: 我切胡萝卜时，你能帮忙削这些土豆吗？
example2_en: Households can compost vegetable peels rather than discard them, reducing the amount of waste sent to landfill.
example2_ja: 家庭可以将蔬菜皮制成堆肥而非丢弃，从而减少送往填埋场的垃圾量。
collocations: peel potatoes｜削土豆皮 ; orange peel｜橙皮 ; peeling paint｜剥落的油漆
tip_ja: peel作动词可指削皮，也可指油漆等剥落。

meanings_ja: n. 小说；虚构文学 | n. 虚构之事；编造
definition_en: Stories about imagined people and events. | Something invented that is presented as true.
example1_en: My sister reads fiction on the train every morning.
example1_ja: 我姐姐每天早上在火车上读小说。
example2_en: Reading fiction can help young people understand unfamiliar perspectives and develop greater empathy for others.
example2_ja: 阅读小说能帮助年轻人理解陌生的视角，并更加体谅他人。
collocations: science fiction｜科幻小说 ; historical fiction｜历史小说 ; a work of fiction｜一部小说作品 ; fact and fiction｜事实与虚构
tip_ja: 统称小说时不可数；一部小说可说a work of fiction。

meanings_ja: v. 编辑；修改；剪辑
definition_en: To improve or prepare writing, images, or recordings by making changes.
example1_en: I need to edit this video before dinner.
example1_ja: 我需要在晚饭前剪辑好这段视频。
example2_en: Students should learn to edit their essays carefully, checking both the structure and the accuracy of their arguments.
example2_ja: 学生应学会仔细修改论文，检查论证的结构与准确性。
collocations: edit an essay｜修改文章 ; edit a video｜剪辑视频 ; edit out｜删去；剪掉
tip_ja: edit强调修改或剪辑，publish才是出版或发布。

meanings_ja: adv. 完全地；充分地
definition_en: Completely or to the greatest possible extent.
example1_en: Make sure your phone is fully charged before leaving.
example1_ja: 出门前确保手机已经充满电。
example2_en: Students benefit most from online learning when they fully understand how to use the available digital tools.
example2_ja: 学生充分了解如何使用现有数字工具时，才能最大程度地从在线学习中受益。
collocations: fully aware｜充分意识到的 ; fully equipped｜设备齐全的 ; fully understand｜充分理解 ; fully booked｜预订已满的
tip_ja: 常修饰分词或形容词，如fully prepared。

meanings_ja: n. 政策；方针；原则 | n. 保险单；保险合同
definition_en: an agreed plan or rule guiding decisions and actions | a contract describing the insurance cover someone has bought
example1_en: Our school has a policy of serving fresh fruit daily.
example1_ja: 我们学校规定每天供应新鲜水果。
example2_en: An effective housing policy should address both rising rents and the shortage of affordable homes.
example2_ja: 有效的住房政策应同时应对租金上涨和可负担住房短缺的问题。
collocations: government policy｜政府政策 ; implement a policy｜实施政策 ; insurance policy｜保险单 ; foreign policy｜外交政策
tip_ja: policy是政策或保险单；politics指政治。

meanings_ja: n. 地点；场所 | n. 斑点；污点 | v. 发现；认出
definition_en: A particular place or position. | A small mark differing in colour from its surroundings. | Notice or recognise someone or something.
example1_en: We found a shady spot beside the river.
example1_ja: 我们在河边找到了一处阴凉的地方。
example2_en: Satellite images help researchers spot changes in forest cover before extensive damage occurs.
example2_ja: 卫星图像帮助研究人员在大面积破坏发生之前发现森林覆盖的变化。
collocations: a quiet spot｜安静的地方 ; on the spot｜当场；在现场 ; spot a mistake｜发现错误 ; a tourist spot｜旅游景点
tip_ja: on the spot可指“当场”或“在现场”，依语境判断。

meanings_ja: v. 应该；应当 | v. 应该会；按理应当
definition_en: Used with to for advice, duty, or the right action. | Used with to to express what is likely or expected.
example1_en: You ought to take an umbrella; those clouds look dark.
example1_ja: 你应该带把伞，那些云看起来很阴沉。
example2_en: Governments ought to ensure that all children have access to quality education, regardless of family income.
example2_ja: 政府应确保所有儿童都能接受优质教育，不受家庭收入影响。
collocations: ought to do｜应该做 ; ought not to do｜不应该做 ; ought to have done｜本应该做
tip_ja: ought是情态动词，后接to do；否定为ought not to。

meanings_ja: n. 餐巾；餐巾纸
definition_en: Cloth or paper used to wipe your mouth while eating
example1_en: He wiped the soup from his chin with a napkin.
example1_ja: 他用餐巾擦掉下巴上的汤。
example2_en: Restaurants can reduce waste by replacing disposable paper napkins with reusable cloth alternatives, provided laundering is managed efficiently.
example2_ja: 只要高效安排洗涤，餐馆就能用可重复使用的布餐巾替代一次性餐巾纸来减少垃圾。
collocations: a paper napkin｜餐巾纸 ; a cloth napkin｜布餐巾 ; fold a napkin｜折餐巾
tip_ja: 现代常指餐巾；“尿布”英式通常用nappy。

meanings_ja: adj. 勇敢的 | v. 勇敢面对；冒着
definition_en: Willing to face danger or difficulty despite feeling afraid. | To face something dangerous or unpleasant with courage.
example1_en: You were brave to speak in front of everyone.
example1_ja: 你敢在大家面前发言，真勇敢。
example2_en: It takes brave leadership to introduce necessary environmental reforms when powerful groups strongly oppose them.
example2_ja: 当强势群体激烈反对时，推行必要的环境改革需要勇敢的领导力。
collocations: a brave decision｜勇敢的决定 ; brave enough to｜有足够勇气做 ; brave the cold｜冒着严寒
tip_ja: brave并非毫不害怕，而是害怕仍敢面对。

meanings_ja: adv. 显然；明显地
definition_en: in a way that is easy to see or understand
example1_en: The puppy was obviously tired after its long walk.
example1_ja: 走了很长一段路后，小狗显然累了。
example2_en: Although renewable energy obviously benefits the environment, its initial costs may discourage investment in poorer regions.
example2_ja: 虽然可再生能源显然有益于环境，但其初期成本可能阻碍较贫困地区的投资。
collocations: obviously pleased｜明显很高兴 ; obviously wrong｜显然错误 ; obviously important｜显然重要
tip_ja: 表示情况显而易见；讨论争议观点时慎用，以免武断。

meanings_ja: n. 燕麦粥；麦片粥
definition_en: A thick breakfast dish made by cooking oats in liquid.

example1_ja: 我在热燕麦粥上放了些香蕉片。
example2_en: Schools can offer porridge at breakfast to provide pupils with an affordable and nutritious meal.
example2_ja: 学校可以在早餐时提供燕麦粥，让学生吃上价格实惠、营养丰富的一餐。
collocations: a bowl of porridge｜一碗燕麦粥 ; porridge oats｜煮粥用燕麦片 ; make porridge｜煮燕麦粥
tip_ja: 通常为不可数名词；一碗用a bowl of。

meanings_ja: v. 冲浪 | v. 浏览互联网 | n. 拍岸浪花

example1_ja: 我们在海滨度假时，我的表亲学会了冲浪。
example2_en: Students who surf the internet for research need skills to distinguish reliable sources from misleading information.
example2_ja: 上网查找研究资料的学生需要具备辨别可靠来源与误导性信息的能力。
collocations: learn to surf｜学习冲浪 ; surf the internet｜浏览互联网 ; surf the waves｜踏浪冲浪
tip_ja: surf the internet指上网浏览，不一定有明确搜索目标。

meanings_ja: adv. 大约；粗略地 | adv. 粗暴地；粗糙地

example1_ja: 步行到湖边大约需要二十分钟。

example2_ja: 受访居民中约有一半支持将旧停车场改为公共花园。
collocations: roughly equal｜大致相等 ; roughly speaking｜大体而言 ; treat roughly｜粗暴对待

meanings_ja: n. 聚会；联欢会

example1_ja: 今晚我们要在公寓里办个小聚会。
example2_en: A regular neighbourhood get-together can strengthen social ties and help new residents feel more welcome.
example2_ja: 定期举办邻里聚会能加强社会联系，让新住户更有归属感。
collocations: family get-together｜家庭聚会 ; informal get-together｜非正式聚会 ; organise a get-together｜组织聚会
tip_ja: 名词带连字符；动词短语get together不带。

meanings_ja: n. 磁盘；计算机存储盘 | n. 圆盘；盘状物
definition_en: a device that stores computer data on a circular surface | a flat, thin, round object

example1_ja: 我的笔记本电脑磁盘里几乎存满了度假照片。

example2_ja: 定期备份可保护重要研究数据，避免其因误删或大学计算机系统的突发磁盘故障而丢失。
collocations: hard disk｜硬盘 ; disk space｜磁盘空间 ; disk drive｜磁盘驱动器 ; disk failure｜磁盘故障
tip_ja: 计算机磁盘用disk；英式圆盘、光盘通常写disc。

meanings_ja: n. 托盘；浅盘

example2_en: Replacing disposable food trays with reusable alternatives can significantly reduce waste in school cafeterias.
example2_ja: 用可重复使用的餐盘替代一次性餐盘，可以显著减少学校食堂的垃圾。

meanings_ja: n. 蚊子

example1_ja: 晚饭时，一只蚊子落在了我的胳膊上。
example2_en: Warmer temperatures may allow mosquito populations to spread into regions where they were previously uncommon.
example2_ja: 气温升高可能使蚊子种群扩散到以前蚊子不常见的地区。

meanings_ja: adv. 其次；第二

collocations: firstly and secondly｜首先和其次 ; secondly, consider｜其次，考虑

meanings_ja: n. 边；边缘 | n. 优势 | v. 缓慢移动

example1_ja: 别把你的玻璃杯放在桌子边缘。
example2_en: Practical experience can give graduates an edge over other candidates in a competitive job market.
example2_ja: 在竞争激烈的就业市场中，实践经验能让毕业生比其他求职者更有优势。

meanings_ja: n. 运输；交通运输系统

example2_en: Reliable public transportation can reduce traffic congestion and make employment opportunities more accessible to people without cars.
example2_ja: 可靠的公共交通能够缓解交通拥堵，让没有汽车的人更容易获得就业机会。
collocations: public transportation｜公共交通 ; transportation costs｜运输费用 ; transportation network｜交通运输网络 ; transportation of goods｜货物运输
tip_ja: 美式常用transportation，英式通常用transport。

meanings_ja: prep. 经由；途经 | prep. 通过；借助
definition_en: travelling through a particular place on the way somewhere | using a particular method, system, or person

example1_ja: 我们途经一个山间小村庄，前往海岸。
example2_en: Providing medical advice via video calls can improve access to healthcare for people in remote communities.
example2_ja: 通过视频通话提供医疗建议，可以让偏远社区的居民更容易获得医疗服务。
collocations: travel via｜途经 ; via email｜通过电子邮件 ; via satellite｜通过卫星
tip_ja: via后直接接地点或方式，如via email。

meanings_ja: n. 改善；进步 | n. 改进之处
definition_en: The process or result of becoming better. | A change that makes something better.
example1_en: Your latest drawing shows a real improvement in shading.
example1_ja: 你最近这幅画的明暗处理确实有进步。
example2_en: Investment in public transport can bring significant improvements in air quality and reduce travel times for urban residents.
example2_ja: 投资公共交通能显著改善空气质量，并缩短城市居民的出行时间。

meanings_ja: v. 给…下定义；解释含义 | v. 明确规定；界定 | v. 构成…的特征
definition_en: To state exactly what a word or idea means. | To establish the limits, duties, or nature of something clearly. | To be the quality that makes someone or something distinctive.

example2_ja: 政府在推行影响企业和当地社区的政策前，应明确界定其环境目标。

meanings_ja: n. 铁轨；铁路运输 | n. 栏杆；扶手；横杆 | v. 愤怒抱怨；严厉指责

example1_ja: 我们乘火车穿过了白雪覆盖的群山。
example2_en: Investment in rail infrastructure can reduce road congestion and provide a cleaner alternative to domestic flights.
example2_ja: 投资铁路基础设施可以缓解道路拥堵，并提供比国内航班更环保的出行选择。

meanings_ja: n. 笨蛋；蠢人（骂人话）

example2_en: Calling a classmate an idiot can damage their confidence and undermine efforts to create a supportive learning environment.

meanings_ja: n. 勇气；胆量

meanings_ja: n. 奖励；回报；酬金 | v. 奖励；酬谢

example1_ja: 大家都不在家时，一名窃贼爬窗而入。
example2_en: Improved street lighting and secure doors may discourage burglars from targeting homes in residential areas.
example2_ja: 改善街道照明并安装牢固的门，可能使窃贼不敢对住宅区的房屋下手。

meanings_ja: n. 寄件人；发送者
definition_en: A person who sends a message, letter or package.
example1_en: The sender wrapped the parcel carefully before posting it.
example1_ja: 寄件人在邮寄前仔细包好了包裹。
example2_en: Email users should verify the sender before opening attachments to reduce the risk of digital fraud.
example2_ja: 电子邮件用户应在打开附件前核实发件人，以降低网络诈骗的风险。

tip_ja: sender是发送者，recipient是接收者。

meanings_ja: n. 庄稼；农作物 | n. 一季的收成 | v. 裁剪；剪短
definition_en: a plant grown in large quantities for food or other uses | the amount of a plant harvested at one time | to remove outer parts of an image or cut hair short
example1_en: The farmer checked his wheat crop after the storm.
example1_ja: 暴风雨过后，农民查看了自己的小麦。
example2_en: Rising temperatures may reduce crop yields, threatening food security in regions that already experience water shortages.
example2_ja: 气温上升可能导致农作物减产，威胁本就缺水地区的粮食安全。

meanings_ja: v. 使钦佩；留下深刻印象 | v. 使铭记；使意识到重要性
definition_en: to make someone admire or respect someone or something | to make someone understand how important something is
example1_en: Her homemade bread impressed everyone at the family dinner.
example1_ja: 她自制的面包让家宴上的每个人都赞不绝口。
example2_en: Applicants can impress potential employers by explaining how their practical experience matches the requirements of the role.
example2_ja: 求职者可以说明自己的实践经验如何符合岗位要求，从而给潜在雇主留下好印象。
collocations: impress someone with｜以……给某人留下好印象 ; be impressed by｜对……印象深刻 ; impress upon someone｜使某人牢记
tip_ja: impressed形容人的感受；impressive形容事物令人赞叹。

meanings_ja: v. 去取来；去接来 | v. 售得；卖得
definition_en: To go somewhere and bring someone or something back. | To be sold for a particular amount of money.
example1_en: Could you fetch my jacket from the bedroom?
example1_ja: 你能去卧室把我的夹克拿来吗？
example2_en: Homes near reliable public transport often fetch higher prices because buyers value convenient access to employment.
example2_ja: 公共交通便利可靠的地段，住宅往往售价更高，因为买家重视通勤的便利性。
collocations: fetch some water｜去取些水 ; fetch someone from school｜去学校接某人 ; fetch a high price｜卖个高价
tip_ja: fetch强调去后取回；bring只强调带来。

meanings_ja: n. 徽章；身份标识
definition_en: A small item worn to show identity, membership, or achievement.
example1_en: She pinned her new badge onto her jacket.
example1_ja: 她把新徽章别在了夹克上。
example2_en: Requiring visitors to wear a visible badge can improve security in schools and other public buildings.

tip_ja: 通常指佩戴的小徽章；奖牌一般用medal。

meanings_ja: v. 结冰；冷冻 | v. 冻结；暂停 | v. 突然僵住
definition_en: To become ice or make something extremely cold and solid. | To stop something changing or being used temporarily. | To stop moving suddenly because of fear or surprise.
example1_en: Freeze the leftover soup and eat it next week.
example1_ja: 把剩下的汤冷冻起来，下周再喝。
example2_en: Governments may freeze public transport fares to reduce financial pressure on households during economic downturns.

collocations: freeze food｜冷冻食物 ; freeze wages｜冻结工资 ; freeze with fear｜吓得僵住
tip_ja: 过去式froze，过去分词frozen。

meanings_ja: n. 海关 | n. 关税 | n. 风俗；习俗
definition_en: The authority or place checking goods entering a country | Taxes charged on goods brought into a country | Traditional practices shared by a community or social group
example1_en: We opened our suitcases for inspection at customs.
example1_ja: 我们在海关打开行李箱接受检查。
example2_en: More efficient customs procedures can reduce delays at borders and support international trade without weakening security.
example2_ja: 更高效的海关程序可以减少边境延误，在不削弱安全保障的情况下促进国际贸易。
collocations: go through customs｜过海关 ; customs officer｜海关官员 ; customs duty｜关税 ; local customs｜当地习俗
tip_ja: 表示海关时保留词尾s；custom单数不表示海关。

meanings_ja: n. 药店；药房 | n. 药剂学
definition_en: A shop or hospital department that prepares and supplies medicines. | The study and practice of preparing and supplying medicines.
example1_en: I collected my medicine from the pharmacy after lunch.
example1_ja: 午饭后，我去药店取了药。
example2_en: A community pharmacy can improve access to healthcare by offering professional advice close to people's homes.
example2_ja: 社区药店能在居民家附近提供专业建议，使医疗保健服务更易获得。
collocations: community pharmacy｜社区药店 ; hospital pharmacy｜医院药房 ; study pharmacy｜学习药剂学
tip_ja: 药店可数，药剂学不可数；药剂师是pharmacist。

meanings_ja: n. 男校长
definition_en: A man who is in charge of a school.
example1_en: The headmaster welcomed new pupils at the school gate.
example1_ja: 男校长在校门口迎接新生。
example2_en: The headmaster introduced a mentoring programme to help younger pupils develop confidence and settle into school life.
example2_ja: 男校长推行了一项辅导计划，帮助低年级学生建立信心并适应学校生活。

meanings_ja: adj. 体贴的；关心他人的 | n. 照护工作
definition_en: kind and concerned about other people's needs | the work of looking after people who need help
example1_en: Our caring neighbour brought soup when I was ill.
example1_ja: 我生病时，体贴的邻居送来了汤。
example2_en: A caring school environment can improve children's confidence and encourage them to seek help when needed.

collocations: a caring attitude｜关怀的态度 ; a caring profession｜照护类职业 ; a caring environment｜充满关怀的环境
tip_ja: caring指关心别人；careful指做事小心。

meanings_ja: n. 乘法 | n. 大量增加；繁殖
definition_en: Finding a total by adding equal groups together. | An increase in quantity, often through repeated reproduction.
example1_en: We practised multiplication by arranging buttons in equal rows.
example1_ja: 我们把纽扣排成等长的几行来练习乘法。
example2_en: A strong understanding of multiplication helps children develop the mathematical skills needed for science and financial literacy.

tip_ja: 乘法用multiplication；乘以可用multiplied by。

meanings_ja: v. 不喜欢；厌恶 | n. 反感；不喜欢
definition_en: To find someone or something unpleasant or not enjoyable. | A feeling of not liking someone or something.
example1_en: I dislike waiting outside when it is raining.
example1_ja: 我不喜欢下雨时在外面等候。
example2_en: Some students dislike group assignments because they feel that individual contributions are not assessed fairly.
example2_ja: 一些学生不喜欢小组作业，因为他们觉得个人贡献没有得到公平评价。

meanings_ja: n. 讲座；大学课堂讲授 | v. 讲课；作讲座 | v. 训斥；说教
definition_en: an educational talk given to an audience, especially university students | to give an educational talk to an audience | to criticize someone at length about their behaviour
example1_en: I stayed after the lecture to ask a question.
example1_ja: 讲座结束后，我留下来问了一个问题。
example2_en: Universities should combine traditional lectures with practical activities that encourage students to apply their knowledge.
example2_ja: 大学应将传统授课与鼓励学生运用知识的实践活动结合起来。

meanings_ja: n. 馅；夹心 | n. 补牙填料 | adj. 容易使人吃饱的
definition_en: Food placed inside a pie, sandwich, or similar item. | Material used to repair a hole in a tooth. | Making you feel full after eating.

meanings_ja: v. 钦佩；敬佩 | v. 欣赏；赞赏
definition_en: To respect someone for their qualities or achievements | To look at something with pleasure because it is attractive
example1_en: I admire my sister for staying calm under pressure.

meanings_ja: n. 状况；状态 | n. 条件；环境 | n. 疾病；健康问题

collocations: in good condition｜状况良好 ; working conditions｜工作条件 ; on condition that｜条件是 ; medical condition｜疾病；健康问题

meanings_ja: adj. 分开的；各自的 | v. 分开；分离
definition_en: not joined, shared, or considered together | to divide things or move them apart

meanings_ja: adj. 纯的；无杂质的 | adj. 纯粹的；完全的 | adj. 纯理论的

meanings_ja: adj. 果实成熟的 | adj. 时机成熟的；适宜的

example2_en: Schools should consider peanut allergies when planning meals to ensure that all children can eat safely.

definition_en: relaxed and not easily upset or worried
example1_en: Our easy-going neighbour never complains when our dog barks.
example1_ja: 我们随和的邻居从不因我们的狗叫而抱怨。
example2_en: Although an easy-going management style can reduce workplace stress, clear expectations remain essential for maintaining productivity.
example2_ja: 虽然随和的管理风格能减轻职场压力，但明确的要求对保持生产力仍然至关重要。
collocations: an easy-going personality｜随和的性格 ; an easy-going attitude｜随和的态度 ; an easy-going manner｜随和的举止
tip_ja: 形容性格随和、不易生气，不表示懒惰。

meanings_ja: adj. 沉默的；不说话的 | adj. 无声的；寂静的 | adj. 不发音的
definition_en: Not speaking or choosing not to speak. | Making no sound or containing no noise. | Written in a word but not pronounced.
example1_en: He remained silent while his sister explained the problem.
example1_ja: 妹妹解释问题时，他一直没有说话。
example2_en: Employees may remain silent about workplace problems if they fear losing their jobs.
example2_ja: 如果员工担心失去工作，就可能对职场问题保持沉默。
collocations: remain silent｜保持沉默 ; fall silent｜安静下来 ; silent film｜无声电影 ; silent letter｜不发音的字母
tip_ja: silent强调不出声；quiet也可表示声音很小。

meanings_ja: adj. 巨大的；极大的
definition_en: extremely large in size, amount, or degree
example1_en: An enormous pumpkin filled the basket on our kitchen table.
example1_ja: 一个巨大的南瓜占满了厨房桌上的篮子。
example2_en: Rapid urban growth places enormous pressure on housing, transport networks, and other essential public services.
example2_ja: 城市的快速发展给住房、交通网络及其他基本公共服务带来巨大压力。
collocations: enormous pressure｜巨大压力 ; an enormous amount of｜大量的 ; enormous potential｜巨大潜力
tip_ja: 既可形容体积，也可形容压力、数量或影响很大。

meanings_ja: n. 安排；筹备 | n. 排列；布置 | n. 商定；协议
definition_en: A plan or preparation for something that will happen. | The way objects are positioned or organised. | An agreement about how something will be done.
example1_en: We made arrangements for someone to feed the cat.
example1_ja: 我们安排了人来喂猫。
example2_en: Flexible working arrangements can help parents balance professional responsibilities with the demands of family life.
example2_ja: 灵活的工作安排可以帮助父母兼顾工作职责与家庭生活的需要。
collocations: make arrangements｜作出安排 ; travel arrangements｜旅行安排 ; flower arrangement｜插花 ; come to an arrangement｜达成协议
tip_ja: 表示具体筹备常用复数：make arrangements for。

meanings_ja: n. 方法；技巧；手法 | n. 技艺；技术水平
definition_en: A particular way of doing something, often requiring skill. | The skill someone shows when performing a particular activity.
example1_en: The coach showed me a better technique for swimming.
example1_ja: 教练向我示范了一种更好的游泳技巧。
example2_en: Teachers can use a range of assessment techniques to identify learning difficulties before students fall behind.
example2_ja: 教师可以运用多种评估方法，在学生落后之前发现他们的学习困难。
collocations: a technique for doing something｜做某事的方法 ; relaxation techniques｜放松技巧 ; improve your technique｜提高技艺 ; teaching techniques｜教学方法
tip_ja: technique重在具体方法；technology指科技。

meanings_ja: v. 放置；铺设 | v. 产卵；下蛋 | adj. 非专业的；非神职的
definition_en: to put something down carefully or arrange it flat | to produce eggs from the body | not professionally trained in a subject or ordained in religion
example1_en: Please lay the clean towels on the bathroom shelf.
example1_ja: 请把干净毛巾放在浴室架子上。
example2_en: Investment in early childhood education can lay the foundations for a more skilled and adaptable workforce.
example2_ja: 投资幼儿教育可以为培养技能更强、适应力更高的劳动力奠定基础。
collocations: lay the foundations｜奠定基础 ; lay eggs｜产卵 ; lay the table｜摆好餐具 ; lay cables｜铺设电缆
tip_ja: 放置用lay–laid–laid；躺下用lie–lay–lain。

meanings_ja: n. 赞美；称赞 | v. 称赞；赞美
definition_en: A remark expressing admiration or approval. | To tell someone that you admire something about them.
example1_en: Her compliment about my cooking made me smile.
example1_ja: 她对我厨艺的称赞让我笑了。
example2_en: Teachers who compliment students on specific improvements can strengthen motivation and encourage continued effort.
example2_ja: 教师若针对学生的具体进步给予表扬，就能增强学习动力，鼓励他们继续努力。
collocations: pay someone a compliment｜称赞某人 ; compliment someone on something｜称赞某人的某方面 ; accept a compliment｜接受赞美 ; a sincere compliment｜真诚的赞美
tip_ja: compliment是赞美；complement是补充、相辅相成。

meanings_ja: n. 退款；退还的金额 | v. 退还款项
definition_en: Money returned after a purchase or an overpayment. | To return money paid for something.
example1_en: The shop gave me a refund for the broken kettle.
example1_ja: 商店把坏水壶的货款退给了我。
example2_en: Airlines should offer passengers a full refund when flights are cancelled without reasonable alternatives.
example2_ja: 航班取消且没有合理的替代方案时，航空公司应向乘客提供全额退款。
collocations: a full refund｜全额退款 ; request a refund｜申请退款 ; refund the cost｜退还费用
tip_ja: 名词重音在前；动词读/rɪˈfʌnd/，重音在后。

meanings_ja: n. 体操
definition_en: A sport involving controlled movements that develop strength, balance, and flexibility.
example1_en: My sister practises gymnastics at the local sports centre.
example1_ja: 我姐姐在当地体育中心练体操。
example2_en: Including gymnastics in school programmes can help children develop coordination, physical confidence, and an interest in exercise.
example2_ja: 将体操纳入学校课程有助于儿童提高协调性、增强身体自信，并培养运动兴趣。
collocations: do gymnastics｜做体操 ; artistic gymnastics｜竞技体操 ; rhythmic gymnastics｜艺术体操
tip_ja: 虽以-s结尾，表示运动时作单数：gymnastics is。

meanings_ja: n. 权力；影响力 | n. 动力；电力 | v. 为…提供动力
definition_en: The ability or authority to control people, events, or decisions. | Energy used to make machines and equipment work. | To supply energy that makes something work.
example1_en: The manager has the power to change our shifts.
example1_ja: 经理有权调整我们的班次。
example2_en: Solar panels can power rural schools while reducing their dependence on expensive and unreliable fuel supplies.
example2_ja: 太阳能板可以为乡村学校供电，同时减少其对昂贵且不稳定的燃料供应的依赖。
collocations: political power｜政治权力 ; renewable power｜可再生能源电力 ; power supply｜电源；电力供应 ; the power to decide｜决定权
tip_ja: 表示有权做某事用have the power to do。

meanings_ja: n. 播客；播客节目 | v. 制作并发布播客
definition_en: An online audio programme available to stream or download. | To produce and distribute an online audio programme.
example1_en: I listen to a cooking podcast while making dinner.
example1_ja: 我做晚饭时会听一档烹饪播客。
example2_en: Educational podcasts allow learners to explore complex subjects while travelling or completing routine household tasks.
example2_ja: 教育类播客让学习者能够在出行或做日常家务时探索复杂的主题。
collocations: listen to a podcast｜收听播客 ; podcast episode｜一期播客 ; host a podcast｜主持播客节目 ; subscribe to a podcast｜订阅播客
tip_ja: 收听播客用listen to a podcast，别漏掉to。

meanings_ja: adv. 大量地；很大程度上 | adv. 沉重地；猛烈地
definition_en: To a great degree or in large amounts. | With great weight, force, or effort.
example1_en: It rained heavily while we waited for the bus.
example1_ja: 我们等公交车时，雨下得很大。
example2_en: Countries that rely heavily on imported fuel are particularly vulnerable to sudden changes in global energy prices.
example2_ja: 严重依赖进口燃料的国家尤其容易受到全球能源价格突变的影响。
collocations: rain heavily｜下大雨 ; rely heavily on｜严重依赖 ; invest heavily in｜大量投资于 ; breathe heavily｜喘粗气
tip_ja: 表示下大雨用rain heavily，不用rain strongly。

meanings_ja: n. 储液罐；水箱 | n. 坦克
definition_en: A large container for holding liquids or gases. | A heavily protected military vehicle that moves on tracks.
example1_en: The fish swam behind a rock in the tank.
example1_ja: 鱼游到了水族箱里的一块石头后面。
example2_en: Installing a rainwater tank allows households to water gardens without relying entirely on treated drinking water.
example2_ja: 安装雨水储水箱能让家庭浇灌花园时不必完全依赖经过处理的饮用水。
collocations: a water tank｜水箱 ; a fuel tank｜燃油箱 ; a fish tank｜水族箱 ; fill the tank｜加满油箱
tip_ja: fish tank是水族箱；汽车的油箱用fuel tank。

meanings_ja: v. 误解；误会
definition_en: to understand someone's words, actions, or intentions incorrectly
example1_en: Please don't misunderstand me; I really want to help.
example1_ja: 请别误会我，我真的想帮忙。
example2_en: Patients may misunderstand medical advice when professionals use technical language rather than clear explanations suited to their audience.
example2_ja: 如果医务人员使用专业术语，而不是适合患者理解的清晰解释，患者可能会误解医嘱。
collocations: misunderstand instructions｜误解指示 ; misunderstand someone's intentions｜误会某人的意图 ; easily misunderstood｜容易被误解
tip_ja: 过去式和过去分词均为misunderstood。

meanings_ja: adj. 基础的；初级的 | adj. 小学的
definition_en: Related to the simplest or first stages of learning. | Relating to the first years of formal school education.
example1_en: This course teaches elementary cooking skills to complete beginners.
example1_ja: 这门课程向零基础学员教授基本烹饪技巧。
example2_en: Elementary education should develop children's curiosity as well as their ability to read and calculate.
example2_ja: 小学教育不仅应培养儿童的阅读和计算能力，还应激发他们的好奇心。
collocations: elementary knowledge｜基础知识 ; elementary school｜小学 ; elementary education｜小学教育 ; elementary level｜初级水平
tip_ja: elementary school主要用于美式英语，英式常用primary school。

meanings_ja: adj. 西部的；西方的 | adj. 西方国家及文化的 | n. 西部电影；西部小说
definition_en: In, from, or relating to the west of an area. | Relating to Europe, North America, and their associated cultures. | A film or story about the historical American West.
example1_en: Our cabin faces the lake on its western shore.
example1_ja: 我们的小屋位于湖的西岸，面朝湖水。
example2_en: Investment in western regions could improve transport links and reduce economic inequalities within the country.
example2_ja: 对西部地区的投资可以改善交通联系，减少国内经济差距。
collocations: the western coast｜西海岸 ; western regions｜西部地区 ; Western culture｜西方文化 ; a western film｜西部电影
tip_ja: 指西方国家或文化时常大写为 Western。

meanings_ja: n. 区域；地带 | v. 划定用途区域
definition_en: An area with a particular purpose, feature, or condition. | Officially assign land to a particular use.
example1_en: Cars are not allowed inside this quiet pedestrian zone.
example1_ja: 汽车不得驶入这片安静的步行区。
example2_en: Creating a low-emission zone can reduce air pollution, provided that affordable public transport is available.
example2_ja: 只要有价格合理的公共交通，设立低排放区就能减少空气污染。
collocations: a pedestrian zone｜步行区 ; a time zone｜时区 ; a residential zone｜住宅区 ; zone land for housing｜将土地划为住宅用地
tip_ja: zone强调特定用途或特征的区域；area含义更宽泛。

meanings_ja: n. 铁；铁元素 | n. 熨斗 | v. 熨烫
definition_en: A strong metal used in construction and needed by the body. | A tool with a heated base for smoothing clothes. | To make clothes smooth using a heated iron.
example1_en: These old iron gates are too heavy to lift.
example1_ja: 这些旧铁门太重，抬不起来。
example2_en: A diet containing sufficient iron can help prevent anaemia, particularly among children and pregnant women.
example2_ja: 摄入足量铁的饮食有助于预防贫血，对儿童和孕妇尤其重要。
collocations: iron deficiency｜缺铁 ; iron ore｜铁矿石 ; cast iron｜铸铁 ; iron a shirt｜熨衬衫
tip_ja: 铁是不可数名词；熨斗可数，用an iron。

meanings_ja: n. 移动；动作 | n. 社会运动 | n. 乐章
definition_en: an act of changing position or moving the body | an organised effort by people seeking shared social change | one main section of a long piece of music
example1_en: A sudden movement in the bushes caught my attention.
example1_ja: 灌木丛里突然有动静，引起了我的注意。
example2_en: The environmental movement has encouraged governments to adopt stronger policies on waste reduction and renewable energy.
example2_ja: 环保运动推动各国政府在减少废物和发展可再生能源方面采取更有力的政策。
collocations: freedom of movement｜行动自由 ; sudden movement｜突然的动作 ; environmental movement｜环保运动 ; social movement｜社会运动

meanings_ja: adj. 混合的；各类的 | adj. 好坏参半的；矛盾的
definition_en: containing different types of things or people | including both positive and negative feelings, opinions, or results
example1_en: I bought a bag of mixed nuts for our picnic.
example1_ja: 我买了一袋混合坚果，准备野餐时吃。
example2_en: The introduction of online lessons received mixed reactions from students, parents, and teachers.
example2_ja: 学生、家长和教师对引入网课的反应褒贬不一。
collocations: mixed feelings｜矛盾的心情 ; mixed results｜好坏参半的结果 ; mixed reactions｜褒贬不一的反应 ; mixed nuts｜混合坚果
tip_ja: mixed feelings指心情矛盾；mixed也是mix的过去分词。

meanings_ja: n. 品脱（容量单位）

example1_ja: 请往碗里加入一品脱牛奶。

example2_ja: 比较不同国家食谱的消费者应注意，英制品脱比美制品脱大。
collocations: a pint of milk｜一品脱牛奶 ; half a pint｜半品脱 ; a pint glass｜品脱杯
tip_ja: 英制品脱约568毫升，美制液量品脱约473毫升。

meanings_ja: adv. 相隔；分开 | adv. 成碎片；散开 | adv. 除外
definition_en: separated by distance or time; not together | into separate pieces | except for something being considered
example1_en: We planted the young trees two metres apart.
example1_ja: 我们把这些小树间隔两米种下。
example2_en: Living apart from their families can make international students more independent, but may also cause loneliness.
example2_ja: 与家人分开生活可以让留学生更加独立，但也可能带来孤独感。
collocations: far apart｜相距很远 ; take apart｜拆开 ; apart from｜除……之外 ; tell apart｜区分

meanings_ja: n. 专家；行家 | adj. 专业的；熟练的
definition_en: Someone with extensive knowledge or skill in a particular subject. | Having or showing great knowledge or skill.
example1_en: We asked an expert to examine the old painting.
example1_ja: 我们请了一位专家来鉴定这幅旧画。
example2_en: Schools should seek expert advice before introducing new technology into classrooms to support student learning.
example2_ja: 学校在将新技术引入课堂以辅助学生学习之前，应征求专家意见。
collocations: an expert on｜某方面的专家 ; expert advice｜专家建议 ; medical expert｜医学专家
tip_ja: expert on/in表示某领域的专家。

meanings_ja: adj. 相似的；相像的 | adv. 同样地；两者都
definition_en: similar in appearance or character | in the same way, or equally for both groups

example1_ja: 这两件夹克看起来很像，但有一件穿着更暖和。
example2_en: Public parks benefit children and adults alike by providing accessible spaces for exercise and relaxation.
example2_ja: 公共公园提供方便使用的运动和休闲空间，让儿童和成人同样受益。
collocations: look alike｜看起来相像 ; think alike｜想法相同 ; treat everyone alike｜一视同仁
tip_ja: 形容词通常放在系动词后，不放在名词前。

meanings_ja: n. 庆祝活动；庆典 | n. 庆祝
definition_en: A special event held to mark a happy occasion. | The act of showing happiness about something special.
example1_en: We decorated the garden for our grandparents' anniversary celebration.
example1_ja: 我们为祖父母的结婚周年庆祝活动布置了花园。
example2_en: Community celebrations can strengthen social bonds by bringing together residents from different cultural backgrounds.
example2_ja: 社区庆祝活动能让不同文化背景的居民相聚，从而加强社会联系。
collocations: hold a celebration｜举办庆祝活动 ; in celebration of｜为庆祝…… ; birthday celebration｜生日庆祝活动

meanings_ja: n. 三角形 | n. 三角铁

example1_en: Fold the paper into a triangle before cutting it.
example1_ja: 先把纸折成三角形，再剪。
example2_en: Engineers often use triangles in bridge designs because these shapes provide strength without requiring excessive material.
example2_ja: 工程师常在桥梁设计中采用三角形，因为这种形状无需耗用过多材料就能提供强度。
collocations: right-angled triangle｜直角三角形 ; equilateral triangle｜等边三角形 ; love triangle｜三角恋
tip_ja: 英式说right-angled triangle，美式常说right triangle。

meanings_ja: n. 醋

example1_ja: 往沙拉酱里加一点醋。
example2_en: Traditional food preservation methods often use vinegar to slow bacterial growth and extend the storage life of vegetables.
example2_ja: 传统食品保存方法常用醋来减缓细菌生长，延长蔬菜的储存时间。
collocations: rice vinegar｜米醋 ; wine vinegar｜葡萄酒醋 ; a splash of vinegar｜少量醋 ; pickled in vinegar｜用醋腌制的

meanings_ja: n. 图表 | v. 记录；跟踪；绘制图表 | n. 海图；航图
definition_en: a visual display of information, often showing comparisons or changes | to record or show how something develops over time | a detailed map used for navigation at sea or in air
example1_en: This colourful chart shows how we spend our money.
example1_ja: 这张彩色图表展示了我们把钱花在了哪些方面。
example2_en: The chart compares the proportion of commuters using public transport in three different cities.
example2_ja: 该图表比较了三个不同城市中使用公共交通的通勤者比例。
collocations: bar chart｜条形图 ; pie chart｜饼图 ; chart progress｜记录进展 ; navigation chart｜航海图
tip_ja: 图表用chart；普通地图用map，海图可用chart。

meanings_ja: adj. 寒冷的；有寒意的 | adj. 冷淡的；不友好的

example1_ja: 外面有些冷，所以我拿上了夹克。
example2_en: Providing warm public spaces during chilly weather can help protect older residents from cold-related illnesses.
example2_ja: 在寒冷天气提供温暖的公共场所，有助于保护老年居民免受寒冷引发的疾病侵害。
collocations: a chilly morning｜寒冷的早晨 ; feel chilly｜觉得冷 ; a chilly reception｜冷淡的接待
tip_ja: chilly比freezing程度轻，也可形容态度冷淡。

meanings_ja: n. 天赋；才能 | n. 人才；有才能的人
definition_en: A natural ability to do something well. | People who have strong abilities in a particular field.
example1_en: My cousin has a real talent for drawing animals.
example1_ja: 我的表亲画动物很有天赋。
example2_en: Schools should nurture creative talent alongside academic skills to help students develop a wider range of abilities.
example2_ja: 学校应在培养学业技能的同时培育创造性才能，帮助学生发展更广泛的能力。
collocations: a talent for｜在某方面的天赋 ; natural talent｜天生的才能 ; nurture talent｜培养人才 ; attract talent｜吸引人才
tip_ja: 表示某方面的天赋，用a talent for加名词或动名词。

meanings_ja: v. 弹起；使弹跳 | n. 弹跳；反弹 | v. 支票遭退票

example1_en: The ball bounced over the fence into our neighbour's garden.
example1_ja: 球弹过篱笆，落进了邻居的花园。
example2_en: Local businesses can bounce back after economic shocks if they receive timely financial support.
example2_ja: 如果及时获得资金支持，当地企业就能在经济冲击后恢复元气。
collocations: bounce a ball｜拍球 ; bounce back｜恢复元气 ; a cheque bounces｜支票遭退票 ; bounce ideas off someone｜与某人交流想法
tip_ja: bounce back既可指弹回，也常指受挫后恢复。

meanings_ja: n. 放松；休息 | n. 肌肉松弛 | n. 规定的放宽
