example1_ja: 庭で、緑色のバッタが私の袖にとまった。
example2_en: Grasshoppers provide food for many birds and play an important role in maintaining healthy grassland ecosystems.
example2_ja: バッタは多くの鳥の餌になり、健全な草原の生態系を保つうえで重要な役割を果たしている。
collocations: a green grasshopper｜緑色のバッタ ; a grasshopper leaps｜バッタが跳ねる ; grasshopper species｜バッタの種類
tip_ja: locust は、群れを成して移動する一部のバッタ（飛蝗）を指す。
forms: 複数形: grasshoppers

meanings_ja: v. 期限が切れる、失効する
definition_en: to reach the end of the time during which something is valid
example1_en: My passport expires next month, so I must renew it.
example1_ja: パスポートが来月切れるので、更新しなければならない。
example2_en: When temporary work permits expire, employees may face uncertainty about their future employment and residence.
example2_ja: 一時的な就労許可が切れると、従業員は今後の雇用や居住について不安を抱えることになりかねない。
collocations: a passport expires｜パスポートの期限が切れる ; a contract expires｜契約が満了する ; expire at midnight｜深夜に期限が切れる
tip_ja: 自動詞なので、契約が切れるは is expired でなく expires を使う。
forms: 三人称単数現在: expires | 過去形: expired | 現在分詞: expiring

meanings_ja: n. 型、鋳型 | v. 形づくる、形成する | n. カビ
definition_en: a hollow container that gives a shape to a liquid as it sets | to shape a soft material, or to strongly influence how someone develops | a soft fungus that grows on damp or old food and surfaces
example1_en: Pour the melted chocolate into the mold carefully.
example1_ja: 溶かしたチョコレートを型に慎重に流し込んでください。
example2_en: Early experiences can mold children's attitudes towards education and influence their confidence throughout their school years.
example2_ja: 幼少期の経験は、子どもの教育に対する姿勢を形づくり、在学中の自信にも影響しうる。
collocations: silicone mold｜シリコン型 ; mold into shape｜形に整える ; mold growth｜カビの発生 ; break the mold｜従来の型を破る
tip_ja: 米式は mold、英式は mould。「カビ」の意味も同じ語で表す。
forms: 複数形: molds | 三人称単数現在: molds | 過去形: molded | 現在分詞: molding

meanings_ja: n. 湾 | n. 大きな隔たり、深い溝
definition_en: a large area of sea partly surrounded by land | a big difference in ideas, wealth or understanding between groups
example1_en: Fishing boats crossed the gulf as the sun rose.
example1_ja: 日が昇ると、漁船は湾を横切っていった。
example2_en: Unequal access to digital technology can widen the gulf between wealthy communities and poorer ones.
example2_ja: デジタル技術へのアクセスの不平等は、豊かな地域とそうでない地域との溝を広げかねない。
collocations: a wide gulf｜大きな隔たり ; bridge the gulf｜溝を埋める ; the gulf between rich and poor｜貧富の格差
tip_ja: 海の「湾」のほか、gulf between ～ で「～間の大きな溝」を表す。
forms: 複数形: gulfs

meanings_ja: adj. 永遠の、永久の | adj. 果てしない、絶え間ない
definition_en: lasting forever, without beginning or end | seeming never to stop, often in an annoying way
example1_en: The couple promised eternal love beneath the flowering tree.
example1_ja: 二人は花咲く木の下で永遠の愛を誓った。
example2_en: Many ancient cultures used monumental architecture to express hopes for eternal life and preserve collective memories.
example2_ja: 多くの古代文化は、永遠の命への願いを表し集団の記憶を残すため、記念碑的な建築を用いた。
collocations: eternal life｜永遠の命 ; eternal love｜永遠の愛 ; eternal optimism｜変わらぬ楽観主義
tip_ja: eternal は終わりがないこと。eternal complaints のように、大げさに「絶えない」意味でも使う。

meanings_ja: adj. 別個の、異なる | adj. はっきりした、明確な
definition_en: clearly different or separate from something else of the same kind | easy to see, hear or notice; clear and definite
example1_en: The twins have similar faces but distinct personalities.
example1_ja: その双子は顔は似ているが、性格ははっきり違う。
example2_en: Public transport and private cars serve distinct needs, so urban planners should consider both.
example2_ja: 公共交通機関と自家用車はそれぞれ別のニーズに応えているので、都市計画者は両方を考慮すべきだ。
collocations: distinct from｜〜とは異なる ; two distinct groups｜2つの異なるグループ ; distinct advantage｜明らかな利点
tip_ja: distinct from は「〜とは別の」。distant（遠い）と取り違えないこと。

meanings_ja: v. 推測する、憶測する | v. 投機する、相場に手を出す
definition_en: to form guesses about something without having enough facts | to buy and sell shares or property hoping to profit from price changes
example1_en: We can only speculate about what caused the delay.
example1_ja: 遅れの原因については推測するしかない。
example2_en: Researchers speculate that changing work patterns could reduce traffic congestion in major urban centres.
example2_ja: 研究者らは、働き方の変化が大都市の交通渋滞を減らす可能性があると推測している。
collocations: speculate about the cause｜原因について推測する ; speculate that｜〜だと推測する ; speculate in property｜不動産に投機する
tip_ja: 「推測」は about か that 節、「投機」は in を伴うのが基本。
forms: 三人称単数現在: speculates | 過去形: speculated | 過去分詞: speculated | 現在分詞: speculating

meanings_ja: n. 存在、実在 | n. 生活、暮らし
definition_en: the fact of being real or being present in the world | a particular way of living, especially in difficult or simple conditions
example1_en: I never knew of this tiny island's existence.
example1_ja: この小さな島の存在を私は全く知らなかった。
example2_en: The existence of affordable housing can significantly improve the quality of life in growing cities.
example2_ja: 手頃な価格の住宅があれば、成長する都市の生活の質は大きく向上しうる。
collocations: come into existence｜生まれる、成立する ; in existence｜現存する ; the existence of｜〜の存在 ; a peaceful existence｜穏やかな暮らし
tip_ja: 「存在」の意味では普通は不可算。a quiet existence は「静かな暮らし」。
forms: 複数形: existences

meanings_ja: v. 立ち向かう、直面する | v. 問い詰める、対決する
definition_en: to deal with a difficult problem or situation directly instead of avoiding it | to face someone and challenge them about something they have done
example1_en: She finally confronted her fear and entered the swimming pool.
example1_ja: 彼女はついに恐怖に向き合い、プールに入った。
example2_en: Cities must confront the challenges of an ageing population by improving housing, healthcare, and public transport.
example2_ja: 都市は住宅、医療、公共交通を改善して、高齢化という課題に立ち向かわなければならない。
collocations: confront a problem｜問題に立ち向かう ; be confronted with｜〜に直面する ; confront someone about something｜ある件で人を問い詰める
tip_ja: 問題を直接目的語に。be confronted with は「〜に直面している」。
forms: 三人称単数現在: confronts | 過去形: confronted | 過去分詞: confronted | 現在分詞: confronting

meanings_ja: adj. 実験の、実験に基づく | adj. 試験的な、試みの
definition_en: relating to or based on scientific tests and experiments | new and still being tried to see whether it works
example1_en: We compared the experimental results over lunch today.
example1_ja: 今日の昼食時に、私たちは実験結果を比較した。
example2_en: Experimental evidence suggests that improved classroom ventilation can help students maintain concentration during longer lessons.
example2_ja: 実験による証拠は、教室の換気を改善すると、長い授業中も生徒が集中力を保ちやすくなることを示唆している。
collocations: experimental evidence｜実験による証拠 ; experimental design｜実験計画 ; experimental method｜実験的手法 ; experimental treatment｜試験的治療
tip_ja: 「実験の」「試験的な」の意味。「経験豊富な」は experienced。

meanings_ja: n. 違反、犯罪、反則 | n. 不快感、気分を害すること
definition_en: an illegal act or a breaking of a rule | a feeling of being upset or insulted by what someone says or does
example1_en: Parking here is an offence, so let's move the car.
example1_ja: ここに駐車するのは違反なので、車を移動しよう。
example2_en: Community service may be more effective than imprisonment for people who commit a minor offence.
example2_ja: 軽微な犯罪を犯した人には、投獄より社会奉仕の方が効果的かもしれない。
collocations: commit an offence｜罪を犯す ; a criminal offence｜刑事犯罪 ; take offence｜気を悪くする ; cause offence｜不快感を与える
tip_ja: 英綴りは offence、米綴りは offense。take offence は「腹を立てる」。
forms: 複数形: offences

meanings_ja: adj. 間違った、思い違いをした
definition_en: wrong in what you think or believe about something
example1_en: I was mistaken about the time of our appointment.
example1_ja: 約束の時間を私は勘違いしていた。
example2_en: The mistaken belief that all bacteria are harmful can prevent people from understanding their ecological importance.
example2_ja: 細菌はすべて有害だという誤った思い込みは、人々が生態系における細菌の重要性を理解する妨げになりうる。
collocations: be mistaken about｜〜について思い違いをしている ; mistaken belief｜誤った思い込み ; mistaken identity｜人違い ; if I am not mistaken｜私の記憶違いでなければ
tip_ja: 人が主語なら be mistaken about で「〜を勘違いしている」。

meanings_ja: n. 電報
definition_en: a message sent by telegraph and delivered in printed form
example1_en: Grandmother kept the telegram announcing her brother's safe arrival.
example1_ja: 祖母は、兄が無事に到着したと知らせる電報を大切に取っておいた。
example2_en: Before telephone services became widely available, sending a telegram was an important way to communicate urgent news.
example2_ja: 電話が広く普及する前は、電報は急ぎの知らせを伝える重要な手段だった。
collocations: send a telegram｜電報を打つ ; receive a telegram｜電報を受け取る ; deliver a telegram｜電報を配達する
tip_ja: telegram は電報の文面、telegraph は電信の仕組みを指す。
forms: 複数形: telegrams

meanings_ja: adj. 目に見える | adj. 明らかな、目立つ
definition_en: able to be seen | easy to notice or clearly shown
example1_en: The mountains were barely visible through the morning mist.
example1_ja: 朝霧のせいで、山はほとんど見えなかった。
example2_en: Investment in public transport has brought visible improvements to air quality in several major cities.
example2_ja: 公共交通への投資は、いくつかの大都市で大気の質に目に見える改善をもたらした。
collocations: clearly visible｜はっきり見える ; visible to the naked eye｜肉眼で見える ; visible improvement｜目に見える改善
tip_ja: visible to ～ で「〜に見える」。visual（視覚の）と区別する。

meanings_ja: adj. 手が届かない、高すぎて払えない
definition_en: costing more than a person can afford to pay
example1_en: The larger flat was unaffordable on my salary.
example1_ja: 広い方のアパートは私の給料では手が届かなかった。
example2_en: When housing becomes unaffordable, essential workers may be forced to move far from their workplaces.
example2_ja: 住宅が手の届かないものになると、不可欠な職種の労働者は職場から遠く離れて暮らさざるを得なくなる。
collocations: unaffordable housing｜手が届かない住宅 ; unaffordable rents｜払えないほど高い家賃 ; become unaffordable｜手が届かなくなる
tip_ja: 単に高いのではなく、支払い能力を超えるという含みがある。

meanings_ja: adj. 自営の、個人事業の
definition_en: working for yourself instead of being employed by a company
example1_en: My aunt is a self-employed electrician with her own van.
example1_ja: 叔母は自分のバンを持つ自営の電気技師だ。
example2_en: Self-employed workers often enjoy flexible schedules but may lack paid holidays and a stable monthly income.
example2_ja: 自営業者は柔軟な働き方を楽しめることが多いが、有給休暇や安定した月収がない場合がある。
collocations: self-employed workers｜自営業の労働者 ; become self-employed｜自営業になる ; self-employed consultant｜個人で活動するコンサルタント
tip_ja: 自分のために働く人のこと。失業中という意味ではない。ハイフンも忘れずに。

meanings_ja: n. 資金集め、募金活動
definition_en: the activity of collecting money for a cause or organization
example1_en: Our fund-raising dinner helped buy books for the library.
example1_ja: 私たちの資金集めの夕食会は、図書館の本を買う助けになった。
example2_en: Community fund-raising can support local services, but essential healthcare should not depend entirely on charitable donations.
example2_ja: 地域の募金活動は地元のサービスを支えうるが、不可欠な医療が慈善の寄付だけに頼るべきではない。
collocations: fund-raising event｜資金集めのイベント ; fund-raising campaign｜募金キャンペーン ; fund-raising target｜募金の目標額
tip_ja: fundraising と綴ることも多い。動詞句は raise funds。

meanings_ja: v. バタンと閉める、叩きつける | v. 酷評する、激しく非難する | n. バタンという音、激しい衝突
definition_en: to shut or put something down with a lot of force and noise | to criticize something very strongly | a loud noise or hard impact made by something shutting or hitting
example1_en: The wind slammed the window shut during breakfast.
example1_ja: 朝食中に風で窓がバタンと閉まった。
example2_en: Environmental groups slammed the proposal because it would allow further construction in protected coastal areas.
example2_ja: 環境団体は、保護された沿岸地域でのさらなる開発を認める案だとして、厳しく非難した。
collocations: slam the door｜ドアをバタンと閉める ; slam shut｜バタンと閉まる ; slam a proposal｜提案を酷評する
tip_ja: 過去形 slammed、現在分詞 slamming は m を重ねる。
forms: 三人称単数現在: slams | 過去形: slammed | 過去分詞: slammed | 現在分詞: slamming | 複数形: slams

meanings_ja: v. 認可する、免許を与える | n. 免許、許可証
definition_en: to give someone official permission to do or sell something | an official document that allows you to do or own something
example1_en: You need a license to drive on public roads.
example1_ja: 公道を運転するには免許が必要だ。
example2_en: Authorities should license childcare providers carefully to ensure that facilities meet appropriate safety and quality standards.
example2_ja: 当局は、施設が適切な安全・品質基準を満たすよう、保育事業者を慎重に認可すべきだ。
collocations: license someone to do something｜人に〜する許可を与える ; a driving license｜運転免許証 ; apply for a license｜免許を申請する ; a licensed operator｜認可を受けた事業者
tip_ja: 英では名詞 licence、動詞 license。米ではどちらも license。
forms: 三人称単数現在: licenses | 過去形: licensed | 過去分詞: licensed | 現在分詞: licensing | 複数形: licenses

meanings_ja: n. 長く困難な徒歩の旅 | v. 長距離を歩く、トレッキングする
definition_en: a long, difficult journey made on foot | to go on a long and tiring walk, especially through wild places
example1_en: Our trek through the forest ended beside a waterfall.
example1_ja: 森を抜ける私たちの長い道のりは、滝のそばで終わった。
example2_en: Visitors who trek through remote mountain regions can support local economies by hiring guides and purchasing local supplies.
example2_ja: 遠隔の山岳地帯をトレッキングする旅行者は、ガイドを雇い現地の物資を買うことで地域経済を支えられる。
collocations: a mountain trek｜山のトレッキング ; trek through the forest｜森を歩き抜く ; go on a trek｜トレッキングに出かける
tip_ja: 今は険しい道のトレッキングを指すことが多い。trekked、trekking は k を重ねる。
forms: 三人称単数現在: treks | 過去形: trekked | 過去分詞: trekked | 現在分詞: trekking | 複数形: treks

meanings_ja: n. 甲虫、カブトムシ類
definition_en: an insect with hard wing cases that cover its back
example1_en: A shiny beetle crawled slowly across the garden path.
example1_ja: つやのある甲虫が庭の小道をゆっくり這っていた。
example2_en: Some beetle species help maintain healthy forests by breaking down dead wood and recycling nutrients.
example2_ja: 一部の甲虫は枯れ木を分解して栄養を循環させ、森を健全に保つ助けをしている。
collocations: dung beetle｜フンコロガシ ; stag beetle｜クワガタムシ ; beetle species｜甲虫の種
tip_ja: 硬い羽を持つ昆虫の総称。日本語の「カブトムシ」だけを指すわけではない。
forms: 複数形: beetles

meanings_ja: n. ひも、ベルト、肩ひも | v. ひもで固定する、縛る
definition_en: a narrow band of leather or cloth used to carry, hold or fasten something | to fasten or hold something in place with a band
example1_en: The strap on my backpack broke near the bus stop.
example1_ja: バス停の近くでリュックの肩ひもが切れた。
example2_en: Passengers should strap their luggage securely to prevent injuries when vehicles stop suddenly or travel over uneven roads.
example2_ja: 乗客は、車が急停止したり凹凸のある道を走ったりしてもけがをしないよう、荷物をしっかり固定すべきだ。
collocations: shoulder strap｜肩ひも ; adjustable strap｜長さ調節できるストラップ ; strap something down｜物をひもで固定する
tip_ja: 動詞の過去形 strapped、現在分詞 strapping は p を重ねる。
forms: 三人称単数現在: straps | 過去形: strapped | 過去分詞: strapped | 現在分詞: strapping | 複数形: straps

meanings_ja: n. 水素
definition_en: a very light gas that is a chemical element and burns easily
example1_en: Our science teacher showed us how hydrogen burns.
example1_ja: 理科の先生が水素の燃え方を見せてくれた。
example2_en: Hydrogen produced using renewable electricity could help reduce emissions from industries that currently depend on fossil fuels.
example2_ja: 再生可能電力で作られた水素は、現在化石燃料に頼る産業の排出を減らす助けになりうる。
collocations: hydrogen fuel｜水素燃料 ; hydrogen gas｜水素ガス ; hydrogen fuel cell｜水素燃料電池
tip_ja: 不可算名詞。元素としての水素、または水素ガスを指す。

meanings_ja: n. ガロン（液体の容量単位）
definition_en: a unit for measuring liquid, used in Britain and the United States
example1_en: We bought a gallon of paint for the kitchen.
example1_ja: 私たちは台所用に1ガロンのペンキを買った。
example2_en: Comparing how far vehicles travel per gallon of fuel helps consumers assess running costs and fuel efficiency.
example2_ja: 燃料1ガロンあたりの走行距離を比べると、消費者は維持費や燃費を判断しやすくなる。
collocations: a gallon of petrol｜1ガロンのガソリン ; miles per gallon｜1ガロンあたりの走行マイル数 ; an imperial gallon｜英ガロン ; a US gallon｜米ガロン
tip_ja: 英ガロンは約4.55リットル、米ガロンは約3.79リットルで異なる。
forms: 複数形: gallons

meanings_ja: n. 調査結果、研究成果
definition_en: the results or conclusions of research or an investigation
example1_en: We shared our findings with the rest of the class.
example1_ja: 私たちは調査結果をクラスの皆と共有した。
example2_en: The findings suggest that access to green spaces is associated with better mental health among urban residents.
example2_ja: その結果は、緑地を利用できることが都市住民のより良い心の健康と関連していることを示唆している。
collocations: research findings｜研究結果 ; key findings｜主な調査結果 ; publish findings｜調査結果を発表する ; preliminary findings｜予備的な調査結果
tip_ja: 普通は複数形で使い、The findings suggest ... のように複数扱いにする。

meanings_ja: adj. 柔らかい、噛みやすい | adj. 優しい、愛情のこもった | adj. 触ると痛い、ひりひりする
definition_en: soft and easy to cut or chew when cooked | gentle and showing kindness or love | painful when touched
example1_en: The carrots were tender enough to mash with a fork.
example1_ja: そのニンジンはフォークでつぶせるほど柔らかかった。
example2_en: Slow cooking makes tougher cuts of meat tender, allowing households to use less expensive ingredients.
example2_ja: じっくり加熱すると硬い部位の肉も柔らかくなるので、家庭は安価な食材を活用できる。
collocations: tender meat｜柔らかい肉 ; tender care｜優しい心遣い ; tender to the touch｜触ると痛い
tip_ja: 食べ物には「柔らかい」、体の部位には「触ると痛い」の意味で使う。
forms: 比較級: tenderer | 最上級: tenderest

meanings_ja: adj. ベストセラーの、よく売れている
definition_en: sold in very large numbers
example1_en: I borrowed her best-selling cookbook and tried the soup.
example1_ja: 私は彼女のベストセラーの料理本を借りて、スープを作ってみた。
example2_en: Best-selling novels can encourage wider reading, although commercial success does not necessarily indicate literary quality.
example2_ja: ベストセラー小説は読書の裾野を広げうるが、商業的成功が文学的な質を示すとは限らない。
collocations: best-selling novel｜ベストセラー小説 ; best-selling author｜ベストセラー作家 ; best-selling product｜売れ筋商品
tip_ja: best-selling は形容詞。名詞の bestseller は「ベストセラー」。

meanings_ja: adj. 行政の、管理運営の
definition_en: relating to the organizing and running of a business, school or institution
example1_en: My sister handles administrative tasks at a local clinic.
example1_ja: 姉は地元のクリニックで事務作業を担当している。
example2_en: Reducing administrative costs could allow schools to spend more money on teaching materials and student support.
example2_ja: 管理運営費を減らせば、学校は教材や生徒の支援により多くの資金を充てられるかもしれない。
collocations: administrative staff｜事務職員 ; administrative costs｜管理運営費 ; administrative tasks｜事務作業
tip_ja: 組織の運営・事務に関わること。政府そのものを指すわけではない。

meanings_ja: n. 思想家、思考する人
definition_en: a person who thinks deeply, or whose ideas are influential
example1_en: My grandfather is a quiet thinker who enjoys difficult questions.
example1_ja: 祖父は難しい問いを好む、物静かな思索家だ。
example2_en: Education should encourage students to become independent thinkers rather than simply accept established ideas without question.
example2_ja: 教育は、確立された考えをただ受け入れるのではなく、生徒が自分で考える人になるよう促すべきだ。
collocations: independent thinker｜自分で考える人 ; critical thinker｜批判的に考える人 ; influential thinker｜影響力のある思想家 ; original thinker｜独創的な思想家
tip_ja: thinker は「人」、thinking は「思考そのもの」や考え方を指す。
forms: 複数形: thinkers

meanings_ja: adj. 完全な、まったくの | v. 口に出す、声を発する
definition_en: complete and total, used to stress how strong something is | to say something or make a sound with your voice
example1_en: The kitchen was in utter chaos after we baked.
example1_ja: 私たちがお菓子を焼いた後、台所は大混乱だった。
example2_en: Without adequate planning, rapid urban expansion can result in utter confusion over land ownership and infrastructure responsibilities.
example2_ja: 十分な計画がないまま都市が急速に拡大すると、土地の所有権やインフラの責任をめぐって完全な混乱が生じうる。
collocations: utter chaos｜大混乱 ; utter disbelief｜まったくの不信 ; utter a word｜一言口にする ; utter a sound｜声を発する
tip_ja: 形容詞の utter は名詞の前だけで使う。副詞は utterly。
forms: 三人称単数現在: utters | 過去形: uttered | 過去分詞: uttered | 現在分詞: uttering

meanings_ja: n. 邸宅つきの広い私有地、屋敷 | n. 団地、住宅地、工業団地 | n. 遺産、財産
definition_en: a large area of land with a big house, owned by one person or family | an area of land planned and built for houses or factories | all the money and property a person leaves when they die
example1_en: We walked past the lake on the old country estate.
example1_ja: 私たちは古い田舎の屋敷の湖のそばを歩いて通り過ぎた。
example2_en: New housing estates should include green spaces and reliable transport links to nearby employment centres.
example2_ja: 新しい住宅団地には、緑地と近隣の職場への信頼できる交通手段を備えるべきだ。
collocations: a country estate｜田舎の屋敷 ; a housing estate｜住宅団地 ; an industrial estate｜工業団地 ; real estate｜不動産
tip_ja: real estate は不動産、housing estate は住宅団地（英国で多用）。
forms: 複数形: estates

meanings_ja: n. 感謝、感謝の気持ち
definition_en: a warm feeling of thanks toward someone who has helped you
example1_en: She brought fresh flowers to express her gratitude.
example1_ja: 彼女は感謝の気持ちを表すために新鮮な花を持ってきた。
example2_en: Schools can encourage gratitude by helping students recognise the contributions that others make to their daily lives.
example2_ja: 学校は、生徒が周囲の人々の貢献に気づけるよう手助けすることで、感謝の心を育むことができる。
collocations: express gratitude｜感謝を表す ; gratitude to someone｜人への感謝 ; gratitude for something｜物事への感謝 ; a token of gratitude｜感謝のしるし
tip_ja: 人には to、事柄には for を使う。基本的に不可算名詞。

meanings_ja: v. 蒸発する、蒸発させる | v. 消え失せる、霧散する
definition_en: to change from liquid into vapour, or to make a liquid do this | to disappear gradually, especially a feeling or hope
example1_en: The puddles evaporated quickly in the warm afternoon sun.
example1_ja: 水たまりは暖かい午後の日差しですぐに蒸発した。
example2_en: As temperatures rise, water evaporates more rapidly from reservoirs, increasing pressure on supplies in drought-prone regions.
example2_ja: 気温が上がると貯水池から水がより速く蒸発し、干ばつの起きやすい地域では水の供給への圧力が高まる。
collocations: water evaporates｜水が蒸発する ; evaporate rapidly｜急速に蒸発する ; moisture evaporates｜水分が蒸発する ; hopes evaporate｜希望が消え失せる
tip_ja: 沸騰しなくても蒸発は起こる。希望などが消える比喩にも使う。
forms: 三人称単数現在: evaporates | 過去形: evaporated | 過去分詞: evaporated | 現在分詞: evaporating | 名詞形: evaporation

meanings_ja: adj. 予測できる、予想どおりの | adj. ありきたりの、新鮮味のない
definition_en: able to be known or guessed before it happens | so expected that it is boring or lacks surprise
example1_en: The film's predictable ending made us laugh rather than cry.
example1_ja: その映画の予想どおりの結末に、私たちは泣くどころか笑ってしまった。
example2_en: A predictable income helps families plan their spending and reduces the stress associated with financial uncertainty.
example2_ja: 安定した収入があれば、家族は支出の計画を立てやすくなり、経済的な不安によるストレスも減る。
collocations: predictable outcome｜予想どおりの結果 ; predictable pattern｜予測可能なパターン ; highly predictable｜非常に予測しやすい
tip_ja: 結果が読めるという中立的な意味と、「つまらない」という否定的な意味がある。
forms: 比較級: more predictable | 最上級: most predictable

meanings_ja: v. 明らかにする、暴く、発見する | v. 覆いを取る
definition_en: to find or reveal something that was hidden or unknown | to take a cover off something
example1_en: Our kitchen repairs helped uncover a hidden water leak.
example1_ja: 台所の修理がきっかけで、隠れていた水漏れが見つかった。
example2_en: Independent research can uncover environmental risks that are overlooked during the early stages of industrial development.
example2_ja: 独立した調査は、産業開発の初期段階で見過ごされがちな環境リスクを明らかにできる。
collocations: uncover evidence｜証拠を見つける ; uncover the truth｜真実を明らかにする ; uncover a problem｜問題を発見する
tip_ja: 物の覆いを取る意味と、隠れた事実を見つけ出す意味がある。
forms: 三人称単数現在: uncovers | 過去形: uncovered | 過去分詞: uncovered | 現在分詞: uncovering

meanings_ja: adj. 厳しい、手厳しい、容赦ない | adj. 過酷な、厳しい | adj. 耳障りな、まぶしい、刺激の強い
definition_en: cruel, strict or unkind, with no sympathy | very difficult to live in or bear, as weather or conditions | unpleasantly rough, bright or strong to the senses
example1_en: His harsh criticism upset everyone at the dinner table.
example1_ja: 彼の手厳しい批判に、食卓の全員が気分を害した。
example2_en: Farmers in regions with harsh climates need reliable irrigation systems to maintain stable food production.
example2_ja: 気候の厳しい地域の農家は、安定した食料生産を維持するために信頼できる灌漑設備を必要とする。
collocations: harsh criticism｜手厳しい批判 ; harsh conditions｜過酷な状況 ; harsh punishment｜厳しい罰 ; harsh light｜まぶしい光
tip_ja: strict より、不快でつらいほどの厳しさを表す。
forms: 比較級: harsher | 最上級: harshest

meanings_ja: v. 似ている
definition_en: to look like or be similar to someone or something
example1_en: These clouds resemble small boats floating across the sky.
example1_ja: これらの雲は空を漂う小さな舟に似ている。
example2_en: Modern learning spaces increasingly resemble collaborative workplaces rather than traditional classrooms with fixed rows of desks.
example2_ja: 現代の学習空間は、固定された机が並ぶ従来の教室よりも、協働の職場にますます似てきている。
collocations: closely resemble｜よく似ている ; strongly resemble｜非常によく似ている ; resemble each other｜互いに似ている
tip_ja: 他動詞なので resemble someone と直接目的語をとり、to や with は不要。
forms: 三人称単数現在: resembles | 過去形: resembled | 過去分詞: resembled | 現在分詞: resembling

meanings_ja: n. 鞍、サドル | v. 鞍を置く | v. 負担を負わせる
definition_en: a seat for a rider on a horse or bicycle | to put a saddle on a horse | to give someone a difficult duty or a burden
example1_en: I lowered the saddle before riding my new bicycle.
example1_ja: 新しい自転車に乗る前に、私はサドルを低くした。
example2_en: Excessive university fees can saddle graduates with debts that limit their career choices for many years.
example2_ja: 大学の過度な学費は、卒業生に何年も進路選択を狭める借金を背負わせかねない。
collocations: adjust the saddle｜サドルを調整する ; saddle a horse｜馬に鞍を置く ; be saddled with debt｜借金を背負わされる
tip_ja: saddle A with B は、Aに望まない負担を負わせること。
forms: 複数形: saddles | 三人称単数現在: saddles | 過去形: saddled | 過去分詞: saddled | 現在分詞: saddling

meanings_ja: n. 運命、宿命 | n. 最期、成り行き、末路
definition_en: a power believed to decide what will happen in life | what finally happens to a person or thing, often something bad
example1_en: It felt like fate when we met again.
example1_ja: 再会したとき、運命のように感じた。
example2_en: The fate of many endangered species depends on whether governments protect their habitats from further destruction.
example2_ja: 多くの絶滅危惧種の行く末は、各国政府がその生息地をこれ以上の破壊から守るかどうかにかかっている。
collocations: leave something to fate｜物事を運命に任せる ; seal someone's fate｜人の運命を決定づける ; suffer the same fate｜同じ末路をたどる
tip_ja: 運命の意味では不可算。a terrible fate は悲惨な最期。
forms: 複数形: fates

meanings_ja: adj. 必死の、自暴自棄の、絶望的な | adj. どうしても欲しい、切実に必要な | adj. 深刻な、危機的な
definition_en: willing to do anything because the situation is very bad | needing or wanting something very strongly | extremely serious or dangerous
example1_en: Desperate to find her cat, Aisha searched every nearby garden.
example1_ja: 必死に猫を探そうと、アイシャは近所の庭を一軒ずつ見て回った。
example2_en: After prolonged drought, farming communities face desperate conditions and require urgent support to restore their livelihoods.
example2_ja: 長引く干ばつの後、農村地域は深刻な状況に直面しており、生計を立て直すための緊急支援を必要としている。
collocations: desperate for help｜助けを切実に求めて ; desperate to escape｜必死に逃げようとして ; a desperate attempt｜必死の試み ; desperate measures｜思い切った手段
tip_ja: 物には desperate for、したい行動には desperate to do。
forms: 比較級: more desperate | 最上級: most desperate

meanings_ja: n. 骨格、骸骨 | n. 骨組み、概要
definition_en: the frame of bones inside a human or animal body | the basic structure or outline of something
example1_en: We saw a huge dinosaur skeleton at the museum.
example1_ja: 博物館で巨大な恐竜の骨格を見た。
example2_en: Studying the skeleton of an ancient animal can reveal how it moved and adapted to its environment.
example2_ja: 古代の動物の骨格を研究すると、その動物がどのように動き、環境に適応したかが分かることがある。
collocations: human skeleton｜人間の骨格 ; dinosaur skeleton｜恐竜の骨格 ; skeleton staff｜最小限の人員
tip_ja: skeleton staff は運営に必要な最小限の人員のこと。
forms: 複数形: skeletons

meanings_ja: n. 予防策、用心
definition_en: something done in advance to avoid danger or trouble
example1_en: We packed an extra torch as a precaution.
example1_ja: 念のため、予備の懐中電灯を荷物に入れた。
example2_en: Taking basic safety precautions in laboratories can prevent accidents and protect both students and teaching staff.
example2_ja: 実験室で基本的な安全対策を講じれば、事故を防ぎ、学生と教職員の両方を守ることができる。
collocations: take precautions｜予防策を講じる ; as a precaution｜念のため ; safety precautions｜安全対策 ; a precaution against fire｜防火対策
tip_ja: take precautions は予防策を講じる、as a precaution は念のため。
forms: 複数形: precautions

meanings_ja: n. 候補者、志願者 | n. 受験者
definition_en: a person who is competing for a job or an elected position | a person taking an examination
example1_en: Each candidate waited outside the office before their interview.
example1_ja: 各志願者は面接の前にオフィスの外で待っていた。
example2_en: Employers should assess each candidate fairly rather than rely on assumptions about their educational or cultural background.
example2_ja: 雇用主は、学歴や文化的背景についての思い込みに頼らず、各候補者を公平に評価すべきだ。
collocations: candidate for a position｜ある職の候補者 ; suitable candidate｜適任者 ; election candidate｜選挙の立候補者 ; exam candidate｜受験者
tip_ja: candidate for の後には応募する職や立候補する役職が来る。
forms: 複数形: candidates

meanings_ja: n. 百科事典
definition_en: a book or website with information on many subjects, arranged for reference
example1_en: I found a fascinating dinosaur picture in this encyclopedia.
example1_ja: この百科事典で、面白い恐竜の絵を見つけた。
example2_en: An online encyclopedia offers convenient background information, but students should verify important claims using reliable academic sources.
example2_ja: オンライン百科事典は手軽な背景情報を提供するが、学生は重要な主張を信頼できる学術資料で確認すべきだ。
collocations: online encyclopedia｜オンライン百科事典 ; encyclopedia entry｜百科事典の項目 ; consult an encyclopedia｜百科事典を調べる
tip_ja: 英国式では encyclopaedia とも綴る。
forms: 複数形: encyclopedias

meanings_ja: adj. 腫れた、膨らんだ | adj. 増水した
definition_en: bigger than normal because of injury, illness or fluid | carrying more water than usual, as a river after rain
example1_en: My ankle was swollen after I fell during practice.
example1_ja: 練習中に転んで、足首が腫れた。
example2_en: After several days of heavy rain, the swollen river threatened homes built close to its banks.
example2_ja: 数日間の大雨の後、増水した川は岸辺近くに建てられた家々を脅かした。
collocations: a swollen ankle｜腫れた足首 ; swollen glands｜腫れたリンパ腺 ; a swollen river｜増水した川
tip_ja: swell の過去分詞でもある。過去形は swelled。
forms: 比較級: more swollen | 最上級: most swollen
grammar_note: swell の過去分詞 swollen が形容詞化したもの。swelled も過去分詞に使える。

meanings_ja: n. 評判、名声
definition_en: the general opinion that people have about someone or something
example1_en: This little bakery has a reputation for excellent bread.
example1_ja: この小さなパン屋は、おいしいパンで評判だ。
example2_en: Companies that respond honestly to customer complaints are more likely to maintain a good reputation.
example2_ja: 顧客の苦情に誠実に対応する企業は、良い評判を保てる可能性が高い。
collocations: build a reputation｜評判を築く ; damage someone's reputation｜人の評判を傷つける ; a reputation for quality｜品質の良さという評判
tip_ja: reputation for で特徴を示す。良い評判にも悪い評判にも使える。
forms: 複数形: reputations

meanings_ja: v. 元気を回復させる、さわやかにする | v. 更新する、再読み込みする | v. 記憶を新たにする、復習する
definition_en: to make someone feel less tired or hot | to reload a web page or update information on a screen | to make knowledge or memory clear again
example1_en: A cool shower refreshed me after the long walk.
example1_ja: 長い散歩の後、冷たいシャワーでさっぱりした。
example2_en: Regular breaks can refresh employees and help them maintain concentration during tasks that require sustained mental effort.
example2_ja: 定期的な休憩は従業員の気分を一新し、精神的な持続力が必要な作業での集中を保つのに役立つ。
collocations: feel refreshed｜元気を取り戻す ; refresh a page｜ページを更新する ; refresh your memory｜記憶を呼び起こす ; refresh your skills｜技能を磨き直す
tip_ja: 人が爽快に感じるなら refreshed、物が爽快なら refreshing。
forms: 三人称単数現在: refreshes | 過去形: refreshed | 過去分詞: refreshed | 現在分詞: refreshing

meanings_ja: adj. 絹のようになめらかな | adj. 柔らかく心地よい声の
definition_en: soft, smooth and shiny like silk | smooth and pleasant, describing a voice
example1_en: This conditioner leaves my hair feeling soft and silky.
example1_ja: このコンディショナーを使うと、髪が柔らかく絹のようになめらかになる。
example2_en: Consumers often prefer fabrics with a silky texture, although their production may require substantial chemical processing.
example2_ja: 消費者はしばしば絹のようになめらかな質感の生地を好むが、その生産には大量の化学処理が必要になることがある。
collocations: silky hair｜絹のようなつやのある髪 ; silky texture｜なめらかな質感 ; silky smooth｜絹のようになめらか ; silky voice｜なめらかで耳に心地よい声
tip_ja: 絹のようななめらかさを表し、本物の絹製とは限らない。
forms: 比較級: silkier | 最上級: silkiest

meanings_ja: n. 家政婦、客室係
definition_en: a person paid to clean and look after a house or hotel rooms
example1_en: The housekeeper left fresh towels beside the bathroom sink.
example1_ja: 客室係は洗面台の横に新しいタオルを置いていった。
example2_en: Hotels should provide housekeepers with suitable equipment and sufficient time to clean each room safely.
example2_ja: ホテルは、客室係が各部屋を安全に清掃できるよう、適切な道具と十分な時間を与えるべきだ。
collocations: hotel housekeeper｜ホテルの客室係 ; live-in housekeeper｜住み込みの家政婦 ; hire a housekeeper｜家政婦を雇う
tip_ja: 家事や客室清掃を仕事とする人。性別は問わない。
forms: 複数形: housekeepers

meanings_ja: n. 負担、重圧、緊張 | v. 痛める、無理をさせる | n. 系統、株、品種
definition_en: pressure or stress that makes something hard to deal with | to hurt a body part by using it too much | a particular type of a plant, animal or germ
example1_en: I strained my back while lifting that heavy box.
example1_ja: 重い箱を持ち上げたときに背中を痛めた。
example2_en: Rapid population growth puts considerable strain on public services, particularly housing and healthcare in large cities.
example2_ja: 急速な人口増加は公共サービス、特に大都市の住宅や医療に大きな負担をかける。
collocations: put a strain on｜～に負担をかける ; under strain｜重圧を受けて ; strain a muscle｜筋肉を痛める ; a strain of virus｜ウイルスの一株
tip_ja: strain は筋肉の痛め、sprain は主に関節の捻挫。
forms: 複数形: strains | 三人称単数現在: strains | 過去形: strained | 過去分詞: strained | 現在分詞: straining

meanings_ja: v. まっすぐにする、まっすぐになる | v. 姿勢を正す、背筋を伸ばす
definition_en: to make something straight, or to become straight | to stand or sit with your body upright
example1_en: She paused to straighten her tie before the interview.
example1_ja: 面接の前に、彼女は立ち止まってネクタイを直した。
example2_en: Regular stretching can help office workers straighten their backs and reduce discomfort caused by prolonged sitting.
example2_ja: 定期的なストレッチは、事務職の人が背筋を伸ばし、長時間座ることによる不快感を和らげるのに役立つ。
collocations: straighten your back｜背筋を伸ばす ; straighten up｜姿勢を正す、片づける ; straighten out a problem｜問題を解決する
tip_ja: straighten up は姿勢を正す意味と、片づける意味がある。
forms: 三人称単数現在: straightens | 過去形: straightened | 過去分詞: straightened | 現在分詞: straightening

meanings_ja: n. 正確さ、精度
definition_en: the quality of being correct and free from mistakes
example1_en: Please check the accuracy of these measurements before cutting.
example1_ja: 切る前に、これらの測定値の正確さを確認してください。
example2_en: The accuracy of climate predictions depends partly on the quality of data collected over long periods.
example2_ja: 気候予測の精度は、長期間にわたって集められたデータの質に一部左右される。
collocations: check the accuracy of｜～の正確さを確認する ; improve accuracy｜精度を高める ; a high degree of accuracy｜高い精度 ; historical accuracy｜歴史的な正確さ
tip_ja: 基本的に不可算名詞。形容詞は accurate。

meanings_ja: n. 討論、議論 | v. 討論する、議論する | v. よく考える、迷う
definition_en: a discussion in which people give different opinions | to discuss a subject formally or at length | to think carefully about what to do
example1_en: We had a lively debate about keeping pets indoors.
example1_ja: 私たちはペットを室内で飼うことについて活発に議論した。
example2_en: The debate over free public transport centres on its environmental benefits and the cost to taxpayers.
example2_ja: 公共交通の無料化をめぐる議論は、環境面の利点と納税者の負担額を中心に展開している。
collocations: public debate｜世論の議論 ; heated debate｜白熱した議論 ; debate an issue｜問題を議論する ; debate whether to｜～すべきか迷う
tip_ja: 動詞は議題を直接目的語にとる。debate whether to で迷う意味。
forms: 複数形: debates | 三人称単数現在: debates | 過去形: debated | 過去分詞: debated | 現在分詞: debating

meanings_ja: n. ポーチ、玄関の屋根付きスペース
definition_en: a covered area at the entrance of a house
example1_en: We left our muddy boots on the porch overnight.
example1_ja: 私たちは泥だらけのブーツを一晩ポーチに置いておいた。
example2_en: A shaded porch can reduce indoor temperatures while providing residents with a comfortable outdoor meeting space.
example2_ja: 日陰のポーチは室内の温度を下げ、住民に快適な屋外の集いの場を提供できる。
collocations: front porch｜玄関ポーチ ; covered porch｜屋根付きポーチ ; sit on the porch｜ポーチに座る
tip_ja: 家の入口の外にある屋根付きの空間で、室内の廊下ではない。

meanings_ja: n. 储存；存放 | n. 数据存储；存储空间
definition_en: The act of keeping things somewhere until they are needed. | The capacity or process of keeping digital information for future use.
example1_en: These boxes provide useful storage for all my winter clothes.
example1_ja: 这些箱子很适合存放我所有的冬装。
example2_en: Improved energy storage could make renewable electricity more reliable when sunlight and wind are unavailable.
example2_ja: 改进储能技术可以在缺少阳光和风力时，让可再生电力的供应更可靠。
collocations: storage space｜储物空间 ; energy storage｜储能 ; cloud storage｜云存储 ; in storage｜存放着
tip_ja: storage通常不可数；一间储藏室用a storeroom。

meanings_ja: n. 连词 | n. 结合；同时发生
definition_en: a word that connects words, phrases, or clauses | a combination of things or events occurring together
example1_en: Our teacher used coloured cards to explain conjunctions.
example1_ja: 老师用彩色卡片讲解连词。
example2_en: Public transport improvements work best in conjunction with policies that discourage unnecessary car journeys.
example2_ja: 公共交通的改善与减少不必要驾车出行的政策相结合时，效果最佳。
collocations: in conjunction with｜与……结合；与……共同 ; coordinating conjunction｜并列连词 ; subordinating conjunction｜从属连词
tip_ja: in conjunction with常表示“与……共同或结合”。

meanings_ja: v. 冥想；静思 | v. 沉思；深思
definition_en: to focus your mind calmly, often as a mental exercise | to think deeply and carefully about something
example1_en: I meditate for ten minutes before breakfast each morning.
example1_ja: 我每天早饭前都会冥想十分钟。
example2_en: Some employers encourage staff to meditate during breaks as a way of managing workplace stress.
example2_ja: 一些雇主鼓励员工在休息时冥想，以缓解工作压力。
collocations: meditate daily｜每天冥想 ; meditate on something｜深入思考某事 ; learn to meditate｜学习冥想
tip_ja: 表示深思某事，常用meditate on或upon。

meanings_ja: adj. 焦虑的；担忧的 | adj. 渴望的；急切的
definition_en: Worried or nervous about something uncertain. | Very eager to do something or for something to happen.
example1_en: I felt anxious while waiting for my exam results.
example1_ja: 等待考试成绩时，我感到很焦虑。
example2_en: Students may become anxious about their future when career guidance is unavailable at school.
example2_ja: 学校不提供职业指导时，学生可能会对未来感到焦虑。
collocations: anxious about｜对……感到焦虑 ; anxious to please｜急于讨好 ; feel anxious｜感到焦虑
tip_ja: anxious about表担忧；anxious to do常表急切。

meanings_ja: v. 证明合理；为…辩护
definition_en: Give good reasons for an action, decision, or belief.
example1_en: I cannot justify buying another coat this winter.
example1_ja: 我找不到理由今年冬天再买一件外套。
example2_en: Governments must justify major infrastructure spending by demonstrating clear benefits for the wider community.
example2_ja: 政府必须通过展示对整个社区的明确益处，来证明重大基础设施支出的合理性。
collocations: justify a decision｜为决定提供理由 ; justify the cost｜证明费用合理 ; justify doing something｜证明做某事合理
tip_ja: justify后接名词或动名词，不接不定式。

meanings_ja: n. 芳香；香气 | n. 香水；香氛
definition_en: A pleasant smell, especially from flowers or perfume. | A liquid or substance used to give a pleasant smell.
example1_en: The fragrance of fresh roses filled the small kitchen.
example1_ja: 鲜玫瑰的香气弥漫在小厨房里。
example2_en: Some consumers prefer products without added fragrance because scented ingredients can irritate sensitive skin.
example2_ja: 一些消费者偏爱不添加香料的产品，因为芳香成分可能刺激敏感肌肤。
collocations: delicate fragrance｜淡雅的香气 ; floral fragrance｜花香 ; added fragrance｜添加的香料 ; fragrance-free products｜无香型产品
tip_ja: fragrance通常指好闻的气味；smell则可褒可贬。

meanings_ja: n. 天才人物 | n. 天赋；非凡才能
definition_en: someone with exceptional intelligence or creative ability | exceptional natural ability in a particular area
example1_en: My sister is a genius at fixing broken toys.
example1_ja: 我姐姐修坏玩具特别有一手。
example2_en: Creative genius often develops when schools allow students to experiment rather than simply memorise facts.
example2_ja: 学校允许学生探索尝试，而非仅仅记忆知识时，创造天赋往往更容易得到发展。
collocations: a mathematical genius｜数学天才 ; creative genius｜创造天赋 ; a genius at｜在……方面极有才干的人 ; a stroke of genius｜绝妙的主意
tip_ja: 指天才人物时可数；指非凡才能时通常不可数。

meanings_ja: n. 参考书目；文献目录
definition_en: a list of sources used or relevant to a subject
example1_en: I added the missing book to my essay's bibliography.
example1_ja: 我把漏掉的那本书补进了论文的参考书目。
example2_en: A carefully prepared bibliography allows readers to locate sources and examine the evidence supporting an academic argument.
example2_ja: 精心编制的参考书目能让读者找到资料来源，并查验支持学术论点的证据。
collocations: compile a bibliography｜编制参考书目 ; annotated bibliography｜附注释的参考书目 ; extensive bibliography｜详尽的参考书目
tip_ja: bibliography是资料清单；biography是人物传记。

meanings_ja: v. 继承财产 | v. 经遗传获得 | v. 接手；承袭
definition_en: Receive money or property from someone who has died | Receive physical characteristics genetically from your parents | Receive responsibilities or problems left by a previous person
example1_en: Leila inherited a small cottage from her grandmother.
example1_ja: 莱拉从祖母那里继承了一间小屋。
example2_en: Future generations may inherit serious environmental problems unless governments take decisive action to reduce pollution.
example2_ja: 除非各国政府采取果断措施减少污染，否则后代可能要接手严重的环境问题。
collocations: inherit property｜继承财产 ; inherit a fortune｜继承巨额财富 ; inherit traits｜遗传获得特征 ; inherit from｜从……继承
tip_ja: 常用inherit sth from sb；遗传特征也可用。

meanings_ja: n. 松鼠 | v. 储藏；积攒
definition_en: A small rodent with a bushy tail, often living in trees. | To store something secretly for later use, usually with away.
example1_en: A squirrel buried a nut beside our garden gate.
example1_ja: 一只松鼠在我们花园门旁埋了一颗坚果。
example2_en: Urban parks provide squirrels with food and shelter, although feeding them can alter their natural behaviour.
example2_ja: 城市公园为松鼠提供食物和栖身之所，但投喂可能改变它们的自然行为。
collocations: a grey squirrel｜灰松鼠 ; a red squirrel｜红松鼠 ; squirrel away money｜悄悄攒钱
tip_ja: 作动词通常用squirrel away，指悄悄储存。

meanings_ja: n. 铝
definition_en: A light, silver-coloured metal used in cans and aircraft.
example1_en: This aluminium pan is light enough to carry camping.
example1_ja: 这个铝锅很轻，适合露营时携带。
example2_en: Recycling aluminium requires significantly less energy than producing new metal from raw materials, reducing industrial emissions.
example2_ja: 回收铝所需的能源远少于从原材料中提炼新铝，有助于减少工业排放。
collocations: aluminium foil｜铝箔 ; aluminium alloy｜铝合金 ; aluminium can｜铝罐 ; recycled aluminium｜再生铝
tip_ja: 美式通常写作aluminum，读作/əˈluːmɪnəm/。

meanings_ja: n. 间谍；密探 | v. 从事间谍活动；暗中监视 | v. 突然发现；瞥见
definition_en: Someone who secretly gathers information about a country or organisation | To secretly watch someone or gather information about them | To notice someone or something, especially after looking carefully
example1_en: I spied a tiny kitten hiding behind the flowerpot.
example1_ja: 我瞥见一只小猫躲在花盆后面。
example2_en: Many users worry that connected devices could spy on their activities without permission.
example2_ja: 许多用户担心联网设备可能未经允许就暗中监视他们的活动。
collocations: spy on someone｜暗中监视某人 ; spy novel｜间谍小说 ; spy network｜间谍网
tip_ja: 监视某人用spy on；过去式和过去分词为spied。

meanings_ja: n. 照明；灯光效果
definition_en: The lights in a place or the effects they produce.
example1_en: The soft lighting makes this room feel warm and cosy.
example1_ja: 柔和的灯光让这个房间显得温暖舒适。
example2_en: Improved street lighting can make pedestrians feel safer and encourage more people to walk after dark.
example2_ja: 改善街道照明可以增强行人的安全感，并鼓励更多人在天黑后步行。
collocations: street lighting｜街道照明 ; natural lighting｜自然采光 ; poor lighting｜照明不足 ; lighting effects｜灯光效果
tip_ja: 表示整体照明时不可数；单个灯用a light。

meanings_ja: n. 人质
definition_en: someone held captive to force others to meet demands
example1_en: The hostage returned home safely and hugged her family.
example1_ja: 那名人质平安回家，拥抱了家人。
example2_en: Governments must balance public safety with the need to secure the release of every hostage.
example2_ja: 政府必须兼顾公众安全与确保每一名人质获释的需要。
collocations: take someone hostage｜劫持某人作人质 ; hold someone hostage｜扣押某人作人质 ; release a hostage｜释放人质 ; hostage negotiations｜人质谈判
tip_ja: take或hold someone hostage中，hostage前不加冠词。

meanings_ja: adj. 部分重叠的 | adj. 部分相同的；交叉的
definition_en: Covering part of the same area or period. | Sharing some features, interests, or responsibilities.
example1_en: The roof was covered with rows of overlapping tiles.
example1_ja: 屋顶铺着一排排相互搭叠的瓦片。
example2_en: Overlapping responsibilities between government departments can create confusion and delay the implementation of essential public services.
example2_ja: 政府部门之间职责交叉可能造成混乱，并延误重要公共服务的落实。
collocations: overlapping responsibilities｜交叉的职责 ; overlapping interests｜共同的利益或兴趣 ; overlapping circles｜相交的圆
tip_ja: 强调部分重合，不一定完全相同；也可指时间重叠。

meanings_ja: adj. 异常的；反常的
definition_en: Different from what is usual or expected, often causing concern.
example1_en: The mechanic noticed an abnormal noise from the engine.
example1_ja: 修理工注意到发动机发出异常响声。
example2_en: Regular medical screening can detect abnormal changes before they develop into conditions that require complex treatment.
example2_ja: 定期医学筛查可以在异常变化发展为需要复杂治疗的疾病之前发现它们。
collocations: abnormal behaviour｜反常行为 ; abnormal growth｜异常生长 ; abnormal heart rhythm｜心律异常
tip_ja: 常用于医学或异常现象，不宜随意用来评价人。

meanings_ja: v. 提升；增强；改善
definition_en: Improve the quality, value, or appeal of something
example1_en: A little lemon juice enhances the flavour of this soup.
example1_ja: 加一点柠檬汁能让这道汤的味道更好。
example2_en: Access to green spaces can enhance residents' wellbeing and encourage more active lifestyles in crowded cities.
example2_ja: 在拥挤的城市中，便利的绿地资源可以提升居民的幸福感，并鼓励更积极的生活方式。
collocations: enhance performance｜提升表现 ; enhance the quality of｜改善……的质量 ; enhance someone's reputation｜提升某人的声誉
tip_ja: 强调质量、效果或价值提升，不单指数量增加。

meanings_ja: n. 打击乐器；打击乐声部
definition_en: Musical instruments played by hitting, shaking, or scraping them.
example1_en: My sister plays percussion in the school band.
example1_ja: 我姐姐在学校乐队里演奏打击乐器。
example2_en: Group percussion lessons can help children develop coordination while encouraging cooperation and creative expression.
example2_ja: 集体打击乐课程可以帮助儿童发展协调能力，同时促进合作与创造性表达。
collocations: percussion instruments｜打击乐器 ; play percussion｜演奏打击乐器 ; percussion section｜打击乐声部
tip_ja: 总称时不可数；一件打击乐器用a percussion instrument。

meanings_ja: v. 赔偿；补偿 | v. 弥补；抵消
definition_en: To give someone money or something else for loss or harm. | To balance a disadvantage by providing something beneficial.
example1_en: The airline compensated us for our lost luggage.
example1_ja: 航空公司赔偿了我们丢失行李的损失。
example2_en: Governments should compensate farmers for income lost when agricultural land is converted into protected habitats.
example2_ja: 政府应补偿农民因农田被改为受保护栖息地而损失的收入。
collocations: compensate someone for a loss｜赔偿某人的损失 ; compensate for a lack of｜弥补……的不足 ; fully compensate｜充分补偿
tip_ja: 赔偿某人用compensate sb for sth；弥补用for。

meanings_ja: v. 犯（罪或错误） | v. 承诺；使承担义务 | v. 投入（资金或资源）
definition_en: To do something illegal or seriously wrong. | To promise firmly to do something or support someone. | To make money, time, or resources available for a purpose.
example1_en: The police arrested someone who had committed a burglary.
example1_ja: 警方逮捕了一名入室盗窃者。
example2_en: Governments must commit sufficient resources to public transport if they want to reduce urban traffic congestion.
example2_ja: 如果政府想缓解城市交通拥堵，就必须向公共交通投入充足的资源。
collocations: commit a crime｜犯罪 ; commit to doing something｜承诺做某事 ; commit resources to｜向……投入资源 ; commit oneself to｜致力于
tip_ja: commit to中的to是介词，后接名词或动名词。

meanings_ja: v. 投入；奉献
definition_en: To give time, effort, or resources to someone or something.
example1_en: I devote an hour each evening to practising the piano.
example1_ja: 我每天晚上花一个小时练钢琴。
example2_en: Governments should devote more resources to preventive healthcare rather than relying entirely on expensive medical treatments.
example2_ja: 政府应将更多资源投入预防性医疗，而不是完全依赖昂贵的医学治疗。
collocations: devote time to｜投入时间于 ; devote resources to｜投入资源于 ; devote oneself to｜致力于
tip_ja: devote…to中的to是介词，后接名词或动名词。

meanings_ja: n. 自我；本来面貌
definition_en: The personality and qualities that make you who you are.
example1_en: After a good sleep, I felt like my usual self.
example1_ja: 好好睡了一觉后，我感觉又恢复了平常的状态。
example2_en: Creative activities can help young people develop a stronger sense of self during periods of rapid change.
example2_ja: 在迅速变化的时期，创意活动能帮助年轻人形成更强的自我意识。
collocations: a sense of self｜自我意识 ; your true self｜真实的自己 ; your usual self｜你平常的状态
tip_ja: self是名词；表达“我自己”通常用myself。

meanings_ja: adj. 牙齿的；牙科的
definition_en: Relating to teeth or their care and treatment
example1_en: My dental appointment is early tomorrow, before work.
example1_ja: 我的牙科预约在明天一早，上班之前。
example2_en: Providing affordable dental care in schools could reduce health inequalities and prevent problems later in life.
example2_ja: 在学校提供价格可负担的牙科保健服务，可以减少健康不平等，并预防日后的问题。
collocations: dental care｜牙齿保健 ; dental treatment｜牙科治疗 ; dental check-up｜牙齿检查 ; dental floss｜牙线
tip_ja: dental是形容词；牙医是dentist。

meanings_ja: v. 用拳猛击 | n. 一拳；拳击 | v. 打孔
definition_en: to hit someone or something with a closed hand | a hit made with a closed hand | to make a hole using a special tool
example1_en: She punched the training bag, then caught her breath.
example1_ja: 她用拳猛击训练沙袋，然后喘了口气。
example2_en: Boxers learn to deliver a controlled punch while maintaining balance and protecting themselves from injury.
example2_ja: 拳击运动员学习在保持平衡、避免受伤的同时，有控制地出拳。
collocations: punch a bag｜击打沙袋 ; throw a punch｜挥拳 ; punch a hole｜打孔 ; hole punch｜打孔器
tip_ja: punch用拳头打；slap通常指用手掌拍打。

meanings_ja: v. 进餐；用餐
definition_en: To eat a meal, especially dinner.
example1_en: We dined outside beside the river last night.
example1_ja: 昨晚我们在河边的露天座位用餐。
example2_en: Tourists who dine at locally owned restaurants can support small businesses and experience regional food traditions.
example2_ja: 在当地人经营的餐馆用餐，游客既能支持小企业，也能体验地方饮食传统。
collocations: dine out｜外出用餐 ; dine with friends｜与朋友共进餐 ; dine at a restaurant｜在餐馆用餐
tip_ja: 比eat正式，通常不直接接食物作宾语。

meanings_ja: n. 绳结；结 | v. 打结；把…系牢 | n. 节（航速单位）
definition_en: A tight fastening made by tying rope or string. | To tie something into a knot. | A speed unit equal to one nautical mile per hour.
example1_en: This knot is too tight for me to undo.
example1_ja: 这个结太紧了，我解不开。
example2_en: During outdoor education courses, students learn to tie a secure knot before attempting basic climbing activities.
example2_ja: 在户外教育课程中，学生先学习打牢固的绳结，再尝试基础攀爬活动。
collocations: tie a knot｜打结 ; undo a knot｜解开绳结 ; a tight knot｜紧结 ; a speed of twenty knots｜二十节的速度
tip_ja: k不发音；航速的knot是每小时一海里。

meanings_ja: v. 漂流；飘移 | v. 逐渐偏离；无目的移动 | n. 大意；主旨
definition_en: To move slowly, carried by water or air. | To move or change gradually without clear purpose or control. | The general meaning of what someone says or writes.
example1_en: We watched a fallen leaf drift across the pond.
example1_ja: 我们看着一片落叶缓缓漂过池塘。
example2_en: Without affordable housing and stable employment, young residents may gradually drift away from rural communities.
example2_ja: 如果缺乏负担得起的住房和稳定的工作，年轻居民可能会逐渐离开农村社区。
collocations: drift apart｜逐渐疏远 ; drift off to sleep｜渐渐入睡 ; drift away｜慢慢离开 ; get the drift｜领会大意
tip_ja: drift强调随水、风移动，或缺乏明确方向。

meanings_ja: v. 适应；使适应 | v. 改编；改装
definition_en: to change behaviour or features to suit new conditions | to change something for a different use or audience
example1_en: Our cat quickly adapted to life in the new flat.
example1_ja: 我们的猫很快适应了新公寓里的生活。
example2_en: Schools must adapt their teaching methods to meet the needs of students from diverse cultural backgrounds.
example2_ja: 学校必须调整教学方法，以满足不同文化背景学生的需求。
collocations: adapt to change｜适应变化 ; adapt teaching methods｜调整教学方法 ; adapt a novel for television｜把小说改编成电视剧
tip_ja: adapt to后接名词或动名词；勿混adopt（采用）。

meanings_ja: n. 诱惑；诱惑物
definition_en: A strong desire for something, or something causing that desire.
example1_en: I resisted the temptation to eat another slice of cake.
example1_ja: 我忍住了再吃一块蛋糕的诱惑。
example2_en: Students may face the temptation to copy online material rather than develop their own ideas.
example2_ja: 学生可能会受到诱惑，抄袭网上的材料，而不是形成自己的观点。
collocations: resist temptation｜抵制诱惑 ; give in to temptation｜经不住诱惑 ; the temptation to do something｜做某事的诱惑
tip_ja: 常用the temptation to do，表示想做某事的诱惑。

meanings_ja: n. 雪茄烟
definition_en: a thick roll of dried tobacco leaves made for smoking
example1_en: An unlit cigar lay inside the small wooden box.
example1_ja: 小木盒里放着一支未点燃的雪茄。
example2_en: Public health campaigns should explain that smoking cigars also carries serious risks to health.
example2_ja: 公共卫生宣传应说明，抽雪茄同样会严重危害健康。
collocations: cigar smoke｜雪茄烟雾 ; cigar box｜雪茄盒 ; smoke a cigar｜抽雪茄
tip_ja: cigar是雪茄；cigarette是通常用纸卷制的香烟。

meanings_ja: adj. 相互的；彼此的 | adj. 共同的；共有的
definition_en: Felt or done by each person towards the other. | Shared by two or more people or groups.
example1_en: Our friendship grew through mutual trust and honest conversations.
example1_ja: 我们的友谊通过相互信任和坦诚交流而加深。
example2_en: Successful international cooperation depends on mutual respect and a willingness to address shared environmental challenges.
example2_ja: 成功的国际合作有赖于相互尊重，以及共同应对环境挑战的意愿。
collocations: mutual respect｜相互尊重 ; mutual benefit｜互利 ; mutual friend｜共同的朋友 ; by mutual agreement｜经双方同意
tip_ja: mutual friend是共同朋友，不是彼此的朋友。

meanings_ja: n. 善良；美德 | n. 营养；有益成分 | int. 天哪
definition_en: the quality of being kind and morally good | the substances in food that help keep you healthy | used to express surprise, worry, or shock
example1_en: Her goodness showed when she shared her last sandwich.
example1_ja: 她把最后一个三明治分给别人，显露出善良的本性。
example2_en: Steaming vegetables can preserve more of their natural goodness than boiling them for long periods.
example2_ja: 与长时间水煮相比，蒸蔬菜能保留更多天然营养。
collocations: out of the goodness of your heart｜纯粹出于好心 ; natural goodness｜天然营养 ; thank goodness｜谢天谢地 ; my goodness｜天哪
tip_ja: 作名词通常不可数；My goodness表示惊讶。

example1_ja: 车站后面的仓库存放着家具和厨房设备。
example2_en: Locating a warehouse near major transport routes can reduce delivery costs and improve supply chain efficiency.
example2_ja: 将仓库设在主要运输线路附近可以降低配送成本，提高供应链效率。
collocations: warehouse worker｜仓库工人 ; warehouse space｜仓储空间 ; automated warehouse｜自动化仓库
tip_ja: 指储存货物的大型建筑；动词用法较正式。

meanings_ja: n. 名声；名望
definition_en: The state of being known by many people.
example1_en: Despite her fame, the singer still shops locally.
example1_ja: 尽管很有名，这位歌手仍在附近购物。
example2_en: Although online platforms can bring sudden fame, public attention does not necessarily lead to a sustainable career.
example2_ja: 虽然网络平台能让人一夜成名，但公众关注并不一定带来可持续的职业发展。
collocations: achieve fame｜成名 ; rise to fame｜声名鹊起 ; international fame｜国际声誉 ; lasting fame｜长久的名声
tip_ja: fame通常不可数；形容词famous常接for。

meanings_ja: adj. 先前的；事先的
definition_en: existing or happening before something else
example1_en: You need prior permission to use this room.
example1_ja: 你需要事先获得许可才能使用这个房间。
example2_en: Applicants with prior experience in community work may adapt more quickly to roles in public services.
example2_ja: 有社区工作经验的申请者可能更快适应公共服务岗位。
collocations: prior experience｜先前的经验 ; prior knowledge｜已有知识 ; prior notice｜事先通知 ; prior to｜在……之前
tip_ja: prior常放名词前；prior to相当于before。

meanings_ja: n. 污水；生活污物
definition_en: Wastewater and human waste carried away through drains
example1_en: Untreated sewage flowed into the river after the storm.
example1_ja: 暴风雨过后，未经处理的污水流入了河里。
example2_en: Investing in modern sewage treatment facilities is essential for protecting freshwater ecosystems and maintaining public health.
example2_ja: 投资建设现代污水处理设施，对保护淡水生态系统和维护公共卫生至关重要。
collocations: raw sewage｜未经处理的污水 ; sewage treatment｜污水处理 ; sewage disposal｜污水处置 ; sewage system｜污水排放系统
tip_ja: 不可数；sewage是污水，sewer才是下水道。

meanings_ja: n. 比；比率
definition_en: A comparison showing the relative sizes of two quantities.
example1_en: Use a higher ratio of vegetables to rice.
example1_ja: 把蔬菜相对于米饭的比例调高一些。
example2_en: A lower ratio of students to teachers may allow schools to provide more individual support in classrooms.
example2_ja: 较低的生师比可能使学校能够在课堂上提供更多个别辅导。
collocations: the ratio of A to B｜A与B之比 ; student-teacher ratio｜生师比 ; a high ratio｜高比率
tip_ja: A与B之比用the ratio of A to B，注意顺序。

meanings_ja: n. 民意调查 | n. 投票；选举投票 | v. 调查民意；获得选票
definition_en: A survey asking people about their opinions or preferences | The process of voting in an election | To survey people's opinions, or receive votes in an election
example1_en: A local poll showed strong support for the park.
example1_ja: 一项当地民意调查显示，人们大力支持这座公园。
example2_en: Opinion polls can help governments understand public concerns, but their accuracy depends on how participants are selected.
example2_ja: 民意调查有助于政府了解公众关切，但其准确性取决于参与者的选择方式。
collocations: opinion poll｜民意调查 ; conduct a poll｜开展民意调查 ; go to the polls｜前往投票 ; poll results｜民调结果
tip_ja: 民调常用opinion poll；the polls指选举投票。

meanings_ja: n. 道路交叉口 | n. 交汇点；交集
definition_en: A place where two or more roads meet. | A point or area shared by things that cross or overlap.
example1_en: Turn left at the intersection beside the bakery.
example1_ja: 在面包店旁的交叉路口左转。
example2_en: Installing better lighting at busy intersections can reduce accidents and improve safety for pedestrians.
example2_ja: 在繁忙的交叉路口安装更好的照明设施，可以减少事故并提高行人的安全性。
collocations: busy intersection｜繁忙的交叉路口 ; at the intersection｜在交叉路口 ; the intersection of two sets｜两个集合的交集
tip_ja: 道路交叉口常用at an intersection。

meanings_ja: n. 周围环境；周围事物
definition_en: The places, objects, and conditions around a person or thing.
example1_en: We ate lunch in the peaceful surroundings of the garden.
example1_ja: 我们在花园宁静的环境中吃了午饭。
example2_en: Students may concentrate better in pleasant surroundings, especially when classrooms offer natural light and views of greenery.
example2_ja: 学生在舒适的环境中可能更容易集中注意力，尤其当教室采光自然且窗外有绿植时。
collocations: peaceful surroundings｜宁静的环境 ; natural surroundings｜自然环境 ; unfamiliar surroundings｜陌生的环境 ; pleasant surroundings｜舒适的环境
tip_ja: 始终用复数形式，作主语时谓语也用复数。

meanings_ja: adj. 难以忍受的
definition_en: Too unpleasant, painful, or intense to tolerate
example1_en: The heat became unbearable, so we rested in the shade.
example1_ja: 天气热得让人受不了，于是我们到阴凉处休息。
example2_en: Without adequate ventilation, summer temperatures in crowded housing can become unbearable, especially for older residents.
example2_ja: 如果通风不足，拥挤住宅内的夏季高温会令人难以忍受，尤其是对老年住户而言。
collocations: unbearable pain｜难以忍受的疼痛 ; unbearable heat｜难耐的酷热 ; unbearable noise｜令人无法忍受的噪声
tip_ja: 这里的bear指忍受；unbearable语气很强。

meanings_ja: n. 过滤器；滤网 | v. 过滤；筛选 | v. 缓缓透入；逐渐传开
definition_en: a device that removes unwanted substances from liquid or air | to remove unwanted substances or select information using particular conditions | to pass through or spread gradually
example1_en: The water filter needs replacing before we leave.
example1_ja: 我们出发前需要更换净水滤芯。
example2_en: Modern treatment plants filter wastewater to remove harmful substances before releasing it into local rivers.
example2_ja: 现代污水处理厂会过滤污水，去除有害物质后再将其排入当地河流。
collocations: air filter｜空气过滤器 ; filter out impurities｜滤除杂质 ; filter search results｜筛选搜索结果 ; light filters through｜光线透过
tip_ja: filter out后接被滤除的东西，不是保留下来的。

meanings_ja: v. 消耗；耗费 | v. 吃；喝 | v. 充满内心；吞噬
definition_en: to use resources, energy, or time | to eat food or drink liquids | to fill someone's mind or destroy something completely
example1_en: Our old heater consumes too much electricity in winter.
example1_ja: 我们那台旧取暖器冬天太耗电了。
example2_en: Households can reduce their environmental impact by consuming fewer resources and choosing products that last longer.
example2_ja: 家庭可以通过减少资源消耗、选择更耐用的产品来减轻对环境的影响。
collocations: consume energy｜消耗能源 ; consume food｜食用食物 ; be consumed by fear｜内心充满恐惧
tip_ja: 表示吃喝时比eat、drink正式；名词为consumption。

meanings_ja: adj. 许多的；众多的
definition_en: Existing in large numbers.
example1_en: Numerous birds gathered around the crumbs on our balcony.
example1_ja: 许多鸟聚在我们阳台上的面包屑周围。
example2_en: Numerous studies suggest that access to green spaces can improve the mental health of urban residents.
example2_ja: 众多研究表明，能方便地接触绿地有助于改善城市居民的心理健康。
collocations: numerous studies｜众多研究 ; numerous occasions｜许多场合 ; numerous benefits｜诸多益处
tip_ja: 修饰可数名词复数，不能直接修饰不可数名词。

meanings_ja: n. 速度；节奏 | n. 一步；步幅 | v. 来回踱步
definition_en: The speed at which someone moves or something happens | A single step taken when walking | To walk repeatedly back and forth, often when worried
example1_en: We slowed our pace so Grandma could catch up.
example1_ja: 我们放慢脚步，好让奶奶跟上。
example2_en: The rapid pace of technological change requires workers to update their skills throughout their careers.
example2_ja: 技术变革的快速步伐要求劳动者在整个职业生涯中不断更新技能。
collocations: at your own pace｜按自己的节奏 ; keep pace with｜与……同步 ; the pace of change｜变化的速度 ; pace up and down｜来回踱步
tip_ja: 按某种速度用at a ... pace；keep pace with指跟上。

meanings_ja: v. 害怕；担忧 | n. 恐惧；忧虑
definition_en: Feel very worried about something unpleasant that may happen. | Strong fear or worry about something that may happen.
example1_en: I dread driving on icy roads after dark.
example1_ja: 我很害怕天黑后在结冰的道路上开车。
example2_en: Many employees dread losing their jobs when new technologies begin to replace familiar tasks in the workplace.
example2_ja: 当新技术开始取代工作中的常规任务时，许多员工担心失去工作。
collocations: dread doing something｜害怕做某事 ; a sense of dread｜恐惧感 ; fill someone with dread｜使某人充满恐惧
tip_ja: 表示害怕做某事通常用 dread doing。

meanings_ja: n. 叙述；故事 | n. 解释性叙事；观点框架 | adj. 叙事的
definition_en: A description of connected events, real or imagined. | A particular account used to explain events and shape understanding. | Related to telling stories or describing connected events.
example1_en: Her travel diary contains a lively narrative of the journey.
example1_ja: 她的旅行日记生动地记述了这段旅程。
example2_en: Museums can use personal narratives to help visitors understand how historical events affected the lives of ordinary people.
example2_ja: 博物馆可以通过个人叙事，帮助参观者理解历史事件如何影响普通人的生活。
collocations: personal narrative｜个人叙事 ; dominant narrative｜主导叙事 ; narrative structure｜叙事结构
tip_ja: 作名词指故事或叙述；作形容词常修饰结构、技巧。

meanings_ja: n. 火山喷发 | n. 突然爆发
definition_en: a sudden release of lava, ash, and gases from a volcano | a sudden, forceful outbreak of an emotion or activity
example1_en: We watched the eruption from a safe distance.
example1_ja: 我们在安全距离外观看了火山喷发。
example2_en: A major volcanic eruption can disrupt air travel and affect the climate far beyond the surrounding region.
example2_ja: 大规模火山喷发可能扰乱航空出行，并影响远超周边地区的气候。
collocations: volcanic eruption｜火山喷发 ; an eruption of anger｜怒火的爆发 ; predict an eruption｜预测火山喷发
tip_ja: 常与volcanic搭配；也可指情绪等突然爆发。

meanings_ja: n. 条款 | n. 分句；从句
definition_en: A separate condition or requirement in a legal document. | A group of words containing a subject and a verb.
example1_en: One clause in our lease allows us to keep pets.
example1_ja: 我们的租约中有一项条款允许养宠物。
example2_en: Employment contracts should include a clause that clearly defines workers' rights to paid leave and flexible working.
example2_ja: 劳动合同应包含明确规定员工带薪休假和弹性工作权利的条款。
collocations: a clause in a contract｜合同中的条款 ; include a clause｜加入一项条款 ; main clause｜主句 ; relative clause｜关系从句
tip_ja: 语法中clause含主语和谓语；phrase通常不含。

meanings_ja: v. 订阅；订购 | v. 赞同；认同
definition_en: To arrange regular access to a publication or service. | To agree with a particular belief or view.
example1_en: We subscribe to a magazine full of easy recipes.
example1_ja: 我们订阅了一本介绍简单食谱的杂志。
example2_en: Many educators subscribe to the view that practical experience should complement theoretical learning in higher education.
example2_ja: 许多教育工作者赞同这样的观点：高等教育应将实践经验与理论学习相结合。
collocations: subscribe to a magazine｜订阅杂志 ; subscribe to a channel｜订阅频道 ; subscribe to the view that｜赞同……的观点
tip_ja: 订阅和赞同都常用subscribe to，to是介词。

meanings_ja: n. 鸟喙；鸟嘴
definition_en: The hard, pointed mouth of a bird.
example1_en: The sparrow carried a tiny seed in its beak.
example1_ja: 那只麻雀嘴里衔着一粒小小的种子。
example2_en: The shape of a bird's beak reflects its diet and adaptation to particular environmental conditions.
example2_ja: 鸟喙的形状反映了鸟的食性及其对特定环境条件的适应。
collocations: a sharp beak｜尖锐的鸟喙 ; a curved beak｜弯曲的鸟喙 ; in its beak｜在它的喙中
tip_ja: 鸟嘴可说beak或bill；人的嘴通常用mouth。

meanings_ja: n. 副歌 | n. 合唱团；齐声 | v. 齐声说；齐声唱
definition_en: A repeated section of a song, usually with unchanged words. | A group singing together, or many voices sounding together. | To say or sing something together at the same time.
example1_en: Everyone joined in when the song reached its chorus.
example1_ja: 歌曲唱到副歌时，大家都跟着唱了起来。
example2_en: A memorable chorus can help environmental campaign songs reach wider audiences and encourage participation in community activities.
example2_ja: 令人难忘的副歌可以帮助环保宣传歌曲吸引更广泛的听众，并鼓励人们参与社区活动。
collocations: sing the chorus｜唱副歌 ; join in the chorus｜加入副歌合唱 ; a chorus of approval｜一片赞同声
tip_ja: 歌曲的chorus是反复出现的副歌，与verse主歌相对。

meanings_ja: adj. 给予支持和帮助的
definition_en: giving help, encouragement, or understanding
example1_en: My supportive sister helped me practise before the interview.
example1_ja: 面试前，支持我的姐姐帮我做了练习。
example2_en: A supportive classroom environment encourages students to ask questions without worrying about making mistakes.
example2_ja: 充满支持的课堂环境能鼓励学生提问，而不必担心犯错。
collocations: a supportive family｜给予支持的家庭 ; a supportive environment｜支持性的环境 ; supportive of｜支持……的
tip_ja: 常用be supportive of表示支持某人或某事。

meanings_ja: adv. 完全地；彻底地
definition_en: completely, used to strongly emphasise a description
example1_en: I was utterly exhausted after carrying those heavy boxes.
example1_ja: 搬完那些沉重的箱子后，我累得筋疲力尽。
example2_en: Without reliable internet access, some rural students feel utterly excluded from opportunities offered by online education.
example2_ja: 由于缺乏可靠的网络连接，一些农村学生觉得自己完全无法获得在线教育提供的机会。
collocations: utterly exhausted｜筋疲力尽 ; utterly impossible｜完全不可能 ; utterly ridiculous｜荒谬至极
tip_ja: 常修饰强烈或负面形容词，如 impossible、ridiculous。

meanings_ja: adj. 民主的；民主制度的 | adj. 平等参与决策的
definition_en: Based on government by people or their elected representatives. | Allowing everyone involved an equal opportunity to influence decisions.
example1_en: Our club takes a democratic vote on every major decision.
example1_ja: 我们俱乐部对每一项重大决定都进行民主投票。
example2_en: A democratic society depends on informed citizens who can access reliable information and participate freely in public debate.
example2_ja: 民主社会有赖于了解公共事务的公民，他们能够获取可靠信息并自由参与公共讨论。
collocations: democratic society｜民主社会 ; democratic elections｜民主选举 ; democratic process｜民主程序 ; democratic principles｜民主原则
tip_ja: 小写democratic泛指民主的，不特指某个政党。

meanings_ja: n. 半岛
definition_en: Land almost surrounded by water but connected to a larger landmass.
example1_en: We cycled around the peninsula and stopped at a beach.
example1_ja: 我们骑车绕着半岛游览，在一处海滩停了下来。
example2_en: Tourism on the peninsula provides local employment, but excessive development could damage its fragile coastal habitats.
example2_ja: 半岛上的旅游业为当地提供了就业机会，但过度开发可能破坏其脆弱的沿海栖息地。
collocations: a narrow peninsula｜狭长的半岛 ; the tip of the peninsula｜半岛的尖端 ; on a peninsula｜在半岛上
tip_ja: 半岛与大陆相连；island指四面环水的岛。

meanings_ja: adj. 必定的；很可能的 | adj. 前往某地的 | v. 跳跃着跑
definition_en: Certain or very likely to happen | Travelling towards a particular destination | To move with long, energetic jumps
example1_en: You're bound to feel tired after such a long walk.
example1_ja: 走了这么远的路，你肯定会觉得累。
example2_en: Without adequate investment in public transport, growing cities are bound to experience increasingly severe traffic congestion.
example2_ja: 如果公共交通投入不足，不断发展的城市必然会面临日益严重的交通拥堵。
collocations: be bound to do｜必定会做 ; be bound for｜前往 ; bound by law｜受法律约束 ; bound up with｜与……密切相关
tip_ja: bound to后接动词；bound for后接目的地。

meanings_ja: n. 提交；提交的文件 | n. 屈服；服从
definition_en: the act of presenting something, or the material presented | accepting another person's authority or control
example1_en: Please check your application carefully before submission tomorrow morning.
example1_ja: 请在明早提交前仔细检查你的申请。
example2_en: Online submission of assignments can reduce paper consumption and allow teachers to provide feedback more efficiently.
example2_ja: 在线提交作业可以减少纸张消耗，并让教师更高效地提供反馈。
collocations: submission deadline｜提交截止日期 ; submission of an application｜申请的提交 ; a written submission｜提交的书面材料 ; submission to authority｜对权威的服从
tip_ja: 表示提交行为通常不可数；一份提交材料可数。

meanings_ja: n. 津贴；定期零用钱 | n. 限额；定量 | n. 体谅；酌情考虑
definition_en: Money given regularly to cover particular needs | An amount you are permitted to use or have | An adjustment made to account for someone's circumstances or difficulties
example1_en: My weekly allowance covers bus fares and occasional snacks.
example1_ja: 我每周的零用钱够支付公交车费，偶尔还能买些零食。
example2_en: A housing allowance can help essential workers afford accommodation in cities where rents are particularly high.
example2_ja: 住房津贴能够帮助必要岗位的工作人员负担租金特别高的城市中的住宿费用。
collocations: a housing allowance｜住房津贴 ; a daily allowance｜每日津贴 ; baggage allowance｜行李限额 ; make allowances for｜体谅；考虑到
tip_ja: 零用钱义常见于美式英语；英式常用pocket money。

meanings_ja: v. 走私；偷运；偷带
definition_en: To move goods or people secretly and against the rules.
example1_en: Someone tried to smuggle rare birds through the airport.
example1_ja: 有人试图通过机场偷运珍稀鸟类。
example2_en: Stronger international cooperation is needed to stop criminal groups that smuggle endangered animals across national borders.
example2_ja: 需要加强国际合作，以阻止跨境走私濒危动物的犯罪团伙。
collocations: smuggle goods｜走私货物 ; smuggle something into a country｜将某物走私入境 ; smuggle something across a border｜跨境偷运某物
tip_ja: 常用smuggle sth into/out of某地，表示偷运进出。

meanings_ja: v. 使十分惊讶
definition_en: To surprise someone very much.
example1_en: The magician's final trick astonished everyone in the room.
example1_ja: 魔术师最后的戏法让屋里的所有人都大吃一惊。
example2_en: The speed at which damaged forests recover can astonish even experienced environmental researchers.
example2_ja: 受损森林恢复的速度甚至会令经验丰富的环境研究人员惊讶。
collocations: astonish an audience｜使观众惊叹 ; be astonished at｜对……十分惊讶 ; be astonished to discover｜惊讶地发现
tip_ja: 人感到惊讶用astonished；事物令人惊讶用astonishing。

meanings_ja: adj. 现实的；切实可行的 | adj. 逼真的；写实的
definition_en: Based on what is actually possible or likely | Looking or sounding very much like real life
example1_en: Finishing this puzzle tonight is not a realistic goal.
example1_ja: 今晚完成这幅拼图不是一个现实的目标。
example2_en: Governments should set realistic targets for reducing emissions, taking economic conditions and available technology into account.
example2_ja: 政府应考虑经济状况和现有技术，为减排制定切实可行的目标。
collocations: realistic expectations｜现实的期望 ; set realistic goals｜制定切实可行的目标 ; a realistic portrait｜逼真的肖像
tip_ja: realistic强调符合现实或逼真，real强调真实存在。

meanings_ja: n. 珍珠
definition_en: A smooth, usually pale gem formed inside certain shellfish.
example1_en: A single pearl hung from her silver necklace.
example1_ja: 她的银项链上挂着一颗珍珠。
example2_en: Pearl farming can provide coastal communities with income, although its environmental effects depend on local management practices.
example2_ja: 珍珠养殖可以为沿海社区带来收入，但其环境影响取决于当地的管理方式。
collocations: pearl necklace｜珍珠项链 ; cultured pearl｜养殖珍珠 ; a string of pearls｜一串珍珠 ; pearls of wisdom｜智慧之言
tip_ja: a pearl是一颗珍珠；一串用a string of pearls。

meanings_ja: n. 寒冷；寒意 | v. 冷藏；使变冷 | v. 放松；休息
definition_en: An unpleasant feeling of cold in the air or body. | To make something cold, without necessarily freezing it. | To relax rather than work or worry.
example1_en: There was a chill in the air this morning.
example1_ja: 今天早晨空气中透着一股寒意。
example2_en: Food businesses should chill perishable products promptly to limit bacterial growth and protect public health.

meanings_ja: n. 外科医生
definition_en: a doctor trained to perform operations

meanings_ja: adj. 有活力的；积极进取的 | adj. 动态的；不断变化的 | n. 互动模式；作用关系
definition_en: Full of energy and eager to make things happen. | Continuously changing or developing. | A pattern of interaction between people or forces.

example1_ja: 我们精力充沛的教练让大家整节训练课都保持运动。

meanings_ja: n. 后续行动；跟进 | adj. 后续的；跟进的
definition_en: An action continuing or checking earlier work or treatment. | Done after something to continue it or check its results.

example2_en: A follow-up study is needed to determine whether the training programme produces lasting improvements in employment outcomes.

meanings_ja: n. 自雇；个体经营

example2_en: Although self-employment offers greater flexibility, it can also involve irregular income and limited access to employment benefits.
example2_ja: 虽然自雇更灵活，但也可能意味着收入不稳定，且难以享有雇员福利。
collocations: go into self-employment｜开始自雇 ; income from self-employment｜自雇收入 ; self-employment opportunities｜自雇机会
tip_ja: 不可数；指为自己工作，不一定是创办公司。

meanings_ja: prep. 在……旁边；与……一起 | adv. 在旁边
definition_en: Beside someone or something, or together with them. | In a position beside someone or something.

example1_ja: 我沿着河边骑车，与姐姐并排而行。
example2_en: Schools should teach practical skills alongside academic subjects to prepare students for adult life.
example2_ja: 学校应在教授学术课程的同时传授实用技能，帮助学生为成年生活做好准备。
collocations: work alongside｜与……共事 ; alongside the river｜在河边 ; alongside other measures｜与其他措施同时

meanings_ja: n. 物质 | n. 实质；要旨 | n. 实质内容；根据
definition_en: A particular type of material with specific physical properties. | The central meaning or most important content of something. | Meaningful content or a solid basis for belief.
example1_en: A sticky substance had leaked onto the kitchen floor.
example1_ja: 一种黏糊糊的物质漏到了厨房地板上。
example2_en: Factories must prevent harmful substances from entering rivers, as contaminated water threatens both wildlife and human health.
example2_ja: 工厂必须防止有害物质进入河流，因为受污染的水会威胁野生动物和人类健康。
collocations: harmful substances｜有害物质 ; chemical substance｜化学物质 ; the substance of｜……的实质 ; lack substance｜缺乏实质内容

meanings_ja: adj. 幸运的；侥幸的
definition_en: Having good luck or experiencing a favourable outcome
example1_en: We were fortunate to find shelter before the storm.
example1_ja: 我们很幸运，在暴风雨来临前找到了避雨处。
example2_en: Students with reliable internet access are fortunate, as many rural communities still lack adequate digital infrastructure.
example2_ja: 能稳定上网的学生是幸运的，因为许多农村社区仍缺乏完善的数字基础设施。
collocations: fortunate enough to｜足够幸运能够 ; fortunate to have｜有幸拥有 ; a fortunate escape｜侥幸逃脱
tip_ja: 常用 be fortunate to do，表示有幸做某事。

meanings_ja: adj. 有害的
definition_en: causing or likely to cause damage or injury
example1_en: Too much direct sunlight can be harmful to your skin.
example1_ja: 过多的阳光直射会伤害你的皮肤。
example2_en: Stricter controls on industrial waste could reduce the harmful effects of water pollution on local ecosystems.
example2_ja: 加强对工业废物的管控，可以减少水污染对当地生态系统的有害影响。
collocations: harmful to health｜有害健康 ; harmful effects｜有害影响 ; harmful substances｜有害物质 ; potentially harmful｜可能有害的
tip_ja: 表示对……有害用harmful to，不用harmful for。

meanings_ja: n. 矿物；矿物质 | adj. 矿物的；矿产的
definition_en: a natural substance found in rocks, soil, food, or water | relating to minerals found in the earth
example1_en: The museum displayed a mineral with bright purple crystals.
example1_ja: 博物馆展出了一块带有亮紫色晶体的矿物。
example2_en: Countries with abundant mineral resources need effective regulations to limit the environmental damage caused by mining.
example2_ja: 矿产资源丰富的国家需要有效的法规，以限制采矿造成的环境破坏。
collocations: mineral resources｜矿产资源 ; mineral deposits｜矿床 ; essential minerals｜必需矿物质 ; mineral water｜矿泉水
tip_ja: 营养语境中minerals指矿物质，不等于维生素。

meanings_ja: adv. 纯粹地；仅仅
definition_en: Only for the stated reason or in the stated way.

example1_ja: 我买这台小相机纯粹是为了好玩。
example2_en: University education should not be judged purely by graduates' salaries, as it also brings wider social benefits.
example2_ja: 不应仅凭毕业生的薪资评价大学教育，因为它还带来更广泛的社会效益。
collocations: purely by chance｜纯属偶然 ; purely for pleasure｜纯粹为了乐趣 ; purely personal｜纯属个人的 ; purely theoretical｜纯理论的
tip_ja: 常放在for、by或形容词前，强调不含其他因素。

meanings_ja: n. 重要性；意义 | n. 含义
definition_en: the importance of something, especially its effects | the special meaning that something carries or suggests
example1_en: I finally understood the significance of her quiet smile.
example1_ja: 我终于明白了她那淡淡微笑中的含义。
example2_en: The discovery has considerable significance for scientists seeking cleaner and more affordable sources of energy.
example2_ja: 这一发现对寻找更清洁、更经济能源的科学家具有重要意义。
collocations: great significance｜重大意义 ; historical significance｜历史意义 ; the significance of｜……的重要性或含义 ; attach significance to｜重视
tip_ja: be of great significance相当于be very significant。

meanings_ja: n. 乐意；意愿
definition_en: The readiness to do something without needing to be forced.
example1_en: Her willingness to help made the move much easier.
example1_ja: 她乐意帮忙，让这次搬家轻松了许多。
example2_en: Students' willingness to ask questions often increases when teachers create a supportive classroom environment.
example2_ja: 教师营造支持性的课堂环境时，学生提问的意愿往往会增强。
collocations: willingness to learn｜学习意愿 ; show willingness｜表现出意愿 ; a willingness to cooperate｜合作的意愿
tip_ja: 不可数名词，常接to do表示做某事的意愿。

meanings_ja: n. 技术员；技师

example2_en: Laboratory technicians play an essential role in medical research by preparing samples and maintaining specialist equipment.
example2_ja: 实验室技术员通过准备样本和维护专业设备，在医学研究中发挥重要作用。

meanings_ja: v. 拥有；持有 | v. 具有；具备

example1_ja: 我叔叔拥有一批令人惊叹的古董钟藏品。
example2_en: Graduates who possess strong communication skills are often better prepared to adapt to changing workplace demands.
example2_ja: 具备较强沟通能力的毕业生通常更能适应不断变化的职场要求。
collocations: possess skills｜具备技能 ; possess knowledge｜掌握知识 ; possess property｜拥有财产

meanings_ja: n. 大豆；大豆制品 | n. 酱油

example2_ja: 大豆提供植物蛋白，但若不负责任地开垦土地，扩大种植可能威胁森林。
collocations: soy milk｜豆奶 ; soy sauce｜酱油 ; soy protein｜大豆蛋白 ; soy products｜大豆制品
tip_ja: 英式英语也常用soya；“酱油”通常说soy sauce。

meanings_ja: v. 下降；衰退 | n. 下降；衰退 | v. 谢绝；婉拒

meanings_ja: n. 受挫感；懊恼

meanings_ja: n. 转变；过渡时期 | v. 转变；过渡

meanings_ja: n. 游艇；帆船

meanings_ja: n. 灯笼；提灯
