meanings_ja: n. 羡慕；嫉妒 | v. 羡慕；嫉妒 | n. 令人羡慕的人或事物
definition_en: a feeling of wanting something that someone else has | to wish you had another person's possessions, qualities, or advantages | a person or thing that others wish to equal or possess
example1_en: I envy your ability to sleep on noisy trains.
example1_ja: 我真羡慕你能在嘈杂的火车上睡着。
example2_en: Social media can encourage envy by exposing users to carefully selected images of other people's achievements and lifestyles.
example2_ja: 社交媒体让用户接触他人精心挑选的成就和生活方式图片，可能引发羡慕或嫉妒。
collocations: envy someone something｜羡慕某人拥有某物 ; with envy｜羡慕地 ; the envy of｜令……羡慕的人或事物 ; green with envy｜十分嫉妒
tip_ja: 动词直接接宾语：envy someone，不加of。

meanings_ja: n. 假定；未经证实的看法 | n. 承担；就任
definition_en: Something accepted as true without definite proof. | The act of taking on responsibility, power, or a role.
example1_en: My assumption that the shop opened early was wrong.
example1_ja: 我以为这家店很早开门，结果想错了。
example2_en: The assumption that all young people possess advanced digital skills may lead to inadequate support in schools.
example2_ja: 认为所有年轻人都具备高级数字技能的假设，可能导致学校提供的支持不足。
collocations: make an assumption｜作出假设 ; underlying assumption｜隐含假设 ; challenge an assumption｜质疑假设 ; assumption of responsibility｜承担责任
tip_ja: 常用assumption that从句，表示未经证实的看法。

meanings_ja: n. 危机；紧要关头
definition_en: a serious situation requiring urgent decisions or action
example1_en: The broken water pipe caused a crisis at home.
example1_ja: 水管破裂让家里陷入了困境。
example2_en: The housing crisis has forced many young adults to delay moving into their own homes.
example2_ja: 住房危机迫使许多年轻人推迟搬进自己的住所。
collocations: face a crisis｜面临危机 ; housing crisis｜住房危机 ; crisis management｜危机管理 ; in times of crisis｜在危机时期
tip_ja: 复数为crises /ˈkraɪsiːz/，注意词尾发音。

meanings_ja: n. 标识；徽标
definition_en: a design or symbol that represents an organisation or product
example1_en: The bakery uses a wheat stalk as its logo.
example1_ja: 这家面包店用一支麦穗作为徽标。
example2_en: A distinctive logo helps consumers recognise a company, but product quality is essential for building lasting trust.
example2_ja: 独特的徽标帮助消费者识别企业，但产品质量才是建立持久信任的关键。
collocations: company logo｜公司徽标 ; design a logo｜设计徽标 ; distinctive logo｜独特的徽标
tip_ja: logo指视觉标识；slogan指宣传口号。

meanings_ja: v. 开花 | n. 花朵；开花 | v. 蓬勃发展；焕发光彩
definition_en: To produce flowers. | A flower, or the state of producing flowers. | To develop successfully or become more confident and attractive.
example1_en: The roses bloom beside our kitchen window every summer.
example1_ja: 每年夏天，玫瑰都在我们的厨房窗边盛开。
example2_en: Urban gardens that bloom throughout spring and summer provide valuable food sources for bees and other pollinators.
example2_ja: 春夏持续开花的城市花园为蜜蜂及其他传粉动物提供了宝贵的食物来源。
collocations: in full bloom｜盛开 ; come into bloom｜开始开花 ; spring blooms｜春日花朵
tip_ja: bloom可作动词；表示正在开花用in bloom。

meanings_ja: n. 座位间过道；货架间通道
definition_en: a passage between rows of seats or shelves
example1_en: Please keep your bag out of the aisle.
example1_ja: 请不要把包放在过道上。
example2_en: Wider supermarket aisles can improve accessibility for wheelchair users and make shopping more comfortable for everyone.
example2_ja: 更宽的超市通道能方便轮椅使用者通行，也能让所有人购物时更加舒适。
collocations: aisle seat｜靠过道的座位 ; supermarket aisle｜超市货架间通道 ; walk down the aisle｜沿过道走；结婚
tip_ja: s不发音，与isle同音；aisle seat是靠过道座位。

meanings_ja: n. 祖先；祖宗 | n. 祖先物种；原型
definition_en: a family member who lived several generations before you | an earlier species or form from which something developed
example1_en: One of my ancestors built this old stone house.
example1_ja: 我的一位祖先建造了这座古老的石屋。
example2_en: Studying how our ancestors adapted to environmental change can offer insights into human resilience.
example2_ja: 研究祖先如何适应环境变化，可以帮助我们理解人类的适应能力。
collocations: common ancestor｜共同祖先 ; distant ancestor｜远祖 ; human ancestors｜人类祖先
tip_ja: ancestor指祖先；descendant指后代。

meanings_ja: adj. 占有欲强的 | adj. 所有格的；表示所属的
definition_en: Wanting exclusive control over someone or something. | Showing who owns something or how things are related.
example1_en: My little brother is possessive about his toy trains.
example1_ja: 我弟弟对他的玩具火车占有欲很强。
example2_en: Possessive behaviour in friendships can limit personal freedom and make it difficult to maintain healthy relationships.
example2_ja: 友谊中的占有行为会限制个人自由，使健康关系难以维持。
collocations: possessive about｜对……占有欲强 ; possessive behaviour｜占有欲强的行为 ; possessive pronoun｜物主代词 ; possessive form｜所有格形式
tip_ja: 对物占有欲强常用about；语法中指所属关系。

meanings_ja: adj. 积极的；有动力的 | adj. 出于某种动机的
definition_en: Eager and willing to work towards a goal. | Driven by a particular reason or purpose.
example1_en: I feel more motivated after exercising in the morning.
example1_ja: 早晨运动之后，我感觉更有干劲。
example2_en: Students are more likely to remain motivated when teachers provide constructive feedback and achievable goals.
example2_ja: 当教师提供建设性反馈和可实现的目标时，学生更有可能保持学习动力。
collocations: highly motivated｜积极性很高的 ; stay motivated｜保持动力 ; motivated by profit｜受利润驱动的
tip_ja: motivated to do表示有动力做；by引出动机。

meanings_ja: n. 气味；异味
definition_en: A noticeable smell, especially an unpleasant one.
example1_en: A strange odour came from the kitchen bin.
example1_ja: 厨房垃圾桶里飘出一股怪味。
example2_en: Residents may oppose new waste facilities if they expect unpleasant odours to affect their quality of life.
example2_ja: 如果居民预计难闻的气味会影响生活质量，他们可能会反对新建垃圾处理设施。
collocations: an unpleasant odour｜难闻的气味 ; a strong odour｜强烈的气味 ; body odour｜体味 ; odour control｜异味控制
tip_ja: 英式拼写odour，美式odor；常指难闻气味。

meanings_ja: v. 使变软；变软 | v. 缓和；减轻
definition_en: To become softer or make something softer | To make something less harsh, severe, or forceful
example1_en: Leave the butter outside the fridge to soften.
example1_ja: 把黄油放在冰箱外，让它变软。
example2_en: Additional financial support could soften the impact of rising energy prices on poorer households.
example2_ja: 额外的经济援助可以减轻能源价格上涨对较贫困家庭的影响。
collocations: soften butter｜使黄油变软 ; soften the impact｜减轻影响 ; soften your tone｜缓和语气
tip_ja: 既可及物也可不及物：热使黄油变软，黄油也会自行变软。

meanings_ja: n. 重大突破；重大进展
definition_en: An important discovery or advance that overcomes a difficult problem.
example1_en: After weeks of practice, I finally made a breakthrough.
example1_ja: 练习了几周后，我终于取得了突破。
example2_en: A breakthrough in battery technology could make renewable energy more reliable and affordable for households.
example2_ja: 电池技术的突破可能使可再生能源对家庭而言更加可靠、更加经济。
collocations: make a breakthrough｜取得突破 ; scientific breakthrough｜科学突破 ; breakthrough in treatment｜治疗方面的突破
tip_ja: 名词写成一个词；动词短语break through分开写。

meanings_ja: n. 惯例；习俗 | n. 大会；代表大会 | n. 国际公约；协定
definition_en: An accepted way of behaving or doing something. | A large meeting of people with shared interests or work. | A formal agreement between countries about a particular issue.
example1_en: By convention, guests wait until everyone is seated before eating.
example1_ja: 按照惯例，客人等所有人落座后才开始用餐。
example2_en: An international convention can strengthen environmental protection by establishing shared responsibilities for participating countries.
example2_ja: 国际公约可以通过确立参与国的共同责任来加强环境保护。
collocations: social convention｜社会习俗 ; annual convention｜年度大会 ; international convention｜国际公约 ; by convention｜按照惯例
tip_ja: 惯例与大会通常可数；by convention意为按惯例。

meanings_ja: n. 批准；许可 | n. 赞同；认可
definition_en: official permission for something to happen | a positive opinion of someone or something
example1_en: We need the landlord's approval before painting the kitchen.
example1_ja: 粉刷厨房前，我们需要得到房东的许可。
example2_en: New housing projects should receive approval only when developers demonstrate that adequate transport and public services will be provided.
example2_ja: 开发商只有证明能提供充足的交通和公共服务，新住宅项目才应获批。
collocations: obtain approval｜获得批准 ; seek approval｜寻求批准 ; give approval｜给予许可 ; meet with approval｜得到认可
tip_ja: approval of常指赞同；approval for常指项目许可。

meanings_ja: adj. 难忘的；值得记住的
definition_en: Special or unusual enough to be remembered for a long time.
example1_en: That snowy train journey was a truly memorable experience.
example1_ja: 那次雪中火车之旅真是一次难忘的经历。
example2_en: Practical experiments often make science lessons more memorable by connecting abstract ideas with direct experience.
example2_ja: 实际操作的实验将抽象概念与亲身体验联系起来，往往使科学课更令人难忘。
collocations: memorable experience｜难忘的经历 ; memorable occasion｜难忘的时刻 ; memorable performance｜令人难忘的表演
tip_ja: memorable形容事物难忘，不表示某人记忆力好。

meanings_ja: v. 减轻重量或负担 | v. 变亮；使变浅 | v. 使轻松；使愉快
definition_en: to make something less heavy or less demanding | to become or make something brighter or paler | to make a mood or atmosphere more cheerful
example1_en: I removed two books to lighten my backpack.
example1_ja: 我拿出了两本书，让背包轻一些。
example2_en: Employers can lighten staff workloads by simplifying administrative procedures and providing better tools for routine tasks.
example2_ja: 雇主可以通过简化行政流程、为日常任务提供更好的工具来减轻员工的工作负担。
collocations: lighten the load｜减轻负担 ; lighten the mood｜活跃气氛 ; lighten a colour｜使颜色变浅
tip_ja: lighten可指减负或变亮；lighten up常指放轻松。

meanings_ja: v. 误导；使产生错误认识
definition_en: to cause someone to believe something incorrect
example1_en: The photograph misled me about the apartment's actual size.
example1_ja: 那张照片让我误判了公寓的实际大小。
example2_en: Advertisements can mislead consumers into believing that expensive products always offer better quality than cheaper alternatives.
example2_ja: 广告可能误导消费者，使他们相信昂贵产品的质量总比便宜的替代品更好。
collocations: mislead consumers｜误导消费者 ; mislead someone into believing｜误导某人相信 ; deliberately mislead｜故意误导
tip_ja: 过去式和过去分词均为misled；常接into doing。

meanings_ja: adj. 令人担忧的；惊人的
definition_en: Causing worry or fear that something bad may happen.
example1_en: The engine made an alarming noise as we climbed.
example1_ja: 我们上坡时，发动机发出了令人不安的声音。
example2_en: The alarming decline in insect populations could threaten food production and disrupt entire ecosystems.
example2_ja: 昆虫数量令人担忧的下降可能威胁粮食生产，并扰乱整个生态系统。
collocations: an alarming rate｜惊人的速度 ; an alarming increase｜令人担忧的增长 ; an alarming trend｜令人担忧的趋势
tip_ja: alarming形容事物令人担忧；alarmed形容人感到惊恐。

meanings_ja: adj. 外部的；外面的 | adj. 来自外部的
definition_en: Located on the outside of something. | Coming from outside a particular organisation, system, or situation.
example1_en: The builders painted the external walls pale yellow.
example1_ja: 建筑工人把外墙刷成了淡黄色。
example2_en: Universities often rely on external funding to conduct research that cannot be supported by tuition fees alone.
example2_ja: 大学经常依赖外部资金，开展仅靠学费无法支持的研究。
collocations: external walls｜外墙 ; external factors｜外部因素 ; external funding｜外部资金 ; for external use only｜仅供外用
tip_ja: external与internal相对；药品上指外用的。

meanings_ja: v. 表扬；赞扬 | n. 表扬；赞美
definition_en: To express approval or admiration for someone or something. | Words expressing approval or admiration.
example1_en: Our coach praised us for helping the new players.
example1_ja: 教练表扬了我们帮助新队员的举动。
example2_en: Teachers who praise effort rather than natural ability may encourage students to persist when facing academic challenges.
example2_ja: 表扬努力而非天赋的教师，可能更能鼓励学生在学业遇到挑战时坚持下去。
collocations: praise someone for something｜因某事表扬某人 ; win praise｜赢得赞誉 ; high praise｜高度赞扬 ; lavish praise on｜大加赞扬
tip_ja: praise sb for sth；名词通常不可数。

meanings_ja: n. 外科手术；外科学 | n. 诊所；诊疗室
definition_en: Medical treatment involving cutting into the body to repair damage. | A place where a doctor or dentist sees patients.
example1_en: My uncle is recovering well after knee surgery.
example1_ja: 我叔叔做完膝关节手术后恢复得很好。
example2_en: Advances in medical technology have made many types of surgery safer and reduced patients' recovery times.
example2_ja: 医疗技术的进步提高了多种手术的安全性，并缩短了患者的康复时间。
collocations: undergo surgery｜接受手术 ; emergency surgery｜急诊手术 ; minor surgery｜小手术 ; a doctor's surgery｜医生诊所
tip_ja: 手术义通常不可数；英式英语中诊所义可数。

meanings_ja: adv. 向南；朝南 | adj. 向南的；朝南的
definition_en: towards the south | moving or pointing towards the south
example1_en: We drove southward until we reached the coast.
example1_ja: 我们一直向南开车，直到抵达海岸。
example2_en: The southward movement of some marine species may reflect changes in ocean temperatures and food availability.
example2_ja: 一些海洋物种向南迁移，可能反映了海水温度和食物供应的变化。
collocations: move southward｜向南移动 ; southward migration｜向南迁徙 ; southward journey｜向南的旅程
tip_ja: southward兼作形容词和副词；southwards仅作副词。

meanings_ja: n. 拱；拱门；拱形结构 | v. 拱起；使成弓形
definition_en: A curved structure spanning an opening or supporting weight | To bend into a curved shape
example1_en: We sheltered from the rain beneath a stone arch.
example1_ja: 我们在一座石拱门下避雨。
example2_en: Traditional bridges often use a central arch to distribute weight and allow boats to pass beneath.
example2_ja: 传统桥梁常用中央拱形结构来分散重量，并让船只从下方通过。
collocations: stone arch｜石拱 ; arch bridge｜拱桥 ; arch your back｜弓起背部
tip_ja: 作动词表示弯成拱形，如arch your back。

meanings_ja: n. 可能的影响；后果 | n. 言外之意；暗示 | n. 牵连；涉及
definition_en: a possible effect or consequence of an action or decision | an idea suggested without being stated directly | involvement in something wrong or illegal
example1_en: We discussed the financial implications of buying a puppy.
example1_ja: 我们讨论了买小狗可能带来的经济负担。
example2_en: Policymakers must consider the long-term implications of automation for employment, education, and social equality.
example2_ja: 政策制定者必须考虑自动化对就业、教育和社会平等的长期影响。
collocations: implications for employment｜对就业的潜在影响 ; far-reaching implications｜深远的影响 ; by implication｜以暗示的方式
tip_ja: 表示潜在影响常用复数 implications，后接 for。

meanings_ja: adj. 三倍的；三部分的 | v. 增至三倍；使成三倍
definition_en: Three times as much, or consisting of three parts. | To become three times as much, or make something so.
example1_en: The hotel charges triple the price during holidays.
example1_ja: 这家酒店在假日期间收取平时三倍的价格。
example2_en: Demand for renewable energy could triple as governments introduce stricter limits on carbon emissions.
example2_ja: 随着各国政府对碳排放实施更严格的限制，可再生能源需求可能增至三倍。
collocations: triple the cost｜三倍的费用 ; triple room｜三人间 ; triple in size｜规模增至三倍 ; triple glazing｜三层玻璃
tip_ja: triple表示变为原来的三倍，即增加两倍。

meanings_ja: adj. 基因的；遗传的
definition_en: relating to genes or characteristics passed from parents to offspring
example1_en: The doctor explained how genetic factors affect eye colour.
example1_ja: 医生解释了遗传因素如何影响眼睛的颜色。
example2_en: Genetic research may help doctors identify health risks before patients develop any noticeable symptoms.
example2_ja: 基因研究可能帮助医生在患者出现明显症状之前识别健康风险。
collocations: genetic factors｜遗传因素 ; genetic variation｜遗传变异 ; genetic engineering｜基因工程 ; genetic disorder｜遗传性疾病
tip_ja: genetic指基因或遗传的；genetics是遗传学。

meanings_ja: n. 鸵鸟
definition_en: a very large flightless bird with long legs and neck
example1_en: The ostrich ran quickly across the dusty grassland.
example1_ja: 那只鸵鸟飞快地跑过尘土飞扬的草原。
example2_en: Although the ostrich cannot fly, its powerful legs allow it to escape many predators in open habitats.
example2_ja: 虽然鸵鸟不会飞，但它强壮的双腿使它能在开阔的栖息地逃脱许多捕食者。
collocations: ostrich egg｜鸵鸟蛋 ; ostrich feather｜鸵鸟羽毛 ; ostrich farm｜鸵鸟养殖场
tip_ja: 复数为ostriches；“埋头沙中逃避”并非真实习性。

meanings_ja: n. 营养；营养摄取 | n. 营养学
definition_en: the process of obtaining and using food for health | the study of how food affects health and growth
example1_en: Good nutrition helps children grow and stay active.
example1_ja: 良好的营养有助于儿童成长并保持活力。
example2_en: Schools should teach nutrition so that young people can make informed choices about their daily diets.
example2_ja: 学校应教授营养知识，让年轻人能够在了解相关信息的基础上选择日常饮食。
collocations: good nutrition｜良好的营养 ; adequate nutrition｜充足的营养 ; nutrition education｜营养教育
tip_ja: nutrition不可数；nutrient指具体的营养物质。

meanings_ja: n. 创造；创作；建立 | n. 创作物；作品
definition_en: the process of bringing something new into existence | something new that someone has made or designed
example1_en: The creation of our garden took several busy weekends.
example1_ja: 我们忙了好几个周末才建好花园。
example2_en: Investment in renewable energy can support job creation while helping countries reduce their dependence on fossil fuels.
example2_ja: 投资可再生能源可以促进就业，同时帮助各国减少对化石燃料的依赖。
collocations: job creation｜创造就业机会 ; the creation of wealth｜财富的创造 ; an original creation｜原创作品
tip_ja: 指创造过程通常不可数；指具体作品时可数。

meanings_ja: v. 腐烂；腐朽 | n. 腐烂；腐朽 | n. 衰败；衰退
definition_en: to gradually break down through natural processes | the natural process of rotting or breaking down | a gradual loss of strength, quality, or importance
example1_en: Fallen leaves decay slowly beneath the trees each winter.
example1_ja: 每到冬天，落叶都会在树下慢慢腐烂。
example2_en: Urban decay often accelerates when public infrastructure is neglected and businesses move away from residential neighbourhoods.
example2_ja: 当公共基础设施缺乏维护、企业迁离居民区时，城市衰败往往会加速。
collocations: tooth decay｜蛀牙；龋齿 ; urban decay｜城市衰败 ; decaying vegetation｜腐烂的植物 ; prevent decay｜防止腐烂
tip_ja: 名词通常不可数；tooth decay指龋齿，不是掉牙。

meanings_ja: n. 维护；保养；维修 | n. 维持；保持 | n. 抚养费；赡养费
definition_en: work needed to keep something in good condition | the act of keeping a condition or situation unchanged | money paid regularly to support a child or former spouse
example1_en: Regular maintenance keeps my old bicycle safe to ride.
example1_ja: 定期保养让我的旧自行车骑起来依然安全。
example2_en: Governments should budget for the long-term maintenance of public infrastructure rather than focusing solely on new construction.
example2_ja: 政府应为公共基础设施的长期维护安排预算，而不应只关注新建工程。
collocations: routine maintenance｜日常维护 ; maintenance costs｜维护费用 ; the maintenance of standards｜标准的维持 ; child maintenance｜子女抚养费
tip_ja: 通常不可数；拼写不是maintainance。

meanings_ja: n. 哺乳动物
definition_en: A warm-blooded animal whose females produce milk for their young.
example1_en: A dolphin is a mammal, even though it lives underwater.
example1_ja: 海豚虽然生活在水下，却是哺乳动物。
example2_en: Protecting marine mammals requires international cooperation because these animals often migrate across the waters of several countries.
example2_ja: 保护海洋哺乳动物需要国际合作，因为这些动物经常跨越多个国家的水域迁徙。
collocations: marine mammal｜海洋哺乳动物 ; small mammal｜小型哺乳动物 ; mammal species｜哺乳动物物种
tip_ja: 鲸和海豚也是哺乳动物；不能按栖息地判断。

meanings_ja: adj. 精神的；心灵的 | adj. 宗教的
definition_en: Connected with inner feelings and meaning rather than material things. | Related to religious beliefs or experiences.
example1_en: Walking quietly in the forest gives me spiritual comfort.
example1_ja: 在森林里静静散步能给我心灵上的慰藉。
example2_en: Public spaces can support spiritual well-being by offering residents peaceful places for reflection and connection with nature.
example2_ja: 公共空间可以为居民提供安静思考和亲近自然的场所，从而促进精神健康。
collocations: spiritual well-being｜精神健康 ; spiritual beliefs｜宗教信仰 ; spiritual growth｜心灵成长
tip_ja: 可指心灵层面，不一定涉及宗教。

meanings_ja: adj. 每季度的 | adv. 每季度一次地 | n. 季刊
definition_en: Happening or produced every three months. | Once every three months. | A magazine published every three months.
example1_en: Our club holds quarterly meetings at the local library.
example1_ja: 我们俱乐部每季度在当地的图书馆开一次会。
example2_en: Quarterly reports allow investors to monitor company performance and identify emerging financial risks throughout the year.
example2_ja: 季度报告让投资者能够全年跟踪公司的表现，并识别新出现的财务风险。
collocations: quarterly report｜季度报告 ; quarterly meeting｜季度会议 ; pay quarterly｜按季度付款
tip_ja: quarterly指每三个月一次，不是每四个月一次。

meanings_ja: v. 占据；占用 | v. 占领 | v. 使忙于
definition_en: to fill or use a space, place, or period | to take and maintain control of a place by force | to keep someone busy or interested
example1_en: These old boxes occupy most of our spare room.
example1_ja: 这些旧箱子占了我们闲置房间的大部分空间。
example2_en: Private cars occupy valuable urban space that could otherwise accommodate parks, cycle lanes, or wider pavements.
example2_ja: 私家车占用了宝贵的城市空间，而这些空间本可用于建设公园、自行车道或更宽的人行道。
collocations: occupy space｜占用空间 ; occupy a position｜担任职位 ; occupy yourself with｜使自己忙于
tip_ja: 忙于某事可用be occupied with或in doing。

meanings_ja: n. 卵石；小圆石
definition_en: A small, smooth stone, often found near water.
example1_en: A smooth grey pebble lay beside my wet shoes.
example1_ja: 我的湿鞋旁躺着一颗光滑的灰色卵石。
example2_en: Removing pebbles from beaches can disturb coastal habitats and reduce natural protection against erosion.
example2_ja: 从海滩上移走卵石可能扰乱沿海栖息地，并削弱抵御侵蚀的天然屏障。
collocations: a smooth pebble｜光滑的卵石 ; a pebble beach｜卵石海滩 ; collect pebbles｜捡卵石
tip_ja: pebble强调小而光滑；stone泛指石头。

meanings_ja: n. 运动场；球场 | n. 音高 | v. 推介；推销
definition_en: An area of ground used for outdoor team sports. | How high or low a sound is. | Present an idea or product to persuade someone to accept it.
example1_en: The players ran onto the pitch despite the rain.
example1_ja: 尽管下着雨，球员们还是跑进了球场。
example2_en: Young entrepreneurs often pitch their business ideas to investors who can provide funding and practical guidance.
example2_ja: 年轻创业者经常向能够提供资金和实用指导的投资者推介商业构想。
collocations: football pitch｜足球场 ; high pitch｜高音 ; pitch an idea｜推介想法 ; pitch a tent｜搭帐篷
tip_ja: 球场义常见于英式英语；pitch a tent意为搭帐篷。

meanings_ja: adj. 极少的；最低限度的
definition_en: very small in amount or as little as possible
example1_en: These plants need minimal care, even during hot weather.
example1_ja: 这些植物即使在炎热天气里也只需极少的照料。
example2_en: Well-designed buildings can maintain comfortable indoor temperatures with minimal energy use, reducing both costs and emissions.
example2_ja: 设计良好的建筑能以极低的能耗保持舒适的室内温度，同时降低成本和排放。
collocations: minimal impact｜极小的影响 ; minimal effort｜极少的努力 ; minimal risk｜极低的风险 ; minimal supervision｜极少的监督
tip_ja: minimal 指极少或最低限度，不一定表示完全没有。

meanings_ja: n. 消失；失踪 | n. 消亡；不复存在
definition_en: The act of vanishing or becoming impossible to find. | The process of gradually ceasing to exist.
example1_en: The disappearance of my keys made me late again.
example1_ja: 我的钥匙不见了，害得我又迟到了。
example2_en: The gradual disappearance of traditional crafts reflects changing lifestyles and declining demand for handmade goods.
example2_ja: 传统手工艺逐渐消亡，反映出生活方式的变化以及手工制品需求的下降。
collocations: sudden disappearance｜突然消失 ; mysterious disappearance｜神秘失踪 ; gradual disappearance｜逐渐消亡
tip_ja: 常接of说明消失的人或物；动词为disappear。

meanings_ja: n. 陶工；制陶者 | v. 悠闲地做琐事
definition_en: someone who makes pots and other objects from clay | to spend time doing small tasks without hurrying
example1_en: The potter shaped a bowl with her wet hands.
example1_ja: 陶工用湿润的双手捏出了一个碗。
example2_en: Local potters can preserve traditional skills while attracting visitors interested in the region's cultural heritage.
example2_ja: 当地陶工既能保护传统技艺，也能吸引对该地区文化遗产感兴趣的游客。
collocations: a skilled potter｜熟练的陶工 ; a potter's wheel｜陶轮 ; potter about the garden｜在花园里悠闲地忙活
tip_ja: 作动词常用potter about/around，表示悠闲忙活。

meanings_ja: n. 套房；套间 | n. 一套软件或家具 | n. 组曲
definition_en: Connected rooms used together, especially in a hotel | A set of software programs or furniture used together | A musical work consisting of several related pieces
example1_en: Our hotel suite has a balcony overlooking the sea.
example1_ja: 我们住的酒店套房有一个面朝大海的阳台。
example2_en: The university provides a software suite that enables students to analyse data and prepare research presentations.
example2_ja: 该大学提供一套软件，帮助学生分析数据并制作研究报告演示文稿。
collocations: a hotel suite｜酒店套房 ; a software suite｜软件套装 ; a three-piece suite｜三件套沙发
tip_ja: 读音同sweet；suit意为西装，读音不同。

meanings_ja: adj. 色盲的
definition_en: unable to distinguish some colours from others
example1_en: My color-blind uncle sometimes confuses red apples with green ones.
example1_ja: 我叔叔有色盲，有时分不清红苹果和青苹果。
example2_en: Designers should use distinct shapes alongside colours to make public information accessible to color-blind users.
example2_ja: 设计师应在使用颜色的同时采用不同形状，让色盲用户也能获取公共信息。
collocations: red-green color-blind｜红绿色盲的 ; color-blind users｜色盲用户
tip_ja: 英式通常拼作colour-blind；不一定完全看不见颜色。

meanings_ja: n. 大学的院；系 | n. 全体教员 | n. 官能；能力
definition_en: A university division covering a particular group of subjects. | The teaching staff of a university, college, or school. | A natural mental or physical ability.
example1_en: The science faculty has moved into a new building.
example1_ja: 理学院已搬进一栋新楼。
example2_en: Cooperation between the faculty of engineering and local industries can help students develop skills relevant to employment.
example2_ja: 工程学院与当地产业的合作可以帮助学生培养与就业相关的技能。
collocations: the faculty of science｜理学院 ; faculty members｜教职人员 ; mental faculties｜心智能力
tip_ja: 英式常指大学院系，美式常指全体教员。

meanings_ja: v. 成熟；使成熟
definition_en: to become ripe or make fruit or crops ripe
example1_en: Leave these green tomatoes on the windowsill to ripen.
example1_ja: 把这些青番茄放在窗台上，让它们慢慢成熟。
example2_en: Warmer temperatures can cause fruit to ripen earlier, forcing farmers to adjust their harvesting schedules.
example2_ja: 气温升高会使水果提早成熟，迫使农民调整采收时间。
collocations: ripen naturally｜自然成熟 ; ripen on the vine｜在藤上成熟 ; ripen in the sun｜在阳光下成熟
tip_ja: ripe是形容词；ripen是动词，可及物也可不及物。

meanings_ja: v. 挤在一起；蜷缩 | n. 挤在一起的人群 | n. 私下短会
definition_en: To gather closely together or curl up for warmth or protection. | A group of people standing or sitting close together. | A brief close gathering to discuss something privately.
example1_en: We huddled under one umbrella until the rain stopped.
example1_ja: 我们挤在同一把伞下，直到雨停。
example2_en: Without adequate shelter, displaced families may huddle together outdoors, increasing their exposure to cold and illness.
example2_ja: 缺乏足够住所时，流离失所的家庭可能只好在户外挤作一团，更容易受寒和生病。
collocations: huddle together｜挤在一起 ; huddle for warmth｜挤在一起取暖 ; huddle around a fire｜围着火堆挤在一起 ; a team huddle｜团队碰头会
tip_ja: huddle强调紧靠，常为取暖、避险或私下商议。

meanings_ja: v. 满足需求；提供服务 | v. 提供餐饮服务
definition_en: to provide what a particular person or group needs | to supply food and drinks for an event
example1_en: These weekend classes cater for children of all ages.
example1_ja: 这些周末课程面向各个年龄段的儿童。
example2_en: Public transport systems should cater for passengers with limited mobility by providing accessible vehicles and stations.
example2_ja: 公共交通系统应提供无障碍车辆和车站，满足行动不便乘客的需求。
collocations: cater for different needs｜满足不同需求 ; cater to individual tastes｜迎合个人喜好 ; cater for a wedding｜为婚礼提供餐饮
tip_ja: cater for指满足需求或供餐；cater to常指迎合。

meanings_ja: n. 例外 | n. 异议；反对
definition_en: someone or something not included in a general rule or pattern | an objection, especially in the phrase take exception to
example1_en: Everyone enjoyed the soup, with the exception of my brother.
example1_ja: 除了我哥哥，大家都很喜欢这道汤。
example2_en: Although public transport is generally affordable, rural communities often represent an exception because services are limited.
example2_ja: 虽然公共交通通常价格低廉，但农村社区往往是例外，因为可用的服务有限。
collocations: an exception to the rule｜规则的例外 ; with the exception of｜除……之外 ; make an exception｜破例 ; take exception to｜对……表示不满
tip_ja: 规则的例外用exception to，不用exception of。

meanings_ja: n. 侧面；侧面轮廓 | n. 简介；概况 | n. 公众关注度
definition_en: The outline of a face or object seen from the side. | A short description of someone's life, work, or characteristics. | The amount of public attention someone or something receives.
example1_en: She drew her grandfather's profile with a soft pencil.
example1_ja: 她用软铅笔画出了祖父的侧面轮廓。
example2_en: Public exhibitions can raise the profile of local artists and attract visitors to smaller towns.
example2_ja: 公共展览能提高当地艺术家的知名度，并吸引游客前往小城镇。
collocations: in profile｜从侧面看 ; a detailed profile｜详细简介 ; raise the profile of｜提高……的知名度 ; keep a low profile｜保持低调
tip_ja: in profile指呈侧面；a high profile指高关注度。

meanings_ja: adj. 异国情调的；奇异的 | adj. 外来的；非本土的
definition_en: Unusual and interesting, especially because of a connection with distant countries. | Originating outside the region where something is now found.
example1_en: The market sells exotic fruits I have never tasted.
example1_ja: 市场里卖着我从未尝过的异国水果。
example2_en: Introducing exotic plants into local gardens can threaten native species if their spread is not controlled.
example2_ja: 将外来植物引入当地花园后，若不控制其蔓延，可能会威胁本土物种。
collocations: exotic fruit｜异国水果 ; exotic destination｜富有异国情调的目的地 ; exotic species｜外来物种
tip_ja: 生态语境中指非本土的，不一定具有入侵性。

meanings_ja: v. 侵蚀；风化 | v. 逐渐削弱；损害
definition_en: To gradually wear away soil or rock through natural forces. | To gradually reduce strength, value, or confidence.
example1_en: Strong waves have eroded the cliffs near our village.
example1_ja: 强劲的海浪侵蚀了我们村庄附近的悬崖。
example2_en: Persistent inflation can erode household savings, making it harder for families to afford essential goods.
example2_ja: 持续的通货膨胀会削弱家庭储蓄的购买力，使家庭更难负担生活必需品。
collocations: erode the soil｜侵蚀土壤 ; erode public trust｜削弱公众信任 ; erode purchasing power｜削弱购买力 ; coastal erosion｜海岸侵蚀
tip_ja: 可指自然侵蚀，也可指信任、价值等逐渐受损。

meanings_ja: n. 裁缝 | v. 量身定制；使适合
definition_en: someone who makes or alters clothes, especially suits | to make or adapt something for particular needs
example1_en: The tailor shortened my trousers while I waited nearby.
example1_ja: 我在旁边等着，裁缝把我的裤子改短了。
example2_en: Teachers should tailor their lessons to students' abilities rather than follow a single approach for everyone.
example2_ja: 教师应根据学生的能力调整课程，而不是对所有人采用同一种方法。
collocations: tailor a suit｜定做西装 ; tailor something to individual needs｜按个人需求调整 ; tailor-made clothes｜定制衣服
tip_ja: tailor A to B表示“根据B调整或定制A”。

meanings_ja: adj. 紧张的；绷紧的 | n. 时态 | v. 使绷紧；变得紧绷
definition_en: Nervous and unable to relax, or stretched tightly. | A verb form that indicates time. | To tighten muscles or become physically stiff.
example1_en: She looked tense while waiting outside the interview room.
example1_ja: 她在面试室外等候时显得很紧张。
example2_en: A tense working environment can reduce productivity and discourage employees from sharing creative ideas.
example2_ja: 紧张的工作环境可能降低生产效率，并使员工不愿分享创新想法。
collocations: feel tense｜感到紧张 ; a tense atmosphere｜紧张的气氛 ; past tense｜过去时 ; tense your muscles｜绷紧肌肉
tip_ja: 作名词指语法“时态”；作形容词指紧张或绷紧。

meanings_ja: n. 文明社会；文明 | n. 文明生活；现代便利
definition_en: an organized society with developed institutions, culture, and technology | the comforts and services associated with modern society
example1_en: We explored the ruins of an ancient civilization yesterday.
example1_ja: 昨天我们探访了一处古代文明的遗址。
example2_en: Reliable water supplies played a crucial role in the development of civilization by supporting agriculture and permanent settlements.
example2_ja: 可靠的水源支持了农业和固定聚落的发展，在文明形成过程中发挥了关键作用。
collocations: ancient civilization｜古代文明 ; the rise of civilization｜文明的兴起 ; human civilization｜人类文明
tip_ja: 英式也拼作 civilisation；某个文明可用 a civilization。

meanings_ja: n. 考虑；斟酌 | n. 体谅；关心 | n. 需要考虑的因素
definition_en: Careful thought about something before making a decision. | Care for other people's feelings, needs, or comfort. | Something important to think about when making a decision.
example1_en: After careful consideration, we chose the smaller flat.
example1_ja: 经过仔细考虑，我们选择了那套较小的公寓。
example2_en: Urban planners should take the needs of older residents into consideration when designing public transport systems.
example2_ja: 城市规划者在设计公共交通系统时，应考虑老年居民的需求。
collocations: careful consideration｜仔细考虑 ; take into consideration｜将……考虑在内 ; under consideration｜正在考虑中 ; show consideration for｜体谅
tip_ja: 表考虑或体谅通常不可数；表考虑因素时可数。

meanings_ja: n. 起重机；吊车 | n. 鹤 | v. 伸长脖子看
definition_en: A machine for lifting and moving heavy objects. | A large bird with long legs and a long neck. | To stretch your neck to see something better.
example1_en: A crane lifted the heavy beam above the roof.
example1_ja: 一台起重机把沉重的横梁吊到了屋顶上方。
example2_en: Construction companies use cranes to assemble tall buildings efficiently, but strict safety procedures remain essential.
example2_ja: 建筑公司利用起重机高效建造高层建筑，但严格的安全规程仍然必不可少。
collocations: a tower crane｜塔式起重机 ; operate a crane｜操作起重机 ; crane your neck｜伸长脖子
tip_ja: 动词常用crane your neck，表示伸长脖子看。

meanings_ja: n. 调查；探究 | n. 询问；咨询
definition_en: a process of investigating facts or seeking knowledge | a request for information about something
example1_en: My inquiry about the missing parcel received a quick reply.
example1_ja: 我询问了丢失包裹的情况，很快就收到了回复。
example2_en: An independent inquiry into river pollution revealed serious weaknesses in the current system of environmental monitoring.
example2_ja: 一项针对河流污染的独立调查揭示了现行环境监测体系的严重缺陷。
collocations: public inquiry｜公开调查 ; inquiry into｜对……的调查 ; make an inquiry｜进行咨询 ; scientific inquiry｜科学探究
tip_ja: 调查某事用inquiry into；英式enquiry也常指咨询。

meanings_ja: n. 钥匙孔
definition_en: a hole in a lock into which a key fits
example1_en: I struggled to find the keyhole in the dark.
example1_ja: 黑暗中，我费了好大劲才找到钥匙孔。
example2_en: Modern electronic locks remove the need for a traditional keyhole, although they may create new security risks.
example2_ja: 现代电子锁不再需要传统的钥匙孔，不过也可能带来新的安全风险。
collocations: put a key in the keyhole｜把钥匙插入锁孔 ; look through the keyhole｜透过钥匙孔看 ; keyhole surgery｜微创手术
tip_ja: keyhole surgery指小切口手术，不是钥匙孔手术。

meanings_ja: v. 联合；团结；使统一
definition_en: To join together or bring people together for a shared purpose.
example1_en: The whole village united to repair the damaged bridge.
example1_ja: 全村人团结起来修复受损的桥。
example2_en: Shared environmental goals can unite communities that otherwise have very different economic and political interests.
example2_ja: 共同的环境目标能让经济和政治利益原本大不相同的社区团结起来。
collocations: unite against｜联合起来反对 ; unite behind a leader｜团结支持一位领袖 ; unite efforts｜汇聚力量
tip_ja: unite可及物也可不及物，强调为共同目标联合。

meanings_ja: n. 界面；接口 | n. 交界面；接触点 | v. 连接；相互对接
definition_en: a system through which users or devices interact | a boundary or connection between two things | connect and work together with another system or group
example1_en: The app's simple interface makes booking tickets much easier.
example1_ja: 这款应用的简洁界面让订票方便多了。
example2_en: An accessible user interface enables people with limited technical experience to benefit from digital public services.
example2_ja: 易于使用的用户界面能让技术经验有限的人也享受到数字公共服务。
collocations: user interface｜用户界面 ; graphical interface｜图形界面 ; interface design｜界面设计 ; interface with｜与……对接
tip_ja: 计算机语境常指界面；作动词常接with。

meanings_ja: n. 大使馆
definition_en: An official office representing a country in another country.
example1_en: I contacted the embassy after losing my passport abroad.
example1_ja: 在国外丢失护照后，我联系了大使馆。
example2_en: An embassy provides assistance to citizens overseas and helps maintain diplomatic relations between the two countries.
example2_ja: 大使馆为海外公民提供援助，并帮助维持两国间的外交关系。
collocations: contact the embassy｜联系大使馆 ; embassy staff｜大使馆工作人员 ; foreign embassy｜外国大使馆
tip_ja: embassy指大使馆；consulate指领事馆。

meanings_ja: n. 其间；等待期间 | adv. 在此期间；与此同时
definition_en: the period before something happens, especially in 'in the meantime' | during the time before another event happens
example1_en: Dinner is cooking; in the meantime, let's set the table.
example1_ja: 饭还在做，我们趁这会儿摆好餐具吧。
example2_en: The new railway will take years to complete; in the meantime, cities should improve existing bus services.
example2_ja: 新铁路还需要数年才能建成；在此期间，城市应改善现有公交服务。
collocations: in the meantime｜在此期间 ; meantime, continue working｜其间继续工作
tip_ja: 最常用in the meantime；meanwhile可直接作副词。

meanings_ja: v. 蹑手蹑脚地走；缓慢移动 | v. 逐渐蔓延；悄然变化
definition_en: to move slowly and quietly, often to avoid being noticed | to spread or change slowly and almost unnoticed
example1_en: I crept upstairs to avoid waking the sleeping baby.
example1_ja: 我蹑手蹑脚地上楼，以免吵醒熟睡的宝宝。
example2_en: Housing costs can creep up gradually, placing increasing financial pressure on families with limited incomes.
example2_ja: 住房成本可能逐渐上涨，给收入有限的家庭带来越来越大的经济压力。
collocations: creep upstairs｜蹑手蹑脚地上楼 ; creep up｜悄然上升 ; creep into｜悄然进入 ; give someone the creeps｜使某人毛骨悚然

tip_ja: 常指大型公司；勿与cooperation（合作）混淆。

meanings_ja: adj. 体贴的；替他人着想的
definition_en: Careful not to upset or inconvenience other people.
example1_en: Our considerate neighbour turns down the music after dinner.
example1_ja: 我们那位体贴的邻居晚饭后会把音乐音量调低。
example2_en: Being considerate towards other passengers can make public transport more comfortable and accessible for everyone.
example2_ja: 体谅其他乘客能让公共交通对所有人而言都更舒适、更便于使用。
collocations: considerate of others｜为他人着想 ; considerate behaviour｜体贴的行为 ; considerate neighbour｜体贴的邻居
tip_ja: considerate是体贴的；considerable是相当大的。

meanings_ja: n. 脚印；足迹 | n. 占用空间 | n. 环境影响程度
definition_en: A mark left by a foot on a surface. | The amount of ground or space something occupies. | The environmental impact of a person, product, or activity.
example1_en: A muddy footprint covered the clean kitchen floor.
example1_ja: 干净的厨房地板上留下了一个泥脚印。
example2_en: Choosing locally grown food can sometimes reduce the carbon footprint associated with transporting agricultural products.
example2_ja: 选择本地种植的食物有时可以减少运输农产品产生的碳足迹。
collocations: leave footprints｜留下脚印 ; carbon footprint｜碳足迹 ; a small footprint｜占地面积小
tip_ja: carbon footprint指碳排放影响，不是实际脚印。

meanings_ja: n. 牲畜；家畜
definition_en: farm animals kept for food, materials, or work
example1_en: The farmer moved the livestock into a sheltered field.
example1_ja: 农民把牲畜赶进了一块有遮蔽的田地。
example2_en: Raising livestock requires substantial land and water resources, which can increase pressure on ecosystems in dry regions.
example2_ja: 饲养牲畜需要大量土地和水资源，这可能加剧干旱地区生态系统的压力。
collocations: raise livestock｜饲养牲畜 ; livestock farming｜畜牧业 ; livestock feed｜牲畜饲料 ; livestock production｜畜牧生产
tip_ja: 集合名词，不加-s；表示活的农场动物。

meanings_ja: adj. 不公正的；不公平的
definition_en: not fair or morally right
example1_en: It seemed unjust to blame her for everyone's mistakes.
example1_ja: 把大家的错误都归咎于她，似乎很不公平。
example2_en: An unjust legal system can weaken public trust and discourage citizens from seeking help through official channels.
example2_ja: 不公正的法律制度会削弱公众信任，并使公民不愿通过官方渠道寻求帮助。
collocations: unjust treatment｜不公正待遇 ; an unjust law｜不公正的法律 ; an unjust punishment｜不公正的惩罚
tip_ja: unjust强调违背公正原则；unfair使用范围更广。

meanings_ja: v. 坦白；供认 | v. 承认难以启齿的事
definition_en: to admit doing something wrong or illegal | to admit something personal that you feel embarrassed about
example1_en: I confessed to eating the last slice of cake.
example1_ja: 我坦白自己吃掉了最后一块蛋糕。
example2_en: Students may be more willing to confess their mistakes when teachers respond calmly and offer constructive guidance.
example2_ja: 如果教师冷静回应并给予建设性指导，学生可能更愿意坦白自己的错误。
collocations: confess to doing something｜坦白做过某事 ; confess a crime｜供认罪行 ; confess that｜承认……
tip_ja: confess to中的to是介词，后接名词或动名词。

meanings_ja: n. 社会主义
definition_en: A political and economic system favouring public ownership of productive resources
example1_en: Our history teacher explained socialism during today's lively class discussion.
example1_ja: 在今天热烈的课堂讨论中，我们的历史老师讲解了社会主义。
example2_en: Debates about socialism often focus on public ownership, economic equality, and the appropriate role of government.
example2_ja: 关于社会主义的讨论往往聚焦于公有制、经济平等以及政府应发挥的作用。
collocations: democratic socialism｜民主社会主义 ; socialism and capitalism｜社会主义与资本主义 ; principles of socialism｜社会主义原则
tip_ja: 通常为不可数名词；socialist可指社会主义者。

meanings_ja: n. 一段时间；持续时间 | n. 跨度；跨距 | v. 持续；横跨；涵盖
definition_en: The period during which something lasts or happens | The distance from one end of something to the other | To extend across a period, area, or range
example1_en: Our dog has a surprisingly short attention span.
example1_ja: 我们家狗狗能集中注意力的时间短得出奇。
example2_en: The research project will span several decades, allowing scientists to track long-term changes in coastal ecosystems.
example2_ja: 该研究项目将持续数十年，使科学家能够追踪沿海生态系统的长期变化。
collocations: attention span｜注意力持续时间 ; a short time span｜短暂的一段时间 ; span several decades｜持续数十年 ; a bridge span｜桥梁跨度
tip_ja: span作动词直接接时间或范围，无需加介词。

meanings_ja: n. 肺
definition_en: Either of the two chest organs used for breathing.
example1_en: The doctor listened to my lungs through a stethoscope.
example1_ja: 医生用听诊器听了听我的肺部。
example2_en: Long periods of exposure to polluted air can damage the lungs and increase the risk of respiratory disease.
example2_ja: 长期接触受污染的空气可能损伤肺部，并增加患呼吸系统疾病的风险。
collocations: lung disease｜肺病 ; lung capacity｜肺活量 ; lung cancer｜肺癌
tip_ja: 单个肺用lung；谈双肺或肺部通常用lungs。

meanings_ja: adj. 现存的；已有的
definition_en: Already present or in use at a particular time.
example1_en: We kept the existing shelves and painted them blue.
example1_ja: 我们保留了原有的架子，并把它们刷成蓝色。
example2_en: Governments should improve existing transport networks before investing public money in entirely new infrastructure projects.
example2_ja: 政府应先改善现有交通网络，再将公共资金投入全新的基础设施项目。
collocations: existing infrastructure｜现有基础设施 ; existing customers｜现有客户 ; existing conditions｜现有条件
tip_ja: 通常放在名词前，强调已经存在而非新建或新增。

meanings_ja: adj. 重大的；显著的 | adj. 意味深长的
definition_en: large or important enough to deserve attention | expressing a meaning that is not directly stated
example1_en: Moving closer to work made a significant difference to me.
example1_ja: 搬到工作地点附近对我的生活产生了很大的影响。
example2_en: Access to reliable internet services has a significant impact on educational opportunities in remote communities.
example2_ja: 能否获得可靠的互联网服务，对偏远社区的教育机会有重大影响。
collocations: a significant increase｜显著增长 ; a significant impact｜重大影响 ; statistically significant｜统计上显著的 ; a significant glance｜意味深长的一瞥
tip_ja: 统计上significant指达到显著性标准，不等于实际影响很大。

meanings_ja: adj. 总体的；全部的 | adv. 总体上；总的来说
definition_en: considering or including every part of something | when everything is considered together
example1_en: The overall cost includes breakfast and a train ticket.
example1_ja: 总费用包括早餐和一张火车票。
example2_en: Overall, investment in public transport can reduce urban congestion while improving access to employment opportunities.
example2_ja: 总体而言，投资公共交通可以缓解城市拥堵，同时让人们更方便地获得就业机会。
collocations: overall cost｜总费用 ; overall performance｜整体表现 ; overall impact｜总体影响 ; overall improvement｜整体改善
tip_ja: 形容词放名词前；副词可放句首概括整体情况。

meanings_ja: adv. 部分地；不完全地
definition_en: to some extent, but not completely
example1_en: The curtains were partially open, letting in sunlight.
example1_ja: 窗帘开了一部分，让阳光透了进来。
example2_en: Although recycling can partially reduce waste, changes in production and consumption are also necessary.
example2_ja: 虽然回收利用能在一定程度上减少废弃物，但生产和消费方式也需要改变。
collocations: partially open｜部分敞开的 ; partially completed｜部分完成的 ; partially responsible｜负有部分责任的
tip_ja: partially表示不完全地；不要误解为偏心地。

meanings_ja: v. 组装；装配 | v. 集合；召集
definition_en: to join separate parts together to make something | to gather together or bring people or things together
example1_en: We assembled the bookshelf before putting our books away.
example1_ja: 我们先组装好书架，再把书收好。
example2_en: Manufacturers increasingly use robots to assemble electronic devices, improving consistency while reducing demand for some manual jobs.
example2_ja: 制造商越来越多地使用机器人组装电子设备，在提高一致性的同时减少了对某些体力岗位的需求。
collocations: assemble furniture｜组装家具 ; assemble a team｜组建团队 ; assemble evidence｜汇集证据 ; assemble in the hall｜在大厅集合
tip_ja: 组装物品时及物；表示人集合时也可不及物。

meanings_ja: adv. 无疑；毫无疑问地

example1_en: This is undoubtedly the warmest coat I have ever owned.
example1_ja: 这无疑是我穿过的最暖和的外套。
example2_en: Access to clean drinking water undoubtedly improves public health, particularly in communities with limited medical services.
example2_ja: 获得清洁饮用水无疑能改善公共健康，尤其是在医疗服务有限的社区。
collocations: undoubtedly true｜无疑属实 ; undoubtedly important｜无疑很重要 ; will undoubtedly benefit｜无疑会受益
tip_ja: 语气很肯定；证据不足时宜用probably等弱化表达。

meanings_ja: n. 常态；通常标准 | n. 行为规范

example1_en: Working from home is now the norm in our team.
example1_ja: 居家办公如今已成为我们团队的常态。
example2_en: Social norms influence how people interact, although acceptable behaviour can vary significantly across cultures.
example2_ja: 社会规范影响人们的交往方式，但不同文化所接受的行为可能差异很大。
collocations: the norm｜常态 ; social norms｜社会规范 ; cultural norms｜文化规范 ; become the norm｜成为常态
tip_ja: 表示“常态”常用the norm；行为规范常用复数。

meanings_ja: v. 蜇；刺痛 | n. 蜇伤；刺痛 | v. 刺伤感情；使难受

example1_en: A bee stung my ankle while I watered the flowers.
example1_ja: 我浇花时，一只蜜蜂蜇了我的脚踝。
example2_en: Harsh criticism can sting young learners and discourage them from participating in classroom discussions.
example2_ja: 严厉的批评会伤害年幼学习者的感情，使他们不愿参与课堂讨论。
collocations: a bee sting｜蜜蜂蜇伤 ; a wasp sting｜黄蜂蜇伤 ; stinging criticism｜尖刻的批评
tip_ja: 过去式、过去分词均为stung；蜇用sting，咬用bite。

meanings_ja: adj. 不情愿的；勉强的
definition_en: Unwilling or hesitant to do something.

example1_ja: 他不情愿离开温暖的被窝。
example2_en: Many commuters remain reluctant to use public transport when services are infrequent or unreliable.
example2_ja: 当班次稀少或服务不可靠时，许多通勤者仍不愿乘坐公共交通。
collocations: reluctant to admit｜不愿承认 ; reluctant to change｜不愿改变 ; reluctant agreement｜勉强同意
tip_ja: 常用be reluctant to do，表示不愿做某事。

meanings_ja: n. 可能性；预期 | n. 前景；成功机会 | v. 勘探矿藏
definition_en: The possibility or expectation that something will happen. | Chances of future success or improvement. | To search an area for valuable minerals or fuels.

example1_ja: 想到即将去海边度假，我们的心情好了起来。
example2_en: Access to vocational training can improve employment prospects for young people in economically disadvantaged regions.
example2_ja: 获得职业培训的机会能改善经济欠发达地区年轻人的就业前景。
collocations: the prospect of｜……的可能性 ; employment prospects｜就业前景 ; a realistic prospect｜切实的可能性 ; prospect for gold｜勘探金矿
tip_ja: 前景常用复数prospects；of后可接动名词。

meanings_ja: v. 鼓舞；激励 | v. 赋予灵感；启发 | v. 激起；唤起
definition_en: to make someone feel eager and able to do something | to give someone an idea for something creative | to cause a particular feeling in someone
example1_en: Our coach inspired us to try again after losing.
example1_ja: 输掉比赛后，教练鼓励我们再试一次。
example2_en: Teachers who connect lessons with real problems can inspire students to pursue careers in science.
example2_ja: 将课程与实际问题联系起来的教师能够激励学生投身科学事业。
collocations: inspire someone to act｜激励某人行动 ; inspire confidence｜激发信心 ; inspire creativity｜激发创造力 ; be inspired by nature｜从自然中获得灵感
tip_ja: 常用 inspire sb to do sth，表示激励某人做某事。

meanings_ja: n. 犯罪团伙；帮派 | n. 一群伙伴；一队工人
definition_en: A group of people involved in crime or violence. | A group of friends or people working together.

example1_ja: 我们这群伙伴每周六都在公园碰面。
example2_en: Community programmes can reduce gang membership by offering young people educational support and meaningful employment opportunities.
example2_ja: 社区项目可以通过提供教育支持和有意义的就业机会，减少青少年加入帮派的现象。
collocations: a criminal gang｜犯罪团伙 ; gang violence｜帮派暴力 ; a gang of workers｜一队工人 ; gang up on someone｜结伙欺负某人
tip_ja: 指朋友群体时较口语化；正式语境常指犯罪团伙。

meanings_ja: n. 怀孕；妊娠期
definition_en: The condition or period of carrying a developing baby.

example1_ja: 去年怀孕期间，她一直喜欢轻松地散步。
example2_en: Access to reliable healthcare during pregnancy improves health outcomes for both mothers and their babies.
example2_ja: 孕期获得可靠的医疗服务，有助于改善母亲和婴儿的健康状况。
collocations: during pregnancy｜在怀孕期间 ; early pregnancy｜孕早期 ; pregnancy test｜妊娠检测
tip_ja: during pregnancy意为孕期；形容词是pregnant。

meanings_ja: n. 理论；学说 | n. 推测；看法 | n. 理论知识
definition_en: an organized explanation of facts or how something works | an idea offered to explain something, not yet proved | the principles of a subject rather than their practical application

example1_ja: 我猜是猫把杯子碰倒了。
example2_en: Students benefit from courses that connect scientific theory with practical experiments and problems from everyday life.
example2_ja: 将科学理论与实践实验及日常问题相结合的课程能让学生受益。
collocations: in theory｜理论上 ; support a theory｜支持一种理论 ; test a theory｜检验一种理论 ; theory and practice｜理论与实践

meanings_ja: n. 研讨课；研讨会
definition_en: A meeting where a group studies or discusses a subject.
example1_en: We discussed our research ideas during the afternoon seminar.
example1_ja: 我们在下午的研讨课上讨论了各自的研究想法。
example2_en: University seminars encourage students to evaluate different perspectives rather than simply memorise information presented by lecturers.
example2_ja: 大学研讨课鼓励学生评估不同观点，而不是仅仅记忆讲师提供的信息。

tip_ja: seminar强调讨论交流；lecture通常以教师讲授为主。

meanings_ja: n. 适应；适应性变化 | n. 改编作品 | n. 改装；调整

example1_ja: 我们花了几个星期才适应较冷的天气。
example2_en: Climate adaptation requires governments to improve flood defences and support communities facing increasingly frequent extreme weather.
example2_ja: 适应气候变化需要政府改善防洪设施，并支持面临日益频繁的极端天气的社区。

meanings_ja: adj. 好斗的；挑衅的 | adj. 强势进取的；积极有力的
definition_en: Ready to argue, threaten, or attack. | Using forceful, determined methods to achieve a goal.

example1_ja: 每当有人靠近大门，那只凶悍的狗就会低吼。
example2_en: Aggressive marketing campaigns may increase sales, but they can also encourage unnecessary consumption and household debt.
example2_ja: 强势营销活动可能提高销量，但也可能助长不必要的消费和家庭负债。

meanings_ja: n. 蜡 | v. 给……上蜡 | v. 月亮渐盈
definition_en: A substance that melts easily, used for candles and protective coatings. | To cover or polish something with wax. | For the moon's visible lit surface to gradually increase.

example1_ja: 温热的蜡从蜡烛上滴到了桌子上。
example2_en: A thin layer of wax can protect fresh fruit and reduce moisture loss during transport.
example2_ja: 一层薄蜡可以保护新鲜水果，并减少运输过程中的水分流失。
collocations: candle wax｜烛蜡 ; a layer of wax｜一层蜡 ; wax the floor｜给地板打蜡 ; wax and wane｜盛衰变化

meanings_ja: v. 呻吟 | v. 抱怨；发牢骚 | n. 呻吟声；抱怨
definition_en: To make a low sound expressing pain or unhappiness. | To complain, especially in an annoying or repeated way. | A low sound of pain, or an expression of complaint.
example1_en: He moaned softly as the nurse examined his ankle.
example1_ja: 护士检查他的脚踝时，他轻轻呻吟着。
example2_en: Rather than moan about unreliable buses, residents could ask local authorities to improve public transport.
example2_ja: 居民与其抱怨公交车不准时，不如向地方政府提出改善公共交通的诉求。

tip_ja: 表示抱怨时较口语化，常用moan about。

meanings_ja: n. 续订；续期 | n. 更新；复兴
definition_en: the extension of an agreement or service for another period | the process of making something fresh, strong, or effective again
example1_en: My gym membership is due for renewal next month.
example1_ja: 我的健身房会员资格下个月该续期了。
example2_en: Urban renewal projects should improve public spaces without forcing existing residents to leave their neighbourhoods.
example2_ja: 城市更新项目应改善公共空间，同时避免迫使现有居民搬离所在社区。

meanings_ja: n. 插图；图解 | n. 例证；说明
definition_en: A picture that accompanies or explains something. | An example that makes an idea clearer.
example1_en: The book has a beautiful illustration of a whale.
example1_ja: 这本书里有一幅漂亮的鲸鱼插图。
example2_en: The rapid recovery of this forest provides a clear illustration of the benefits of long-term conservation.
example2_ja: 这片森林的迅速恢复清楚地说明了长期保护的益处。

meanings_ja: v. 获得；购得 | v. 学到；习得
definition_en: Get or become the owner of something. | Develop knowledge or skills through learning or experience.

example1_ja: 我们为狭小的厨房添置了一张二手桌子。
example2_en: Work placements allow students to acquire practical skills that are difficult to develop through classroom learning alone.
example2_ja: 实习让学生获得仅靠课堂学习难以培养的实用技能。
collocations: acquire skills｜习得技能 ; acquire knowledge｜获取知识 ; acquire a company｜收购公司 ; an acquired taste｜后天养成的喜好
tip_ja: 比get正式；可接资产，也可接知识、技能。

meanings_ja: adj. 空中的；从空中进行的 | n. 天线
definition_en: Happening in the air or done from above the ground. | A device that receives or sends radio or television signals.

example1_ja: 这张航拍照片拍出了我们河边的房子。
example2_en: Aerial surveys allow researchers to monitor forest loss across remote regions without disturbing wildlife.
example2_ja: 航空调查让研究人员能够监测偏远地区的森林流失，而不惊扰野生动物。

meanings_ja: n. 活动中心；枢纽 | n. 轮毂 | n. 网络集线器

example1_ja: 门铃再次响起时，她烦躁地叹了口气。

example1_ja: 外面持续不断的噪声让我难以集中注意力。

meanings_ja: n. 总部；指挥部

meanings_ja: adj. 不规则的；不整齐的 | adj. 不定时的；无规律的 | adj. 不规则变化的

meanings_ja: adj. 松动的；未固定的 | adj. 宽松的 | adj. 不严密的；不严格的

meanings_ja: adj. 忠诚的；忠实的
definition_en: Continuing to support someone or something, even during difficulties.
example1_en: Our loyal dog waits by the door every evening.
example1_ja: 我们忠实的狗每天傍晚都在门边等候。
example2_en: Companies that treat their employees fairly are more likely to retain a loyal and productive workforce.
example2_ja: 公平对待员工的公司更有可能留住忠诚且高效的员工队伍。
collocations: loyal to｜忠于 ; a loyal customer｜忠实顾客 ; remain loyal｜保持忠诚 ; a loyal supporter｜忠实支持者
tip_ja: 表示忠于某人或组织，用loyal to，不用loyal with。

meanings_ja: n. 堵塞；堵塞物
definition_en: Something that prevents movement through a passage, or the resulting obstruction.
example1_en: A blockage in the pipe stopped the water flowing.
example1_ja: 管道里有堵塞物，水流不出来了。
example2_en: Regular maintenance of urban drainage systems can prevent blockages that increase the risk of flooding.
example2_ja: 定期维护城市排水系统可以防止堵塞，从而降低洪涝风险。
collocations: clear a blockage｜清除堵塞物 ; a blockage in a pipe｜管道内的堵塞 ; intestinal blockage｜肠梗阻
tip_ja: 指通道堵塞；军事或经济“封锁”通常用blockade。

meanings_ja: n. 顾问；指导教师
definition_en: someone whose job is to give guidance or expert advice
example1_en: My advisor helped me choose courses for next term.
example1_ja: 我的指导老师帮我选了下学期的课程。
example2_en: A qualified financial advisor can help households plan for retirement and manage the risks of long-term investments.
example2_ja: 合格的财务顾问能帮助家庭规划退休生活，并管理长期投资的风险。
collocations: financial advisor｜财务顾问 ; academic advisor｜学业指导教师 ; careers advisor｜职业顾问
tip_ja: advisor与adviser均正确；英式英语常用后者。

meanings_ja: adv. 最终；最后 | adv. 归根结底；根本上
definition_en: in the end, after a series of events | when considering the most important underlying fact
example1_en: We explored several flats but ultimately chose this small house.
example1_ja: 我们看了好几套公寓，但最终选了这栋小房子。
example2_en: Although technology can support classroom learning, educational success ultimately depends on effective teaching and student engagement.
example2_ja: 虽然技术可以辅助课堂学习，但教育成效归根结底取决于有效教学和学生参与。
collocations: ultimately depend on｜归根结底取决于 ; ultimately lead to｜最终导致 ; ultimately responsible｜负最终责任的
tip_ja: 强调最终结果或根本因素，不用于列举中的最后一项。

meanings_ja: adv. 通常；普遍地
definition_en: often or among many people or in many places
example1_en: This spice is commonly used in soups and stews.
example1_ja: 这种香料常用于汤和炖菜。
example2_en: Although online learning is commonly viewed as convenient, its effectiveness depends on student motivation and access to reliable technology.
example2_ja: 尽管在线学习普遍被认为很方便，其效果仍取决于学生的学习动力和可靠的技术条件。
collocations: commonly used｜常用的 ; commonly known as｜通常称为 ; commonly found｜常见的 ; commonly believed｜普遍认为的
tip_ja: 常置于实义动词前、be动词后，如is commonly used。

meanings_ja: n. 叛乱；起义 | n. 反抗；叛逆
definition_en: Organized resistance, often violent, against a government or ruler. | Refusal to accept authority, rules, or expected behaviour.
example1_en: Refusing to tidy his room was his small rebellion.
example1_ja: 拒绝整理房间是他小小的反抗。
example2_en: Historians often examine how economic hardship and political exclusion contribute to rebellion against established authority.
example2_ja: 历史学家常研究经济困境和政治排斥如何促成对既有权威的反抗。
collocations: armed rebellion｜武装叛乱 ; teenage rebellion｜青少年叛逆 ; rebellion against authority｜对权威的反抗 ; crush a rebellion｜镇压叛乱
tip_ja: 常接against，说明反抗的对象。

meanings_ja: adj. 极度的；极端的 | adj. 偏激的；过激的 | n. 极端；极限
definition_en: very great in degree or far beyond what is usual | far beyond what most people consider reasonable or acceptable | either end of a range of conditions or behaviour
example1_en: We kept the curtains closed during the extreme heat.
example1_ja: 酷热期间，我们一直拉着窗帘。
example2_en: Extreme weather events can damage infrastructure and place considerable pressure on emergency services in vulnerable communities.
example2_ja: 极端天气事件会破坏基础设施，并给脆弱社区的应急服务带来巨大压力。
collocations: extreme weather｜极端天气 ; extreme poverty｜极度贫困 ; extreme views｜偏激的观点 ; go to extremes｜走极端
tip_ja: 副词用extremely；名词常见go to extremes。

meanings_ja: n. 乘务员；活动服务人员 | n. 管理人；守护者 | v. 管理；妥善照管
definition_en: Someone who assists passengers or people attending an event. | Someone responsible for caring for property or resources. | To manage or protect resources responsibly.
example1_en: A steward helped us find our seats before the concert.
example1_ja: 音乐会开始前，一位工作人员帮我们找到了座位。
example2_en: Local communities can act as stewards of natural habitats when they receive adequate funding and decision-making powers.
example2_ja: 当地社区若获得充足资金和决策权，就能成为自然栖息地的守护者。
collocations: a ship's steward｜船上乘务员 ; a steward of natural resources｜自然资源守护者 ; steward resources｜妥善管理资源
tip_ja: 不只指乘务员；a steward of也可指资源守护者。

meanings_ja: n. 援助；救助 | v. 帮助；促进 | n. 辅助工具
definition_en: Help provided through money, supplies, services, or practical support. | To help someone or make a process easier. | An object or device that helps someone do something.
example1_en: Volunteers brought food and medical aid to the village.
example1_ja: 志愿者为村子送来了食物和医疗援助。
example2_en: International aid can improve access to clean water, but lasting progress also requires investment in local infrastructure.
example2_ja: 国际援助可以改善清洁用水的获取条件，但持久进步还需要对当地基础设施进行投资。
collocations: humanitarian aid｜人道主义援助 ; financial aid｜经济援助 ; first aid｜急救 ; hearing aid｜助听器
tip_ja: 援助义通常不可数；辅助工具义可数，如a hearing aid。

meanings_ja: n. 抹布；破布 | n. 破旧衣服
definition_en: A piece of old cloth, often used for cleaning. | Old, badly torn clothes, usually described in the plural.
example1_en: He wiped the oily tools with an old rag.
example1_ja: 他用一块旧抹布擦拭沾满油污的工具。
example2_en: Reusing worn clothing as cleaning rags can reduce household waste and demand for disposable products.
example2_ja: 把旧衣服改作清洁抹布，可以减少家庭垃圾及对一次性用品的需求。
collocations: an old rag｜一块旧抹布 ; a cleaning rag｜清洁抹布 ; in rags｜衣衫褴褛 ; from rags to riches｜从贫穷到富有
tip_ja: 单数常指一块破布；in rags表示衣衫褴褛。

meanings_ja: adj. 相反的；相违背的 | n. 相反的情况
definition_en: opposite to something or inconsistent with it | the opposite of what has been said or suggested
example1_en: Contrary to the forecast, sunshine filled our garden.
example1_ja: 与天气预报相反，阳光洒满了我们的花园。
example2_en: Contrary to popular belief, expanding road networks does not always reduce traffic congestion in major cities.
example2_ja: 与普遍看法相反，扩大道路网络并不总能缓解大城市的交通拥堵。
collocations: contrary to expectations｜出乎预料 ; contrary evidence｜相反证据 ; on the contrary｜恰恰相反 ; to the contrary｜表明相反情况的
tip_ja: on the contrary用于纠正前述观点，意为恰恰相反。

meanings_ja: n. 橱柜；储物柜 | n. 内阁
definition_en: a cupboard with shelves or drawers for storing things | the group of senior ministers who make major government decisions
example1_en: The clean cups are in the cabinet above the sink.
example1_ja: 干净杯子放在水槽上方的橱柜里。
example2_en: The cabinet approved a national programme to improve access to affordable housing in rapidly growing cities.
example2_ja: 内阁批准了一项全国性计划，以增加快速发展城市中可负担住房的供应。
collocations: kitchen cabinet｜厨房橱柜 ; filing cabinet｜文件柜 ; cabinet minister｜内阁大臣 ; cabinet meeting｜内阁会议
tip_ja: 可指家具或内阁；内阁由政府高级部长组成。

meanings_ja: n. 完美；尽善尽美
definition_en: The state of being completely without faults or weaknesses
example1_en: The bread was baked to perfection, with a crisp crust.
example1_ja: 这面包烤得恰到好处，外皮酥脆。
example2_en: An excessive desire for perfection can increase students' anxiety and discourage them from experimenting with new ideas.
example2_ja: 过度追求完美会加重学生的焦虑，并使他们不愿尝试新想法。
collocations: strive for perfection｜力求完美 ; achieve perfection｜达到完美 ; to perfection｜完美地；恰到好处 ; pursuit of perfection｜对完美的追求
tip_ja: 通常为不可数名词；to perfection指做得恰到好处。

meanings_ja: v. 搭便车旅行
definition_en: Travel by getting free rides in passing vehicles.
example1_en: We hitchhiked to the coast with our backpacks.
example1_ja: 我们背着背包搭便车去了海边。
example2_en: Although some tourists hitchhike to reduce travel costs, limited transport services can make such journeys unpredictable.
example2_ja: 虽然一些游客为节省交通费用而搭便车，但交通服务有限可能使这类旅程难以预测。
collocations: hitchhike across a country｜搭便车穿越一个国家 ; hitchhike to the coast｜搭便车去海边
tip_ja: 通常作不及物动词；目的地前用to。

meanings_ja: n. 顶峰；山峰；最高点 | v. 达到最高点 | adj. 最高的；高峰期的
definition_en: A mountain's top or the highest level of something. | To reach the highest level or amount. | At the highest level of activity, demand, or achievement.
example1_en: Snow still covered the mountain peak in June.
example1_ja: 六月时，山顶仍覆盖着积雪。
example2_en: Electricity demand usually peaks in the early evening, when households use several appliances at once.
example2_ja: 电力需求通常在傍晚达到高峰，因为那时许多家庭会同时使用多种电器。
collocations: reach a peak｜达到顶峰 ; peak demand｜需求高峰 ; mountain peak｜山峰 ; peak season｜旺季
tip_ja: peak at后接峰值；peak season表示旺季。

meanings_ja: n. 芳香；香气
definition_en: a noticeable pleasant smell, especially from food or drink
example1_en: The aroma of fresh bread filled the kitchen.
example1_ja: 新鲜面包的香气弥漫了整个厨房。
example2_en: The aroma of freshly prepared food can enhance customers' dining experiences and influence their perception of quality.
example2_ja: 现做食物的香气能够提升顾客的用餐体验，并影响他们对品质的判断。
collocations: the aroma of coffee｜咖啡的香气 ; rich aroma｜浓郁的香气 ; release an aroma｜散发香气
tip_ja: 通常指令人愉悦的气味，尤用于食物和饮品。

meanings_ja: v. 给……接种疫苗
definition_en: To give a vaccine that helps protect against a disease.
example1_en: The vet will vaccinate our puppy during today's appointment.
example1_ja: 兽医会在今天的就诊中给我们的小狗接种疫苗。
example2_en: Public health programmes aim to vaccinate vulnerable populations and reduce the spread of infectious diseases.
example2_ja: 公共卫生项目旨在为易感人群接种疫苗，并减少传染病的传播。
collocations: vaccinate against measles｜接种麻疹疫苗 ; vaccinate children｜给儿童接种疫苗 ; get vaccinated｜接种疫苗
tip_ja: 用vaccinate someone against某疾病。

meanings_ja: n. 贡献；促成作用 | n. 捐款；捐赠物 | n. 投稿；稿件
definition_en: Something done or provided to help achieve a shared result. | Money or goods given to support a person or cause. | A piece of writing supplied for a publication.
example1_en: Your contribution helped us finish the garden before sunset.
example1_ja: 有了你的帮助，我们在日落前完成了花园的整理工作。
example2_en: Public libraries make a valuable contribution to lifelong learning by providing free access to information.
example2_ja: 公共图书馆通过免费提供信息资源，为终身学习作出了宝贵贡献。
collocations: make a contribution to｜为…作出贡献 ; a significant contribution｜重大贡献 ; a voluntary contribution｜自愿捐款
tip_ja: 常用make a contribution to；to后接名词或动名词。

meanings_ja: adj. 海面下的；海底的
definition_en: Located or happening below the surface of the sea
example1_en: The documentary showed colourful fish around an undersea cave.
example1_ja: 这部纪录片展示了海底洞穴周围色彩斑斓的鱼。
example2_en: Undersea cables connect continents and provide essential infrastructure for global communication and international trade.
example2_ja: 海底电缆连接各大洲，为全球通信和国际贸易提供重要基础设施。
collocations: undersea cable｜海底电缆 ; undersea exploration｜海底勘探 ; undersea tunnel｜海底隧道
tip_ja: 常放在名词前；强调海面以下，而非所有水下环境。

meanings_ja: n. 暴风雪
definition_en: A severe snowstorm with strong winds.
example1_en: We stayed indoors while the blizzard shook our windows.
example1_ja: 暴风雪吹得窗户直响，我们一直待在屋里。
example2_en: A severe blizzard can disrupt public transport and leave rural communities without electricity for several days.
example2_ja: 严重的暴风雪可能扰乱公共交通，并使农村社区连续数天断电。
collocations: a severe blizzard｜猛烈的暴风雪 ; blizzard conditions｜暴风雪天气
tip_ja: 比普通snowstorm更强调强风和恶劣天气。

meanings_ja: n. 一户；同住的一家人 | adj. 家庭的；家用的
definition_en: all the people who live together in one home | relating to a home and its everyday needs
example1_en: Everyone in our household takes turns washing the dishes.
example1_ja: 我们家每个人都轮流洗碗。
example2_en: Rising energy prices place considerable pressure on household budgets, particularly among families with lower incomes.
example2_ja: 能源价格上涨给家庭预算带来了很大压力，低收入家庭尤其如此。
collocations: household income｜家庭收入 ; household appliances｜家用电器 ; household chores｜家务 ; single-person household｜独居户
tip_ja: household强调同住一户，不一定有亲属关系。

meanings_ja: v. 相符；相对应 | v. 通信
definition_en: To match something or have an equivalent role or position. | To exchange letters or messages with someone.
example1_en: The colours on these lids correspond to the containers.
example1_ja: 这些盖子的颜色与各自的容器相对应。
example2_en: University courses should correspond more closely to the skills that employers need in a changing economy.
example2_ja: 在不断变化的经济中，大学课程应与雇主所需的技能更加契合。
collocations: correspond to｜对应于 ; correspond with someone｜与某人通信 ; correspond closely｜高度相符
tip_ja: 对应常用correspond to；与人通信接with。

meanings_ja: adj. 广阔的；巨大的
definition_en: Extremely large in area, size, amount, or degree.
example1_en: A vast desert stretched beyond the small village.
example1_ja: 小村庄外是一片绵延的广阔沙漠。
example2_en: Digital libraries give students access to vast amounts of information, although evaluating its reliability remains essential.
example2_ja: 数字图书馆让学生能够获取海量信息，但评估信息的可靠性仍然至关重要。
collocations: the vast majority｜绝大多数 ; vast amounts of｜大量的 ; a vast area｜广阔的区域 ; vast resources｜巨大的资源储备
tip_ja: the vast majority of表示……中的绝大多数。

meanings_ja: n. 部分；片段；瓣 | v. 分割；划分
definition_en: one part of something divided into separate sections | to divide something into separate parts or groups
example1_en: He offered me a juicy segment of orange.
example1_ja: 他递给我一瓣多汁的橙子。
example2_en: Companies often segment their customers by age to develop more effective advertising strategies.
example2_ja: 企业常按年龄划分顾客群体，以制定更有效的广告策略。
collocations: market segment｜细分市场 ; orange segment｜一瓣橙子 ; segment customers｜划分顾客群体
tip_ja: 名词重音在前；动词读/seɡˈment/。

meanings_ja: n. 侦察员；球探；星探 | v. 搜寻；侦察 | n. 童子军成员
definition_en: Someone sent to gather information or discover talented people. | To search an area for something or gather information. | A member of a youth group learning outdoor skills.
example1_en: A scout watched our team practise after school.
example1_ja: 放学后，一位球探观看了我们队的训练。
example2_en: Sports clubs often scout for talented young players in communities that lack access to professional training facilities.
example2_ja: 体育俱乐部经常到缺乏专业训练设施的社区寻找有天赋的年轻球员。
collocations: a talent scout｜星探；人才发掘者 ; a football scout｜足球球探 ; scout for talent｜寻找人才 ; scout out a location｜勘察地点
tip_ja: scout for后接寻找的对象；童子军成员常写作Scout。

meanings_ja: n. 替代品；替补者 | v. 替代；用……代替
definition_en: A person or thing used in place of another. | Use someone or something instead of another person or thing.
example1_en: Yoghurt makes a good substitute for cream in this soup.
example1_ja: 做这道汤时，酸奶可以很好地代替奶油。
example2_en: Online lessons can support independent learning, but they are not always an adequate substitute for classroom interaction.
example2_ja: 线上课程能支持自主学习，但并不总能充分替代课堂互动。
collocations: a substitute for｜……的替代品 ; substitute A for B｜用A代替B ; a suitable substitute｜合适的替代品 ; a substitute teacher｜代课教师
tip_ja: substitute A for B＝用A代替B，勿颠倒。

meanings_ja: v. 撒；洒 | n. 少量；少许
definition_en: To scatter small drops or pieces over something. | A small amount scattered over a surface.
example1_en: Sprinkle some cinnamon over your porridge before eating.
example1_ja: 吃燕麦粥前，在上面撒些肉桂粉。
example2_en: Rather than adding excessive salt, consumers can sprinkle herbs over meals to enhance flavour more healthily.
example2_ja: 消费者可以在饭菜上撒些香草，以更健康的方式增添风味，而不是加入过多盐。
collocations: sprinkle sugar over｜把糖撒在……上 ; sprinkle with herbs｜撒上香草 ; a sprinkle of salt｜少许盐
tip_ja: 可说sprinkle A over B，也可说sprinkle B with A。

meanings_ja: n. 孤独；寂寞
definition_en: Sadness caused by feeling alone or lacking close relationships
example1_en: Calling an old friend helped ease my loneliness.
example1_ja: 给一位老朋友打电话缓解了我的孤独感。
example2_en: Community activities can reduce loneliness among older adults by creating opportunities for regular and meaningful social contact.
example2_ja: 社区活动能提供定期且有意义的社交机会，从而减轻老年人的孤独感。
collocations: feelings of loneliness｜孤独感 ; ease loneliness｜缓解孤独 ; social isolation and loneliness｜社会隔离与孤独
tip_ja: loneliness强调难过；solitude可指享受独处。

meanings_ja: adj. 传染性的 | adj. 有感染力的
definition_en: able to spread disease between people or organisms | causing others to share the same feeling or behaviour
example1_en: His infectious laugh soon had everyone at the table smiling.
example1_ja: 他富有感染力的笑声很快让桌边的每个人都笑了起来。
example2_en: Improved sanitation and access to clean water are essential for preventing infectious diseases in densely populated communities.
example2_ja: 改善卫生条件并保障清洁用水，对预防人口密集社区的传染病至关重要。
collocations: infectious disease｜传染病 ; highly infectious｜传染性很强的 ; infectious enthusiasm｜有感染力的热情 ; infectious laughter｜有感染力的笑声
tip_ja: infectious表示有传染性；infected表示已被感染。

meanings_ja: n. 危险因素；隐患 | v. 冒险提出
definition_en: Something that could cause harm, damage, or an accident. | To suggest something despite uncertainty about whether it is correct.
example1_en: That loose cable is a hazard near the stairs.
example1_ja: 楼梯旁那根松散的电线是个安全隐患。
example2_en: Poorly stored industrial chemicals pose a serious health hazard to workers and residents in nearby communities.
example2_ja: 储存不当的工业化学品会对工人及附近社区居民造成严重的健康威胁。
collocations: health hazard｜健康隐患 ; fire hazard｜火灾隐患 ; pose a hazard｜构成危险 ; hazard a guess｜大胆猜测
tip_ja: 名词指危险来源；动词常见于hazard a guess。

meanings_ja: v. 发出柔和的光 | n. 柔光；红光 | v. 脸发红；容光焕发
definition_en: to produce a steady, soft light | a soft, steady light | to look warm, healthy, or full of pleasure
example1_en: The last embers glowed softly in the fireplace.
example1_ja: 壁炉里最后的余烬发出柔和的红光。
example2_en: The warm glow of street lighting can make public spaces feel safer after dark.
example2_ja: 街灯温暖的光芒能让公共空间在天黑后给人更安全的感觉。
collocations: a warm glow｜温暖的柔光 ; glow with pride｜因自豪而容光焕发 ; a healthy glow｜健康红润的气色
tip_ja: glow常指持续柔光；flash指短暂闪光。

meanings_ja: n. 新奇；新颖 | n. 新鲜事物 | n. 新奇小玩意儿
definition_en: the quality of being new, unusual, or unfamiliar | something new or unusual that attracts interest | a small unusual object made mainly for amusement

meanings_ja: v. 浸；蘸 | v. 短暂下降；下沉 | n. 短时游泳；短暂下降

example2_en: Temperatures may dip overnight, increasing the demand for heating in homes that lack adequate insulation.
example2_ja: 夜间气温可能下降，使保温不足的住宅对供暖的需求增加。
collocations: dip into water｜浸入水中 ; a dip in sales｜销量的短暂下降 ; go for a dip｜去游一会儿泳
tip_ja: 过去式和过去分词为dipped；现在分词为dipping。

meanings_ja: n. 考古学家
definition_en: someone who studies past societies through objects and physical remains

example1_ja: 考古学家轻轻刷去陶碗上的泥土。
example2_en: An archaeologist can reveal how ancient communities adapted to environmental change by examining tools and settlement patterns.
example2_ja: 考古学家可以通过研究工具和聚落分布，揭示古代群体如何适应环境变化。
collocations: a team of archaeologists｜一队考古学家 ; a leading archaeologist｜杰出的考古学家 ; a field archaeologist｜田野考古学家
tip_ja: 考古研究人类遗存；研究恐龙的通常是古生物学家。

meanings_ja: n. 共和国；共和政体

example1_ja: 老师讲解了这个国家如何成为共和国。
example2_en: In a republic, constitutional rules usually define the powers of the head of state and other public institutions.
example2_ja: 在共和国中，宪法规则通常规定国家元首及其他公共机构的权力。
collocations: become a republic｜成为共和国 ; establish a republic｜建立共和国 ; a parliamentary republic｜议会制共和国
tip_ja: 共和国没有君主，但并不必然实行民主制度。

meanings_ja: n. 主席；董事长；会议主持人
definition_en: a person, usually a man, who leads a meeting or organisation
example1_en: The chairman welcomed everyone and opened the meeting.
example1_ja: 主席欢迎大家到场，并宣布会议开始。
example2_en: The chairman of the committee urged members to consider how the proposed policy would affect rural communities.
example2_ja: 委员会主席敦促成员考虑拟议政策会对农村社区产生怎样的影响。
collocations: chairman of the board｜董事长 ; committee chairman｜委员会主席 ; appoint a chairman｜任命主席
tip_ja: 性别中性的表达可用chair或chairperson。

meanings_ja: n. 捐赠；捐赠物
definition_en: Money or goods given to help a person or organisation.
example1_en: We made a small donation to the animal shelter.
example1_ja: 我们向动物收容所捐了一小笔钱。
example2_en: Regular donations from local businesses enable the charity to provide free meals for vulnerable residents.
example2_ja: 当地企业的定期捐赠使这家慈善机构能够为弱势居民提供免费餐食。
collocations: make a donation｜捐款；捐赠 ; generous donation｜慷慨的捐赠 ; blood donation｜献血
tip_ja: 常用make a donation to，表示向某方捐赠。

meanings_ja: n. 和解；解决协议 | n. 定居点；聚居地 | n. 结算；清偿
definition_en: An agreement that ends a dispute. | A place where people establish a community. | The payment of money owed.
example1_en: The neighbours finally reached a settlement over the damaged fence.
example1_ja: 邻居们终于就受损围栏的问题达成了和解。
example2_en: Ancient settlements often developed near rivers because reliable water supplies supported farming, trade, and daily life.
example2_ja: 古代聚居地往往形成于河流附近，因为可靠的水源能支持农业、贸易和日常生活。
collocations: reach a settlement｜达成和解 ; a peace settlement｜和平协议 ; a rural settlement｜乡村聚居地 ; settlement of debts｜债务清偿
tip_ja: 可指争议的解决协议，也可指人们居住的定居点。

meanings_ja: n. 霸凌；欺凌行为 | v. 欺负；恐吓

example1_ja: 午饭后，她向老师报告了遭受欺凌的事。
example2_en: Schools should address bullying through clear reporting procedures and consistent support for affected students.

collocations: school bullying｜校园霸凌 ; online bullying｜网络霸凌 ; prevent bullying｜预防霸凌
tip_ja: 作名词通常不可数；也可作bully的现在分词。

meanings_ja: adj. 夸大的；言过其实的 | adj. 刻意夸张的
definition_en: Presented as greater, worse, or more important than it really is | Made unusually large or noticeable for emphasis or effect
example1_en: His exaggerated story made the small spider sound enormous.
example1_ja: 他把故事说得很夸张，让那只小蜘蛛听起来大得吓人。
example2_en: Exaggerated claims in advertising can mislead consumers and reduce public trust in businesses over time.
example2_ja: 广告中夸大的宣传可能误导消费者，并逐渐削弱公众对企业的信任。
collocations: exaggerated claims｜夸大的说法 ; greatly exaggerated｜大大夸大的 ; exaggerated gestures｜夸张的手势
tip_ja: 形容说法或表现被夸大；不要与“准确的”混用。

meanings_ja: adv. 均匀地；平均地 | adv. 平静地；平稳地
definition_en: In equal amounts or with equal spaces between things | In a calm, steady way without noticeable changes
example1_en: Spread the butter evenly over each slice of bread.
example1_ja: 把黄油均匀地涂在每片面包上。
example2_en: Public investment should be distributed more evenly across regions to reduce inequalities in access to essential services.
example2_ja: 公共投资应更均衡地分配到各地区，以减少基本服务获取方面的不平等。
collocations: evenly distributed｜均匀分布的 ; evenly spaced｜间距相等的 ; divide evenly｜平均分配 ; speak evenly｜平静地说话
tip_ja: 强调数量或间距均等；不等于表示始终如一的consistently。

meanings_ja: n. 入侵者；侵略者 | n. 入侵物种
definition_en: a person or force entering a place without permission | an organism spreading into an area and threatening native life
example1_en: The castle walls once protected villagers from invaders.
example1_ja: 这些城堡围墙曾保护村民免遭入侵者袭击。
example2_en: Biological invaders can disrupt local ecosystems by competing with native species for food, space, and other resources.
example2_ja: 生物入侵者会与本地物种争夺食物、空间及其他资源，从而扰乱当地生态系统。
collocations: foreign invaders｜外国侵略者 ; repel invaders｜击退入侵者 ; biological invader｜生物入侵者
tip_ja: invader指入侵者；invasion指入侵这一行为。

meanings_ja: adj. 免息的；无息的
definition_en: Requiring no interest payments on borrowed money.
example1_en: We bought our sofa with an interest-free loan.
example1_ja: 我们用一笔免息贷款买了沙发。
example2_en: Interest-free loans can help students cover living expenses without increasing their financial burden through interest charges.
example2_ja: 免息贷款可以帮助学生支付生活开支，而不会因利息费用增加他们的经济负担。
collocations: interest-free loan｜免息贷款 ; interest-free credit｜免息信贷 ; interest-free period｜免息期
tip_ja: 免息不等于免费：本金仍须偿还。

meanings_ja: adj. 看不见的；隐形的 | adj. 不被注意的；被忽视的
definition_en: Impossible to see. | Not noticed or acknowledged by other people.
example1_en: The thin fishing line was almost invisible underwater.
example1_ja: 那根细鱼线在水下几乎看不见。
example2_en: Although many air pollutants are invisible, prolonged exposure can seriously damage respiratory health, particularly among children.
example2_ja: 尽管许多空气污染物看不见，长期接触仍可能严重损害呼吸系统健康，儿童尤其如此。
collocations: invisible to the naked eye｜肉眼看不见的 ; almost invisible｜几乎看不见的 ; remain invisible｜仍不被看见
tip_ja: invisible指看不见；与看不懂的incomprehensible不同。

meanings_ja: n. 专长；专业领域 | n. 特色食品；特产
definition_en: a subject or activity someone has particular knowledge or skill in | a food or product a person or place is known for

example1_ja: 烤水果派一直是我祖母的拿手活。
example2_en: Choosing a medical specialty requires students to consider their interests alongside the healthcare needs of the wider population.
example2_ja: 选择医学专科要求学生兼顾自身兴趣与广大民众的医疗需求。
collocations: medical specialty｜医学专科 ; local specialty｜地方特产 ; house specialty｜本店招牌菜 ; area of specialty｜专长领域
tip_ja: 美式常用specialty；英式也常用speciality。

meanings_ja: adj. 宏伟的；豪华的 | adj. 宏大的；重大的 | adj. 极好的；令人愉快的

example1_ja: 我们沿着闪亮吊灯下的豪华楼梯走了上去。

example2_ja: 保护宏伟的公共建筑可以增强地方认同感，但维护往往需要大量政府资金。
collocations: a grand staircase｜豪华的大楼梯 ; a grand plan｜宏大的计划 ; a grand opening｜隆重的开幕式 ; the grand total｜总计
tip_ja: grand total指全部加起来的总数。

meanings_ja: n. 小册子；宣传册
definition_en: A thin booklet giving information or arguments about a subject

example1_ja: 护士递给我一本关于健康饮食的小册子。
example2_en: Public health pamphlets should use clear language and illustrations to explain preventive measures to a broad audience.
example2_ja: 公共卫生宣传册应使用清晰的语言和插图，向广大受众解释预防措施。
collocations: an information pamphlet｜信息手册 ; distribute pamphlets｜分发小册子 ; a pamphlet on health｜健康宣传册
tip_ja: 通常指介绍专题的薄册子，比普通书籍篇幅短。

meanings_ja: n. 数据库；资料库

example1_ja: 图书馆的数据库帮我找到了一本园艺书。
example2_en: Hospitals need secure databases to protect patient records while allowing doctors to access essential information.
example2_ja: 医院需要安全的数据库来保护病历，同时让医生能够获取必要信息。

example1_ja: 连日灰暗的天空和不停的雨让我感到沮丧。

example2_ja: 高昂的借贷成本会抑制消费支出，使小企业更难生存。

meanings_ja: n. 加工；处理 | n. 数据处理

meanings_ja: adj. 巨大的；厚重的 | adj. 大量的；程度极大的

meanings_ja: n. 货摊；摊位 | v. 使停滞；拖延 | v. 使熄火；熄火

meanings_ja: n. 微风 | n. 轻而易举的事 | v. 轻松通过；轻快走动

example1_ja: 一阵凉风吹起了我床边的窗帘。
example2_en: Coastal parks offer residents pleasant places to exercise while enjoying the fresh sea breeze.
example2_ja: 沿海公园为居民提供了宜人的锻炼场所，让他们同时享受清新的海风。

meanings_ja: v. 感激 | v. 欣赏；赏识 | v. 理解；意识到

example1_ja: 非常感谢你在我不在的时候帮忙给植物浇水。
example2_en: Policymakers need to appreciate the difficulties rural communities face when accessing healthcare and other essential services.

meanings_ja: adj. 正式的；官方的 | adj. 庄重的；拘谨的 | adj. 正规的；系统的

example1_ja: 你需要正式邀请才能出席典礼。
example2_en: Formal education provides essential knowledge, while practical experience helps students apply what they have learned.
example2_ja: 正规教育提供必备知识，而实践经验帮助学生运用所学内容。

meanings_ja: n. 连指手套

example1_ja: 她把一只羊毛连指手套掉在了积雪的小路旁。
example2_en: In cold climates, insulated mittens help outdoor workers maintain hand warmth during prolonged exposure to low temperatures.
example2_ja: 在寒冷地区，保温连指手套能帮助长时间处于低温环境的户外工作者保持双手温暖。

meanings_ja: n. 冥想；静坐 | n. 沉思；深思

example2_ja: 一些学校开设冥想课程，帮助学生缓解压力并提高专注力。

meanings_ja: n. 灰泥；石膏材料 | n. 创可贴 | v. 抹灰泥；涂石膏

meanings_ja: n. 聚光灯；聚光灯光束 | n. 公众关注；关注焦点 | v. 突出呈现；使受到关注
definition_en: A lamp directing a strong beam onto a small area. | Public attention directed towards a person or issue. | To draw particular attention to someone or something.

example2_ja: 近期研究使城市空气污染成为关注焦点，引发了加强车辆监管的呼声。

meanings_ja: n. 黄昏；薄暮

meanings_ja: adj. 清爽提神的 | adj. 令人耳目一新的

meanings_ja: adj. 不安的；忧虑的 | adj. 不稳定的；勉强维持的

meanings_ja: n. 进步；进展 | v. 前进；促进；推进 | adj. 预先的；事先的

meanings_ja: n. 自立；自主 | n. 国家独立

meanings_ja: adj. 酷热的；灼热的

meanings_ja: n. 烈酒
definition_en: Strong alcoholic drink made by distillation.

meanings_ja: n. 选择；挑选 | n. 可供挑选的一组物品 | n. 精选集；选出的事物

meanings_ja: adv. 向外；朝外

meanings_ja: n. 估算；估计 | n. 评价；看法

example1_ja: 据我估计，我们还需要三把椅子。

collocations: cost estimation｜成本估算 ; rough estimation｜粗略估计 ; in my estimation｜在我看来
tip_ja: estimation常指估算过程；具体估价常用estimate。

meanings_ja: n. 烟草；烟叶

example2_ja: 提高烟草制品税可以抑制吸烟，并为公共卫生项目筹集资金。

meanings_ja: n. 专家组；评审小组 | n. 镶板；嵌板 | n. 控制面板；仪表盘
definition_en: a group chosen to discuss, judge, or advise | a flat piece forming part of a surface | a surface containing controls or instruments

meanings_ja: adj. 陶瓷的 | n. 陶瓷材料；陶瓷制品
definition_en: Made from clay or similar materials hardened by heat. | A material hardened by heat, or an object made from it.

meanings_ja: adj. 微不足道的；不重要的

meanings_ja: v. 为…祈福；祝福 | v. 使有幸拥有

meanings_ja: n. 惨剧；灾难；不幸事件 | n. 悲剧；悲剧作品

meanings_ja: n. 集会；集合 | n. 装配；组装 | n. 议会；立法机构

meanings_ja: v. 劝阻；阻碍 | v. 使气馁

meanings_ja: n. 火花；电火花 | v. 引发；激起 | n. 一丝；触发因素
