definition_en: An object that protects someone or something from harm. | To protect someone or something from harm or exposure.
example1_en: The worker lowered a clear shield over her face.
example1_ja: 这名工人放下透明面罩，护住脸部。
example2_en: Urban trees can shield pedestrians from intense sunlight while reducing temperatures in densely populated neighbourhoods.
example2_ja: 城市树木能为行人遮挡强烈阳光，同时降低人口密集街区的温度。
collocations: a face shield｜防护面罩 ; a protective shield｜防护屏障 ; shield someone from harm｜保护某人免受伤害
tip_ja: 动词常用shield someone from something。

meanings_ja: n. 暗示；提示 | v. 暗示 | n. 少许；微量
definition_en: An indirect suggestion or clue that helps someone understand | To suggest something without stating it directly | A very small amount or slight sign of something
example1_en: Give me a hint about where you hid the gift.
example1_ja: 给我一点提示吧，你把礼物藏在哪里了？
example2_en: Survey responses hint at growing dissatisfaction with public transport, particularly among commuters living outside city centres.
example2_ja: 调查回复暗示，人们对公共交通的不满日益加深，住在市中心以外的通勤者尤其如此。
collocations: give someone a hint｜给某人提示 ; take the hint｜领会暗示 ; hint at something｜暗示某事 ; a hint of lemon｜一丝柠檬味
tip_ja: 动词常用hint at sth或hint that从句。

meanings_ja: v. 改变；修改 | v. 改衣服
definition_en: To change, or make something different. | To change clothing so that it fits better.
example1_en: Could you alter these trousers so they fit better?
example1_ja: 你能改一下这条裤子，让它更合身吗？
example2_en: Rising temperatures may alter rainfall patterns and create serious challenges for farmers in dry regions.
example2_ja: 气温上升可能改变降雨模式，给干旱地区的农民带来严峻挑战。
collocations: alter plans｜更改计划 ; alter significantly｜显著改变 ; alter the appearance｜改变外观
tip_ja: 可及物也可不及物；altar是“祭坛”，勿混。

meanings_ja: n. 赌博者；赌徒 | n. 冒险者
definition_en: Someone who risks money on uncertain outcomes | Someone willing to take risks for possible rewards
example1_en: The gambler left the table after losing his money.
example1_ja: 那个赌徒输掉钱后离开了赌桌。
example2_en: Support services can help a problem gambler regain financial stability and rebuild relationships with family members.
example2_ja: 支持服务可以帮助有赌博问题的人恢复财务稳定，并重建与家人的关系。
collocations: problem gambler｜有赌博问题的人 ; compulsive gambler｜嗜赌成瘾者 ; professional gambler｜职业赌徒
tip_ja: gamble是赌博或冒险；gambler指从事这种行为的人。

meanings_ja: adv. 逆时针地 | adj. 逆时针方向的
definition_en: In the opposite direction to the movement of clock hands | Moving opposite to the direction of clock hands
example1_en: Turn the lid anticlockwise to open the jar.
example1_ja: 逆时针拧盖子，就能打开罐子。
example2_en: In the experiment, participants rotated a handle anticlockwise while researchers measured changes in muscle activity.
example2_ja: 实验中，参与者逆时针转动把手，研究人员同时测量肌肉活动的变化。
collocations: turn anticlockwise｜逆时针转动 ; rotate anticlockwise｜逆时针旋转 ; an anticlockwise direction｜逆时针方向
tip_ja: 英式常用anticlockwise，美式常用counterclockwise。

meanings_ja: adj. 拥挤的；堵塞的 | adj. 鼻塞的；充血的
definition_en: Too crowded with traffic or people to allow easy movement. | Blocked by too much mucus or blood.
example1_en: The roads were so congested that we walked home.
example1_ja: 道路堵得厉害，我们便走路回家了。
example2_en: Investing in reliable public transport can reduce traffic on congested roads and improve air quality in cities.
example2_ja: 投资建设可靠的公共交通可以减少拥堵道路上的车辆，并改善城市空气质量。
collocations: congested roads｜拥堵的道路 ; heavily congested｜严重拥堵的 ; a congested city centre｜拥挤的市中心 ; a congested nose｜堵塞的鼻子
tip_ja: 既可形容交通拥堵，也可形容鼻腔等堵塞。

meanings_ja: adj. 最终的；终极的 | adj. 最出色的；极致的
definition_en: Being the final or most important aim or result. | The best or most extreme example of something.
example1_en: Our ultimate goal is to buy a small house.
example1_ja: 我们的最终目标是买一栋小房子。
example2_en: The ultimate aim of public transport investment should be to provide affordable and reliable travel for everyone.
example2_ja: 公共交通投资的最终目标应是为所有人提供价格合理、可靠的出行服务。
collocations: ultimate goal｜最终目标 ; ultimate responsibility｜最终责任 ; the ultimate in comfort｜极致舒适
tip_ja: ultimate强调最终目标或极致，不指最近一次。

meanings_ja: v. 监管；管制 | v. 调节；控制
definition_en: control an activity through rules or laws | adjust something to maintain a suitable level or rate
example1_en: This small device helps regulate the temperature indoors.
example1_ja: 这个小装置有助于调节室内温度。
example2_en: Governments should regulate industrial emissions to protect public health without placing unnecessary burdens on small businesses.
example2_ja: 政府应监管工业排放，在保护公众健康的同时，避免给小企业增加不必要的负担。
collocations: regulate an industry｜监管一个行业 ; regulate emissions｜管制排放 ; regulate body temperature｜调节体温 ; strictly regulated｜受到严格监管的
tip_ja: 及物动词，直接接宾语；regulate temperature指调温。

meanings_ja: adv. 很少；不常
definition_en: Not often; on very few occasions.
example1_en: We seldom eat out because we enjoy cooking together.
example1_ja: 我们很少外出吃饭，因为我们喜欢一起做饭。
example2_en: Rural communities seldom receive the same level of public transport investment as major urban centres.
example2_ja: 农村社区很少获得与主要城市中心同等水平的公共交通投资。
collocations: seldom seen｜很少见到的 ; seldom used｜很少使用的 ; seldom occur｜很少发生
tip_ja: 通常放实义动词前、be动词后；置于句首常需倒装。

meanings_ja: n. 默认设置；默认选项 | n. 违约；拖欠 | v. 拖欠；违约
definition_en: a setting used automatically unless you choose another | failure to pay a debt or fulfil a legal obligation | to fail to pay a debt or meet an obligation
example1_en: This app uses a dark background by default.
example1_ja: 这个应用默认使用深色背景。
example2_en: Borrowers are more likely to default on their loans when unemployment rises and household incomes fall.
example2_ja: 当失业率上升、家庭收入下降时，借款人更容易拖欠贷款。
collocations: by default｜默认地 ; default setting｜默认设置 ; default on a loan｜拖欠贷款 ; debt default｜债务违约
tip_ja: by default 表示默认；拖欠贷款用 default on a loan。

meanings_ja: adj. 闪闪发光的 | adj. 含气泡的 | adj. 生动有趣的；才华横溢的
definition_en: shining with many small flashes of light | containing bubbles of gas | lively, clever, and entertaining
example1_en: She held the sparkling bracelet up to the sunlight.
example1_ja: 她把闪闪发亮的手链举到阳光下。
example2_en: Restaurants can reduce packaging waste by serving locally filtered sparkling water rather than imported bottled alternatives.
example2_ja: 餐厅可以供应本地过滤的气泡水，代替进口瓶装水，从而减少包装废弃物。
collocations: sparkling water｜气泡水 ; sparkling eyes｜神采奕奕的眼睛 ; sparkling conversation｜妙趣横生的交谈
tip_ja: 饮用水中sparkling指含气泡，still指无气泡。

meanings_ja: v. 逆转；撤销；倒车 | adj. 相反的；反向的 | n. 相反情况；背面
definition_en: to change something to its opposite, or move backwards | going in the opposite direction or order | the opposite of something, or its back surface
example1_en: He reversed the car slowly into the garage.
example1_ja: 他慢慢地把车倒进车库。
example2_en: Investment in renewable energy could help reverse the recent rise in emissions from electricity generation.
example2_ja: 对可再生能源的投资可能有助于扭转近期发电排放量上升的趋势。
collocations: reverse a decision｜撤销决定 ; reverse a trend｜逆转趋势 ; in reverse order｜按相反顺序 ; the reverse side｜背面
tip_ja: 倒车用reverse；撤销决定可说reverse a decision。

meanings_ja: n. 补助金；拨款 | v. 正式准许；授予 | v. 承认
definition_en: money given by an organisation for a particular purpose | to officially give someone something they request | to accept that something is true, often reluctantly
example1_en: A small grant helped us repair the village playground.
example1_ja: 一笔小额补助金帮助我们修好了村里的游乐场。
example2_en: Governments should provide research grants to universities developing affordable technologies for reducing household energy consumption.
example2_ja: 政府应向研发低成本家庭节能技术的大学提供研究拨款。
collocations: apply for a grant｜申请补助金 ; research grant｜研究拨款 ; grant permission｜准许 ; take something for granted｜认为某事理所当然
tip_ja: grant sb sth可改为grant sth to sb。

meanings_ja: n. 副职；代理人 | n. 议员
definition_en: someone authorised to assist or act for a more senior person | an elected member of parliament in some countries
example1_en: The manager asked her deputy to lead today's meeting.
example1_ja: 经理让她的副手主持今天的会议。
example2_en: Appointing a capable deputy allows school leaders to share administrative responsibilities and focus on educational improvement.
example2_ja: 任命一位能干的副职能让学校领导分担行政职责，并专注于教育改进。
collocations: deputy director｜副主任；副局长 ; deputy head｜副校长 ; appoint a deputy｜任命副手 ; act as deputy｜担任代理人
tip_ja: 常置于职务前，如deputy director；不泛指所有代表。

meanings_ja: adj. 轻率的；鲁莽的 | n. 皮疹
definition_en: Done without enough thought about possible risks or consequences. | An area of irritated skin covered with spots.
example1_en: It was rash to leave without checking the weather.
example1_ja: 没有查看天气就出发，实在太轻率了。
example2_en: Rash decisions about urban development can leave communities with inadequate transport and limited access to green spaces.
example2_ja: 关于城市发展的轻率决策可能导致社区交通不足，且居民难以享有绿地。
collocations: a rash decision｜轻率的决定 ; a rash promise｜轻率的承诺 ; develop a rash｜出现皮疹 ; a skin rash｜皮疹
tip_ja: 作形容词指鲁莽；作名词指皮疹，常用a rash。

meanings_ja: n. 残余物；剩余部分 | n. 遗迹；遗址 | n. 遗骸
definition_en: Parts left after something has been used, damaged, or destroyed. | Surviving parts of ancient buildings or objects. | The body or bones of a dead person or animal.
example1_en: The remains of our picnic filled a small bag.
example1_ja: 我们野餐后剩下的东西装满了一个小袋子。
example2_en: The remains of ancient settlements provide valuable evidence about how early communities adapted to environmental change.
example2_ja: 古代聚落遗迹为了解早期群体如何适应环境变化提供了宝贵证据。
collocations: the remains of a meal｜餐后剩余物 ; archaeological remains｜考古遗迹 ; human remains｜人类遗骸
tip_ja: 作名词用复数谓语；也可为remain的单数动词形式。

meanings_ja: n. 树桩；残余根部 | v. 难倒；使困惑
definition_en: the base remaining after a tree or object is cut | to leave someone unable to answer or solve something
example1_en: We sat on a tree stump to eat lunch.
example1_ja: 我们坐在一个树桩上吃午饭。
example2_en: Removing tree stumps can disturb forest soils and destroy habitats used by insects and other small organisms.
example2_ja: 清除树桩可能扰动森林土壤，破坏昆虫和其他小型生物的栖息地。
collocations: a tree stump｜树桩 ; remove a stump｜清除树桩 ; be stumped by a question｜被问题难倒
tip_ja: be stumped by表示被难倒，并非被绊倒。

meanings_ja: v. 呕吐；吐出 | n. 呕吐物
definition_en: To bring food or liquid from the stomach through the mouth. | Food or liquid brought up from the stomach.
example1_en: The rough boat ride made several passengers vomit.
example1_ja: 船在航行中剧烈颠簸，导致几位乘客呕吐。
example2_en: Patients who vomit repeatedly may become dehydrated and should seek medical advice if symptoms persist.
example2_ja: 反复呕吐的患者可能出现脱水，若症状持续，应咨询医生。
collocations: start to vomit｜开始呕吐 ; vomit repeatedly｜反复呕吐 ; nausea and vomiting｜恶心与呕吐
tip_ja: 名词指呕吐物；呕吐这一过程常用vomiting。

meanings_ja: n. 革命；政权变革 | n. 重大变革 | n. 旋转一周；公转一周
definition_en: a major change in government, often achieved by force | a dramatic change in how something works or is done | one complete turn around a point or axis
example1_en: The museum has a room devoted to the revolution.
example1_ja: 博物馆有一个专门介绍这场革命的展厅。
example2_en: The digital revolution has transformed education by allowing students to access learning materials from almost anywhere.
example2_ja: 数字革命让学生几乎随时随地都能获取学习资料，从而改变了教育。
collocations: political revolution｜政治革命 ; industrial revolution｜工业革命 ; digital revolution｜数字革命 ; a complete revolution｜旋转一整周
tip_ja: revolution强调根本变革；reform通常指渐进改革。

meanings_ja: n. 消耗；消费 | n. 食用；饮用；摄入量
definition_en: the use of resources, energy, goods, or services | the act or amount of eating or drinking something
example1_en: Our electricity consumption rises when we use the heater.
example1_ja: 使用暖气时，我们的用电量就会上升。
example2_en: Governments can reduce fossil fuel consumption by investing in reliable public transport and renewable energy.
example2_ja: 政府可以通过投资可靠的公共交通和可再生能源，减少化石燃料消耗。
collocations: energy consumption｜能源消耗 ; water consumption｜用水量 ; household consumption｜家庭消费 ; fit for human consumption｜适合人类食用
tip_ja: 通常不可数；消费的人是consumer，不是consumption。

meanings_ja: adj. 长期的
definition_en: continuing or having effects over a long period
example1_en: We need a long-term plan for our garden.
example1_ja: 我们需要为花园制定一个长期规划。
example2_en: Investment in public transport can bring long-term benefits to both local economies and the environment.
example2_ja: 投资公共交通可以为地方经济和环境带来长期效益。
collocations: long-term goal｜长期目标 ; long-term impact｜长期影响 ; long-term investment｜长期投资
tip_ja: 作定语常用连字符；in the long term不加。

meanings_ja: adj. 坐立不安的；难以休息的 | adj. 不满足现状的
definition_en: Unable to relax, stay still, or sleep peacefully. | Eager for change because the present situation feels unsatisfying.
example1_en: The restless child kept swinging her legs under the table.
example1_ja: 那个坐不住的孩子不停地在桌下晃腿。
example2_en: Students may become restless during lengthy lectures if they have few opportunities to participate actively.
example2_ja: 如果缺少积极参与的机会，学生在长时间的讲座中可能会坐立不安。
collocations: restless sleep｜不安稳的睡眠 ; feel restless｜感到坐立不安 ; grow restless｜变得焦躁不安 ; a restless spirit｜不甘安定的性情
tip_ja: restless指难以安静；restful指令人放松的。

meanings_ja: prep. 在……上 | prep. 一……就；在……时
definition_en: on something, especially in formal or literary language | immediately after or at the time of an event
example1_en: The cat rested upon a cushion beside the window.
example1_ja: 猫趴在窗边的垫子上休息。
example2_en: Upon completing their training, new teachers should receive ongoing support from experienced colleagues at school.
example2_ja: 新教师完成培训后，应持续获得校内资深同事的支持。
collocations: upon arrival｜一到达 ; upon completion｜一完成 ; once upon a time｜从前
tip_ja: 比on正式；upon doing表示“一……就”。

meanings_ja: adj. 数学的
definition_en: relating to mathematics
example1_en: This puzzle really puts your mathematical skills to work.
example1_ja: 这道谜题真能让你运用数学技能。
example2_en: Mathematical models help researchers predict how rising temperatures may affect coastal communities over time.
example2_ja: 数学模型帮助研究人员预测气温上升可能如何逐步影响沿海社区。
collocations: mathematical model｜数学模型 ; mathematical skills｜数学技能 ; mathematical calculation｜数学计算
tip_ja: mathematics是学科名，虽以s结尾但用单数谓语。

meanings_ja: n. 不公正；不公正的事
definition_en: Unfair treatment or a particular example of it.
example1_en: We challenged the injustice of excluding her from the team.
example1_ja: 我们对将她排除在队伍之外的不公正做法提出了质疑。
example2_en: Access to affordable legal advice is essential for people seeking to challenge injustice in the workplace.
example2_ja: 对于想要挑战职场不公的人来说，获得负担得起的法律咨询至关重要。
collocations: social injustice｜社会不公 ; a sense of injustice｜不公平感 ; suffer an injustice｜遭受不公正待遇 ; challenge injustice｜挑战不公
tip_ja: 泛指不公时不可数；具体不公事件可用 an injustice。

meanings_ja: n. 畅销书；畅销商品
definition_en: A book or other product that sells in very large quantities.
example1_en: Her first novel became a bestseller within weeks.
example1_ja: 她的第一部小说几周内就成了畅销书。
example2_en: A bestseller can introduce complex scientific ideas to readers who rarely engage with academic publications.
example2_ja: 畅销书能向很少接触学术出版物的读者介绍复杂的科学概念。
collocations: international bestseller｜国际畅销书 ; become a bestseller｜成为畅销书 ; bestseller list｜畅销书榜
tip_ja: 指畅销书或商品，不指畅销书作者。

meanings_ja: n. 翻修；整修
definition_en: The process of repairing and improving a building or room.
example1_en: We stayed with friends during the renovation of our kitchen.
example1_ja: 厨房翻修期间，我们住在朋友家。
example2_en: The renovation of historic buildings can preserve local identity while providing suitable spaces for modern businesses.
example2_ja: 翻修历史建筑既能保留地方特色，也能为现代商业提供合适的空间。
collocations: undergo renovation｜接受翻修 ; extensive renovation｜大规模整修 ; renovation work｜翻修工程 ; renovation costs｜翻修费用
tip_ja: 主要指建筑翻修；制度革新通常不用此词。

meanings_ja: n. 英亩
definition_en: A unit of land area equal to about 4,047 square metres
example1_en: Their vegetable garden covers almost an acre behind the house.
example1_ja: 他们屋后的菜园占地近一英亩。
example2_en: Protecting each acre of wetland helps preserve wildlife habitats and reduces the risk of local flooding.
example2_ja: 保护每一英亩湿地都有助于维护野生动物栖息地，并降低当地发生洪灾的风险。
collocations: an acre of land｜一英亩土地 ; per acre｜每英亩 ; hundreds of acres｜数百英亩
tip_ja: 面积单位：1英亩约4047平方米，不等于一公顷。

meanings_ja: n. 形成；组建 | n. 构造物；地层 | n. 队形；编队
definition_en: The process of developing or bringing something into existence. | A natural structure with a particular shape or arrangement. | An organised arrangement of people, vehicles, or animals.
example1_en: Cold nights encourage the formation of ice on puddles.
example1_ja: 寒冷的夜晚容易使水洼表面结冰。
example2_en: Scientists study the formation of clouds to improve weather forecasts and understand changes in the global climate.
example2_ja: 科学家研究云的形成，以改进天气预报并了解全球气候的变化。
collocations: cloud formation｜云的形成 ; rock formations｜岩石构造 ; the formation of a government｜政府的组建 ; fly in formation｜编队飞行
tip_ja: formation可指形成过程，也可指形成的结构或队形。

meanings_ja: adj. 密集的；强化的 | adj. 集约的；投入密集的
definition_en: involving much work or effort within a short period | using large amounts of resources to produce high output
example1_en: I took an intensive swimming course during the holidays.
example1_ja: 假期里我参加了一个游泳强化课程。
example2_en: Intensive farming can increase food production, but it may also damage soil quality and reduce biodiversity.
example2_ja: 集约化农业可以提高粮食产量，但也可能损害土壤质量并减少生物多样性。
collocations: an intensive course｜强化课程 ; intensive care｜重症监护 ; intensive farming｜集约化农业 ; labour-intensive production｜劳动密集型生产
tip_ja: intensive 强调集中投入；intense 强调感受或程度强烈。

meanings_ja: n. 霜；霜冻 | v. 结霜于；覆以霜 | v. 给糕点涂糖霜
definition_en: Thin ice crystals on surfaces, or weather that forms them. | To cover or become covered with a thin layer of ice. | To cover a cake with a sweet, creamy topping.
example1_en: A thin frost covered the grass outside our kitchen.
example1_ja: 厨房外的草地上覆盖着一层薄霜。
example2_en: Unexpected spring frost can damage young crops, reducing yields and increasing financial pressure on farmers.
example2_ja: 突如其来的春季霜冻会损伤幼苗，降低产量并增加农民的经济压力。
collocations: a sharp frost｜严重霜冻 ; ground frost｜地面霜冻 ; frost damage｜霜冻损害 ; frost a cake｜给蛋糕涂糖霜
tip_ja: frost是霜，不是雪；涂糖霜这一动词义多见于美语。

meanings_ja: adv. 精确地；准确地 | adv. 恰好；正是
definition_en: Exactly and accurately, without any difference or error. | Used to emphasize that something is exactly the case.
example1_en: The carpenter cut each shelf precisely to fit the cupboard.
example1_ja: 木匠精确裁切了每块搁板，使其与柜子吻合。
example2_en: Researchers must measure changes in sea level precisely to assess the long-term effects of climate change.
example2_ja: 研究人员必须精确测量海平面的变化，以评估气候变化的长期影响。
collocations: precisely measure｜精确测量 ; precisely define｜准确界定 ; precisely because｜正是因为
tip_ja: precisely because表示“正是因为”，强调原因。

meanings_ja: v. 诊断疾病 | v. 查明问题原因
definition_en: to identify an illness by examining symptoms and test results | to identify the cause or nature of a problem
example1_en: The doctor diagnosed asthma after checking my breathing.
example1_ja: 医生检查我的呼吸情况后，诊断我患有哮喘。
example2_en: New screening technologies can help doctors diagnose certain diseases before serious symptoms appear.
example2_ja: 新的筛查技术可以帮助医生在严重症状出现前诊断出某些疾病。
collocations: diagnose a disease｜诊断疾病 ; be diagnosed with｜被诊断患有 ; diagnose a fault｜查明故障
tip_ja: 诊断某人患病用diagnose someone with某病。

meanings_ja: n. 结合；组合 | n. 密码锁的密码
definition_en: two or more things joined or used together | a sequence used to open a lock
example1_en: This soup has a delicious combination of herbs and vegetables.
example1_ja: 这道汤把香草与蔬菜搭配得十分美味。
example2_en: A combination of affordable housing and reliable public transport can improve living standards in growing cities.
example2_ja: 经济适用的住房与可靠的公共交通相结合，可以提高发展中城市的生活水平。
collocations: a combination of｜……的组合 ; in combination with｜与……结合 ; winning combination｜成功的组合 ; combination lock｜密码锁
tip_ja: 常用a combination of A and B表示两者结合。

meanings_ja: adj. 巨大的；极大的
definition_en: Extremely large in size, amount, or degree
example1_en: An immense ship blocked our view of the harbour.
example1_ja: 一艘巨轮挡住了我们望向港口的视线。
example2_en: The transition to renewable energy requires immense investment but can deliver substantial environmental and economic benefits.
example2_ja: 向可再生能源转型需要巨额投资，但能带来显著的环境和经济效益。
collocations: immense pressure｜巨大压力 ; immense potential｜巨大潜力 ; immense satisfaction｜极大的满足感 ; immense contribution｜巨大贡献
tip_ja: 既可形容体积巨大，也可形容压力、潜力等程度极大。

meanings_ja: v. 褪色；使褪色 | v. 逐渐减弱；逐渐消失
definition_en: to lose colour or make something lose colour gradually | to become weaker, less clear, or less noticeable over time
example1_en: The curtains have faded after years of bright sunlight.
example1_ja: 窗帘经过多年强烈日晒，已经褪色了。
example2_en: Public interest in environmental campaigns may fade unless organisations provide regular updates and opportunities for participation.
example2_ja: 如果组织不定期提供最新进展和参与机会，公众对环保活动的兴趣可能会逐渐减退。
collocations: fade away｜逐渐消失 ; fade in the sun｜在阳光下褪色 ; memories fade｜记忆逐渐模糊 ; fade into the background｜逐渐不再引人注意
tip_ja: 强调逐渐变化；fade away指慢慢减弱或消失。

meanings_ja: v. 磨快；削尖 | v. 提高；增强
definition_en: To make an edge or point sharper. | To make a skill, sense, or quality more effective.
example1_en: I sharpened my pencil before sketching the sleeping cat.
example1_ja: 画那只熟睡的猫之前，我削尖了铅笔。
example2_en: Classroom debates can sharpen students' critical thinking skills by encouraging them to examine competing arguments.
example2_ja: 课堂辩论鼓励学生审视相互对立的论点，从而提高批判性思维能力。
collocations: sharpen a pencil｜削铅笔 ; sharpen a knife｜磨刀 ; sharpen skills｜提升技能 ; sharpen focus｜增强专注力
tip_ja: sharp加-en构成动词，也可比喻提升技能。

meanings_ja: n. 臭氧
definition_en: A gas whose molecules each contain three oxygen atoms.
example1_en: High ozone levels kept us from jogging outside today.
example1_ja: 今天臭氧浓度高，我们没有到户外慢跑。
example2_en: While ozone high in the atmosphere protects life, ground-level ozone can damage human health and crops.
example2_ja: 尽管高空中的臭氧能保护生命，近地面的臭氧却会损害人体健康和农作物。
collocations: ozone layer｜臭氧层 ; ground-level ozone｜近地面臭氧 ; ozone depletion｜臭氧消耗 ; ozone levels｜臭氧浓度
tip_ja: 臭氧不可数；高空臭氧有保护作用，近地面臭氧有害。

meanings_ja: n. 实习；实习岗位 | n. 摆放；布置 | n. 安置；安排
definition_en: A temporary job that provides practical experience during training. | The act of putting something in a particular position. | The act of finding someone a suitable position or home.
example1_en: I learned practical skills during my hospital placement.
example1_ja: 我在医院实习期间学到了实用技能。
example2_en: Universities should offer work placements so that students can apply classroom knowledge in professional settings.
example2_ja: 大学应提供实习机会，让学生能够在职场环境中运用课堂知识。
collocations: work placement｜工作实习 ; job placement｜就业安置 ; product placement｜植入式广告
tip_ja: 英式英语中work placement常指课程中的实习。

meanings_ja: n. 格式；编排方式 | v. 设置格式；编排 | v. 格式化存储设备
definition_en: the way information or an event is arranged or presented | to arrange the appearance of a document or information | to prepare a storage device so it can store data
example1_en: Please send the photos in a different file format.
example1_ja: 请换一种文件格式发送这些照片。
example2_en: Offering course materials in a digital format can make education more accessible to students in remote areas.
example2_ja: 以数字格式提供课程材料，可以让偏远地区的学生更容易获得教育资源。
collocations: file format｜文件格式 ; digital format｜数字格式 ; format a document｜设置文档格式 ; standard format｜标准格式
tip_ja: 动词过去式formatted，现在分词formatting。

meanings_ja: adj. 苏联的；苏维埃的 | n. 苏联人
definition_en: Relating to the former Soviet Union or its governing councils. | A citizen of the former Soviet Union.
example1_en: My grandfather kept a Soviet camera in this drawer.
example1_ja: 我祖父在这个抽屉里存放过一台苏联相机。
example2_en: Researchers study Soviet housing policies to understand how central planning influenced urban development and everyday life.
example2_ja: 研究人员通过考察苏联的住房政策，了解中央计划如何影响城市发展和日常生活。
collocations: Soviet Union｜苏联 ; Soviet era｜苏联时期 ; Soviet architecture｜苏联建筑
tip_ja: Soviet通常大写；小写soviet可指苏维埃议会。

meanings_ja: v. 敦促；力劝 | n. 强烈欲望；冲动
definition_en: To strongly encourage someone to do something. | A strong desire to do something.
example1_en: I resisted the urge to eat another biscuit.
example1_ja: 我忍住了再吃一块饼干的冲动。
example2_en: Health experts urge governments to invest in preventive care rather than focus solely on treating diseases.
example2_ja: 健康专家敦促政府投资预防保健，而不是只关注疾病治疗。
collocations: urge someone to do something｜敦促某人做某事 ; a strong urge to｜想……的强烈冲动 ; resist the urge｜克制冲动 ; urge caution｜力劝谨慎行事
tip_ja: 动词用urge sb to do；名词用an urge to do。

meanings_ja: adj. 组织机构的 | adj. 统筹安排的
definition_en: Relating to the structure or management of an organization. | Relating to planning activities and arranging things effectively.
example1_en: The new manager announced several organizational changes this morning.
example1_ja: 新经理今天上午宣布了几项组织调整。
example2_en: A clear organizational structure can improve communication between departments and help employees understand their responsibilities.
example2_ja: 清晰的组织架构可以改善部门间的沟通，并帮助员工明确职责。
collocations: organizational structure｜组织架构 ; organizational change｜组织变革 ; organizational skills｜统筹能力 ; organizational culture｜组织文化
tip_ja: 英式也写作organisational。

meanings_ja: n. 大块；厚块 | n. 相当大的部分
definition_en: A large, thick piece of something. | A substantial part of an amount or whole.
example1_en: She dropped a chunk of cheese into the soup.
example1_ja: 她把一大块奶酪放进了汤里。
example2_en: Housing costs consume a large chunk of household income, leaving less money for education and leisure.
example2_ja: 住房开支占据了家庭收入的很大一部分，使可用于教育和休闲的钱减少了。
collocations: a chunk of bread｜一大块面包 ; a large chunk of｜很大一部分 ; manageable chunks｜便于处理的小部分
tip_ja: 可指实物的大块，也可指时间或金钱的一大部分。

meanings_ja: adj. 适度的；中等的 | adj. 温和的；不极端的 | v. 缓和；节制
definition_en: Neither very large nor very small in amount or degree | Avoiding extreme political views or actions | To become or make something less extreme or intense
example1_en: A moderate amount of exercise helps me sleep better.
example1_ja: 适量运动能让我睡得更好。
example2_en: Moderate increases in housing density could accommodate urban growth without placing excessive pressure on local infrastructure.
example2_ja: 适度提高住房密度可以满足城市发展的需求，同时避免给当地基础设施造成过大压力。
collocations: moderate exercise｜适度运动 ; moderate growth｜温和增长 ; moderate views｜温和的观点 ; moderate your expectations｜适当降低期望
tip_ja: 形容词末尾读/ət/，动词末尾读/eɪt/。

meanings_ja: adj. 乐于合作的；合作的 | n. 合作社
definition_en: willing to help others or work together | a business owned and run jointly by its members
example1_en: Everyone was cooperative when we rearranged the shared kitchen.
example1_ja: 我们重新布置共用厨房时，大家都很配合。
example2_en: Cooperative learning can help students develop communication skills while taking shared responsibility for completing a task.
example2_ja: 合作学习可以帮助学生培养沟通技能，同时共同承担完成任务的责任。
collocations: cooperative approach｜合作方式 ; cooperative learning｜合作学习 ; agricultural cooperative｜农业合作社
tip_ja: 作形容词表示合作；作名词指合作社。

meanings_ja: adj. 自愿的；非强制的 | adj. 志愿的；无偿的
definition_en: done by choice rather than because it is required | done without payment to help people or an organisation
example1_en: Joining the weekend walking group is completely voluntary.
example1_ja: 参加周末步行小组完全出于自愿。
example2_en: Voluntary work can help young people develop practical skills while contributing to their local communities.
example2_ja: 志愿工作既能帮助年轻人培养实用技能，也能让他们为当地社区作贡献。
collocations: voluntary work｜志愿工作 ; voluntary participation｜自愿参与 ; voluntary organisation｜志愿组织 ; voluntary contributions｜自愿捐款
tip_ja: voluntary是形容词；“志愿者”用volunteer。

meanings_ja: v. 干涉；插手 | v. 妨碍；干扰
definition_en: To become involved in others' affairs without being wanted. | To prevent something from working or progressing properly.
example1_en: Please don't interfere when I'm teaching the puppy to sit.
example1_ja: 我教小狗坐下时，请不要插手。
example2_en: Excessive background noise can interfere with students' concentration and reduce their ability to absorb new information.
example2_ja: 过大的背景噪声会干扰学生的注意力，降低他们吸收新信息的能力。
collocations: interfere in someone's affairs｜干涉某人的事务 ; interfere with concentration｜干扰注意力 ; interfere with sleep｜妨碍睡眠
tip_ja: interfere in多指干涉事务；with多指妨碍正常进行。

meanings_ja: v. 监禁；关押
definition_en: To put someone in prison or keep them confined.
example1_en: The judge imprisoned the thief for stealing valuable paintings.
example1_ja: 法官判处那名偷窃名贵画作的小偷入狱。
example2_en: Governments should consider whether imprisoning people for minor offences is more effective than providing supervised community service.
example2_ja: 政府应考虑，对轻微违法者实行监禁是否比安排受监督的社区服务更有效。
collocations: be imprisoned for｜因……被监禁 ; imprison someone for life｜终身监禁某人 ; false imprisonment｜非法拘禁
tip_ja: be imprisoned for后可接罪名，也可接监禁时长。

meanings_ja: adv. 独立地；不依赖他人地 | adv. 分别地；互不关联地
definition_en: Without needing help or support from others. | Separately, without being connected to or influenced by something else.
example1_en: My grandmother still lives independently in her own flat.
example1_ja: 我祖母仍独立生活在自己的公寓里。
example2_en: Students who learn to work independently are often better prepared for the demands of higher education.
example2_ja: 学会独立完成任务的学生，往往能更好地应对高等教育的要求。
collocations: live independently｜独立生活 ; work independently｜独立工作 ; independently of｜不依赖于；独立于 ; independently verified｜经独立核实的
tip_ja: 表示“不依赖于……”用independently of。

meanings_ja: n. 语言流利度 | n. 流畅；娴熟
definition_en: The ability to use a language easily and smoothly. | The quality of performing an activity smoothly and confidently.
example1_en: Daily chats with friends have improved my fluency in English.
example1_ja: 每天和朋友聊天提高了我说英语的流利度。
example2_en: Language courses should develop fluency alongside accuracy so that learners can communicate confidently in unfamiliar situations.
example2_ja: 语言课程应兼顾流利度与准确性，使学习者能够在陌生情境中自信交流。
collocations: fluency in English｜英语流利度 ; oral fluency｜口语流利度 ; develop fluency｜提高流利度
tip_ja: 通常不可数；表示某种语言的流利程度用fluency in。

meanings_ja: n. 口渴 | n. 渴望；强烈欲望
definition_en: The feeling of needing or wanting something to drink. | A strong desire to have or learn something.
example1_en: Cool water relieved my thirst after the long walk.
example1_ja: 走了很长一段路后，凉水缓解了我的口渴。
example2_en: Schools should nurture children's thirst for knowledge rather than focus exclusively on examination results.
example2_ja: 学校应培养孩子们的求知欲，而不是只关注考试成绩。
collocations: quench your thirst｜解渴 ; a thirst for knowledge｜求知欲 ; a thirst for adventure｜对冒险的渴望
tip_ja: 口渴常说be thirsty；thirst for表示对……的渴望。

meanings_ja: n. 船桨
definition_en: A long pole with a flat blade for rowing boats
example1_en: He lifted one oar and gently pushed the boat away.
example1_ja: 他抬起一支船桨，轻轻把船撑开。
example2_en: Visitors can explore the lake in traditional boats, using oars rather than engines to minimise disturbance to wildlife.
example2_ja: 游客可以乘传统小船游湖，用桨而非发动机推进，以尽量减少对野生动物的干扰。
collocations: a pair of oars｜一对船桨 ; pull on the oars｜用力划桨 ; oar blade｜桨叶
tip_ja: oar通常支在船侧划动；paddle通常手持划动。

meanings_ja: v. 乔装；掩饰 | n. 伪装；乔装用品
definition_en: To change appearance or hide something's true nature. | Something worn or done to prevent recognition.
example1_en: Nadia disguised herself with a wig and oversized glasses.
example1_ja: 娜迪娅戴上假发和超大眼镜，把自己乔装起来。
example2_en: Attractive packaging can disguise poor product quality, making it harder for consumers to make informed choices.
example2_ja: 精美包装可能掩盖产品质量问题，使消费者更难作出明智选择。
collocations: disguise yourself as｜把自己装扮成 ; in disguise｜乔装着 ; disguise the fact that｜掩盖……的事实 ; a blessing in disguise｜因祸得福的事
tip_ja: disguise oneself as后接所扮角色。

meanings_ja: v. 超过；超出
definition_en: to be greater than a particular amount, limit, or expectation
example1_en: This suitcase must not exceed the airline's weight limit.
example1_ja: 这个行李箱不得超过航空公司的重量限制。
example2_en: Demand for affordable housing continues to exceed supply in many rapidly growing cities around the world.
example2_ja: 在世界许多快速发展的城市中，经济适用住房的需求持续超过供应。
collocations: exceed expectations｜超出预期 ; exceed the limit｜超出限度 ; exceed demand｜超过需求 ; exceed the budget｜超出预算
tip_ja: 及物动词，直接接数量或限度，不加than。

meanings_ja: adj. 外交的 | adj. 说话得体的；圆融的
definition_en: relating to official relations between countries | handling people sensitively to avoid offence or conflict
example1_en: You gave a diplomatic answer to that awkward question.
example1_ja: 你对那个尴尬问题的回答很得体。
example2_en: Maintaining diplomatic relations allows countries to resolve disagreements through negotiation rather than allowing tensions to escalate.
example2_ja: 保持外交关系使各国能够通过谈判解决分歧，而不是任由紧张局势升级。
collocations: diplomatic relations｜外交关系 ; diplomatic efforts｜外交努力 ; a diplomatic solution｜外交解决方案 ; a diplomatic answer｜得体的回答
tip_ja: 既可指国家间外交，也可形容说话处事得体。

meanings_ja: n. 发夹；发针 | n. 急转弯；发夹弯
definition_en: A thin bent pin used to hold hair in place. | A very sharp bend where a road nearly doubles back.
example1_en: She secured her bun with a silver hairpin.
example1_ja: 她用一枚银色发夹固定住发髻。
example2_en: Mountain roads with frequent hairpin bends require careful design to reduce accident risks and protect surrounding habitats.
example2_ja: 急转弯频繁的山路需要精心设计，以降低事故风险并保护周边栖息地。
collocations: a silver hairpin｜银色发夹 ; hairpin bend｜发夹弯 ; hairpin turn｜急转弯
tip_ja: hairpin bend指形似发夹、几乎折返的急弯。

meanings_ja: n. 参与者；参加者
definition_en: Someone who takes part in an activity or event.
example1_en: Each participant brought a homemade dish to the cooking workshop.
example1_ja: 每位参与者都带了一道自制菜来参加烹饪工作坊。
example2_en: Every participant in the research project gave informed consent before sharing information about their daily exercise habits.
example2_ja: 研究项目的每位参与者都在知情同意后，才分享了自己的日常锻炼习惯信息。
collocations: active participant｜积极参与者 ; participant in a study｜研究参与者 ; study participants｜研究对象
tip_ja: 常作名词；表示某活动的参与者用participant in。

meanings_ja: n. 试演；试镜；试音 | v. 参加试演；让…试演
definition_en: A short performance to show suitability for a performing role. | Perform or test someone for a role in a production.
example1_en: Lena practised her song before the audition yesterday.
example1_ja: 莉娜昨天在试音前练习了她的歌曲。
example2_en: Open auditions can help local theatres discover talented performers who lack professional training or industry connections.
example2_ja: 公开试演能帮助地方剧院发现缺乏专业训练或行业人脉的优秀表演者。
collocations: attend an audition｜参加试演 ; hold auditions｜举办试演 ; audition for a role｜为某个角色试镜
tip_ja: 现代常用义是试演、试镜，不是一般的听力。

meanings_ja: n. 婴儿 | adj. 婴儿的；初期的
definition_en: a baby or very young child | relating to babies or an early stage of development
example1_en: The infant slept peacefully in her father's arms.
example1_ja: 那个婴儿在父亲怀里安静地睡着。
example2_en: Access to clean water and basic healthcare is essential for reducing infant mortality in disadvantaged communities.
example2_ja: 获得清洁饮水和基本医疗服务，对于降低弱势社区的婴儿死亡率至关重要。
collocations: infant care｜婴儿护理 ; infant mortality｜婴儿死亡率 ; infant formula｜婴儿配方奶 ; an infant industry｜新兴产业
tip_ja: 比baby正式；infant mortality专指婴儿死亡率。

meanings_ja: adv. 相对地；比较而言
definition_en: To a particular degree when compared with something else.
example1_en: This cafe is comparatively quiet after the lunch rush.
example1_ja: 午餐高峰过后，这家咖啡馆相对安静。
example2_en: Cycling remains a comparatively inexpensive form of transport, especially in cities with safe and extensive cycle networks.
example2_ja: 骑行仍是一种相对便宜的交通方式，尤其是在拥有安全、完善自行车道网络的城市。
collocations: comparatively low｜相对较低的 ; comparatively inexpensive｜相对便宜的 ; comparatively little｜相对较少
tip_ja: 常修饰形容词原级，如comparatively cheap。

meanings_ja: n. 因素；要素 | v. 把…计入考虑
definition_en: something that influences a result or situation | to include something when calculating or making a decision
example1_en: Price was the main factor when we chose our sofa.
example1_ja: 我们选沙发时，价格是主要考虑因素。
example2_en: Access to reliable public transport is a key factor in reducing dependence on private cars.
example2_ja: 能否使用可靠的公共交通，是减少对私家车依赖的关键因素。
collocations: key factor｜关键因素 ; contributing factor｜促成因素 ; risk factor｜风险因素 ; factor in the cost｜把成本考虑在内
tip_ja: 动词常用factor in，表示把某因素考虑在内。

meanings_ja: n. 预期；预料 | n. 期望；要求
definition_en: A belief that something will happen. | A standard of success or behaviour someone hopes for.
example1_en: We packed warm coats in expectation of cold weather.
example1_ja: 我们预计天气会冷，就带上了厚外套。
example2_en: High parental expectations can motivate students, but excessive pressure may negatively affect their mental health.
example2_ja: 父母的高期望可以激励学生，但过大的压力可能损害他们的心理健康。
collocations: in expectation of｜预料到；期待着 ; meet expectations｜达到期望 ; exceed expectations｜超出预期 ; high expectations｜很高的期望
tip_ja: 表示对表现的期望时常用复数expectations。

meanings_ja: adj. 敏感的；易受影响的 | adj. 体贴的；善解人意的 | adj. 需谨慎处理的；敏感的
definition_en: Easily affected by emotions, substances, or changes | Aware of and considerate towards other people's feelings | Requiring careful handling because of possible harm or offence
example1_en: My skin is sensitive to this new washing powder.
example1_ja: 我的皮肤对这种新洗衣粉很敏感。
example2_en: Teachers should be sensitive to students' cultural backgrounds when discussing potentially controversial issues in class.
example2_ja: 教师在课堂上讨论可能引发争议的问题时，应顾及学生的文化背景。
collocations: sensitive skin｜敏感皮肤 ; sensitive to criticism｜对批评敏感 ; sensitive information｜敏感信息 ; sensitive issue｜敏感问题
tip_ja: sensitive指敏感的；sensible指明智的，勿混淆。

meanings_ja: n. 帆布 | n. 油画布；油画
definition_en: Strong, heavy cloth used for tents, bags, and sails. | Cloth used for painting, or a painting on this cloth.
example1_en: She packed her lunch in a sturdy canvas bag.
example1_ja: 她把午饭装进一个结实的帆布包里。
example2_en: Painting on canvas allows students to explore colour and texture while developing their creative confidence.
example2_ja: 在画布上作画让学生探索色彩与质感，同时增强创作信心。
collocations: canvas bag｜帆布包 ; canvas tent｜帆布帐篷 ; oil on canvas｜布面油画 ; blank canvas｜空白画布
tip_ja: 帆布作材料时不可数；指一幅油画时可数。

meanings_ja: v. 修剪；削减 | n. 修剪；饰边 | adj. 整洁的；苗条健壮的
definition_en: To remove small amounts to neaten something or reduce it. | A small cut to neaten something, or decorative edging. | Neat in appearance, or slim and physically fit.
example1_en: I trim the hedge before it blocks our window.
example1_ja: 我会在树篱挡住窗户之前修剪它。
example2_en: Local authorities can trim operating costs by improving energy efficiency in public buildings rather than reducing essential services.
example2_ja: 地方政府可以通过提高公共建筑的能源效率来削减运营成本，而不是减少基本服务。
collocations: trim a hedge｜修剪树篱 ; trim costs｜削减成本 ; a quick trim｜简单修剪 ; keep trim｜保持苗条健壮
tip_ja: 过去式trimmed、现在分词trimming都双写m。

meanings_ja: adv. 几乎不；勉强 | adv. 仅仅；刚好
definition_en: Only just; almost not | No more than a small amount or a particular limit
example1_en: I could barely hear her above the heavy rain.
example1_ja: 雨声太大，我几乎听不清她说话。
example2_en: Many low-income households can barely afford basic necessities, leaving little money for education or preventive healthcare.
example2_ja: 许多低收入家庭勉强负担得起基本生活必需品，几乎没有余钱用于教育或预防保健。
collocations: barely visible｜几乎看不见的 ; barely enough｜勉强足够 ; barely survive｜勉强维持生存 ; barely notice｜几乎没注意到
tip_ja: 本身含否定意义，通常不再与not连用。

meanings_ja: n. 供认；坦白 | n. 宗教上的忏悔
definition_en: an admission that you have done something wrong | the act of admitting sins, especially to a priest
example1_en: I have a confession: I ate the last biscuit.
example1_ja: 我得坦白：最后一块饼干是我吃的。
example2_en: Courts should examine whether a confession was obtained voluntarily before accepting it as reliable evidence.
example2_ja: 法庭在将供词采纳为可靠证据之前，应审查其是否出于自愿。
collocations: make a confession｜作出坦白 ; extract a confession｜逼取口供 ; a false confession｜虚假供认 ; go to confession｜去忏悔
tip_ja: confession to 后接名词或动名词；不表示“自由”。

meanings_ja: adv. 公开地；当众 | adv. 由政府或公众出资地
definition_en: in a way that people generally can see or know | through government or community funding or ownership
example1_en: She publicly thanked the neighbours who found her cat.
example1_ja: 她公开感谢了帮她找到猫的邻居们。
example2_en: Research funded by taxpayers should be publicly available so that everyone can benefit from its findings.
example2_ja: 由纳税人资助的研究应向公众开放，让所有人都能从研究成果中受益。
collocations: publicly available｜公众可获取的 ; publicly funded｜由公共资金资助的 ; publicly acknowledge｜公开承认 ; publicly owned｜公有的
tip_ja: 拼写是publicly，不是publically。

meanings_ja: adj. 可进入的；可使用的 | adj. 易懂的
definition_en: easy to reach, enter, obtain, or use | easy for people to understand
example1_en: The garden is accessible through a small wooden gate.
example1_ja: 穿过一扇小木门就能进入花园。
example2_en: Public libraries should provide digital resources that are accessible to users with a wide range of abilities.
example2_ja: 公共图书馆应提供各种能力水平的用户都能使用的数字资源。
collocations: accessible to everyone｜人人可使用的 ; wheelchair accessible｜可供轮椅通行的 ; readily accessible｜很容易获取的 ; accessible language｜通俗易懂的语言
tip_ja: 常用accessible to sb；易懂的内容也可用此词。

meanings_ja: n. 铁锈 | v. 生锈；使生锈
definition_en: A reddish-brown substance that forms on iron exposed to moisture. | To develop rust or cause metal to develop rust.
example1_en: Orange rust covered the chain of my old bicycle.
example1_ja: 我那辆旧自行车的链条上布满了橙色铁锈。
example2_en: Regular maintenance prevents steel bridges from rusting and reduces the long-term cost of infrastructure repairs.
example2_ja: 定期养护可防止钢桥生锈，并降低基础设施维修的长期成本。
collocations: remove rust｜除锈 ; prevent rust｜防锈 ; rust away｜锈蚀损坏
tip_ja: 技能生疏常用rusty：My French is rusty。

meanings_ja: adj. 阴天的；乌云密布的
definition_en: Covered with clouds, making the sky dull and grey.
example1_en: The sky was overcast when we left for school.
example1_ja: 我们出门上学时，天空阴云密布。
example2_en: Although overcast conditions reduce solar electricity generation, modern panels can still produce useful amounts of power.
example2_ja: 虽然阴天会降低太阳能发电量，但现代太阳能板仍能产生可供使用的电力。
collocations: an overcast sky｜阴云密布的天空 ; an overcast day｜阴天 ; overcast conditions｜阴天天气状况
tip_ja: 指天空被云层覆盖，不一定下雨。

meanings_ja: n. 一部分 | n. 一份食物 | v. 分配；把食物分份
definition_en: A part or share of something larger. | An amount of food served to one person. | To divide food into amounts for different people.
example1_en: A large portion of our garden is shaded.
example1_ja: 我们花园里有很大一部分处于阴凉处。
example2_en: Housing costs consume a substantial portion of household income, particularly in cities with limited affordable accommodation.
example2_ja: 住房开支占家庭收入的很大一部分，在平价住房有限的城市尤其如此。
collocations: a large portion of｜……的一大部分 ; a substantial portion｜相当大的一部分 ; generous portions｜分量充足的食物 ; portion size｜每份食物的分量
tip_ja: portion可指整体的一部分，也常指一人份食物。

meanings_ja: n. 细枝；嫩枝 | v. 突然明白；察觉
definition_en: a small, thin branch of a tree or bush | to suddenly understand or notice something
example1_en: A sparrow carried a twig back to its nest.
example1_ja: 一只麻雀衔着一根细枝飞回了巢里。
example2_en: Leaving fallen twigs on forest floors provides shelter for insects and supports the natural recycling of nutrients.
example2_ja: 将掉落的细枝留在林地上能为昆虫提供庇护，并促进养分的自然循环。
collocations: dry twigs｜干树枝 ; snap a twig｜折断细枝 ; twig that｜突然意识到
tip_ja: 动词义为英式非正式用法；过去式twigged。

meanings_ja: n. 原木；木柴 | n. 日志；记录 | v. 记录
definition_en: a thick piece of wood cut from a tree | a detailed record of events or activities | to record information about events, activities, or measurements
example1_en: We sat on a fallen log beside the lake.
example1_ja: 我们坐在湖边一段倒下的树干上。
example2_en: Researchers log changes in water temperature to assess how climate change affects freshwater ecosystems over time.
example2_ja: 研究人员记录水温变化，以评估气候变化长期以来对淡水生态系统的影响。
collocations: a fallen log｜倒下的树干 ; keep a log｜记日志 ; log data｜记录数据 ; log in｜登录
tip_ja: 动词过去式为logged；log in表示登录。

meanings_ja: n. 抽屉柜（美式） | n. 餐具柜（英式） | n. 穿着某种风格的人
definition_en: A piece of furniture with drawers for storing clothes. | A kitchen cupboard with shelves above for displaying dishes. | A person who dresses in a particular way.
example1_en: I put my clean socks in the bedroom dresser.
example1_ja: 我把干净袜子放进卧室的抽屉柜里。
example2_en: Restoring an old dresser rather than buying new furniture can reduce waste and conserve natural resources.
example2_ja: 修复旧抽屉柜而非购买新家具，可以减少浪费并节约自然资源。
collocations: bedroom dresser｜卧室抽屉柜 ; kitchen dresser｜厨房餐具柜 ; a smart dresser｜穿着讲究的人
tip_ja: 美式常指衣物抽屉柜，英式常指餐具柜。

meanings_ja: n. 观察；监测 | n. 观察所得；评论
definition_en: The act of watching carefully to learn or check something. | Something noticed or a comment based on what you notice.
example1_en: The doctor kept him in hospital overnight for observation.
example1_ja: 医生让他留院观察一晚。
example2_en: Careful observation of children's behaviour helps teachers identify learning difficulties and provide appropriate support at an early stage.
example2_ja: 仔细观察儿童的行为有助于教师及早发现学习困难，并提供适当支持。
collocations: close observation｜仔细观察 ; under observation｜受到观察或监测 ; make an observation｜发表观察意见 ; direct observation｜直接观察
tip_ja: 观察活动通常不可数；一条观察意见可数。

meanings_ja: adj. 富有的；富裕的
definition_en: Having a large amount of money or valuable possessions.
example1_en: A wealthy neighbour donated new equipment to our playground.
example1_ja: 一位富裕的邻居为我们的游乐场捐赠了新设备。
example2_en: Wealthy countries can support global development by investing in clean energy projects in poorer regions.
example2_ja: 富裕国家可以通过投资较贫困地区的清洁能源项目来支持全球发展。
collocations: wealthy family｜富裕家庭 ; wealthy countries｜富裕国家 ; wealthy individuals｜富裕人士
tip_ja: the wealthy指富人群体；wealthy本身是形容词。

meanings_ja: v. 升级；改进 | n. 升级；改良版本
definition_en: To improve something or replace it with a better version. | An improvement or a newer, better version of something.
example1_en: We upgraded our old computer with a faster processor.
example1_ja: 我们给旧电脑换上了更快的处理器。
example2_en: Governments should upgrade ageing water systems to reduce waste and provide reliable supplies for growing urban populations.
example2_ja: 政府应升级老旧供水系统，以减少浪费，并为不断增长的城市人口提供可靠供水。
collocations: upgrade software｜升级软件 ; upgrade to｜升级为 ; a system upgrade｜系统升级
tip_ja: 动词重音在后，名词重音在前。

meanings_ja: adj. 犹豫的；迟疑的
definition_en: slow to act or speak because you feel uncertain
example1_en: She looked hesitant before stepping onto the narrow bridge.
example1_ja: 踏上那座窄桥前，她显得有些犹豫。
example2_en: Some older consumers remain hesitant to use online banking because they worry about financial security.
example2_ja: 一些年长消费者仍不愿贸然使用网上银行，因为他们担心资金安全。
collocations: hesitant to agree｜犹豫着不肯同意 ; hesitant about change｜对改变犹豫不决 ; a hesitant smile｜迟疑的微笑
tip_ja: 常用 hesitant to do 或 hesitant about sth。

meanings_ja: adv. 顺便说一句 | adv. 附带地；偶然地
definition_en: Used to introduce an additional or loosely related remark | As a secondary result, rather than the main purpose
example1_en: Incidentally, your scarf is still hanging by our door.
example1_ja: 顺便说一句，你的围巾还挂在我们家门边。
example2_en: Children may learn new vocabulary incidentally while watching educational programmes, even when language learning is not their main goal.
example2_ja: 孩子们看教育节目时，即使主要目的不是学习语言，也可能附带学到新词汇。
collocations: incidentally acquired｜附带习得的 ; learn incidentally｜附带学到 ; mention incidentally｜顺带提及
tip_ja: 句首常表示“顺便说”；不等于所有语境中的偶然。

meanings_ja: n. 电灯泡 | n. 鳞茎
definition_en: A glass or plastic device that produces electric light. | A rounded underground plant part that stores food and grows shoots.
example1_en: The kitchen bulb failed while I was washing dishes.
example1_ja: 我洗碗时，厨房的灯泡坏了。
example2_en: Replacing traditional bulbs with energy-efficient alternatives can reduce household electricity consumption and lower long-term costs.
example2_ja: 用节能灯泡替换传统灯泡可以减少家庭用电量，并降低长期成本。
collocations: light bulb｜电灯泡 ; change a bulb｜换灯泡 ; energy-saving bulb｜节能灯泡 ; plant bulbs｜种植鳞茎
tip_ja: 既指灯泡，也指洋葱、水仙等植物的鳞茎。

meanings_ja: v. 变稠；使变稠 | v. 变厚或密；使增厚
definition_en: To become thicker, or make a liquid thicker. | To become or make something thicker or denser.
example1_en: Add a little flour to thicken the mushroom sauce.
example1_ja: 加一点面粉，让蘑菇酱变稠。
example2_en: As coastal fog thickens, transport operators may need to reduce services to maintain passenger safety.
example2_ja: 随着沿海雾气变浓，运输运营商可能需要减少班次，以保障乘客安全。
collocations: thicken a sauce｜使酱汁变稠 ; fog thickens｜雾变浓 ; the plot thickens｜情况变得更扑朔迷离
tip_ja: 可及物也可不及物：thicken soup；soup thickens。

meanings_ja: n. 容量；容纳能力 | n. 能力；生产能力 | n. 身份；职务
definition_en: the maximum amount something can hold or accommodate | the ability or resources to do or produce something | a particular role in which someone acts
example1_en: This small lift has a capacity of six people.
example1_ja: 这部小电梯最多能容纳六个人。
example2_en: Investment in renewable energy can expand electricity generation capacity while reducing dependence on imported fossil fuels.
example2_ja: 投资可再生能源可以扩大发电能力，同时减少对进口化石燃料的依赖。
collocations: seating capacity｜座位容量 ; production capacity｜生产能力 ; capacity to learn｜学习能力 ; in a professional capacity｜以专业人士身份
tip_ja: 能力用capacity to do；身份用in one's capacity as。

meanings_ja: n. 询问；疑问 | v. 询问；对……提出质疑
definition_en: A question or request for information | To ask about something or question whether it is correct
example1_en: The receptionist answered my query about the swimming pool.
example1_ja: 接待员回答了我关于游泳池的询问。
example2_en: Consumers should query unexpected charges on their bills rather than assume that automated payment systems are always accurate.
example2_ja: 消费者应对账单上的意外收费提出疑问，而不是认为自动支付系统总是准确的。
collocations: answer a query｜回答询问 ; raise a query｜提出疑问 ; query a charge｜质疑一笔收费 ; a database query｜数据库查询
tip_ja: query作动词可直接接所质疑的费用或决定。

meanings_ja: v. 凝视；注视 | n. 凝视；注视的目光
definition_en: To look steadily at something for a long time. | A steady look directed at someone or something.
example1_en: Lina gazed at the moon through her bedroom window.
example1_ja: 莉娜透过卧室窗户凝望着月亮。
example2_en: Visitors often gaze at historic buildings, yet overlook the maintenance work required to preserve these cultural treasures.
example2_ja: 游客常常凝望历史建筑，却忽视了保护这些文化瑰宝所需的维护工作。
collocations: gaze at｜凝视 ; gaze out of the window｜凝望窗外 ; meet someone's gaze｜与某人目光相接 ; avert one's gaze｜移开目光
tip_ja: 动词常接at；比glance看得久，通常比stare柔和。

meanings_ja: n. 罪；罪孽 | v. 犯宗教或道德上的罪
definition_en: an action that breaks a religious or moral rule | to break a religious or moral rule
example1_en: He believed that lying to his friends was a sin.
example1_ja: 他认为对朋友撒谎是一种罪过。
example2_en: Ideas about sin can influence social attitudes, even in societies where religious participation is declining.
example2_ja: 即使在宗教参与度下降的社会，对罪的观念也可能影响社会态度。
collocations: commit a sin｜犯下罪过 ; confess one's sins｜忏悔罪过 ; sin against｜违背；冒犯
tip_ja: 侧重宗教或道德上的罪，不等于法律上的crime。

meanings_ja: v. 抵制；反抗 | v. 忍住；抵挡诱惑 | v. 耐受；抵御
definition_en: Oppose something or try to prevent it from happening | Stop yourself from doing something tempting | Remain undamaged or unaffected by something harmful
example1_en: I could not resist buying another warm cinnamon bun.
example1_ja: 我忍不住又买了一个热乎乎的肉桂面包卷。
example2_en: Employees may resist technological change if they believe new systems will threaten their job security.
example2_ja: 如果员工认为新系统会威胁其工作保障，他们可能会抵制技术变革。
collocations: resist change｜抵制变革 ; resist temptation｜抵挡诱惑 ; resist pressure｜顶住压力 ; resist corrosion｜耐腐蚀
tip_ja: 表示忍住做某事，用resist doing，不用to do。

meanings_ja: n. 甲板；船或巴士的一层 | n. 户外木制平台 | n. 一副纸牌
definition_en: a floor on a ship or a level of a bus | a wooden outdoor platform beside a house | a complete set of playing cards
example1_en: We stood on deck and watched dolphins swim past.
example1_ja: 我们站在甲板上，看着海豚游过。
example2_en: Passengers on the upper deck of sightseeing buses can enjoy clear views of historic buildings.
example2_ja: 观光巴士上层的乘客可以清楚地欣赏历史建筑。
collocations: on deck｜在甲板上 ; upper deck｜上层甲板；巴士上层 ; wooden deck｜木制露台 ; a deck of cards｜一副纸牌
tip_ja: 一副纸牌美式常用deck，英式也常用pack。

meanings_ja: n. 干旱；旱灾
definition_en: A long period with little or no rain.
example1_en: The river dried up during the long drought.
example1_ja: 在那场持续很久的干旱中，河流干涸了。
example2_en: Prolonged drought can reduce agricultural yields and force rural communities to depend on imported food.
example2_ja: 长期干旱会降低农业产量，迫使农村社区依赖进口粮食。
collocations: severe drought｜严重干旱 ; prolonged drought｜长期干旱 ; drought conditions｜干旱状况 ; drought relief｜抗旱救助
tip_ja: 读音押韵于out；不要与draught混淆。

meanings_ja: v. 吸引；使投入 | v. 参与；从事 | v. 雇用；聘请
definition_en: To attract someone's attention and keep them interested or involved. | To take part in an activity. | To hire someone to perform a particular job.
example1_en: The puppet show engaged even the youngest children.
example1_ja: 这场木偶戏连最小的孩子都吸引住了。
example2_en: Schools should encourage students to engage in community activities that develop cooperation and a sense of responsibility.
example2_ja: 学校应鼓励学生参与社区活动，培养合作能力和责任感。
collocations: engage in discussion｜参与讨论 ; engage with an audience｜与观众互动 ; engage someone's attention｜吸引某人的注意 ; engage a consultant｜聘请顾问
tip_ja: 参与活动用engage in；与人互动用engage with。

meanings_ja: n. 议会；国会
definition_en: A country's group of representatives that debates and makes laws
example1_en: Our class visited parliament and watched a lively debate.
example1_ja: 我们班参观了议会，观看了一场热烈的辩论。
example2_en: Parliament should examine the long-term environmental consequences of major infrastructure projects before approving public funding.
example2_ja: 议会应在批准公共拨款前，审查重大基础设施项目的长期环境影响。
collocations: member of parliament｜议会议员 ; parliamentary debate｜议会辩论 ; dissolve parliament｜解散议会
tip_ja: 特指某国议会时常大写；英国议员简称MP。

meanings_ja: adj. 荒谬的；可笑的
definition_en: Extremely silly or unreasonable and deserving to be laughed at.
example1_en: This tiny sandwich costs a ridiculous amount of money.
example1_ja: 这么小的三明治，价格却贵得离谱。
example2_en: It is ridiculous to expect public transport use to increase without improving the reliability of existing services.

tip_ja: 既指失事事件，也指失事后留下的船体。

meanings_ja: v. 舔 | n. 舔；舔一下
definition_en: Move your tongue across something, often to taste it. | An act of moving the tongue across something.
example1_en: The puppy licked my hand and wagged its tail.
example1_ja: 小狗舔了舔我的手，摇着尾巴。
example2_en: Visitors should not allow wild animals to lick their hands, as close contact may spread infections.
example2_ja: 游客不应让野生动物舔自己的手，因为近距离接触可能传播感染。
collocations: lick your lips｜舔嘴唇 ; lick an ice cream｜舔冰激凌 ; give something a lick｜舔一下某物
tip_ja: lick指用舌头舔；咬用bite，吸吮用suck。

meanings_ja: n. 样品；样本 | v. 取样；试尝；体验
definition_en: A small amount or group examined to understand a larger whole. | Take a small amount for testing, or try something.
example1_en: The baker offered us a sample of fresh bread.
example1_ja: 面包师给了我们一小块新鲜面包试吃。
example2_en: Researchers collected a representative sample of households to investigate changes in energy consumption across the region.
example2_ja: 研究人员选取了具有代表性的家庭样本，以调查该地区能源消耗的变化。
collocations: a representative sample｜代表性样本 ; a blood sample｜血样 ; a free sample｜免费样品 ; sample local food｜品尝当地食物
tip_ja: sample强调从整体取出的一部分；example常用于举例。

meanings_ja: n. 替代选择；替代品 | adj. 可替代的；另一种的 | adj. 非传统的
definition_en: something you can choose instead of something else | available to use or choose instead of something else | different from what is usual or widely accepted
example1_en: Cycling is a cheaper alternative to taking the bus.
example1_ja: 骑自行车是比坐公交车更便宜的出行选择。
example2_en: Governments should invest in alternative energy sources to reduce dependence on fossil fuels and improve energy security.
example2_ja: 政府应投资替代能源，以减少对化石燃料的依赖并提高能源安全。
collocations: an alternative to｜……的替代选择 ; alternative energy｜替代能源 ; a viable alternative｜可行的替代方案 ; have no alternative｜别无选择
tip_ja: 替代某物用alternative to，不限于二选一。

meanings_ja: v. 使变甜；变甜 | v. 使更有吸引力
definition_en: to make something sweeter or become sweeter | to make an offer or situation more attractive
example1_en: I sweeten my porridge with a little honey.
example1_ja: 我会加一点蜂蜜，让粥甜一些。
example2_en: Employers may sweeten job offers with flexible working hours to attract skilled candidates in competitive industries.
example2_ja: 竞争激烈的行业中，雇主可能提供弹性工作时间，让职位更具吸引力，从而吸引技术人才。
collocations: sweeten with honey｜用蜂蜜增加甜味 ; sweeten the deal｜增加交易的吸引力 ; sweeten an offer｜使提议更诱人
tip_ja: sweeten the deal指增加优惠，让交易更诱人。

meanings_ja: n. 保险丝；熔断器 | v. 熔合；融合 | n. 导火线；引信
definition_en: A safety device that breaks a circuit when current is excessive. | To join together into one whole, often through heat. | A cord or device that makes an explosive charge go off.
example1_en: The electrician replaced the fuse, and the lights came on.
example1_ja: 电工换了保险丝，灯就亮了。
example2_en: Modern design often fuses traditional craftsmanship with digital technology to create more sustainable consumer products.
example2_ja: 现代设计常将传统工艺与数字技术融合，以创造更可持续的消费品。
collocations: blow a fuse｜烧断保险丝；大发雷霆 ; replace a fuse｜更换保险丝 ; fuse together｜融合在一起 ; light a fuse｜点燃导火线
tip_ja: 作动词指融合；blow a fuse也可比喻大发雷霆。

meanings_ja: n. 小径；路线 | n. 踪迹；一串痕迹 | v. 拖；落在后面
definition_en: A path through countryside, forests, or mountains. | A series of marks or objects left by something moving. | To drag behind something or move slowly behind others.
example1_en: We followed a narrow trail through the pine forest.
example1_ja: 我们沿着一条狭窄的小径穿过松林。
example2_en: Maintaining walking trails can encourage outdoor recreation while protecting fragile habitats from uncontrolled visitor access.
example2_ja: 维护步行小径既能鼓励户外休闲，也能避免游客随意进入脆弱的栖息地。
collocations: a hiking trail｜徒步路线 ; a trail of footprints｜一串脚印 ; trail behind｜落在后面
tip_ja: trail作名词可指小径或痕迹；trail behind指落在后面。

meanings_ja: n. 预算；预算额 | v. 编制预算 | adj. 廉价的；经济型的
definition_en: A plan for spending money, or the amount available. | To plan how much money to spend on particular things. | Low in price compared with similar products or services.
example1_en: We have a small budget for our weekend trip.
example1_ja: 我们周末旅行的预算不多。
example2_en: Local governments should allocate a larger share of their budget to maintaining public transport systems.
example2_ja: 地方政府应将更大比例的预算用于维护公共交通系统。
collocations: on a tight budget｜预算紧张 ; within budget｜在预算内 ; budget for expenses｜为开支做预算 ; budget accommodation｜经济型住宿
tip_ja: budget for后接预计开支；on a budget指经费有限。

meanings_ja: adj. 根本的；基本的 | n. 基本原理；基础知识
definition_en: Forming the essential basis of something. | A basic principle or skill, usually considered with others.
example1_en: Trust is fundamental to a happy life together.
example1_ja: 信任是共同幸福生活的根本。
example2_en: Access to clean drinking water is a fundamental requirement for improving public health in disadvantaged communities.
example2_ja: 获得清洁饮用水是改善弱势社区公共卫生的基本条件。
collocations: fundamental to｜对……至关重要 ; a fundamental principle｜基本原则 ; fundamental change｜根本性改变 ; the fundamentals of｜……的基础知识
tip_ja: 名词通常用复数 fundamentals，表示基本原理。

meanings_ja: adj. 无效的；不被认可的 | adj. 不成立的；缺乏依据的
definition_en: not legally or officially acceptable | not supported by sound reasoning or reliable evidence
example1_en: My ticket was invalid, so I bought another one.
example1_ja: 我的票无效，所以我又买了一张。
example2_en: Conclusions drawn from a small, unrepresentative sample may be invalid and should not guide major policy decisions.
example2_ja: 从缺乏代表性的小样本中得出的结论可能不成立，不应作为重大政策决策的依据。
collocations: invalid ticket｜无效票证 ; invalid argument｜不成立的论证 ; invalid data｜无效数据 ; declare something invalid｜宣布某事物无效
tip_ja: 名词“病弱者”重音在首音节，现已较少使用。

meanings_ja: n. 护肤；皮肤护理
definition_en: the practice of keeping skin clean, healthy, and protected
example1_en: My daily skincare routine includes washing gently and applying moisturiser.
example1_ja: 我每天的护肤步骤包括温和清洁和涂保湿霜。
example2_en: Public health campaigns can promote sensible skincare habits, including regular sun protection and avoiding irritating products.
example2_ja: 公共卫生宣传可以推广合理的护肤习惯，包括经常采取防晒措施和避免使用刺激性产品。
collocations: skincare routine｜日常护肤步骤 ; skincare products｜护肤品 ; daily skincare｜日常护肤
tip_ja: 通常不可数；也可写成两个词skin care。

meanings_ja: v. 哭泣；流泪
definition_en: To cry, usually because of strong emotion
example1_en: He began to weep when his lost dog returned.
example1_ja: 走失的狗回来时，他流下了眼泪。
example2_en: Emotional scenes in films can make audiences weep while encouraging greater empathy for people facing difficult circumstances.
example2_ja: 电影中的感人场景能够使观众落泪，同时增进他们对身处困境者的共情。
collocations: weep with joy｜喜极而泣 ; weep for someone｜为某人哭泣 ; weep bitterly｜痛哭
tip_ja: 过去式和过去分词均为wept；比cry更书面。

meanings_ja: v. 消除；排除 | v. 淘汰
definition_en: To remove or get rid of something completely. | To defeat someone so they cannot continue in a competition.
example1_en: This water filter eliminates unpleasant smells from tap water.
example1_ja: 这个净水器能去除自来水中的异味。
example2_en: Improved public transport could eliminate the need for many urban residents to own a private car.
example2_ja: 改善公共交通可以使许多城市居民不再需要拥有私家车。
collocations: eliminate the need for｜消除对……的需要 ; eliminate errors｜消除错误 ; eliminate a possibility｜排除一种可能性 ; be eliminated from a competition｜在比赛中被淘汰
tip_ja: 比reduce更彻底，强调完全去除或排除。

meanings_ja: adj. 致命的 | adv. 极其；非常
definition_en: Causing death or likely to cause death. | Extremely or completely, especially with certain adjectives.
example1_en: These pretty mushrooms can be deadly if you eat them.
example1_ja: 这些漂亮的蘑菇如果吃下去，可能会致命。
example2_en: Improved access to clean drinking water can prevent deadly diseases in communities with inadequate sanitation.
example2_ja: 让卫生设施不足的社区更容易获得清洁饮用水，可以预防致命疾病。
collocations: a deadly disease｜致命疾病 ; a deadly poison｜致命毒物 ; deadly serious｜极其认真的 ; deadly dull｜极其乏味的
tip_ja: 虽以-ly结尾，deadly也常作形容词，意为致命的。

meanings_ja: n. 业余爱好者 | adj. 业余的 | n. 外行；生手
definition_en: Someone who pursues an activity for pleasure rather than pay. | Done for enjoyment rather than as a paid profession. | Someone who lacks skill or experience in an activity.
example1_en: Although an amateur, she takes beautiful photographs of birds.
example1_ja: 虽然是业余爱好者，她拍的鸟类照片却很漂亮。
example2_en: Amateur sports clubs provide affordable opportunities for physical activity and help strengthen relationships within local communities.
example2_ja: 业余体育俱乐部提供费用低廉的锻炼机会，并有助于加强社区居民之间的联系。
collocations: amateur photographer｜业余摄影爱好者 ; amateur athlete｜业余运动员 ; amateur theatre｜业余戏剧活动 ; complete amateur｜完全的外行
tip_ja: amateur通常指非职业者，不一定表示水平低。

meanings_ja: n. 坟墓；墓穴 | adj. 严重的；严峻的 | adj. 神情严肃的
definition_en: A place in the ground where a dead person is buried. | Very serious and giving cause for concern. | Showing a serious or solemn expression or manner.
example1_en: She placed fresh flowers beside her grandfather's grave.
example1_ja: 她把鲜花放在祖父的坟墓旁。
example2_en: The destruction of coastal habitats poses a grave threat to biodiversity and the livelihoods of local communities.
example2_ja: 沿海栖息地的破坏对生物多样性和当地社区的生计构成严重威胁。
collocations: visit a grave｜扫墓；探访墓地 ; a grave threat｜严重威胁 ; grave consequences｜严重后果
tip_ja: 作形容词比serious更正式，常修饰威胁或后果。

meanings_ja: n. 事件；意外事件
definition_en: An event, especially one that is unusual or unpleasant.
example1_en: Nobody was hurt in the incident outside the station.
example1_ja: 车站外的那起事件中没有人受伤。
example2_en: Every workplace incident should be investigated carefully so that employers can identify risks and prevent similar problems.
example2_ja: 每起工作场所事件都应得到仔细调查，以便雇主识别风险并防止类似问题发生。
collocations: report an incident｜报告事件 ; a serious incident｜严重事件 ; an isolated incident｜个别事件 ; without incident｜平安无事地
tip_ja: incident指具体事件；incidence指发生率。

meanings_ja: n. 鳕鱼；鳕鱼肉
definition_en: A large sea fish, or its white flesh eaten as food.
example1_en: We baked the cod with lemon and fresh herbs.
example1_ja: 我们用柠檬和新鲜香草烤了鳕鱼。
example2_en: Strict fishing limits can help cod populations recover while protecting the long-term livelihoods of coastal communities.
example2_ja: 严格的捕捞限额可以帮助鳕鱼种群恢复，同时保障沿海社区的长远生计。
collocations: cod fillet｜鳕鱼片 ; cod liver oil｜鱼肝油 ; cod stocks｜鳕鱼资源量
tip_ja: 鱼的单复数均为cod；指鳕鱼肉时不可数。

meanings_ja: adj. 美容的；化妆用的 | adj. 表面的；装点门面的 | n. 化妆品
definition_en: intended to improve or change physical appearance | changing appearances without solving underlying problems | a product used to improve or change physical appearance
example1_en: This shop sells cosmetic products alongside soap and shampoo.
example1_ja: 这家店除了肥皂和洗发水，还出售美容化妆产品。
example2_en: Critics argue that cosmetic changes to school buildings cannot address deeper problems such as overcrowded classrooms.
example2_ja: 批评者认为，对校舍进行表面修饰无法解决教室过度拥挤等更深层的问题。
collocations: cosmetic products｜美容化妆产品 ; cosmetic surgery｜整容手术 ; cosmetic changes｜表面上的改变
tip_ja: 作名词表示“化妆品”时通常用复数cosmetics。

meanings_ja: n. 丰富；多样 | n. 浓郁；醇厚
definition_en: The quality of containing many varied or valuable elements. | A deep, strong, or full quality of flavour or colour.
example1_en: The richness of local wildlife amazed us during our walk.
example1_ja: 散步时，当地野生生物的丰富多样让我们惊叹。
example2_en: Protecting traditional crafts helps preserve the cultural richness of communities facing rapid social change.
example2_ja: 保护传统手工艺有助于保存面临快速社会变迁的社区所拥有的丰富文化。
collocations: cultural richness｜文化的丰富性 ; species richness｜物种丰富度 ; richness of flavour｜风味的浓郁
tip_ja: 常指内容丰富或味道浓郁；个人财富多用wealth。

meanings_ja: n. 远征；考察；探险 | n. 探险队；考察队
definition_en: An organised journey made for exploration or a specific purpose. | A group of people travelling together to explore or investigate.
example1_en: We packed warm clothes for our expedition into the mountains.
example1_ja: 我们为进山探险打包了保暖衣物。
example2_en: A scientific expedition to the polar regions collected valuable evidence of changes in sea ice.
example2_ja: 一支前往极地的科学考察队收集了海冰变化的重要证据。
collocations: a scientific expedition｜科学考察 ; go on an expedition｜去探险 ; lead an expedition｜带领探险队 ; an expedition to Antarctica｜南极考察
tip_ja: expedition多指有组织、有特定目的的远行。

meanings_ja: n. 可靠性；可信度
definition_en: The quality of working well or being worthy of trust.
example1_en: We chose this washing machine for its proven reliability.
example1_ja: 我们选择这台洗衣机，是因为它的可靠性经过了验证。
example2_en: Improving the reliability of public transport could encourage more commuters to leave their cars at home.
example2_ja: 提高公共交通的可靠性可以鼓励更多通勤者不开私家车出行。
collocations: improve reliability｜提高可靠性 ; long-term reliability｜长期可靠性 ; the reliability of data｜数据的可信度
tip_ja: reliability通常不可数；形容词是reliable。

meanings_ja: v. 有关；使有联系 | v. 理解；产生共鸣 | v. 讲述；叙述
definition_en: To have or establish a connection between things. | To understand someone's feelings through similar personal experience. | To tell someone about events or experiences.
example1_en: I can relate to your fear of flying.
example1_ja: 我能理解你对坐飞机的恐惧。
example2_en: Researchers should relate their findings to existing evidence before drawing conclusions about the causes of unemployment.
example2_ja: 研究人员在对失业原因下结论之前，应将研究结果与现有证据联系起来。
collocations: relate to｜与……有关；理解 ; relate A to B｜把A与B联系起来 ; relate an experience｜讲述一段经历
tip_ja: relate to可指“与……有关”，也可指“产生共鸣”。

meanings_ja: v. 陪同；陪伴 | v. 伴随；与……同时发生 | v. 为……伴奏
definition_en: Go somewhere with someone. | Exist or happen together with something else. | Play music to support a singer or another musician.
example1_en: My sister will accompany me to the clinic tomorrow.
example1_ja: 明天姐姐会陪我去诊所。
example2_en: Investment in public transport should accompany urban expansion to prevent congestion and improve access to employment.
example2_ja: 城市扩张应配合公共交通投资，以防止交通拥堵并改善就业可达性。
collocations: accompany someone to｜陪某人去 ; be accompanied by｜伴有；由……陪同 ; accompany on the piano｜用钢琴伴奏
tip_ja: 直接接人作宾语，不说accompany with someone。

meanings_ja: n. 大部分；主要部分 | n. 庞大体积；大块
definition_en: the largest part of something | the large size or mass of something
example1_en: The bulk of my clothes fit in this suitcase.
example1_ja: 我的大部分衣服都能装进这个行李箱。
example2_en: The bulk of public transport funding should support reliable services in areas with limited access to employment.
example2_ja: 公共交通资金的大部分应当用于支持就业交通不便地区的可靠运输服务。
collocations: the bulk of｜……的大部分 ; buy in bulk｜大批量购买 ; sheer bulk｜庞大的体积 ; bulk buying｜批量采购
tip_ja: the bulk of指大部分；in bulk指大批量。

meanings_ja: adv. 严格地；严厉地 | adv. 仅限于；完全地 | adv. 严格说来；精确地
definition_en: with rules followed or enforced exactly | only, without including anything or anyone else | in a completely exact or accurate way
example1_en: The swimming pool strictly enforces its rule against running.
example1_ja: 游泳池严格执行禁止奔跑的规定。
example2_en: Environmental regulations must be strictly enforced if governments are to protect rivers from industrial pollution.
example2_ja: 政府若要保护河流免受工业污染，就必须严格执行环境法规。
collocations: strictly prohibited｜严禁 ; strictly confidential｜严格保密的 ; strictly speaking｜严格说来 ; strictly limited to｜严格限于
tip_ja: strictly speaking是固定表达，意为“严格说来”。

meanings_ja: n. 检查员；督察员 | n. 督察；警官
definition_en: an official who checks that rules and standards are followed | a police officer of a particular rank
example1_en: The inspector checked the kitchen before the restaurant opened.
example1_ja: 餐厅开门营业前，检查员检查了厨房。
example2_en: A qualified building inspector can identify structural problems before they become serious risks to public safety.
example2_ja: 合格的建筑检查员能够在结构问题严重危及公共安全之前发现它们。
collocations: safety inspector｜安全检查员 ; building inspector｜建筑检查员 ; police inspector｜警务督察
tip_ja: inspect是检查；inspector指执行检查的人。

meanings_ja: v. 威胁；恐吓 | v. 危及；可能造成
definition_en: Say you will cause harm or trouble unless demands are met | Put something at risk or make something harmful seem likely
example1_en: They threatened to cancel our booking unless we paid today.
example1_ja: 他们威胁说，如果我们今天不付款，就取消我们的预订。
example2_en: Rising sea levels threaten coastal communities by increasing the frequency of flooding and damaging essential infrastructure.
example2_ja: 海平面上升增加了洪水发生的频率，并破坏重要基础设施，危及沿海社区。
collocations: threaten to do something｜威胁要做某事 ; threaten someone's safety｜危及某人的安全 ; threaten livelihoods｜威胁生计 ; be threatened with closure｜面临关闭的威胁
tip_ja: threaten to do指威胁要做；threaten sth可指危及某物。

meanings_ja: n. 间隔；间距 | n. 幕间休息
definition_en: A period or distance between events or objects. | A short break between parts of a performance.
example1_en: There was a short interval between the two calls.
example1_ja: 两通电话之间隔了一小会儿。
example2_en: Taking breaks at regular intervals can help students maintain concentration during long periods of study.
example2_ja: 长时间学习时，定时休息有助于学生保持专注。
collocations: at regular intervals｜每隔固定时间或距离 ; a short interval｜短暂的间隔 ; a time interval｜时间间隔 ; during the interval｜在幕间休息时
tip_ja: at intervals表示每隔一段时间或距离。

meanings_ja: adj. 不可退款的
definition_en: Not eligible for money to be returned after payment.
example1_en: We chose cheaper tickets, but they were non-refundable.
example1_ja: 我们选了更便宜的票，但这些票不能退款。
example2_en: Non-refundable booking fees can discourage travellers from changing plans, even when their circumstances unexpectedly change.
example2_ja: 不可退还的预订费可能让旅客不愿更改计划，即使他们的情况突然发生了变化。
collocations: a non-refundable deposit｜不可退还的订金 ; a non-refundable ticket｜不可退款的票 ; a non-refundable booking fee｜不可退还的预订费
tip_ja: 指已付款项不能退回，不表示物品不能归还。

meanings_ja: v. 发抖；打哆嗦 | n. 颤抖；寒战
definition_en: To shake slightly because of cold, fear, or excitement | A brief shaking movement caused by cold or strong emotion
example1_en: I shivered while waiting outside in my thin jacket.
example1_ja: 我穿着单薄的夹克在外面等候，冻得直发抖。
example2_en: People may shiver when exposed to low temperatures, as muscle movements help the body generate heat.
example2_ja: 人在低温环境中可能会发抖，因为肌肉运动有助于身体产生热量。
collocations: shiver with cold｜冷得发抖 ; shiver with fear｜害怕得发抖 ; a shiver down your spine｜脊背一阵发凉

meanings_ja: n. 代表；代理人 | adj. 有代表性的；典型的

example2_en: Researchers need a representative sample to draw reliable conclusions about the wider population.

collocations: a representative sample｜有代表性的样本 ; a sales representative｜销售代表 ; representative of｜能代表……的 ; an elected representative｜民选代表

meanings_ja: adv. 看似；表面上

example2_en: Seemingly minor changes in daily travel habits can significantly reduce a city's overall carbon emissions.
example2_ja: 日常出行习惯中看似微小的改变，可以显著减少一座城市的总体碳排放。

meanings_ja: n. 措辞；用语

example2_en: Careful wording in public health announcements can prevent confusion and encourage people to follow advice.

collocations: careful wording｜严谨的措辞 ; exact wording｜确切的原话 ; change the wording｜修改措辞

meanings_ja: n. 质地；纹理；口感

example2_en: The texture of recycled materials can influence whether consumers find sustainable products attractive.
example2_ja: 再生材料的质地会影响消费者是否觉得可持续产品有吸引力。

meanings_ja: adj. 最初的；开始的 | n. 姓名首字母 | v. 用姓名首字母签署
definition_en: Happening or existing at the beginning | The first letter of a person's name | To mark a document with the first letters of your names

meanings_ja: n. 碳水化合物；糖类

example2_en: A balanced diet includes carbohydrates, proteins, and fats in proportions suited to individual nutritional needs.

meanings_ja: n. 外部；外表 | adj. 外部的；外面的

example1_ja: 他们把房子的外墙刷成了淡蓝色。
example2_en: Improving a building's exterior can protect it from weather damage while preserving its historical character.
example2_ja: 改善建筑外部可以保护它免受天气损害，同时保留其历史特色。
collocations: the exterior of a building｜建筑物的外部 ; exterior walls｜外墙 ; exterior paint｜外墙涂料

meanings_ja: adj. 富有想象力的；有创意的

example1_ja: 我那富有想象力的侄女把空盒子变成了一艘宇宙飞船。
example2_en: Schools should encourage imaginative thinking rather than require students to memorise every detail of a textbook.
example2_ja: 学校应鼓励有创意的思考，而不是要求学生记住课本中的每一个细节。

tip_ja: imaginative指有想象力；imaginary指想象中的。

meanings_ja: n. 康复；恢复 | n. 找回；收回
definition_en: A return to health or a normal condition. | The process of getting something lost or stolen back.

example1_ja: 她康复得很慢，但已经能重新走路了。
example2_en: Economic recovery depends partly on restoring consumer confidence and supporting small businesses through difficult periods.
example2_ja: 经济复苏部分取决于恢复消费者信心，以及帮助小企业渡过困难时期。
collocations: make a full recovery｜完全康复 ; economic recovery｜经济复苏 ; data recovery｜数据恢复

meanings_ja: adv. 在别处；到别处

example2_ja: 当本地住房变得难以负担时，年轻劳动者往往会迁往别处，寻找更好的生活条件。

meanings_ja: n. 伤害；损害 | v. 伤害；损害

example1_ja: 阳光过强会损伤这种植物的叶子。
example2_en: Stricter controls on industrial waste could reduce the harm caused to rivers and protect local wildlife.
example2_ja: 加强对工业废弃物的管控可以减少河流受到的损害，并保护当地野生动物。
collocations: cause harm｜造成伤害 ; do more harm than good｜弊大于利 ; harm the environment｜危害环境

meanings_ja: n. 家禽 | n. 禽肉

example1_ja: 我阿姨在后院一个宽敞的围栏里养家禽。

example2_ja: 提高家禽福利标准可以改善动物健康，但可能增加生产成本。
collocations: poultry farming｜家禽养殖 ; poultry feed｜家禽饲料 ; poultry products｜禽类产品

meanings_ja: v. 倾斜；倚靠 | adj. 精瘦的；少脂肪的 | adj. 精简高效的

example2_ja: 精益生产方法能帮助制造商在保持产品质量的同时减少浪费。
