example1_ja: 我们看着一架巨型客机在雨中降落。
example2_en: Modern airliners can carry more passengers efficiently, although aviation remains a significant source of greenhouse gas emissions.
example2_ja: 现代客机能够高效运载更多乘客，但航空业仍是温室气体的重要排放源。
collocations: a passenger airliner｜载客民航机 ; a commercial airliner｜商用客机 ; a jet airliner｜喷气式客机
tip_ja: airliner指客机；airline指航空公司，并非航班。

meanings_ja: n. 液体；流体 | adj. 不固定的；易变的 | adj. 流畅的；流动的
definition_en: a substance that flows, such as a liquid or gas | likely to change rather than remain fixed | moving smoothly and continuously
example1_en: The nurse reminded me to drink plenty of fluids.
example1_ja: 护士提醒我要多喝水等液体。
example2_en: Employment patterns are increasingly fluid, requiring workers to update their skills throughout their professional lives.
example2_ja: 就业模式日益多变，要求劳动者在整个职业生涯中不断更新技能。
collocations: body fluids｜体液 ; fluid intake｜液体摄入量 ; a fluid situation｜不断变化的局势 ; fluid movements｜流畅的动作
tip_ja: 日常语境多指液体；科学中的fluid也包括气体。

meanings_ja: v. 刺；戳；刺伤 | n. 突发的刺痛或强烈情绪 | n. 尝试
definition_en: push a sharp object into something or someone | a sudden sharp pain or strong feeling | an attempt to do something
example1_en: She stabbed a potato with her fork to test it.
example1_ja: 她用叉子戳了戳土豆，看看熟了没有。
example2_en: Many graduates feel a stab of anxiety when considering their employment prospects in an uncertain economy.
example2_ja: 在经济形势不明朗时，许多毕业生想到自己的就业前景便会突然感到焦虑。
collocations: stab at something｜朝某物戳去 ; a stab of pain｜一阵刺痛 ; have a stab at｜尝试做
tip_ja: have a stab at doing表示尝试做某事，较口语化。

meanings_ja: n. 自传
definition_en: a book about someone's life written by that person
example1_en: My grandmother is writing her autobiography at the kitchen table.
example1_ja: 我祖母正在厨房桌旁写自传。
example2_en: An autobiography offers insights into personal experience, although its account of historical events may be selective.
example2_ja: 自传有助于深入了解个人经历，但其中对历史事件的叙述可能有所取舍。
collocations: write an autobiography｜写自传 ; publish an autobiography｜出版自传 ; a bestselling autobiography｜畅销自传
tip_ja: autobiography是本人写的自传；biography是传记。

meanings_ja: adj. 微湿的；湿润的
definition_en: Slightly wet, rather than dry or soaked.
example1_en: Keep the soil moist until the first leaves appear.
example1_ja: 在第一批叶子长出之前，保持土壤湿润。
example2_en: A layer of fallen leaves helps keep soil moist, reducing the need for frequent watering.
example2_ja: 一层落叶有助于保持土壤湿润，减少频繁浇水的需要。
collocations: moist soil｜湿润的土壤 ; keep something moist｜使某物保持湿润 ; moist cake｜松润的蛋糕
tip_ja: moist常指适度湿润；damp常带潮湿、不舒服之意。

meanings_ja: v. 理解；领会 | v. 抓牢；握紧 | n. 理解；紧握
definition_en: To understand something, especially a difficult idea. | To take and hold something firmly. | An understanding of something, or a firm hold.
example1_en: I finally grasped the rules after watching one round.
example1_ja: 看完一轮后，我终于弄懂了规则。
example2_en: Students grasp complex scientific concepts more easily when teachers connect them to familiar everyday experiences.
example2_ja: 教师将复杂的科学概念与熟悉的日常经历联系起来时，学生更容易理解。
collocations: grasp a concept｜理解概念 ; a firm grasp of｜对……的扎实理解 ; grasp an opportunity｜抓住机会 ; within reach or grasp｜力所能及
tip_ja: 表示理解时可作动词；名词常用a grasp of。

meanings_ja: n. 恶意；怨恨 | v. 故意使恼怒；刁难
definition_en: A desire to upset or hurt someone deliberately. | To deliberately upset someone, often because you feel angry.
example1_en: He hid his sister's favourite toy out of spite.
example1_ja: 他出于恶意，把妹妹最喜欢的玩具藏了起来。
example2_en: In spite of limited funding, the community centre continues to provide valuable support for local families.
example2_ja: 尽管资金有限，社区中心仍继续为当地家庭提供宝贵的支持。
collocations: out of spite｜出于恶意 ; in spite of｜尽管 ; pure spite｜纯粹的恶意
tip_ja: in spite of后接名词或动名词，不直接接句子。

meanings_ja: n. 激励；诱因
definition_en: something that encourages someone to act or work harder
example1_en: The free lunch gave us an incentive to stay.
example1_ja: 免费午餐让我们有了留下来的动力。
example2_en: Governments can offer financial incentives to encourage households to install solar panels and reduce energy consumption.
example2_ja: 政府可以提供经济激励，鼓励家庭安装太阳能板并减少能源消耗。
collocations: financial incentive｜经济激励 ; provide an incentive｜提供动力 ; incentive to work｜工作的动力
tip_ja: 常用 incentive to do sth，表示做某事的动力。

meanings_ja: n. 选民；投票人
definition_en: Someone who votes or has the right to vote
example1_en: Each voter placed a folded ballot into the sealed box.
example1_ja: 每位投票人都把折好的选票投入密封的票箱。
example2_en: Clear information about public policies enables each voter to make a more informed choice during elections.
example2_ja: 清晰的公共政策信息能让每位选民在选举中作出更明智的选择。
collocations: registered voter｜登记选民 ; eligible voter｜有投票资格的选民 ; voter turnout｜选民投票率 ; voter registration｜选民登记
tip_ja: voter指人，vote可指投票行为或一票。

meanings_ja: n. 沟；排水沟 | v. 抛弃；放弃
definition_en: A long narrow channel dug in the ground, often for drainage. | To get rid of someone or something no longer wanted.
example1_en: Rainwater flowed through the ditch beside our vegetable garden.
example1_ja: 雨水流过我们菜园旁的排水沟。
example2_en: Cities should ditch outdated planning policies that encourage car dependence and invest instead in reliable public transport.
example2_ja: 城市应摒弃鼓励依赖汽车的过时规划政策，转而投资可靠的公共交通。
collocations: a drainage ditch｜排水沟 ; dig a ditch｜挖沟 ; ditch a plan｜放弃计划
tip_ja: 作动词表示抛弃或放弃时偏口语。

meanings_ja: n. 竞争对手 | v. 与…匹敌；比得上 | adj. 竞争的；对立的
definition_en: Someone competing with another for the same goal or advantage. | Be as good or impressive as someone or something. | Competing for the same goal or advantage.
example1_en: She shook hands with her rival before the race.
example1_ja: 比赛前，她与竞争对手握了手。
example2_en: Smaller companies can rival larger firms by offering personalised services and responding quickly to customer needs.
example2_ja: 小公司可以通过提供个性化服务并迅速回应客户需求，与大企业相匹敌。
collocations: a major rival｜主要竞争对手 ; a rival company｜竞争公司 ; rival teams｜相互竞争的队伍 ; rival someone in quality｜在质量上与某人匹敌
tip_ja: rival作动词直接接宾语，无需加with。

meanings_ja: adj. 农村的；乡村的
definition_en: Relating to the countryside rather than towns or cities.
example1_en: My grandparents live in a quiet rural village.
example1_ja: 我的祖父母住在一个安静的乡村。
example2_en: Reliable internet access can improve educational opportunities for children living in remote rural areas.
example2_ja: 稳定的互联网连接可以改善偏远农村地区儿童的教育机会。
collocations: rural areas｜农村地区 ; rural communities｜乡村社区 ; rural development｜农村发展 ; rural population｜农村人口
tip_ja: rural修饰乡村事物，urban修饰城市事物。

meanings_ja: adj. 知识渊博的；很内行的
definition_en: knowing a lot about a particular subject
example1_en: Our knowledgeable guide explained how each garden plant grows.
example1_ja: 我们那位知识丰富的导游讲解了园中每种植物如何生长。
example2_en: Knowledgeable teachers can help students evaluate online information rather than accept every claim they encounter.
example2_ja: 知识渊博的教师能帮助学生评估网络信息，而不是对看到的每种说法都照单全收。
collocations: knowledgeable about｜对……很了解 ; knowledgeable staff｜专业知识丰富的员工 ; a knowledgeable guide｜知识丰富的导游
tip_ja: 常用 knowledgeable about 表示对某领域了解很多。

meanings_ja: n. 豪宅；大宅邸
definition_en: A very large, impressive house.
example1_en: An enormous mansion stood behind the tall iron gates.
example1_ja: 高高的铁门后矗立着一座巨大的宅邸。
example2_en: The historic mansion has been converted into a museum to preserve the region's cultural heritage.
example2_ja: 这座历史悠久的宅邸已被改建为博物馆，以保护当地的文化遗产。
collocations: a luxurious mansion｜豪华宅邸 ; a historic mansion｜历史宅邸 ; a sprawling mansion｜占地广阔的豪宅
tip_ja: 通常指大型豪宅，不是普通办公大厦。

meanings_ja: n. 油酥面团；酥皮 | n. 酥皮糕点
definition_en: Dough made with flour and fat for pies and similar foods. | A small baked food made from pastry, often with sweet filling.
example1_en: Roll the pastry thinly before covering the apple filling.
example1_ja: 先把酥皮擀薄，再盖到苹果馅上。
example2_en: Culinary courses teach students to prepare pastry while developing practical skills for careers in hospitality.
example2_ja: 烹饪课程教授学生制作酥皮，同时培养酒店餐饮业所需的实用技能。
collocations: puff pastry｜千层酥皮 ; shortcrust pastry｜油酥派皮 ; roll out pastry｜擀开酥皮面团 ; a pastry chef｜糕点师
tip_ja: 指酥皮面团时不可数；指单个糕点时可数。

meanings_ja: adj. 短期的
definition_en: lasting or having effects for only a limited time
example1_en: This short-term job will cover my summer expenses.
example1_ja: 这份短期工作能支付我暑假期间的开销。
example2_en: Short-term solutions may reduce immediate pressure but fail to address the underlying causes of unemployment.
example2_ja: 短期措施或许能缓解眼前的压力，却无法解决失业的根本原因。
collocations: short-term solution｜短期解决办法 ; short-term contract｜短期合同 ; short-term memory｜短时记忆
tip_ja: 作定语常用连字符；in the short term不加。

meanings_ja: n. 铜 | n. 铜币
definition_en: a reddish-brown metal used for wires, pipes, and coins | a coin made of copper or a similar metal
example1_en: The old kitchen sink has beautiful copper taps.
example1_ja: 这个旧厨房水槽装着漂亮的铜水龙头。
example2_en: Copper is widely used in electrical systems because it conducts electricity efficiently and can be recycled.
example2_ja: 铜广泛用于电气系统，因为它导电效率高，而且可以回收利用。
collocations: copper wire｜铜线 ; copper pipe｜铜管 ; copper mine｜铜矿
tip_ja: 表示金属铜时不可数；表示铜币时可数。

meanings_ja: n. 静脉 | n. 叶脉 | n. 矿脉
definition_en: a blood vessel that carries blood towards the heart | a thin tube carrying water and nutrients through a leaf | a narrow layer of mineral within rock
example1_en: A blue vein was visible beneath his wrist.
example1_ja: 他的手腕皮肤下可以看到一条蓝色静脉。
example2_en: Regular movement helps blood flow through the veins and may reduce health risks associated with prolonged sitting.
example2_ja: 经常活动有助于静脉血液流动，并可能降低久坐带来的健康风险。
collocations: varicose veins｜静脉曲张 ; leaf veins｜叶脉 ; a vein of gold｜一条金矿脉
tip_ja: vein指静脉；artery指动脉，二者不是反义词。

meanings_ja: n. 珊瑚；珊瑚虫 | adj. 珊瑚色的
definition_en: tiny sea animals, or the hard structures they build | having a pinkish-orange colour
example1_en: Bright fish swam between branches of coral beneath us.

example2_en: Rising ocean temperatures threaten coral reefs, which provide essential habitats for many marine species.
example2_ja: 海洋温度上升威胁着珊瑚礁，而珊瑚礁为许多海洋物种提供了重要栖息地。
collocations: coral reef｜珊瑚礁 ; coral bleaching｜珊瑚白化 ; coral colony｜珊瑚群体 ; coral restoration｜珊瑚修复
tip_ja: 指珊瑚材料通常不可数；指种类或群体时可用corals。

meanings_ja: adj. 详细的；详尽的
definition_en: Including many facts or specific pieces of information.
example1_en: She gave me detailed instructions for baking the cake.
example1_ja: 她详细地告诉了我这个蛋糕的烘焙步骤。
example2_en: Detailed research into commuting patterns can help cities design more efficient public transport systems.

meanings_ja: n. 高管；主管 | adj. 行政的；执行的 | n. 行政部门；执行机构

example1_ja: 那位高管今天和我们团队一起吃了午饭。
example2_en: Senior executives should consider employee wellbeing alongside financial performance when making decisions about company restructuring.
example2_ja: 高管在作出公司重组决策时，应同时考虑员工福祉和财务表现。
collocations: senior executive｜高级管理人员 ; chief executive｜首席执行官 ; executive power｜行政权 ; executive board｜执行委员会
tip_ja: 名词可指高管；形容词常修饰power、board等。

meanings_ja: adj. 国内的 | adj. 家庭的；家务的 | adj. 家养的；驯养的

example2_en: Investment in domestic food production can reduce a country's dependence on imports and strengthen its economy.
example2_ja: 投资国内粮食生产可以减少一国对进口的依赖，并增强其经济实力。
collocations: domestic market｜国内市场 ; domestic flight｜国内航班 ; domestic chores｜家务活 ; domestic animals｜家养动物
tip_ja: 与international相对指国内的；与wild相对指家养的。

meanings_ja: n. 彗星
definition_en: An icy object orbiting the sun, sometimes showing a bright tail

example2_en: Studying a comet can provide valuable evidence about the conditions in which our solar system formed.

collocations: a comet's tail｜彗星的尾巴 ; a passing comet｜经过的彗星 ; observe a comet｜观测彗星

meanings_ja: adj. 神圣的；宗教的 | adj. 不可侵犯的；极珍视的
definition_en: Connected with religion and deserving deep respect | Considered too important or valuable to change or harm
example1_en: Visitors remove their shoes before entering the sacred temple.
example1_ja: 游客进入这座神圣的寺庙前会脱鞋。
example2_en: Tourism can support local economies, but visitors must respect sacred places and religious customs.
example2_ja: 旅游业可以促进当地经济，但游客必须尊重圣地和宗教习俗。

meanings_ja: v. 变暗；使变黑 | v. 脸色变阴沉；使忧郁
definition_en: to become darker or make something darker | to become or make someone look unhappy or angry
example1_en: Heavy clouds darkened the sky before we reached home.

example2_en: Thick smoke from industrial fires can darken the sky and reduce visibility across nearby residential areas.

collocations: darken the sky｜使天空变暗 ; darken a room｜使房间变暗 ; someone's face darkens｜某人脸色阴沉下来

meanings_ja: v. 取笑；戏弄 | n. 爱逗弄别人的人

meanings_ja: n. 大使 | n. 代表；推广使者

example2_en: An ambassador can strengthen international cooperation by encouraging educational exchanges and maintaining dialogue during periods of tension.
example2_ja: 大使可以通过鼓励教育交流并在紧张时期保持对话，来加强国际合作。

meanings_ja: v. 缩短；变短

example1_ja: 你能在婚礼前把这条裤子改短吗？

example2_ja: 改善公共交通可以缩短通勤时间，减少城市居民对私家车的依赖。

meanings_ja: n. 香草；药草

example1_ja: 她在厨房窗边的花盆里种了新鲜香草。

meanings_ja: n. 爬行动物

example1_ja: 那只爬行动物一动不动地趴在一块温热的岩石上。

meanings_ja: n. 国会议员；美国众议员

meanings_ja: n. 饮料
definition_en: A drink, such as tea, juice, or coffee.
example1_en: Would you like a hot beverage with your sandwich?
example1_ja: 你想来杯热饮配三明治吗？
example2_en: Reducing the consumption of sugary beverages could help lower obesity rates among young people.
example2_ja: 减少含糖饮料的摄入可能有助于降低年轻人的肥胖率。
collocations: hot beverage｜热饮 ; alcoholic beverage｜酒精饮料 ; sugary beverage｜含糖饮料 ; food and beverages｜食品与饮料
tip_ja: beverage较正式，多用于餐饮或学术语境；日常用drink。

meanings_ja: adj. 口头的；非书面的 | adj. 言语的；与词语有关的
definition_en: spoken rather than written | relating to words or the use of language
example1_en: We made a verbal agreement to share the garden.
example1_ja: 我们口头约定共用这个花园。
example2_en: Employers should confirm verbal agreements in writing to prevent misunderstandings about working hours and responsibilities.
example2_ja: 雇主应以书面形式确认口头协议，以防对工作时间和职责产生误解。
collocations: a verbal agreement｜口头协议 ; verbal communication｜言语交流 ; verbal skills｜语言能力 ; a verbal warning｜口头警告
tip_ja: verbal也指用词语表达，不总与written对立。

meanings_ja: n. 金融；资金管理 | n. 资金 | v. 为…提供资金
definition_en: the management of money by people, businesses, or governments | money needed to support an activity or project | to provide money for something
example1_en: The bank agreed to finance our new bakery.
example1_ja: 银行同意为我们的新面包店提供资金。
example2_en: Access to affordable finance allows small businesses to invest in equipment and create more local jobs.
example2_ja: 获得成本可承受的资金使小企业能够投资设备并创造更多本地就业机会。
collocations: public finance｜公共财政 ; raise finance｜筹集资金 ; finance a project｜为项目提供资金 ; personal finances｜个人财务状况
tip_ja: finance可指资金或金融；个人财务常用finances。

meanings_ja: n. 破坏；毁灭
definition_en: Damage so severe that something no longer exists or works.
example1_en: The storm left a trail of destruction along the coast.
example1_ja: 风暴沿海岸留下了一片破坏的痕迹。
example2_en: The destruction of natural habitats threatens biodiversity and reduces the resources available to local communities.
example2_ja: 自然栖息地的破坏威胁生物多样性，也减少了当地社区可利用的资源。
collocations: habitat destruction｜栖息地破坏 ; widespread destruction｜大范围破坏 ; a trail of destruction｜沿途的破坏痕迹
tip_ja: 通常不可数；动词是destroy，不是destruct。

meanings_ja: n. 情感；情绪
definition_en: a strong feeling such as joy, fear, or sadness
example1_en: Her voice shook with emotion when she saw her brother.
example1_ja: 见到哥哥时，她激动得声音都颤抖了。
example2_en: Teaching children to recognise and manage emotion can improve their relationships and support long-term mental health.
example2_ja: 教孩子识别和管理情绪，可以改善他们的人际关系，并促进长期心理健康。
collocations: express emotion｜表达情感 ; strong emotions｜强烈的情绪 ; mixed emotions｜复杂的情绪 ; control your emotions｜控制自己的情绪
tip_ja: 泛指情感时可不可数；具体的各种情绪常用emotions。

meanings_ja: n. 进化 | n. 演变；逐步发展
definition_en: Gradual changes in living things over many generations. | The gradual development of something over time.
example1_en: The museum uses bird skeletons to explain evolution.
example1_ja: 这家博物馆用鸟类骨骼来解释进化。
example2_en: The evolution of digital technology has transformed how people communicate, study and access public services.
example2_ja: 数字技术的演变改变了人们交流、学习和获取公共服务的方式。
collocations: the theory of evolution｜进化论 ; human evolution｜人类进化 ; biological evolution｜生物进化 ; the evolution of technology｜技术的演变
tip_ja: evolution指进化；进化论用the theory of evolution。

meanings_ja: v. 监督；指导；照看
definition_en: watch and guide people to ensure work or activities go properly
example1_en: An adult must supervise the children near the pool.
example1_ja: 孩子们在泳池附近时，必须有成人照看。
example2_en: Experienced nurses should supervise new staff to ensure that patients receive safe and effective care.
example2_ja: 经验丰富的护士应指导新员工，确保患者获得安全有效的护理。
collocations: supervise staff｜监督员工 ; supervise children｜照看儿童 ; supervise a project｜监管项目
tip_ja: 及物动词，直接接人或活动：supervise staff。

meanings_ja: v. 咧嘴笑；露齿笑 | n. 咧嘴笑；露齿笑
definition_en: To smile widely, usually showing your teeth. | A broad smile that usually shows the teeth.
example1_en: She grinned when her puppy brought back the ball.
example1_ja: 小狗把球叼回来时，她咧嘴笑了。
example2_en: A friendly grin from a teacher may help nervous students feel more comfortable participating in classroom discussions.
example2_ja: 老师一个友善的笑容，可能让紧张的学生更自在地参与课堂讨论。
collocations: grin broadly｜咧嘴大笑 ; a cheeky grin｜调皮的笑容 ; grin at someone｜朝某人咧嘴笑
tip_ja: grin比smile更强调咧嘴露齿；过去式为grinned。

meanings_ja: v. 插入；放入 | v. 添加；插入内容 | n. 插页；插入物
definition_en: to put something into something else | to add something within a document, recording, or piece of writing | something designed to be placed inside another thing
example1_en: Insert the key gently, then turn it to the left.
example1_ja: 轻轻插入钥匙，然后向左转动。
example2_en: Students should insert relevant examples into their essays to support arguments about complex social issues.
example2_ja: 学生应在作文中加入相关例子，以支持关于复杂社会问题的论点。
collocations: insert into｜插入……中 ; insert a card｜插卡 ; insert an image｜插入图像
tip_ja: 动词重音在后，名词重音在前。

meanings_ja: n. 市场营销
definition_en: activities that identify customers' needs and promote products or services
example1_en: My sister handles marketing for a small local bakery.
example1_ja: 我姐姐负责一家本地小面包店的营销工作。
example2_en: Effective marketing helps small businesses reach new customers without necessarily spending large amounts on advertising.
example2_ja: 有效的营销能帮助小企业接触新客户，而不一定需要投入大量广告费。
collocations: marketing strategy｜营销策略 ; digital marketing｜数字营销 ; marketing campaign｜营销活动 ; market research｜市场调研
tip_ja: marketing通常不可数，范围比advertising更广。

meanings_ja: v. 重新开始；继续
definition_en: To start again after stopping or being interrupted.
example1_en: We will resume our walk when the rain stops.
example1_ja: 雨停后，我们会继续散步。
example2_en: Schools can resume normal teaching once damaged buildings have been repaired and essential safety checks are complete.
example2_ja: 受损建筑修复且必要的安全检查完成后，学校便可恢复正常教学。
collocations: resume work｜恢复工作 ; resume talks｜重启谈判 ; resume normal service｜恢复正常服务
tip_ja: 后接名词或动名词；名词résumé意为简历。

meanings_ja: n. 铝
definition_en: A light, silvery metal used for cans, foil, and aircraft.
example1_en: This aluminum ladder is light enough to carry alone.
example1_ja: 这把铝梯很轻，一个人就能搬动。
example2_en: Recycling aluminum requires substantially less energy than producing new metal from ore, reducing the environmental impact of manufacturing.
example2_ja: 回收铝所需的能源远少于从矿石中提炼新铝，因此能减少制造业对环境的影响。
collocations: aluminum foil｜铝箔 ; aluminum cans｜铝罐 ; aluminum alloy｜铝合金
tip_ja: 美式拼写；英式通常写aluminium，读音也不同。

meanings_ja: n. 团队合作
definition_en: People working together effectively to achieve a shared goal
example1_en: Good teamwork helped us finish painting before lunch.
example1_ja: 良好的团队合作让我们在午饭前刷完了漆。
example2_en: Group projects can develop teamwork skills that students will need in their future careers.
example2_ja: 小组项目可以培养学生未来工作所需的团队合作能力。
collocations: effective teamwork｜有效的团队合作 ; teamwork skills｜团队合作技能 ; encourage teamwork｜鼓励团队合作
tip_ja: 不可数名词；强调团队成员共同协作。

meanings_ja: adj. 静止的；不变的 | adj. 静电的 | n. 静电干扰；静电
definition_en: not moving, changing, or developing | relating to electric charges that build up on surfaces | electrical interference or an electric charge collected on a surface
example1_en: The television picture stayed static while the sound continued.
example1_ja: 电视画面停住不动了，但声音还在继续。
example2_en: Wages have remained static for several years, while housing costs have risen steadily in major cities.
example2_ja: 工资多年来一直没有变化，而大城市的住房成本却持续上涨。
collocations: remain static｜保持不变 ; static electricity｜静电 ; static image｜静态图像
tip_ja: static强调不动或不变；静电用static electricity。

meanings_ja: n. 氧；氧气
definition_en: A gas needed by most living things for life.
example1_en: The nurse gave him oxygen through a clear plastic mask.
example1_ja: 护士通过透明塑料面罩给他输氧。
example2_en: Pollution can reduce oxygen levels in rivers, making it difficult for fish and other aquatic organisms to survive.
example2_ja: 污染会降低河流中的含氧量，使鱼类和其他水生生物难以生存。
collocations: oxygen supply｜氧气供应 ; oxygen levels｜含氧量 ; lack of oxygen｜缺氧 ; oxygen mask｜氧气面罩
tip_ja: oxygen是不可数名词，不说an oxygen。

meanings_ja: n. 商人；交易员
definition_en: Someone who buys and sells goods or financial assets.
example1_en: A market trader arranged fresh oranges outside his stall.
example1_ja: 一位市场商贩在摊位外摆放新鲜橙子。
example2_en: Small traders often struggle to compete with larger retailers that can negotiate lower prices from suppliers.
example2_ja: 小商贩往往难以与能向供应商争取更低价格的大型零售商竞争。
collocations: market trader｜市场商贩 ; currency trader｜外汇交易员 ; independent trader｜独立商户 ; stock trader｜股票交易员
tip_ja: 可指实物买卖者，也可指金融市场交易员。

meanings_ja: adv. 容易地；轻易地 | adv. 欣然地；乐意地
definition_en: Easily and without difficulty or delay. | Willingly and without hesitation.
example1_en: My sister readily agreed to water the plants.
example1_ja: 姐姐欣然答应帮忙给植物浇水。
example2_en: Reliable health information should be readily available to all citizens, regardless of their income or location.
example2_ja: 所有公民都应能方便地获取可靠的健康信息，不受收入或居住地点限制。
collocations: readily available｜易于获取的 ; readily accessible｜容易接触或使用的 ; readily agree｜欣然同意 ; readily admit｜坦然承认
tip_ja: readily available指容易获得，不是“乐意提供”。

meanings_ja: n. 传说；传奇故事 | n. 传奇人物 | n. 图例
definition_en: an old popular story that may not be historically true | someone greatly admired for exceptional achievements | a guide explaining the symbols used on a map or chart
example1_en: Grandma told us a legend about a sleeping dragon.
example1_ja: 奶奶给我们讲了一个关于沉睡巨龙的传说。
example2_en: Local legends can strengthen cultural identity while attracting visitors interested in the history of a region.
example2_ja: 地方传说既能增强文化认同，也能吸引对当地历史感兴趣的游客。
collocations: according to legend｜据传说 ; local legend｜地方传说 ; a living legend｜当世传奇人物 ; map legend｜地图图例
tip_ja: legend可能有历史原型，不等于已证实的历史。

meanings_ja: n. 情况；条件；环境 | n. 经济状况；境遇
definition_en: a fact or condition that affects a situation | the conditions of someone's life, especially their financial situation
example1_en: Under no circumstances should you leave the front door unlocked.
example1_ja: 无论什么情况下，你都不该让前门不上锁。
example2_en: Schools should consider each student's personal circumstances when developing policies on attendance and access to learning resources.
example2_ja: 学校制定出勤和学习资源获取政策时，应考虑每位学生的个人情况。
collocations: under the circumstances｜在这种情况下 ; personal circumstances｜个人情况 ; unforeseen circumstances｜意外情况 ; under no circumstances｜绝不
tip_ja: 常用复数；under no circumstances置句首须倒装。

meanings_ja: adj. 随机的；无规律的
definition_en: Chosen or happening without a fixed pattern or deliberate plan.
example1_en: I opened the cookbook at a random page.
example1_ja: 我随手翻开了食谱中的一页。
example2_en: Researchers selected a random sample of households to assess public attitudes towards renewable energy.
example2_ja: 研究人员随机抽取了一些家庭，以评估公众对可再生能源的态度。
collocations: random sample｜随机样本 ; random selection｜随机选择 ; at random｜随机地
tip_ja: random是形容词；作状语用randomly或at random。

meanings_ja: n. 腌菜；泡菜 | v. 腌制
definition_en: A vegetable preserved in vinegar or salty water. | To preserve food in vinegar or salty water.
example1_en: She added a crunchy pickle to her sandwich.
example1_ja: 她在三明治里加了一根脆腌黄瓜。
example2_en: Many communities pickle seasonal vegetables to extend their shelf life and reduce household food waste.
example2_ja: 许多社区的居民会腌制时令蔬菜，以延长保存期并减少家庭食物浪费。
collocations: pickled vegetables｜腌制蔬菜 ; a jar of pickles｜一罐腌菜 ; in a pickle｜陷入困境
tip_ja: 美式英语中a pickle常指一根腌黄瓜。

meanings_ja: adv. 自愿地；乐意地
definition_en: By choice and without needing to be forced or persuaded.
example1_en: My neighbour willingly watered the plants while I was away.
example1_ja: 我不在家时，邻居欣然帮我给植物浇水。
example2_en: Residents are more likely to participate willingly in recycling schemes when collection services are convenient and reliable.
example2_ja: 当回收服务便利且可靠时，居民更可能自愿参与回收计划。
collocations: willingly agree｜欣然同意 ; participate willingly｜自愿参与 ; willingly accept｜欣然接受
tip_ja: 强调自愿而非被迫；不等于单纯“开心地”。

meanings_ja: n. 大猩猩
definition_en: A large African ape with dark hair and powerful arms.
example1_en: The young gorilla clung tightly to its mother's back.
example1_ja: 那只年幼的大猩猩紧紧趴在妈妈背上。
example2_en: Protecting gorilla habitats also preserves tropical forests that support numerous other species and store carbon.
example2_ja: 保护大猩猩的栖息地，也能保存为众多其他物种提供生存空间并储存碳的热带森林。
collocations: a mountain gorilla｜山地大猩猩 ; a silverback gorilla｜银背大猩猩 ; gorilla conservation｜大猩猩保护
tip_ja: gorilla是大猩猩；chimpanzee是黑猩猩。

meanings_ja: adj. 全面的；详尽的
definition_en: Covering all or nearly all important parts of something.
example1_en: This comprehensive guide covers every trail in the park.
example1_ja: 这本详尽的指南涵盖了公园里的每条步道。
example2_en: Schools should provide comprehensive health education to help students make informed decisions about their lifestyles.
example2_ja: 学校应提供全面的健康教育，帮助学生对自己的生活方式作出明智决定。
collocations: comprehensive guide｜详尽指南 ; comprehensive review｜全面审查 ; comprehensive assessment｜综合评估
tip_ja: 强调涵盖范围全面，不是指容易理解。

meanings_ja: adv. 越来越；日益
definition_en: More and more as time passes
example1_en: The bus has become increasingly crowded since last month.
example1_ja: 从上个月起，这趟公交车变得越来越拥挤。
example2_en: As cities expand, governments are increasingly investing in public transport to reduce congestion and improve air quality.
example2_ja: 随着城市扩张，政府正加大公共交通投入，以缓解拥堵并改善空气质量。
collocations: increasingly important｜日益重要 ; increasingly common｜越来越普遍 ; increasingly concerned｜越来越担忧 ; increasingly difficult｜越来越困难
tip_ja: 直接修饰原级形容词：increasingly popular。

meanings_ja: v. 拖；拉 | v. 缓慢进行；拖沓 | n. 阻力；拖累
definition_en: To pull something along a surface, often with effort. | To pass or progress so slowly that it feels boring. | A force or influence that slows movement or progress.
example1_en: We dragged the heavy rug across the floor.
example1_ja: 我们拖着沉重的地毯穿过房间。
example2_en: Complicated approval procedures can drag on for months, delaying essential improvements to public transport.
example2_ja: 复杂的审批程序可能拖延数月，耽误公共交通的必要改善。
collocations: drag a chair｜拖动椅子 ; drag on｜拖延下去 ; drag and drop｜拖放 ; a drag on growth｜增长的拖累
tip_ja: drag过去式为dragged；drag on指拖延下去。

meanings_ja: adj. 不新鲜的 | adj. 陈旧乏味的
definition_en: No longer fresh, especially when describing bread or air. | No longer interesting or original because of repeated use.
example1_en: This bread is stale, so I'll use it for breadcrumbs.
example1_ja: 这面包不新鲜了，我就拿它做面包屑吧。
example2_en: Teaching methods can become stale when educators lack opportunities to exchange ideas and develop new skills.
example2_ja: 如果教育工作者缺乏交流想法和培养新技能的机会，教学方法就可能变得陈旧乏味。
collocations: stale bread｜不新鲜的面包 ; stale air｜污浊的空气 ; stale jokes｜老掉牙的笑话
tip_ja: stale指失去新鲜感；rotten指已腐烂。

meanings_ja: adj. 统计的；统计学的
definition_en: relating to collecting, studying, or interpreting numerical data
example1_en: She used statistical software to compare the survey results.
example1_ja: 她用统计软件比较了调查结果。
example2_en: Reliable statistical evidence helps governments identify communities that need better access to healthcare.
example2_ja: 可靠的统计证据有助于政府确定哪些社区需要更便利的医疗服务。
collocations: statistical analysis｜统计分析 ; statistical data｜统计数据 ; statistical significance｜统计显著性
tip_ja: statistical指与统计有关，不等于“显著的”。

meanings_ja: adj. 有能力的；能…的 | adj. 能干的；有才干的
definition_en: Having the ability or qualities needed to do something. | Skilled and effective at handling tasks or responsibilities.
example1_en: This little printer is capable of producing excellent colour photos.
example1_ja: 这台小打印机能打印出色彩出众的照片。
example2_en: With appropriate training and support, young employees are capable of taking on substantial responsibilities within an organisation.
example2_ja: 经过适当培训并获得支持，年轻员工有能力在组织内承担重要职责。
collocations: capable of doing something｜有能力做某事 ; highly capable｜非常能干的 ; a capable leader｜能干的领导者
tip_ja: 用capable of doing，不用capable to do。

meanings_ja: adj. 相应的；对应的
definition_en: Matching or directly related to something else
example1_en: Put each coloured lid on its corresponding container.
example1_ja: 把每个彩色盖子盖在对应的容器上。
example2_en: A rise in urban population often creates a corresponding increase in demand for public transport.
example2_ja: 城市人口增长往往会使公共交通需求相应增加。
collocations: corresponding increase｜相应的增长 ; corresponding period｜同期 ; corresponding figures｜对应的数据
tip_ja: 强调相互对应；correspond to表示与……相对应。

meanings_ja: n. 实况解说 | n. 评论；评述
definition_en: a spoken description of an event as it happens | an explanation or discussion expressing opinions about something
example1_en: We listened to the football commentary while cooking dinner.
example1_ja: 我们一边做晚饭，一边听足球比赛的实况解说。
example2_en: Political commentary can help citizens understand complex policies, but it should be clearly distinguished from factual reporting.
example2_ja: 政治评论可以帮助公民理解复杂政策，但应与事实报道明确区分。
collocations: live commentary｜现场直播解说 ; running commentary｜连续解说 ; political commentary｜政治评论 ; commentary on｜对……的评论
tip_ja: commentary常指持续解说或深入评述，不只是单条评论。

meanings_ja: adj. 渴望的；热切的
definition_en: very interested and excited about doing or having something
example1_en: The children were eager to open their presents.
example1_ja: 孩子们迫不及待地想拆开礼物。
example2_en: Many graduates are eager to gain practical experience before committing to a particular career path.
example2_ja: 许多毕业生渴望先积累实践经验，再决定具体的职业道路。
collocations: eager to learn｜渴望学习 ; eager for success｜渴望成功 ; eager anticipation｜热切期待
tip_ja: 常用eager to do或eager for＋名词。

meanings_ja: n. 一件衣服；服装
definition_en: a single item of clothing
example1_en: This delicate garment needs to be washed by hand.
example1_ja: 这件质地娇贵的衣服需要手洗。
example2_en: Improving working conditions in the garment industry requires cooperation between manufacturers, retailers, and national governments.
example2_ja: 改善服装业的工作条件需要制造商、零售商和各国政府共同合作。
collocations: a woollen garment｜一件羊毛衣物 ; the garment industry｜服装业 ; garment workers｜制衣工人
tip_ja: 可数名词，指一件衣服；clothing通常不可数。

meanings_ja: adj. 易碎的；娇弱的 | adj. 微妙的；需谨慎处理的 | adj. 精巧的；柔和的

definition_en: The process of getting someone to agree or do something. | A particular religious or political belief or group.
example1_en: After some persuasion, my brother joined our evening walk.
example1_ja: 经过一番劝说，我弟弟加入了我们的晚间散步。
example2_en: Public health campaigns often rely on persuasion rather than legal restrictions to encourage healthier habits.
example2_ja: 公共卫生宣传活动往往依靠劝导而非法律限制来鼓励更健康的习惯。
collocations: powers of persuasion｜说服能力 ; gentle persuasion｜温和的劝说 ; political persuasion｜政治信仰
tip_ja: 表示劝说时通常不可数；动词是persuade。

meanings_ja: n. 机制；运作方式 | n. 机械装置；机械结构
definition_en: a process or system through which something works or happens | a set of connected parts that performs a particular function
example1_en: The club needs a fair mechanism for resolving disputes.
example1_ja: 俱乐部需要一个公平的争议解决机制。
example2_en: Governments should establish effective monitoring mechanisms to ensure that environmental regulations are consistently enforced across industries.
example2_ja: 政府应建立有效的监督机制，确保各行业始终贯彻执行环境法规。
collocations: coping mechanism｜应对机制 ; defence mechanism｜防御机制 ; monitoring mechanism｜监督机制 ; locking mechanism｜锁定装置
tip_ja: mechanism for doing表示“做某事的机制或办法”。

meanings_ja: n. 影响；作用 | n. 撞击；冲击 | v. 影响
definition_en: a strong effect on someone or something | the force or action of one object hitting another | to affect someone or something, often strongly
example1_en: The new playground had a positive impact on our neighbourhood.
example1_ja: 新游乐场给我们社区带来了积极影响。
example2_en: Governments should assess the environmental impact of major construction projects before allowing work to begin.
example2_ja: 政府应在批准开工之前评估大型建设项目对环境的影响。
collocations: have an impact on｜对……有影响 ; environmental impact｜环境影响 ; on impact｜在撞击时 ; impact on communities｜影响社区
tip_ja: 名词重音在前；动词通常读/ɪmˈpækt/。

meanings_ja: adj. 正在进行的；持续的
definition_en: Continuing to happen or develop, rather than being finished.
example1_en: The ongoing repairs mean we cannot use the kitchen.
example1_ja: 维修仍在进行，所以我们没法使用厨房。
example2_en: Ongoing research into renewable energy is essential for reducing dependence on fossil fuels and limiting environmental damage.
example2_ja: 持续开展可再生能源研究，对减少化石燃料依赖和限制环境损害至关重要。
collocations: ongoing research｜持续进行的研究 ; an ongoing process｜持续的过程 ; ongoing support｜持续的支持 ; an ongoing investigation｜正在进行的调查
tip_ja: 强调尚在持续，不等于即将发生的upcoming。

meanings_ja: v. 使模糊；变模糊 | n. 模糊的影像；模糊的记忆
definition_en: to make or become difficult to see or distinguish clearly | something that cannot be seen or remembered clearly
example1_en: Tears blurred my vision as the train pulled away.
example1_ja: 火车驶离时，泪水模糊了我的视线。
example2_en: Working from home can blur the boundary between professional responsibilities and personal life, increasing stress.
example2_ja: 居家办公可能模糊工作职责与个人生活之间的界限，增加压力。
collocations: blur the distinction｜模糊区别 ; blur the boundaries｜模糊界限 ; a blur of colour｜一片模糊的色彩
tip_ja: 常指视线或界限模糊；不是“污点”的常用译法。

meanings_ja: n. 哲学家
definition_en: Someone who studies fundamental questions about existence, knowledge, and values.
example1_en: The philosopher asked us what makes a life meaningful.
example1_ja: 那位哲学家问我们，什么使人生有意义。
example2_en: A philosopher might question whether economic growth should be the main measure of a society's progress.
example2_ja: 哲学家可能会质疑，经济增长是否应当成为衡量社会进步的主要标准。
collocations: moral philosopher｜伦理哲学家 ; political philosopher｜政治哲学家 ; ancient philosopher｜古代哲学家
tip_ja: philosopher指人，philosophy指哲学或理念。

meanings_ja: pron. 任何…的人；无论谁 | pron. 究竟是谁
definition_en: any person who, or no matter which person | used in questions to express surprise about someone's identity
example1_en: Whoever finishes first can choose the next game.
example1_ja: 谁先完成，谁就可以选择下一个游戏。
example2_en: Public libraries should welcome whoever needs access to reliable information, regardless of their income or educational background.
example2_ja: 公共图书馆应欢迎任何需要获取可靠信息的人，不论其收入或教育背景如何。
collocations: whoever you are｜无论你是谁 ; whoever wants to｜任何想要…的人 ; whoever is responsible｜任何负有责任的人
tip_ja: 可引导名词性或让步从句；并非所有场合都能换成no matter who。

meanings_ja: adj. 真正的；正宗的 | adj. 真实可信的
definition_en: Genuine or traditional, rather than copied or invented | Accurately representing real events, experiences, or conditions
example1_en: This small restaurant serves authentic dishes from the region.
example1_ja: 这家小餐馆供应这个地区的正宗菜肴。
example2_en: Museums should preserve authentic objects while using digital tools to make local history more accessible.
example2_ja: 博物馆应保存真品，同时利用数字工具让公众更容易了解当地历史。
collocations: authentic cuisine｜正宗菜肴 ; authentic experience｜真实体验 ; authentic account｜真实可信的叙述
tip_ja: authentic强调真品或正宗，不只表示事实正确。

meanings_ja: n. 观点；视角 | n. 透视法 | n. 客观判断力
definition_en: A particular way of considering a situation or issue. | A drawing technique that makes objects appear realistically distant. | The ability to judge the relative importance of things.
example1_en: Hearing her story gave me a completely different perspective.
example1_ja: 听了她的故事，我对事情有了完全不同的看法。
example2_en: Examining urban development from residents' perspective can help planners create more inclusive and accessible public spaces.
example2_ja: 从居民的视角审视城市发展，有助于规划者打造更具包容性、更加便利的公共空间。
collocations: from a different perspective｜从不同视角 ; broaden your perspective｜拓宽视野 ; put things into perspective｜客观看待事物 ; a sense of perspective｜透视感；分寸感
tip_ja: 从某一视角用from a perspective，不用in。

meanings_ja: v. 使烦躁；惹恼 | v. 刺激；使不适
definition_en: To make someone feel annoyed or impatient. | To make skin or another body part sore or uncomfortable.
example1_en: The constant dripping from the tap really irritates me.
example1_ja: 水龙头不停滴水，真让我烦躁。
example2_en: Some household cleaning products contain chemicals that can irritate the skin and cause breathing difficulties.
example2_ja: 某些家用清洁产品含有会刺激皮肤并导致呼吸困难的化学物质。
collocations: irritate the skin｜刺激皮肤 ; irritate the eyes｜刺激眼睛 ; really irritate someone｜着实惹恼某人
tip_ja: irritated形容人感到烦躁；irritating形容事物烦人。

meanings_ja: n. 真空；空缺 | n. 真空吸尘器 | v. 用吸尘器清扫
definition_en: A space without air, or a gap left by something missing. | An electric machine that sucks up dust and dirt. | To clean something using a vacuum cleaner.
example1_en: I vacuum the carpet while my brother dusts the shelves.
example1_ja: 我用吸尘器清扫地毯，弟弟则擦去架子上的灰尘。
example2_en: Sound cannot travel through a vacuum because it needs a medium such as air or water.
example2_ja: 声音无法在真空中传播，因为它需要空气或水等介质。
collocations: vacuum cleaner｜真空吸尘器 ; a political vacuum｜政治真空 ; vacuum the carpet｜用吸尘器清扫地毯
tip_ja: 表示清扫时可直接作动词：vacuum the floor。

meanings_ja: adj. 担心的；忧虑的 | adj. 有关的；涉及的 | adj. 关注的；以…为内容的
definition_en: Worried about someone or something. | Involved in or affected by a particular matter. | Interested in or dealing with a particular subject.
example1_en: I was concerned when you missed the last bus.
example1_ja: 你没赶上末班公交车时，我很担心。
example2_en: Residents are increasingly concerned about air pollution and want local authorities to improve public transport.
example2_ja: 居民越来越担心空气污染，希望地方政府改善公共交通。
collocations: concerned about｜担心 ; the people concerned｜相关人员 ; concerned with｜涉及；关注 ; as far as I am concerned｜就我而言
tip_ja: about常接担忧对象；with常接涉及的主题。

meanings_ja: adv. 真诚地；由衷地
definition_en: In a way that expresses what you genuinely feel.
example1_en: I sincerely hope you feel better very soon.
example1_ja: 我由衷地希望你很快好起来。
example2_en: Organisations should listen sincerely to residents' concerns before introducing changes that affect the local community.
example2_ja: 机构在推行影响当地社区的变革之前，应真诚倾听居民的关切。
collocations: sincerely hope｜由衷希望 ; sincerely apologise｜真诚道歉 ; sincerely believe｜真心相信 ; Yours sincerely｜谨上
tip_ja: 英式书信称呼已知姓名者，结尾常用Yours sincerely。

meanings_ja: n. 范围；涉及面 | n. 机会；发挥余地
definition_en: The range of subjects or activities that something covers. | The opportunity or freedom to do or develop something.
example1_en: Kitchen repairs fall outside the scope of this job.
example1_ja: 厨房维修不属于这项工作的范围。
example2_en: The scope of the study was limited to urban schools, so its findings may not apply to rural communities.
example2_ja: 该研究仅涉及城市学校，因此其结论未必适用于农村社区。
collocations: scope of the study｜研究范围 ; beyond the scope of｜超出……的范围 ; scope for improvement｜改进空间 ; broaden the scope｜扩大范围
tip_ja: 范围用scope of；做某事的余地用scope for。

meanings_ja: n. 物理学家
definition_en: A scientist who studies matter, energy, and their interactions.
example1_en: A physicist showed our class how magnets work.
example1_ja: 一位物理学家向我们班演示了磁铁的工作原理。
example2_en: Physicists contribute to medical progress by developing imaging technologies that help doctors examine the human body.
example2_ja: 物理学家通过开发帮助医生检查人体的成像技术，推动医学进步。
collocations: theoretical physicist｜理论物理学家 ; nuclear physicist｜核物理学家 ; experimental physicist｜实验物理学家
tip_ja: physicist是物理学家；physician是医生。

meanings_ja: n. 观众；旁观者
definition_en: Someone who watches an event, especially a sporting event.
example1_en: A spectator caught the ball near the fence.
example1_ja: 一名观众在围栏附近接住了球。
example2_en: Major sporting events attract thousands of spectators and can generate substantial income for local businesses.
example2_ja: 大型体育赛事吸引成千上万的观众，并能为当地商家带来可观收入。
collocations: spectator sport｜观赏性体育运动 ; spectator safety｜观众安全 ; attract spectators｜吸引观众
tip_ja: 常指体育赛事现场观众；演出观众多用audience。

meanings_ja: n. 赞助者；赞助机构 | v. 赞助；资助
definition_en: A person or organisation providing support, often in return for publicity. | To support a person, event, or activity financially.
example1_en: Our swimming club needs a sponsor for new equipment.
example1_ja: 我们的游泳俱乐部需要赞助者资助购置新器材。
example2_en: Local businesses can sponsor community sports programmes to improve public health and strengthen relationships with residents.
example2_ja: 当地企业可以赞助社区体育项目，以改善公众健康并加强与居民的联系。
collocations: a corporate sponsor｜企业赞助商 ; the main sponsor｜主要赞助方 ; sponsor an event｜赞助活动 ; sponsor a team｜赞助队伍
tip_ja: sponsor可作名词或动词；赞助行为用sponsorship。

meanings_ja: n. 偏见；成见 | v. 使有偏见；损害
definition_en: An unfair opinion formed without enough knowledge or experience. | To unfairly influence someone's judgement or harm their chances.
example1_en: Her neighbours welcomed her warmly, without any prejudice.
example1_ja: 邻居们热情地欢迎她，没有任何偏见。
example2_en: Schools can challenge prejudice by encouraging students to learn about cultures different from their own.
example2_ja: 学校可以鼓励学生了解不同于自身的文化，从而消除偏见。
collocations: racial prejudice｜种族偏见 ; prejudice against｜对……的偏见 ; challenge prejudice｜质疑并反对偏见 ; prejudice someone's chances｜损害某人的机会
tip_ja: 表示对某群体的偏见，常用prejudice against。

meanings_ja: adj. 可耻的；丢脸的
definition_en: So bad or unacceptable that it deserves strong disapproval.
example1_en: Leaving rubbish all over this beautiful park is disgraceful.
example1_ja: 在这么美的公园里到处乱扔垃圾，真是可耻。
example2_en: The report exposed disgraceful working conditions and called for stronger protection of employees across the industry.
example2_ja: 报告揭露了恶劣得令人不齿的工作条件，并呼吁加强对全行业雇员的保护。
collocations: disgraceful behaviour｜可耻的行为 ; disgraceful treatment｜令人愤慨的对待 ; absolutely disgraceful｜极其可耻
tip_ja: 表示强烈谴责；“名誉扫地的”常用disgraced。

meanings_ja: adj. 悲惨的；令人悲痛的 | adj. 悲剧的
definition_en: Causing deep sadness, especially through death or serious suffering. | Relating to a serious play or story with an unhappy ending.
example1_en: The film tells a tragic story of lost friendship.
example1_ja: 这部电影讲述了一个关于友谊破裂的悲伤故事。
example2_en: Tragic accidents on busy roads highlight the need for safer crossings and stricter enforcement of speed limits.
example2_ja: 繁忙道路上的惨痛事故凸显了设置更安全的过街设施及严格执行限速规定的必要性。
collocations: a tragic accident｜惨痛的事故 ; a tragic loss｜令人悲痛的损失 ; a tragic ending｜悲剧结局 ; a tragic hero｜悲剧主角
tip_ja: 比sad程度更重，常涉及死亡或严重不幸。

meanings_ja: n. 缺点；不利因素
definition_en: A disadvantage that makes something less useful or attractive
example1_en: The flat's only drawback is its tiny kitchen.
example1_ja: 这套公寓唯一的缺点是厨房太小。
example2_en: A major drawback of working remotely is the reduced opportunity for informal communication with colleagues.
example2_ja: 远程办公的一大弊端是与同事非正式交流的机会减少了。
collocations: a major drawback｜主要缺点 ; the main drawback｜最大的弊端 ; a drawback of｜……的缺点
tip_ja: 可数名词，常用a drawback of加名词或动名词。

meanings_ja: v. 专门从事；专攻
definition_en: to focus on a particular subject, activity, or service
example1_en: The bakery near our house specializes in fresh sourdough bread.
example1_ja: 我们家附近的面包店专做新鲜的酸面包。
example2_en: Students who specialize too early may miss opportunities to develop knowledge across a broader range of subjects.
example2_ja: 过早确定专业方向的学生可能错过拓宽学科知识的机会。
collocations: specialize in medicine｜专攻医学 ; specialize in repairing cars｜专门修理汽车 ; highly specialized skills｜高度专业化的技能
tip_ja: 常用specialize in；英式也常拼作specialise。

meanings_ja: v. 撕裂；扯破 | n. 裂口；破洞
definition_en: To tear something quickly or forcefully, or become torn. | A long hole caused by tearing material.
example1_en: I ripped my sleeve on a sharp branch yesterday.
example1_ja: 昨天我的袖子被一根尖树枝扯破了。
example2_en: Repairing a small rip in clothing instead of replacing it can reduce household waste.
example2_ja: 修补衣物上的小裂口而非换掉整件衣物，可以减少家庭垃圾。
collocations: rip open｜撕开 ; rip apart｜撕碎；扯开 ; a rip in｜……上的裂口
tip_ja: rip的过去式和过去分词均为ripped。

meanings_ja: adj. 灵活的；可调整的 | adj. 柔韧的；易弯曲的
definition_en: able to change to suit different needs or situations | able to bend easily without breaking
example1_en: My flexible schedule lets me collect the children after school.
example1_ja: 我的时间安排很灵活，可以在放学后接孩子。
example2_en: Flexible working arrangements can help employees balance professional responsibilities with their family commitments.
example2_ja: 灵活的工作安排能帮助员工兼顾工作职责与家庭责任。
collocations: flexible working hours｜弹性工作时间 ; a flexible approach｜灵活的方法 ; flexible materials｜柔性材料
tip_ja: 既可形容安排灵活，也可形容材料易弯曲。

meanings_ja: n. 芽；花蕾 | v. 发芽；长出花蕾
definition_en: a small growth that develops into a leaf or flower | to produce new buds
example1_en: A tiny green bud appeared on the bare branch.
example1_ja: 光秃秃的树枝上冒出了一个小小的绿芽。
example2_en: Warmer spring temperatures can cause trees to bud earlier, leaving new growth vulnerable to sudden frost.
example2_ja: 春季气温升高会使树木提前发芽，导致新芽容易受到突发霜冻的损害。
collocations: a flower bud｜花蕾 ; a leaf bud｜叶芽 ; in bud｜含苞待放 ; nip something in the bud｜将某事扼杀在萌芽中
tip_ja: 动词过去式budded，现在分词budding，双写d。

meanings_ja: v. 低估；小看 | n. 偏低的估计
definition_en: To judge something as less important, capable, or large than reality | An estimate that is lower than the actual amount
example1_en: We underestimated the traffic and arrived half an hour late.
example1_ja: 我们低估了交通拥堵程度，结果迟到了半小时。
example2_en: Policymakers should not underestimate the long-term effects of poor housing on children's health and educational achievement.
example2_ja: 政策制定者不应低估恶劣住房条件对儿童健康和学业表现的长期影响。
collocations: underestimate the cost｜低估成本 ; underestimate the importance of｜低估……的重要性 ; seriously underestimate｜严重低估
tip_ja: 动词末尾读/ meɪt /，名词末尾读/ mət /。

meanings_ja: n. 旋转；转动 | n. 轮换；轮作
definition_en: Movement around a central point or axis | The regular replacement of one thing or person by another
example1_en: The wheel completed one rotation before stopping in the mud.
example1_ja: 车轮转了一圈后便停在了泥里。
example2_en: Crop rotation helps farmers maintain soil fertility and reduce their reliance on chemical pesticides.
example2_ja: 作物轮作有助于农民保持土壤肥力，并减少对化学农药的依赖。
collocations: the Earth's rotation｜地球自转 ; crop rotation｜作物轮作 ; job rotation｜岗位轮换 ; in rotation｜轮流
tip_ja: rotation 可指绕轴旋转，也可指按顺序轮换。

meanings_ja: n. 满意；满足 | n. 满足；履行
definition_en: Pleasure felt when needs, wishes, or expectations are fulfilled. | The act of meeting a need, demand, or requirement.
example1_en: He smiled with satisfaction after fixing the broken chair.
example1_ja: 修好那把坏椅子后，他满意地笑了。
example2_en: Greater job satisfaction can reduce staff turnover and encourage employees to contribute more actively to their organisations.
example2_ja: 更高的工作满意度可以减少人员流失，并鼓励员工更积极地为所在机构作贡献。
collocations: job satisfaction｜工作满意度 ; customer satisfaction｜顾客满意度 ; a sense of satisfaction｜满足感 ; the satisfaction of basic needs｜基本需求的满足
tip_ja: 通常不可数；满意某事常说satisfaction with。

meanings_ja: n. 杂技演员
definition_en: A performer who does difficult balancing, jumping, or gymnastic movements.
example1_en: The acrobat balanced on one hand above the soft mat.
example1_ja: 杂技演员在软垫上方用单手支撑身体，保持平衡。
example2_en: Training as an acrobat requires sustained physical discipline, making injury prevention an essential part of professional education.
example2_ja: 杂技演员的训练需要长期严格的身体训练，因此伤害预防是专业教育中不可或缺的一部分。
collocations: skilled acrobat｜技艺娴熟的杂技演员 ; circus acrobat｜马戏团杂技演员 ; professional acrobat｜职业杂技演员
tip_ja: acrobat指演员；acrobatics指杂技表演或技巧。

meanings_ja: n. 焦虑；担忧
definition_en: Worry or nervousness about something uncertain or threatening.
example1_en: Her anxiety faded when she heard the good news.
example1_ja: 听到好消息后，她的焦虑消退了。
example2_en: Regular physical activity can reduce anxiety among students facing demanding examinations and uncertain career prospects.
example2_ja: 经常锻炼可以减轻学生面对高难度考试和不确定就业前景时的焦虑。
collocations: anxiety about｜对……的焦虑 ; reduce anxiety｜减轻焦虑 ; severe anxiety｜严重焦虑
tip_ja: anxiety about后接担忧的事情；形容词是anxious。

meanings_ja: n. 投入；奉献精神 | n. 承诺；保证 | n. 必须履行的责任
definition_en: A strong willingness to give time and effort to something. | A firm promise to do something. | A duty or arrangement requiring your time, money, or attention.
example1_en: Her commitment to gardening keeps the flowers blooming.
example1_ja: 她用心打理花园，让鲜花一直盛开。
example2_en: Improving public transport requires sustained political commitment and reliable funding rather than occasional investment in isolated projects.
example2_ja: 改善公共交通需要持续的政治决心和可靠的资金，而非偶尔投资零散项目。
collocations: commitment to a cause｜对事业的投入 ; make a commitment｜作出承诺 ; family commitments｜家庭责任 ; long-term commitment｜长期投入
tip_ja: commitment to中的to是介词，后接名词或动名词。

meanings_ja: n. 女主席；女董事长
definition_en: A woman who leads a meeting, committee, or organisation.
example1_en: The chairwoman invited everyone to share their ideas.
example1_ja: 女主席邀请大家分享各自的想法。
example2_en: The chairwoman proposed new training programmes to improve employees' skills and support equal opportunities.
example2_ja: 女董事长提议开展新的培训项目，以提升员工技能并促进机会平等。
collocations: chairwoman of the board｜董事会女主席 ; committee chairwoman｜委员会女主席 ; appoint a chairwoman｜任命女主席
tip_ja: 复数为chairwomen；不强调性别可用chair。

meanings_ja: adv. 相当；还算 | adv. 通情达理地；合理地 | adv. 价格公道地
definition_en: to a fairly good or satisfactory degree | in a sensible, fair, or logical way | at a fair and affordable price
example1_en: The kitchen is reasonably clean, but the floor needs sweeping.
example1_ja: 厨房还算干净，不过地板需要扫一扫。
example2_en: Public transport must be reasonably priced if cities want more residents to leave their cars at home.
example2_ja: 如果城市希望更多居民不开车出门，公共交通就必须定价合理。
collocations: reasonably good｜相当不错 ; reasonably priced｜价格公道的 ; reasonably expect｜合理预期
tip_ja: 表示程度时近于 fairly，并非 very。

meanings_ja: n. 导航；航行 | n. 网站或应用的浏览操作
definition_en: Finding and following a route to a destination. | Moving between pages or sections of a website or application.
example1_en: We used a compass for navigation during our hike.
example1_ja: 徒步时，我们用指南针辨别方向。
example2_en: Clear website navigation helps users find essential information quickly, making online public services more accessible to everyone.
example2_ja: 清晰的网站导航能帮助用户快速找到重要信息，让所有人都更方便地使用在线公共服务。
collocations: satellite navigation｜卫星导航 ; a navigation system｜导航系统 ; website navigation｜网站导航
tip_ja: 不仅指航海，也用于道路导航和网页浏览。

meanings_ja: adj. 更可取的；更合意的
definition_en: Better or more suitable than another option.
example1_en: A quiet evening at home is preferable to another party.
example1_ja: 比起再参加一场聚会，在家度过安静的夜晚更合心意。
example2_en: Investing in reliable public transport is often preferable to building more roads in densely populated cities.
example2_ja: 在人口稠密的城市，投资可靠的公共交通通常比修建更多道路更可取。
collocations: preferable to｜比……更可取 ; far preferable｜好得多的 ; a preferable alternative｜更可取的替代方案
tip_ja: 用A is preferable to B，不用than；通常不加more。

meanings_ja: v. 联想；联系 | n. 同事；业务伙伴 | adj. 副的；准的
definition_en: to connect people or things in your mind | someone connected with you through work or business | having a related position, often below the main or full rank
example1_en: I always associate the smell of cinnamon with home.
example1_ja: 我总是一闻到肉桂的气味就想起家。
example2_en: Many consumers associate higher prices with better quality, although research suggests this connection is not always reliable.
example2_ja: 许多消费者把较高价格与较好品质联系起来，但研究表明，这种联系并非总是可靠。
collocations: associate A with B｜把A与B联系起来 ; be associated with｜与……有关 ; business associate｜业务伙伴 ; associate professor｜副教授
tip_ja: 动词尾音/eɪt/；名词、形容词尾音/ət/。

meanings_ja: adj. 过量的；过度的
definition_en: Greater than is necessary, reasonable, or acceptable.
example1_en: The excessive heat made our afternoon walk uncomfortable.
example1_ja: 酷热让我们下午的散步变得很不舒服。
example2_en: Excessive use of private cars contributes to urban air pollution and places pressure on existing roads.
example2_ja: 过度使用私家车加剧了城市空气污染，也给现有道路带来压力。
collocations: excessive consumption｜过度消费 ; excessive pressure｜过大压力 ; excessive noise｜过大噪声 ; excessive use of｜过度使用
tip_ja: 含超过合理限度之意，不等于extra（额外的）。

meanings_ja: v. 明确说明；具体指定
definition_en: To state exactly what is required or meant.
example1_en: Please specify which colour you want for the curtains.
example1_ja: 请明确说明你想要哪种颜色的窗帘。
example2_en: Governments should specify clear safety standards that all manufacturers must meet before selling products to consumers.
example2_ja: 政府应明确规定所有制造商向消费者出售产品前必须达到的安全标准。
collocations: specify requirements｜明确要求 ; specify a date｜指定日期 ; specify conditions｜明确条件
tip_ja: 可接名词、that从句或疑问词引导的从句。

meanings_ja: n. 加班时间；加班费 | adv. 加班地 | n. 加时赛
definition_en: Extra working hours, or the money paid for them. | For longer than the usual working hours. | Additional playing time used to decide a tied game.
example1_en: I worked overtime yesterday to finish the kitchen repairs.
example1_ja: 我昨天加班完成了厨房的维修。
example2_en: Regular overtime may increase short-term productivity, but it can also undermine employees' health and reduce job satisfaction.
example2_ja: 经常加班可能提高短期生产力，但也会损害员工健康，降低工作满意度。
collocations: work overtime｜加班 ; overtime pay｜加班费 ; unpaid overtime｜无偿加班 ; mandatory overtime｜强制加班
tip_ja: 加班用work overtime；over time意为随着时间推移。

meanings_ja: v. 欺骗；蒙骗
definition_en: to deliberately make someone believe something that is not true
example1_en: The seller deceived me about the bicycle's condition.
example1_ja: 卖家在自行车的状况上欺骗了我。
example2_en: Misleading advertisements can deceive consumers into purchasing products that offer little benefit to their health.
example2_ja: 误导性广告可能诱使消费者购买对健康益处甚微的产品。
collocations: deceive someone into doing something｜骗某人做某事 ; deceive yourself｜自欺 ; deliberately deceive｜故意欺骗
tip_ja: deceive sb into doing sth表示骗某人做某事。

meanings_ja: n. 局限；不足 | n. 限制；限额
definition_en: a weakness that prevents someone or something from being fully effective | a rule or condition that controls how much is allowed
example1_en: The main limitation of this camera is its battery life.
example1_ja: 这台相机的主要不足是电池续航时间短。
example2_en: Researchers should acknowledge the limitations of small samples before drawing conclusions about the wider population.
example2_ja: 研究人员在对更广泛人群作出结论前，应承认小样本的局限性。
collocations: limitations of a study｜研究的局限性 ; place limitations on｜对……加以限制 ; budget limitations｜预算限制 ; recognise your limitations｜认识自身的局限
tip_ja: “局限性”常用复数；对……的限制用limitation on。

meanings_ja: n. 冲突；争执 | n. 矛盾；抵触 | v. 相冲突；相抵触
definition_en: A serious disagreement or struggle between people or groups. | A situation where different needs or ideas cannot agree. | To disagree with or be incompatible with something.
example1_en: Sharing a bedroom sometimes causes conflict between the brothers.
example1_ja: 共用一间卧室有时会让兄弟俩发生争执。
example2_en: Economic growth can conflict with environmental protection when industries rely heavily on fossil fuels.
example2_ja: 当工业高度依赖化石燃料时，经济增长可能与环境保护相冲突。
collocations: resolve a conflict｜解决冲突 ; conflict with｜与……相抵触 ; a conflict of interest｜利益冲突
tip_ja: 名词重音在首音节，动词重音在第二音节。

meanings_ja: adj. 准时的；守时的
definition_en: Arriving or happening at the agreed or expected time
example1_en: Please be punctual; the bus cannot wait for everyone.
example1_ja: 请准时到达，公交车不能等每一个人。
example2_en: Punctual employees help organisations operate efficiently by ensuring that meetings and daily tasks begin on time.
example2_ja: 守时的员工确保会议和日常任务按时开始，从而帮助机构高效运作。
collocations: be punctual for｜准时参加 ; a punctual arrival｜准时到达 ; punctual service｜准点服务
tip_ja: 表示准时参加会议，用be punctual for a meeting。

meanings_ja: n. 挂钩；短桩；固定钉 | n. 晾衣夹 | v. 使价格或汇率挂钩
definition_en: a small pin or post used to hang or secure things | a clip that holds clothes on a washing line | to fix a price or rate in relation to another
example1_en: Hang your wet coat on the peg by the door.
example1_ja: 把你的湿外套挂在门边的挂钩上。
example2_en: Some governments peg their currencies to a major foreign currency to reduce exchange rate uncertainty.
example2_ja: 一些政府将本国货币与某种主要外币挂钩，以降低汇率的不确定性。
collocations: tent peg｜帐篷桩 ; clothes peg｜晾衣夹 ; peg a currency to｜将货币与……挂钩
tip_ja: 动词常用peg A to B；晾衣夹在美式中叫clothespin。

meanings_ja: n. 混凝土 | adj. 具体的；确实的 | adj. 混凝土制的
definition_en: A building material made from cement, water, sand, and stones. | Specific and based on facts rather than general ideas. | Made of concrete.
example1_en: The workers poured wet concrete into the wooden frame.
example1_ja: 工人们把湿混凝土倒入木框中。
example2_en: Governments need concrete evidence before investing public money in expensive solutions to environmental problems.
example2_ja: 政府在投入公共资金采用昂贵的环境问题解决方案之前，需要确实的证据。
collocations: reinforced concrete｜钢筋混凝土 ; concrete evidence｜确实的证据 ; concrete steps｜具体措施 ; concrete example｜具体例子
tip_ja: cement是水泥，是制作concrete（混凝土）的原料之一。

meanings_ja: adj. 喜悦的；令人高兴的
definition_en: Feeling, expressing, or causing great happiness.
example1_en: We heard joyful laughter coming from the kitchen.
example1_ja: 我们听到厨房里传来欢快的笑声。
example2_en: Community festivals create joyful shared experiences that can strengthen social connections among residents of different backgrounds.
example2_ja: 社区节庆活动创造共同的欢乐体验，有助于加强不同背景居民之间的社会联系。
collocations: a joyful occasion｜喜庆的场合 ; joyful laughter｜欢快的笑声 ; a joyful reunion｜欢乐的重聚
tip_ja: 比happy更强调强烈喜悦，也可形容场合。

meanings_ja: adj. 虚拟的；通过网络进行的 | adj. 事实上的；几乎完全的
definition_en: Created by computers or experienced through an online connection. | Almost complete or effectively true, though not officially so.
example1_en: We took a virtual tour of the museum yesterday.
example1_ja: 昨天我们在线上虚拟参观了那座博物馆。
example2_en: Virtual classrooms can widen access to education, although reliable internet connections remain essential for effective participation.
example2_ja: 虚拟课堂能够扩大教育覆盖面，但可靠的网络连接仍是有效参与的必要条件。
collocations: virtual reality｜虚拟现实 ; virtual classroom｜虚拟课堂 ; virtual tour｜虚拟游览 ; a virtual monopoly｜事实上的垄断
tip_ja: virtual不只指电脑虚拟，也可表示事实上的、近乎的。

meanings_ja: n. 处理；管理；应对 | n. 搬运；用手操作 | n. 车辆操控性能
definition_en: The way someone deals with a situation, task, or person. | The act of moving, holding, or touching something. | How easily a vehicle responds to its driver's control.
example1_en: Her calm handling of the complaint impressed everyone.
example1_ja: 她冷静处理投诉的表现给大家留下了深刻印象。
example2_en: Effective handling of household waste requires cooperation between local authorities, recycling companies, and residents throughout the community.
example2_ja: 有效处理生活垃圾需要地方政府、回收企业和整个社区的居民共同合作。
collocations: handling of complaints｜投诉处理 ; safe handling｜安全操作 ; manual handling｜人工搬运 ; handling charges｜手续费
tip_ja: 表示处理方式时，常用handling of加所处理的事物。

meanings_ja: adv. 因此；由此 | adv. 从现在起；之后
definition_en: For this reason; as a result | After a stated period measured from now
example1_en: The oven broke, hence our cold dinner tonight.
example1_ja: 烤箱坏了，所以今晚我们吃冷餐。
example2_en: Urban populations are growing rapidly; hence, governments need to invest more in reliable public transport.
example2_ja: 城市人口正在迅速增长，因此政府需要加大对可靠公共交通的投入。
collocations: hence the need for｜因此需要 ; hence the importance of｜由此可见……的重要性 ; years hence｜若干年后
tip_ja: 正式用语；表示“因此”时，后面也可直接接名词短语。

meanings_ja: v. 深爱；非常喜爱
definition_en: to love someone or like something very much
example1_en: My grandparents adore spending quiet afternoons in their garden.
example1_ja: 我的祖父母非常喜欢在花园里度过宁静的下午。
example2_en: Although many visitors adore historic neighbourhoods, excessive tourism can disrupt the daily lives of residents.
example2_ja: 虽然许多游客非常喜爱历史街区，但过度旅游可能扰乱居民的日常生活。
collocations: absolutely adore｜极其喜爱 ; adore doing something｜非常喜欢做某事 ; adore someone｜深爱某人
tip_ja: 语气比like强；后接名词或动名词，不接不定式。

meanings_ja: v. 使沮丧；使懊恼 | v. 阻挠；挫败
definition_en: Make someone annoyed because they cannot achieve what they want. | Prevent a plan or effort from succeeding.
example1_en: These constant delays frustrate everyone waiting for the bus.
example1_ja: 这样一再延误，让所有等公交车的人都很烦躁。
example2_en: Complicated application procedures can frustrate small business owners who need financial support to expand their operations.
example2_ja: 繁琐的申请程序会让需要资金支持来扩大经营的小企业主感到沮丧。
collocations: frustrate efforts｜阻挠努力 ; frustrate a plan｜挫败计划 ; deeply frustrated｜极度沮丧的
tip_ja: 人感到沮丧用 frustrated；事情令人沮丧用 frustrating。

meanings_ja: n. 感染；传染病
definition_en: a condition caused by harmful organisms entering the body
example1_en: The doctor checked my sore throat for signs of infection.
example1_ja: 医生检查了我疼痛的喉咙，看是否有感染迹象。
example2_en: Improved sanitation can reduce the risk of infection, particularly in communities with limited access to clean water.
example2_ja: 改善卫生条件可以降低感染风险，尤其是在难以获得洁净水的社区。
collocations: prevent infection｜预防感染 ; risk of infection｜感染风险 ; bacterial infection｜细菌感染 ; spread of infection｜感染的传播
tip_ja: infection既可指感染过程，也可指一次具体感染。

meanings_ja: v. 合作；协作 | v. 配合；协助
definition_en: to work together to achieve a shared aim | to help by doing what someone asks
example1_en: We cooperated with our neighbours to clean the shared garden.
example1_ja: 我们和邻居一起清理了共用花园。
example2_en: Countries must cooperate on climate policy because pollution crosses borders and affects communities far from its source.
example2_ja: 各国必须在气候政策上合作，因为污染会跨越国界，影响远离污染源的社区。
collocations: cooperate with｜与……合作；配合…… ; cooperate on a project｜在项目上合作 ; cooperate closely｜密切合作
tip_ja: 不及物：与人合作用with，就某事合作用on。

meanings_ja: n. 罢工 | v. 击打；撞击 | v. 突然想到；给……印象
definition_en: a refusal to work to demand better employment conditions | hit someone or something with force | occur suddenly to someone or create a strong impression
example1_en: The drivers are on strike, so we walked home.
example1_ja: 司机们正在罢工，所以我们走路回了家。
example2_en: Workers may go on strike when negotiations over pay and working conditions fail.
example2_ja: 当有关薪酬和工作条件的谈判失败时，工人可能会举行罢工。
collocations: go on strike｜举行罢工 ; be on strike｜正在罢工 ; strike a balance｜取得平衡 ; strike someone as unusual｜让某人觉得不寻常
tip_ja: 过去式struck；过去分词通常也用struck。

meanings_ja: v. 建造；构筑 | v. 构思；组织
definition_en: to build something by putting parts or materials together | to carefully develop an argument, theory, or explanation
example1_en: Workers are constructing a wooden bridge across the stream.
example1_ja: 工人们正在小溪上建造一座木桥。
example2_en: Students should learn to construct clear arguments supported by reliable evidence rather than personal assumptions.
example2_ja: 学生应学会用可靠证据而非个人臆断来构建清晰的论证。
collocations: construct a bridge｜建造桥梁 ; construct an argument｜构建论证 ; construct a model｜建立模型
tip_ja: 动词重音在后；名词construct重音在前。

meanings_ja: n. 性别 | n. 语法性
definition_en: Being male, female, or another identity, especially socially and culturally. | A grammatical class of nouns affecting related word forms.
example1_en: The club welcomes everyone, regardless of age or gender.
example1_ja: 这个俱乐部欢迎所有人加入，不论年龄或性别。
example2_en: Policies promoting gender equality can improve access to education and expand employment opportunities across society.
example2_ja: 促进性别平等的政策可以改善受教育机会，并扩大整个社会的就业机会。
collocations: gender equality｜性别平等 ; gender roles｜性别角色 ; gender identity｜性别认同 ; gender gap｜性别差距
tip_ja: gender常侧重社会性别；sex常侧重生理性别。

meanings_ja: n. 弹力绳；蹦极绳
definition_en: A strong stretchy cord used for securing objects or bungee jumping.
example1_en: We secured the sleeping bags with a strong bungee.
example1_ja: 我们用一根结实的弹力绳固定住了睡袋。
example2_en: Adventure tourism operators must inspect every bungee cord regularly to ensure that essential safety standards are maintained.
example2_ja: 探险旅游经营者必须定期检查每根蹦极绳，以确保符合基本安全标准。
collocations: bungee cord｜弹力绳；蹦极绳 ; bungee jumping｜蹦极运动 ; a bungee jump｜一次蹦极
tip_ja: bungee主要指弹力绳；蹦极运动通常说bungee jumping。

meanings_ja: v. 缩小；缩水；减少 | v. 退缩；畏缩
definition_en: To become smaller, or make something smaller. | To move back or avoid something through fear or discomfort.
example1_en: My wool jumper shrank after I washed it badly.
example1_ja: 我的羊毛套头衫因洗涤不当而缩水了。
example2_en: As rural populations shrink, maintaining affordable public transport becomes increasingly difficult for local authorities with limited budgets.
example2_ja: 随着农村人口减少，预算有限的地方政府越来越难以维持价格合理的公共交通服务。
collocations: shrink in size｜体积缩小 ; a shrinking population｜不断减少的人口 ; shrink from responsibility｜逃避责任
tip_ja: 过去式shrank，过去分词shrunk；shrink from指退缩。

meanings_ja: n. 航天器；宇宙飞船
definition_en: A vehicle designed to travel or operate in space.
example1_en: We watched the spacecraft launch from our garden.
example1_ja: 我们在花园里观看了航天器发射。
example2_en: Unmanned spacecraft allow scientists to explore distant planets without putting human lives at risk.
example2_ja: 无人航天器让科学家能够探索遥远的行星，而不危及人的生命。
collocations: launch a spacecraft｜发射航天器 ; unmanned spacecraft｜无人航天器 ; reusable spacecraft｜可重复使用的航天器
tip_ja: 单复数同形：one spacecraft，two spacecraft。

meanings_ja: adj. 背阴的；成荫的 | adj. 可疑的；不正当的
definition_en: Protected from direct sunlight by trees or other objects. | Seeming dishonest or possibly involved in illegal activities.
example1_en: We found a shady spot beneath the old oak.
example1_ja: 我们在老橡树下找到了一处阴凉的地方。
example2_en: Planting trees along busy streets creates shady spaces that encourage walking during hot weather.
example2_ja: 在繁忙街道两旁种树可以创造阴凉空间，鼓励人们在炎热天气里步行。
collocations: shady spot｜阴凉处 ; shady dealings｜不正当交易 ; shady character｜可疑人物
tip_ja: shady指背阴或可疑；shadowy多指昏暗、模糊。

meanings_ja: n. 学士 | n. 未婚男子；单身汉
definition_en: Someone awarded a first university degree | A man who has never married
example1_en: My cousin earned a bachelor's degree in engineering.
example1_ja: 我的表哥获得了工程学学士学位。
example2_en: A bachelor's degree can improve employment prospects, although practical experience remains important in many industries.
example2_ja: 学士学位可以改善就业前景，但在许多行业中，实践经验仍然重要。
collocations: bachelor's degree｜学士学位 ; Bachelor of Arts｜文学学士 ; Bachelor of Science｜理学学士 ; eligible bachelor｜条件优越的未婚男子
tip_ja: 学士学位写作bachelor's degree，注意所有格。

meanings_ja: n. 疫苗接种
definition_en: Giving a vaccine to help protect someone against disease
example1_en: The nurse asked me to relax before my vaccination.
example1_ja: 接种疫苗前，护士让我放松。
example2_en: Accessible vaccination programmes help prevent infectious diseases and reduce pressure on public healthcare services.
example2_ja: 便捷可及的疫苗接种计划有助于预防传染病，并减轻公共医疗服务的压力。
collocations: a vaccination programme｜疫苗接种计划 ; vaccination against flu｜流感疫苗接种 ; vaccination coverage｜疫苗接种覆盖率
tip_ja: 接种以预防某病用vaccination against。

meanings_ja: n. 自卫；正当防卫
definition_en: protecting yourself from attack or physical harm
example1_en: My sister attends a self-defence class every Saturday.
example1_ja: 我姐姐每周六都上自卫术课。
example2_en: Self-defence courses can build confidence, although avoiding dangerous situations should remain the primary focus of personal safety.
example2_ja: 自卫课程能增强信心，但人身安全仍应以避免危险处境为首要重点。

meanings_ja: adj. 杰出的；出色的 | adj. 尚未处理的；未偿付的

example2_en: Suicide prevention requires accessible mental health services, supportive communities, and responsible reporting in the media.
example2_ja: 自杀预防需要便捷可及的心理健康服务、相互支持的社区以及负责任的媒体报道。
collocations: suicide prevention｜自杀预防 ; suicide risk｜自杀风险 ; die by suicide｜死于自杀
tip_ja: 中性表达常用die by suicide，避免污名化。

meanings_ja: n. 调查；查明 | n. 研究；探究

meanings_ja: adj. 令人愉快的；宜人的 | adj. 愿意同意的

example2_en: Employees may be more agreeable to organisational changes when managers explain the benefits and address their concerns.
example2_ja: 如果管理者解释好处并回应员工的顾虑，员工可能会更愿意接受组织变革。

definition_en: A reference work containing information about many subjects or one field

example2_en: An online encyclopaedia provides a useful starting point for research, but students should verify information using reliable sources.
example2_ja: 在线百科全书为研究提供了有用的起点，但学生应通过可靠来源核实信息。

meanings_ja: v. 用自己的话改述 | n. 改述；释义

collocations: paraphrase a passage｜改述一段文字 ; accurate paraphrase｜准确的改述 ; paraphrase in your own words｜用自己的话改述

collocations: form an alliance｜结成联盟 ; strategic alliance｜战略联盟 ; military alliance｜军事同盟

meanings_ja: n. 生态学 | n. 生态；生态关系

example2_en: Understanding forest ecology can help governments protect wildlife while managing natural resources more effectively.
example2_ja: 了解森林生态有助于政府在更有效地管理自然资源的同时保护野生动物。
collocations: marine ecology｜海洋生态学 ; forest ecology｜森林生态学 ; study ecology｜研究生态学

meanings_ja: adv. 到一旁；在旁边 | adv. 暂且不论；留着备用 | n. 旁白；低声插话；题外话
