meanings_ja: n. 播音员；现场广播员
definition_en: Someone who presents information on broadcasts or at public events
example1_en: The announcer reminded passengers to keep their bags nearby.
example1_ja: 广播员提醒乘客把行李放在身边。
example2_en: A skilled announcer can make emergency broadcasts clearer, helping the public respond calmly and appropriately.
example2_ja: 训练有素的播音员能让紧急广播更加清晰，帮助公众冷静、恰当地应对。
collocations: radio announcer｜电台播音员 ; television announcer｜电视播音员 ; stadium announcer｜体育场现场广播员
tip_ja: announcer负责播报；journalist侧重新闻采访。

meanings_ja: v. 弄平；变平 | v. 摧毁；夷为平地
definition_en: to make something flat or become flat | to destroy something so that it falls to the ground
example1_en: Flatten the dough gently with the palm of your hand.
example1_ja: 用手掌轻轻把面团压平。
example2_en: Developers sometimes flatten existing buildings rather than renovate them, increasing construction waste and destroying local heritage.
example2_ja: 开发商有时会拆平现有建筑而非翻修，增加建筑垃圾并破坏当地遗产。
collocations: flatten the dough｜压平面团 ; flatten a building｜夷平建筑 ; flatten out｜趋于平稳
tip_ja: flatten out也可指价格、曲线等趋于平稳。

meanings_ja: n. 发票；付款清单 | v. 向……开具发票
definition_en: a document listing goods or services and the payment required | to send someone a document requesting payment for goods or services
example1_en: The plumber emailed an invoice after fixing our sink.
example1_ja: 水管工修好我们的水槽后，通过电子邮件发来了付款清单。
example2_en: Small businesses benefit from digital systems that track each invoice and remind customers when payments are due.
example2_ja: 小企业可以从追踪每张发票并提醒客户按时付款的数字系统中受益。
collocations: issue an invoice｜开具发票 ; pay an invoice｜支付发票款项 ; an outstanding invoice｜尚未结清的发票 ; invoice someone for something｜就某项费用向某人开票
tip_ja: invoice 通常用于要求付款；receipt 是已付款的收据。

meanings_ja: n. 奖学金 | n. 学术研究；学问
definition_en: Money awarded to help someone pay for their studies. | Serious academic study or the knowledge gained through it.
example1_en: A scholarship helped Ravi pay for his university course.
example1_ja: 一笔奖学金帮助拉维支付了大学课程的费用。
example2_en: Universities should offer more scholarships to talented applicants from families with limited financial resources.
example2_ja: 大学应为经济条件有限的家庭中有才华的申请者提供更多奖学金。
collocations: win a scholarship｜获得奖学金 ; full scholarship｜全额奖学金 ; academic scholarship｜学术研究
tip_ja: 指奖学金时可数；指学问或学术研究时不可数。

meanings_ja: n. 大众传播媒介；媒体
definition_en: Organisations and channels that provide news and information publicly.
example1_en: The local media reported on our neighbourhood festival.
example1_ja: 当地媒体报道了我们社区的节日活动。
example2_en: The media can influence public attitudes by deciding which environmental issues receive the most attention.
example2_ja: 媒体可以通过决定重点关注哪些环境问题来影响公众态度。
collocations: mass media｜大众传媒 ; media coverage｜媒体报道 ; social media｜社交媒体 ; the media｜新闻媒体
tip_ja: 统称新闻媒体常用the media；单一媒介用medium。

meanings_ja: n. 指挥官
definition_en: an officer responsible for directing a military unit or operation
example1_en: The commander asked the crew to check their equipment.
example1_ja: 指挥官要求队员检查装备。
example2_en: During disaster relief operations, the military commander coordinated transport to deliver essential supplies to isolated communities.
example2_ja: 在救灾行动中，军事指挥官协调运输，向与外界隔绝的社区运送必需物资。
collocations: military commander｜军事指挥官 ; naval commander｜海军指挥官 ; commander-in-chief｜总司令
tip_ja: 泛指指挥官；作具体军衔时，级别因国家而异。

meanings_ja: n. 狂怒；暴怒 | n. 猛烈；狂暴
definition_en: An extremely strong feeling of anger. | Extreme force or violence, especially in weather.
example1_en: He shook with fury when he discovered the damage.
example1_ja: 发现东西遭到损坏时，他气得浑身发抖。
example2_en: The sudden closure of the local hospital provoked fury among residents who depended on its services.
example2_ja: 当地医院突然关闭，激起了依赖其服务的居民的强烈愤怒。
collocations: shake with fury｜气得发抖 ; provoke fury｜激起暴怒 ; the fury of the storm｜风暴的猛烈
tip_ja: 比anger语气强；in a fury表示“勃然大怒”。

meanings_ja: adj. 便携式的；轻便的
definition_en: Easy to carry or move from place to place
example1_en: We took a portable speaker to the picnic.
example1_ja: 我们带了一个便携式音箱去野餐。
example2_en: Portable medical equipment enables healthcare workers to provide essential services in remote rural communities.
example2_ja: 便携式医疗设备使医护人员能够在偏远农村社区提供基本服务。
collocations: portable device｜便携设备 ; portable charger｜便携式充电器 ; portable equipment｜便携式设备
tip_ja: 强调容易携带或移动，不一定能放进口袋。

meanings_ja: n. 君主统治时期 | v. 当政；统治 | v. 盛行；占主导地位
definition_en: the period when a king or queen rules | to rule as a king or queen | to be the strongest or most noticeable condition
example1_en: This castle was built during a young queen's reign.
example1_ja: 这座城堡建于一位年轻女王在位期间。
example2_en: During the king's reign, investment in public libraries made education more accessible to ordinary citizens.
example2_ja: 在这位国王统治期间，对公共图书馆的投入让普通民众更容易获得教育。
collocations: during the reign of｜在……统治期间 ; a long reign｜漫长的统治时期 ; reign supreme｜占绝对优势 ; chaos reigns｜混乱笼罩
tip_ja: 与rain同音；reign指统治，rein指缰绳。

meanings_ja: n. 淤青；挫伤 | v. 使淤青；碰伤
definition_en: A dark mark caused by bleeding under the skin. | To injure skin or fruit without breaking its surface.
example1_en: I have a purple bruise on my knee.
example1_ja: 我的膝盖上有一块紫色的淤青。
example2_en: Soft fruit can bruise during transport, so producers need packaging that provides adequate protection.
example2_ja: 软质水果在运输中容易碰伤，因此生产者需要使用能提供充分保护的包装。
collocations: a nasty bruise｜严重的淤青 ; bruise easily｜容易淤青 ; a bruised knee｜淤青的膝盖
tip_ja: bruise通常不破皮；cut指割破皮肤的伤口。

meanings_ja: n. 使情况复杂的因素；难题 | n. 并发症
definition_en: An extra problem that makes a situation harder to manage | An additional medical problem arising during an illness or treatment
example1_en: A delayed train added another complication to our journey.
example1_ja: 火车晚点又给我们的旅程添了一个麻烦。
example2_en: Regular medical checkups can help detect complications early and improve outcomes for patients with chronic conditions.
example2_ja: 定期体检有助于及早发现并发症，并改善慢性病患者的治疗效果。
collocations: an unexpected complication｜意外的麻烦 ; a serious complication｜严重并发症 ; avoid complications｜避免麻烦或并发症 ; postoperative complications｜术后并发症
tip_ja: 可指数额外难题，也可指疾病或治疗引起的并发症。

meanings_ja: n. 动物的爪；脚掌 | v. 用爪抓挠；用蹄刨
definition_en: the foot of an animal such as a cat or dog | to scratch or touch something repeatedly with a paw or hoof
example1_en: The puppy rested one muddy paw on my knee.
example1_ja: 小狗把一只沾满泥的爪子搭在我的膝盖上。
example2_en: Urban wildlife may suffer paw injuries from broken glass and other waste left in public spaces.
example2_ja: 城市野生动物可能因公共场所遗留的碎玻璃和其他垃圾而导致脚掌受伤。
collocations: front paw｜前爪 ; paw print｜爪印 ; paw at the door｜用爪子挠门
tip_ja: paw指整个脚掌；claw指尖锐的爪或爪甲。

meanings_ja: v. 戳；捅 | v. 伸出；探出 | n. 戳；捅
definition_en: to push a finger or pointed object into something | to move or stick out through an opening | a quick push with a finger or pointed object
example1_en: She poked the dough gently to check its softness.
example1_ja: 她轻轻戳了戳面团，检查它是否柔软。
example2_en: Museum visitors can poke virtual objects on interactive screens to explore scientific concepts through play.
example2_ja: 博物馆游客可以戳点互动屏幕上的虚拟物体，在玩乐中探索科学概念。
collocations: poke a hole in｜在……上戳洞 ; poke your head out｜探出头 ; poke fun at｜取笑
tip_ja: poke fun at是“取笑”，不是“戳”。

meanings_ja: v. 拆下；使分离 | v. 使超然；使摆脱影响
definition_en: to remove or separate something from what it is attached to | to separate yourself emotionally from a situation or experience
example1_en: You can detach the hood when the rain stops.
example1_ja: 雨停后，你可以把帽兜拆下来。
example2_en: Researchers must detach themselves from personal preferences when evaluating evidence to ensure that their conclusions remain reliable.
example2_ja: 研究人员评估证据时必须摆脱个人偏好的影响，以确保结论可靠。
collocations: detach from｜从……分离 ; detach the cable｜拔下连接线 ; detach yourself from｜使自己超脱于
tip_ja: 常用 detach A from B；detachable 指可拆卸的。

meanings_ja: n. 接力赛 | v. 转达；转播 | n. 继电器
definition_en: a race in which teammates take turns completing sections | to pass information or broadcast signals to another person or place | an electrical switch controlled by another electrical circuit
example1_en: Our team dropped the baton during the school relay.
example1_ja: 我们队在学校接力赛中掉了接力棒。
example2_en: Emergency services relay weather warnings to remote communities through local radio stations and mobile networks.
example2_ja: 应急部门通过地方广播电台和移动网络向偏远社区传达天气警报。
collocations: relay race｜接力赛 ; relay a message｜传达信息 ; relay information｜转达信息 ; electrical relay｜继电器
tip_ja: 动词也读/rɪˈleɪ/；relay a message指转达消息。

meanings_ja: n. 基因
definition_en: A unit of inherited information that influences an organism's characteristics
example1_en: This gene can influence the colour of a cat's fur.
example1_ja: 这种基因会影响猫的毛色。
example2_en: Identifying a gene linked to an inherited disease may help researchers develop more effective treatments.
example2_ja: 识别出与某种遗传病相关的基因，可能有助于研究人员开发更有效的治疗方法。
collocations: gene expression｜基因表达 ; gene therapy｜基因治疗 ; inherit a gene｜遗传某个基因
tip_ja: gene是可数名词；genetics指遗传学。

meanings_ja: v. 盯着看；凝视 | n. 凝视；注视
definition_en: to look at someone or something steadily for a while | a long, fixed look at someone or something
example1_en: The cat stared at a bird outside the window.
example1_ja: 猫盯着窗外的一只鸟。
example2_en: Children who stare at screens for long periods may have fewer opportunities for physical activity.
example2_ja: 长时间盯着屏幕的儿童可能较少有机会进行身体活动。
collocations: stare at｜盯着看 ; stare into space｜出神地望着 ; a blank stare｜茫然的目光
tip_ja: stare at强调长时间盯看；glance at指瞥一眼。

meanings_ja: n. 人类
definition_en: all human beings considered as one group
example1_en: This museum explores how mankind learned to grow food.
example1_ja: 这座博物馆展示人类如何学会种植粮食。
example2_en: Climate change presents a challenge to mankind that requires sustained cooperation across national borders.
example2_ja: 气候变化给人类带来了挑战，需要各国持续开展跨境合作。
collocations: the future of mankind｜人类的未来 ; the history of mankind｜人类历史 ; for the benefit of mankind｜为了人类的福祉
tip_ja: 指全人类，不指男性；包容性表达可用humankind。

meanings_ja: adj. 优雅的；姿态优美的
definition_en: Moving or shaped in a smooth, attractive way.
example1_en: The swan made a graceful turn across the pond.
example1_ja: 天鹅在池塘水面上优雅地转了个弯。
example2_en: The bridge combines graceful curves with practical engineering, creating an attractive landmark for the city.
example2_ja: 这座桥将优美的曲线与实用的工程设计结合起来，成为城市一道亮丽的地标。
collocations: graceful movements｜优雅的动作 ; graceful curves｜优美的曲线 ; a graceful dancer｜舞姿优美的舞者
tip_ja: graceful多形容姿态优美；gracious多指亲切有礼。

meanings_ja: adv. 仔细地；严密地 | adv. 紧密地；密切地 | adv. 近距离地
definition_en: with careful attention to details or changes | with a strong connection or much cooperation | with little space between people or things
example1_en: Look closely at this leaf and notice its tiny veins.
example1_ja: 仔细看看这片叶子，留意它细小的叶脉。
example2_en: Governments should closely monitor air quality near schools to protect children from the harmful effects of pollution.
example2_ja: 政府应密切监测学校附近的空气质量，保护儿童免受污染的危害。
collocations: closely monitor｜密切监测 ; closely related｜密切相关的 ; work closely with｜与……密切合作 ; look closely｜仔细看
tip_ja: look closely指仔细看；stand close指站得近。

meanings_ja: n. 公式 | n. 方法；配方 | n. 婴儿配方奶
definition_en: a mathematical rule expressed using symbols | a particular method or mixture used to achieve something | specially prepared milk used to feed babies
example1_en: Our teacher showed us a formula for calculating area.
example1_ja: 老师给我们讲解了一个计算面积的公式。
example2_en: There is no single formula for reducing urban poverty, since local economic conditions vary considerably.
example2_ja: 减少城市贫困没有统一的方法，因为各地经济状况差异很大。
collocations: mathematical formula｜数学公式 ; formula for success｜成功之道 ; infant formula｜婴儿配方奶
tip_ja: 复数可用formulas或formulae；方法常接for。

meanings_ja: adj. 不合理的；不讲理的 | adj. 过分的；过高的
definition_en: Not fair, sensible, or willing to accept good reasons. | Greater than is fair or acceptable.
example1_en: It seems unreasonable to blame you for the weather.
example1_ja: 因为天气不好而责怪你，似乎很不讲理。
example2_en: Expecting employees to answer messages throughout their holidays places unreasonable demands on their time and harms wellbeing.
example2_ja: 要求员工整个假期都回复消息，是对其时间的过分索取，也会损害身心健康。
collocations: unreasonable demands｜过分的要求 ; unreasonable behaviour｜不讲理的行为 ; unreasonable expectations｜不合理的期望
tip_ja: 可形容人不讲理，也可形容要求或价格过分。

meanings_ja: n. 磨坊；磨粉机 | n. 工厂；制造厂 | v. 碾磨；磨成粉
definition_en: a building or machine where grain is ground into flour | a factory that processes materials such as paper or steel | to crush grain or other material into small particles
example1_en: We watched wheat being ground at the old mill.
example1_ja: 我们在那座老磨坊看了小麦磨粉的过程。
example2_en: Converting abandoned textile mills into housing can preserve industrial heritage while meeting demand for urban accommodation.
example2_ja: 将废弃纺织厂改建为住房，可以在满足城市居住需求的同时保护工业遗产。
collocations: flour mill｜面粉厂；磨坊 ; steel mill｜钢铁厂 ; paper mill｜造纸厂 ; mill grain｜碾磨谷物
tip_ja: mill多指加工原料的工厂；普通工厂常用factory。

meanings_ja: adj. 压倒性的；极大的 | adj. 令人难以承受的
definition_en: So great or strong that little can oppose it | Too intense or difficult to deal with
example1_en: The proposal received overwhelming support from our neighbours.
example1_ja: 这项提议获得了邻居们的压倒性支持。
example2_en: An overwhelming majority of residents support investment in reliable public transport rather than wider roads.
example2_ja: 绝大多数居民支持投资建设可靠的公共交通，而不是拓宽道路。
collocations: overwhelming majority｜绝大多数 ; overwhelming evidence｜确凿有力的证据 ; overwhelming support｜压倒性的支持 ; overwhelming pressure｜难以承受的压力
tip_ja: 强调程度极大；既可形容支持，也可形容压力。

meanings_ja: n. 部长；大臣 | n. 牧师 | v. 照料；帮助
definition_en: A senior government official responsible for a particular area. | A religious leader in certain Christian churches. | To care for someone or attend to their needs.
example1_en: The minister visited our school to meet the teachers.
example1_ja: 部长来到我们学校与教师们见面。
example2_en: Trained volunteers minister to the needs of older residents who lack access to regular medical care.
example2_ja: 受过培训的志愿者照料无法定期获得医疗服务的老年居民。
collocations: education minister｜教育部长 ; prime minister｜首相；总理 ; a church minister｜教会牧师 ; minister to someone's needs｜照顾某人的需要
tip_ja: 动词义较正式，常用minister to表示照料。

meanings_ja: adj. 有效的；正式认可的 | adj. 有根据的；合理的
definition_en: officially acceptable and able to be used | based on sound reasons or evidence
example1_en: Your ticket is still valid for the return journey.
example1_ja: 你的票在返程时仍然有效。
example2_en: Although online learning offers flexibility, students have valid concerns about limited interaction with their teachers.
example2_ja: 虽然在线学习灵活方便，但学生对师生互动不足的担忧是合理的。
collocations: valid ticket｜有效票据 ; valid reason｜正当理由 ; valid for｜有效期为；适用于 ; valid concern｜合理的担忧
tip_ja: valid for可接有效时长；valid until接到期时间。

meanings_ja: v. 正式禁止 | v. 阻止；使不可能
definition_en: To officially forbid an action through rules or laws. | To prevent something by making it impossible or impractical.
example1_en: The pool rules prohibit running on the wet floor.
example1_ja: 泳池规定禁止在湿滑的地面上奔跑。
example2_en: Governments should prohibit the dumping of untreated industrial waste into rivers to protect public health.
example2_ja: 政府应禁止将未经处理的工业废物倾倒入河，以保护公众健康。
collocations: strictly prohibit｜严格禁止 ; prohibit someone from doing something｜禁止某人做某事 ; prohibit the use of｜禁止使用
tip_ja: 用prohibit doing或prohibit sb from doing。

meanings_ja: n. 水母
definition_en: a soft sea animal with hanging tentacles that can sting
example1_en: A translucent jellyfish drifted past our boat this morning.
example1_ja: 今天早上，一只半透明的水母从我们船边漂过。
example2_en: Rising ocean temperatures may encourage jellyfish populations to grow, potentially disrupting marine ecosystems and coastal tourism.
example2_ja: 海洋温度上升可能促使水母数量增加，进而扰乱海洋生态系统并影响沿海旅游业。
collocations: a jellyfish sting｜水母蜇伤 ; a swarm of jellyfish｜一大群水母 ; jellyfish populations｜水母种群
tip_ja: 复数通常仍用 jellyfish；它不是鱼类。

meanings_ja: n. 奇迹；不可思议的事
definition_en: An extraordinary event that seems impossible or beyond natural explanation.
example1_en: It was a miracle that the vase survived.
example1_ja: 那个花瓶竟然没碎，真是个奇迹。
example2_en: Although new technology can appear to work miracles, lasting environmental progress also requires changes in public behaviour.
example2_ja: 虽然新技术似乎能创造奇迹，但持久的环境改善也需要公众行为的改变。
collocations: work miracles｜创造奇迹 ; a medical miracle｜医学奇迹 ; a miracle cure｜神奇疗法
tip_ja: work miracles指创造奇迹，也可夸张表示效果惊人。

meanings_ja: v. 建立；创立 | v. 确立；使获认可 | v. 查明；证实
definition_en: to start an organisation, system, or lasting arrangement | to make a position or reputation widely accepted | to discover or prove that something is true
example1_en: Our neighbours established a gardening club last spring.
example1_ja: 我们的邻居去年春天成立了一个园艺俱乐部。
example2_en: Governments should establish clear standards to ensure that new housing is both safe and energy efficient.
example2_ja: 政府应制定明确的标准，确保新建住房既安全又节能。
collocations: establish a business｜创办企业 ; establish a reputation｜树立声誉 ; establish the facts｜查明事实 ; establish a link｜确立联系
tip_ja: establish是及物动词，后接机构、制度或事实等。

meanings_ja: n. 标准；准则（复数）
definition_en: Standards used to judge something or make a decision.
example1_en: This flat meets all our criteria for a home.
example1_ja: 这套公寓符合我们对住房的所有要求。
example2_en: Scholarships should be awarded according to clear criteria that consider both academic achievement and financial need.
example2_ja: 奖学金应依据明确的标准颁发，同时考虑学业成绩和经济需求。
collocations: meet the criteria｜符合标准 ; selection criteria｜筛选标准 ; assessment criteria｜评估标准
tip_ja: criteria是复数，单数为criterion；用criteria are。

meanings_ja: v. 交流；互动 | v. 相互作用；相互影响
definition_en: To communicate or do things with other people. | To affect one another when combined or brought together.
example1_en: Our neighbours often interact while their children play outside.
example1_ja: 孩子们在外面玩耍时，我们的邻居常常互相交流。
example2_en: Group projects encourage students to interact with classmates whose experiences and perspectives differ from their own.
example2_ja: 小组项目鼓励学生与经历和观点不同于自己的同学互动。
collocations: interact with｜与……互动 ; interact socially｜进行社交互动 ; interact with each other｜相互交流

meanings_ja: adj. 迷信的
definition_en: believing certain actions or objects bring good or bad luck

example1_ja: 我那迷信的表亲总是带着一块幸运石。
example2_en: Superstitious beliefs may influence financial decisions when people rely on lucky objects rather than reliable evidence.
example2_ja: 当人们依赖幸运物而非可靠证据时，迷信观念可能影响财务决策。
collocations: superstitious beliefs｜迷信观念 ; superstitious about｜对……迷信 ; superstitious practices｜迷信做法
tip_ja: 常用be superstitious about表示对某事迷信。

meanings_ja: n. 国会；议会 | n. 代表大会；专题会议
definition_en: A national body of representatives that makes laws. | A large formal meeting of representatives or specialists.
example1_en: The congress debated the new law late into the night.
example1_ja: 国会就这项新法律辩论到深夜。
example2_en: Delegates at the international congress discussed practical ways to improve access to healthcare in rural communities.
example2_ja: 国际大会的代表们讨论了改善农村社区医疗可及性的切实办法。
collocations: a national congress｜全国代表大会 ; an international congress｜国际大会 ; a member of Congress｜国会议员
tip_ja: 特指美国等国家的国会时，通常大写Congress。

meanings_ja: n. 恐慌；惊慌 | v. 惊慌失措；使恐慌
definition_en: sudden strong fear that makes clear thinking difficult | to feel or cause sudden fear and lose calm
example1_en: I felt a moment of panic when my keys disappeared.
example1_ja: 发现钥匙不见时，我一时惊慌起来。
example2_en: Clear communication during emergencies can reduce public panic and help people follow safety instructions more effectively.
example2_ja: 紧急情况下清晰的沟通能减少公众恐慌，帮助人们更有效地遵循安全指示。
collocations: in a panic｜惊慌失措地 ; panic attack｜惊恐发作 ; cause panic｜引发恐慌 ; panic buying｜恐慌性抢购
tip_ja: 过去式panicked、进行式panicking均须在c后加k。

meanings_ja: n. 水泥 | v. 巩固；加强
definition_en: Powder mixed with water to bind building materials together. | To make a relationship or agreement stronger.
example1_en: The builder mixed cement and water in a bucket.
example1_ja: 建筑工人在桶里搅拌水泥和水。
example2_en: Joint research projects can cement relationships between universities and encourage the exchange of scientific knowledge.
example2_ja: 联合研究项目可以巩固大学之间的关系，并促进科学知识的交流。
collocations: a bag of cement｜一袋水泥 ; mix cement｜搅拌水泥 ; cement a relationship｜巩固关系
tip_ja: cement是水泥；concrete是含水泥、砂石的混凝土。

meanings_ja: adj. 严重的；剧烈的 | adj. 严厉的；苛刻的
definition_en: Very bad, intense, or damaging. | Very strict or harsh in treatment or judgment.
example1_en: Severe storms knocked down several trees near our house.
example1_ja: 猛烈的暴风雨刮倒了我们家附近的几棵树。
example2_en: Severe water shortages can undermine agricultural production, forcing governments to invest in more efficient irrigation systems.
example2_ja: 严重缺水会削弱农业生产，迫使政府投资建设效率更高的灌溉系统。
collocations: severe pain｜剧痛 ; severe weather｜恶劣天气 ; a severe shortage｜严重短缺 ; severe punishment｜严厉惩罚
tip_ja: 可修饰疼痛、天气、短缺或惩罚，表示程度重。

meanings_ja: n. 功能；作用 | v. 运转；发挥作用 | n. 函数
definition_en: The purpose or job of something or someone. | To work or operate in the intended way. | A mathematical relationship assigning each input exactly one output.
example1_en: What is the function of this small red button?
example1_ja: 这个红色小按钮有什么作用？
example2_en: Urban parks serve an important function by providing space for exercise, relaxation, and social interaction.
example2_ja: 城市公园提供运动、休闲和社交的空间，发挥着重要作用。
collocations: perform a function｜发挥作用 ; function properly｜正常运转 ; function as｜起……作用 ; basic function｜基本功能
tip_ja: function as后接名词，表示起……作用。

meanings_ja: adv. 想必；据推测
definition_en: Probably true, based on what is known or reasonably expected.
example1_en: Her coat is gone, so presumably she has left.
example1_ja: 她的外套不见了，想必她已经离开了。
example2_en: More frequent bus services would presumably encourage commuters to leave their cars at home, reducing urban traffic.
example2_ja: 更频繁的公交班次想必会鼓励通勤者不开车出门，从而缓解城市交通拥堵。
collocations: presumably because｜大概是因为 ; presumably intended to｜想必是为了 ; presumably true｜据推测属实
tip_ja: 表示有依据的推测，不等于certainly的确定语气。

meanings_ja: n. 协调；配合 | n. 身体协调能力
definition_en: Organising people or activities so they work effectively together | The ability to move different body parts smoothly together
example1_en: Moving this sofa upstairs will take some coordination.
example1_ja: 把这张沙发搬上楼需要大家配合一下。
example2_en: Effective coordination between schools and health services can improve support for children with additional needs.
example2_ja: 学校与医疗卫生服务机构之间的有效协调，能改善对有额外需求儿童的支持。
collocations: close coordination｜密切协调 ; coordination between departments｜部门之间的协调 ; hand-eye coordination｜手眼协调能力
tip_ja: 通常不可数；between引出需要协调的双方或多方。

meanings_ja: v. 使感染；传染 | v. 感染；影响情绪
definition_en: to cause a person or organism to develop an infection | to spread a feeling or attitude to others
example1_en: One sick rabbit can infect the others in its cage.
example1_ja: 一只生病的兔子可能传染同笼的其他兔子。
example2_en: Viruses can infect vulnerable patients more easily when hospitals lack effective hygiene measures and adequate ventilation.
example2_ja: 如果医院缺乏有效的卫生措施和充分的通风，病毒就更容易感染身体脆弱的患者。
collocations: infect someone with a virus｜使某人感染病毒 ; become infected｜受到感染 ; infect a wound｜使伤口感染
tip_ja: 常用infect someone with a virus，表示使某人感染病毒。

meanings_ja: n. 线；细线 | n. 思路；讨论串 | v. 穿线；穿过
definition_en: a long, thin fibre used for sewing | a connected sequence of ideas or online messages | to pass thread or another thin object through an opening
example1_en: I need some blue thread to mend this shirt.
example1_ja: 我需要一些蓝线来补这件衬衫。
example2_en: Clear transitions help readers follow the thread of an argument in a complex academic essay.
example2_ja: 清晰的过渡能帮助读者理解复杂学术文章中的论证思路。
collocations: sewing thread｜缝纫线 ; thread a needle｜穿针 ; lose the thread｜跟不上思路 ; discussion thread｜讨论串
tip_ja: lose the thread指跟不上谈话或文章的思路。

meanings_ja: adj. 深爱的；深受喜爱的 | n. 心爱的人
definition_en: deeply loved by someone or many people | a person whom someone loves deeply
example1_en: He carefully repaired his daughter's beloved wooden toy.
example1_ja: 他小心地修好了女儿心爱的木玩具。
example2_en: Public libraries remain beloved community spaces because they offer opportunities for learning and social connection.
example2_ja: 公共图书馆依然是深受喜爱的社区空间，因为它们提供学习和社交的机会。
collocations: a beloved friend｜挚爱的朋友 ; a beloved pet｜心爱的宠物 ; a beloved institution｜深受喜爱的机构
tip_ja: 通常作形容词；作名词指爱人，语气较文学化。

meanings_ja: n. 木工活；木工技艺
definition_en: The work or skill of making and repairing wooden structures.
example1_en: I learned basic carpentry by building a small bookshelf.
example1_ja: 我通过制作一个小书架学会了基础木工技艺。
example2_en: Schools that offer carpentry courses can help students develop practical skills and explore careers in construction.
example2_ja: 开设木工课程的学校可以帮助学生培养实用技能，并探索建筑行业的职业方向。
collocations: carpentry skills｜木工技能 ; carpentry workshop｜木工车间 ; basic carpentry｜基础木工 ; carpentry tools｜木工工具
tip_ja: carpentry指技艺或工作；carpenter指木匠。

meanings_ja: adj. 不切实际的；不可行的 | adj. 不善处理实际事务的
definition_en: Unlikely to work well or be useful in practice | Not skilled at handling everyday practical tasks
example1_en: These white shoes are impractical for a muddy walk.
example1_ja: 穿这双白鞋走泥泞的路不太实用。
example2_en: Building underground railways may be impractical in smaller cities because construction costs often exceed available budgets.
example2_ja: 在较小的城市修建地铁可能不可行，因为建设成本往往超过可用预算。
collocations: an impractical solution｜不切实际的解决办法 ; highly impractical｜极不实用的 ; impractical for everyday use｜不适合日常使用
tip_ja: 是形容词，不是动词；不实用不一定是不可能。

meanings_ja: adj. 机械的；机器的 | adj. 机械呆板的；无意识的
definition_en: relating to machines or their moving parts | done without thought, interest, or feeling
example1_en: A mechanical fault stopped our car outside the village.
example1_ja: 一处机械故障让我们的车停在了村外。
example2_en: Regular inspections can identify mechanical problems before they cause serious disruptions to public transport services.
example2_ja: 定期检查可以在机械问题严重影响公共交通服务之前将其发现。
collocations: mechanical engineering｜机械工程 ; mechanical failure｜机械故障 ; mechanical parts｜机械零件 ; a mechanical response｜机械式的回应
tip_ja: mechanical指机器相关；mechanic指机械修理工。

meanings_ja: n. 化合物 | n. 围墙内的场地或建筑群 | v. 加重；使恶化
definition_en: A substance formed from chemically joined elements. | An enclosed area containing buildings. | To make an existing problem or difficulty worse.
example1_en: Water is a compound made from hydrogen and oxygen.
example1_ja: 水是由氢和氧组成的化合物。
example2_en: Poor public transport can compound the difficulties faced by people seeking employment in rural areas.
example2_ja: 公共交通不便会加重农村地区求职者面临的困难。
collocations: chemical compound｜化合物 ; compound a problem｜使问题恶化 ; residential compound｜住宅院区 ; compound interest｜复利
tip_ja: 名词重音在首音节；动词重音在第二音节。

meanings_ja: v. 绑架；劫持
definition_en: To take someone away illegally and hold them captive
example1_en: In the film, criminals kidnap a wealthy businessman.
example1_ja: 电影中，犯罪分子绑架了一位富商。
example2_en: International cooperation helps police investigate criminal groups that kidnap people and demand money for their release.
example2_ja: 国际合作有助于警方调查绑架他人并索要赎金的犯罪团伙。
collocations: kidnap someone for ransom｜绑架某人索取赎金 ; a kidnapping victim｜绑架受害者 ; a kidnapping attempt｜绑架企图
tip_ja: 不限于儿童；常用过去式kidnapped，分词kidnapping。

meanings_ja: n. 庭院；院子；天井

example1_ja: 我们在庭院的喷泉旁吃了早餐。
example2_en: Traditional houses with a central courtyard can provide natural ventilation while offering residents a private outdoor space.
example2_ja: 带有中央庭院的传统住宅既能自然通风，又能为住户提供私密的户外空间。
collocations: central courtyard｜中央庭院 ; enclosed courtyard｜围合式庭院 ; courtyard garden｜庭院花园
tip_ja: 强调由建筑或墙围合的露天空间，不等同于花园。

meanings_ja: adj. 语法的 | adj. 符合语法的

example2_ja: 尽管语法准确性对语言学习很重要，学生也需要通过对话建立自信的机会。
collocations: grammatical accuracy｜语法准确性 ; grammatical errors｜语法错误 ; grammatical structure｜语法结构
tip_ja: 可指“语法方面的”，也可指句子“符合语法的”。

meanings_ja: v. 碰撞；相撞 | v. 冲突；抵触

example1_ja: 两辆购物车在繁忙的超市入口附近撞到了一起。

example2_ja: 政府考虑批准大型基础设施项目时，经济目标往往与环保重点发生冲突。
collocations: collide with｜与……相撞；冲突 ; collide head-on｜迎头相撞 ; colliding interests｜相互冲突的利益
tip_ja: 通常是不及物动词；与某物相撞用with。

meanings_ja: n. 商品；货品 | v. 推销；促销
definition_en: goods available for sale | to promote goods and encourage people to buy them
example1_en: The shop displays its new merchandise near the entrance.
example1_ja: 这家店在入口附近陈列新商品。
example2_en: Selling locally produced merchandise can support small businesses and reduce the environmental impact of transport.
example2_ja: 销售本地生产的商品可以扶持小企业，并减少运输对环境的影响。
collocations: sell merchandise｜销售商品 ; branded merchandise｜品牌商品 ; display merchandise｜陈列商品
tip_ja: 名词不可数；动词词尾常读作/daɪz/。

meanings_ja: adj. 可食用的
definition_en: Safe or suitable to eat.
example1_en: These edible flowers make the salad look especially colourful.
example1_ja: 这些可食用的花让沙拉显得格外缤纷。
example2_en: Redistributing edible food that shops would otherwise discard could reduce waste and support families on low incomes.
example2_ja: 将商店原本会丢弃的可食用食物重新分配，可以减少浪费并帮助低收入家庭。
collocations: edible plants｜可食用植物 ; edible flowers｜可食用花卉 ; edible oil｜食用油
tip_ja: edible表示能吃，不表示美味；勿凭外观判断野生植物。

meanings_ja: v. 扰乱；使中断
definition_en: Prevent an activity or system from continuing normally.
example1_en: Heavy snow could disrupt our train journey tomorrow.
example1_ja: 大雪可能会影响我们明天的火车行程。
example2_en: Frequent power cuts disrupt online learning, particularly in rural communities where reliable internet access is already limited.
example2_ja: 频繁停电扰乱了在线学习，在本就缺乏可靠网络的农村社区尤其如此。
collocations: disrupt traffic｜扰乱交通 ; disrupt services｜使服务中断 ; disrupt sleep｜干扰睡眠 ; disrupt learning｜扰乱学习
tip_ja: 及物动词，直接接活动或系统；不是形容词。

meanings_ja: n. 例子；事例；情况
definition_en: A particular example or occurrence of something.

example1_ja: 有些水果适合冷冻，比如浆果就能保留风味。
example2_en: This project provides an instance of successful cooperation between local businesses and environmental research groups.
example2_ja: 这个项目提供了当地企业与环境研究团体成功合作的实例。
collocations: for instance｜例如 ; in this instance｜在这种情况下 ; an isolated instance｜个别事例
tip_ja: for instance意为“例如”，作用类似for example。

meanings_ja: adj. 受威胁的；濒危的 | adj. 感到受威胁的
definition_en: At risk of harm, loss, or extinction. | Feeling that someone or something may cause harm or loss.
example1_en: The rescue centre cares for several threatened bird species.
example1_ja: 这家救助中心照料着几种受威胁的鸟类。
example2_en: Protecting threatened species requires governments to preserve natural habitats and address the underlying causes of biodiversity loss.
example2_ja: 保护受威胁物种需要政府保全天然栖息地，并解决生物多样性丧失的根本原因。
collocations: threatened species｜受威胁物种 ; feel threatened｜感到受威胁 ; threatened with extinction｜面临灭绝威胁
tip_ja: threatened指受到威胁；threatening指构成威胁。

meanings_ja: v. 嚎叫；呼啸 | n. 嚎叫声；怒吼声
definition_en: Make a long, loud cry or a similar rushing sound. | A long, loud cry expressing pain, anger, or another strong feeling.
example1_en: Our dog howled when the ambulance passed the house.
example1_ja: 救护车经过家门时，我们的狗嚎叫起来。
example2_en: Residents complained that wind howled through poorly insulated windows, making their homes uncomfortable during winter.
example2_ja: 居民抱怨寒风从隔热不良的窗户灌入并发出呼啸声，导致冬天家里很不舒适。
collocations: howl at the moon｜对月长嚎 ; howl with laughter｜放声大笑 ; howls of protest｜愤怒的抗议声 ; the wind howls｜风呼啸
tip_ja: 既用于动物长嚎，也用于风声或人的强烈反应。

meanings_ja: adj. 令人满意的；合格的

example1_en: The mechanic confirmed that the brakes were satisfactory.
example1_ja: 修理工确认刹车状况合格。
example2_en: Providing satisfactory public transport is essential if cities want residents to rely less on private cars.
example2_ja: 城市若希望居民减少对私家车的依赖，就必须提供令人满意的公共交通服务。
collocations: satisfactory results｜令人满意的结果 ; satisfactory explanation｜令人满意的解释 ; satisfactory progress｜符合预期的进展
tip_ja: 强调达到要求，不一定出色；人的满意感用satisfied。

meanings_ja: adj. 主要的；首要的 | adj. 首席的；最高级别的 | n. 首领；负责人
definition_en: Most important among several things. | Having the highest rank in an organisation or profession. | The person who leads a group or organisation.
example1_en: My chief concern is getting everyone home safely.
example1_ja: 我最关心的是让大家安全到家。
example2_en: The chief advantage of public transport is its ability to move large crowds while using less road space.
example2_ja: 公共交通的主要优势在于能用较少的道路空间运送大量乘客。
collocations: chief concern｜首要关切 ; chief executive｜首席执行官 ; chief reason｜主要原因 ; police chief｜警察局长
tip_ja: chief可作形容词或名词；副词用chiefly。

meanings_ja: adv. 间接地 | adv. 含蓄地；拐弯抹角地
definition_en: Through another person, thing, or stage rather than directly | Without expressing something clearly or openly
example1_en: I heard about the empty flat indirectly through a colleague.
example1_ja: 我是通过一位同事间接得知那套空置公寓的消息的。
example2_en: Higher fuel prices indirectly affect food costs because transporting agricultural products becomes more expensive for suppliers.
example2_ja: 燃油价格上涨会间接影响食品价格，因为供应商运输农产品的成本会增加。
collocations: indirectly affect｜间接影响 ; indirectly responsible for｜对……负有间接责任 ; refer indirectly to｜含蓄地提及 ; directly or indirectly｜直接或间接地
tip_ja: 是副词，不是形容词；修饰动词时用indirectly。

meanings_ja: v. 停止；使停止 | n. 停止；中止
definition_en: to stop moving or happening, or make something stop | a stop in movement, activity, or progress
example1_en: The bus halted suddenly when a sheep crossed.
example1_ja: 一只羊横穿道路时，公交车突然停了下来。
example2_en: Urgent international cooperation is needed to halt the destruction of habitats and protect species at risk of extinction.
example2_ja: 迫切需要开展国际合作，以阻止栖息地遭到破坏，并保护面临灭绝风险的物种。
collocations: come to a halt｜停下来 ; bring to a halt｜使停止 ; halt production｜停止生产 ; halt the decline｜遏制衰退
tip_ja: 比stop正式；come to a halt表示停下来。

meanings_ja: adj. 人造的；人为的
definition_en: made or caused by people rather than occurring naturally
example1_en: We walked around a man-made lake near the airport.
example1_ja: 我们绕着机场附近的一个人工湖散步。
example2_en: Man-made barriers such as dams can disrupt river ecosystems by preventing fish from reaching their breeding grounds.
example2_ja: 水坝等人工屏障会阻碍鱼类到达繁殖地，从而破坏河流生态系统。
collocations: man-made lake｜人工湖 ; man-made materials｜人造材料 ; man-made disaster｜人为灾难 ; man-made fibres｜人造纤维
tip_ja: 强调由人制造或造成；也可用human-made。

meanings_ja: adj. 荒谬的；不合理的
definition_en: Completely unreasonable or silly.
example1_en: It seems absurd to drive when the shop is so close.
example1_ja: 商店这么近还要开车去，似乎太不合理了。
example2_en: It is absurd to expect public transport use to increase without improving service quality or affordability.
example2_ja: 不提高服务质量或降低出行成本，却指望公共交通使用量增加，这是不合理的。

example2_en: Planting colourful flowers can brighten neglected public spaces and encourage residents to take greater pride in their neighbourhood.
example2_ja: 种植色彩鲜艳的花卉可以让无人照管的公共空间焕发生机，并增强居民对社区的自豪感。
collocations: brighten a room｜使房间明亮 ; brighten someone's day｜让某人一天心情愉快 ; brighten up｜变明亮；振作起来
tip_ja: 可及物也可不及物；brighten up也指心情好转。

meanings_ja: n. 部落；部族
definition_en: a social group sharing ancestry, traditions, and community ties
example1_en: The guide belongs to a tribe from this valley.
example1_ja: 这位向导属于这个山谷中的一个部族。
example2_en: Development projects should respect the land rights and cultural traditions of local tribes.
example2_ja: 开发项目应尊重当地部族的土地权利和文化传统。
collocations: tribal traditions｜部族传统 ; a nomadic tribe｜游牧部落 ; members of a tribe｜部落成员
tip_ja: 指特定社群时，宜尊重其自称，避免泛称。

meanings_ja: v. 突出；强调 | n. 最精彩或最重要的部分 | v. 用荧光笔标出
definition_en: Draw attention to something important or especially noticeable. | The best or most memorable part of an experience. | Mark words with bright colour to make them noticeable.
example1_en: The boat ride was the highlight of our holiday.
example1_ja: 乘船游览是我们假期中最精彩的部分。
example2_en: Recent studies highlight the importance of accessible green spaces for the physical and mental health of urban residents.
example2_ja: 近期研究强调，方便到达的绿地对城市居民的身心健康十分重要。
collocations: highlight a problem｜突出一个问题 ; highlight the importance of｜强调……的重要性 ; the highlight of the trip｜旅途中最精彩的部分
tip_ja: 作动词直接接宾语：highlight the problem。

meanings_ja: adj. 大胆的；勇敢的 | adj. 醒目的；鲜明的 | adj. 粗体的
definition_en: Willing to take risks or act with confidence. | Strong and easily noticed in colour, shape, or design. | Printed with thicker, darker lines than ordinary type.
example1_en: She made a bold decision to open her own bakery.
example1_ja: 她大胆决定开一家自己的面包店。
example2_en: Governments need bold policies to address housing shortages while protecting green spaces and supporting affordable development.
example2_ja: 政府需要大胆的政策来解决住房短缺，同时保护绿地并支持可负担住房的开发。
collocations: bold decision｜大胆的决定 ; bold colours｜鲜明的色彩 ; bold type｜粗体字 ; bold approach｜大胆的做法
tip_ja: in bold表示“用粗体”，常用于排版说明。

meanings_ja: n. 可能性；机会 | n. 投注赔率
definition_en: The likelihood that something will happen. | The ratio determining how much a successful bet pays.
example1_en: The odds of finding my keys here are low.
example1_ja: 在这里找到我钥匙的可能性很小。
example2_en: Access to affordable healthcare can improve the odds of recovery for patients with chronic illnesses.
example2_ja: 获得负担得起的医疗服务可以提高慢性病患者康复的可能性。
collocations: the odds of success｜成功的可能性 ; against all odds｜尽管困难重重 ; at odds with｜与……不一致 ; improve the odds｜提高成功机会
tip_ja: odds用复数形式，常接of或that从句。

meanings_ja: n. 合作；协作 | n. 配合；协助
definition_en: the act of working together towards a shared goal | willingness to help or do what someone requests
example1_en: Cleaning the shared kitchen requires cooperation from everyone.
example1_ja: 清洁共用厨房需要大家的配合。
example2_en: International cooperation is essential for addressing environmental problems that extend beyond the borders of individual countries.
example2_ja: 应对跨越单个国家边界的环境问题，国际合作至关重要。
collocations: international cooperation｜国际合作 ; close cooperation｜密切合作 ; in cooperation with｜与……合作 ; full cooperation｜充分配合
tip_ja: 通常不可数；与……合作用in cooperation with。

meanings_ja: n. 小部分；少量 | n. 分数
definition_en: a small part or amount of something | a mathematical quantity representing part of a whole
example1_en: This jacket costs a fraction of the original price.
example1_ja: 这件夹克的售价只是原价的一小部分。
example2_en: Only a small fraction of household waste is recycled in some rapidly growing cities.
example2_ja: 在一些快速发展的城市，只有少量生活垃圾得到回收利用。
collocations: a fraction of｜……的一小部分 ; a small fraction｜很小一部分 ; a fraction of a second｜极短的一瞬 ; simple fraction｜简单分数
tip_ja: a fraction of常强调占比极小，不只是一般部分。

meanings_ja: n. 灵活性；变通能力 | n. 柔韧性
definition_en: the ability to change or adapt to different needs | the ability to bend or stretch easily
example1_en: This job gives me flexibility to collect my daughter.
example1_ja: 这份工作时间灵活，方便我去接女儿。
example2_en: Greater flexibility in working hours can help employees balance professional responsibilities with family commitments.
example2_ja: 更灵活的工作时间能帮助员工平衡工作职责与家庭义务。
collocations: offer flexibility｜提供灵活性 ; greater flexibility｜更大的灵活性 ; improve flexibility｜提高柔韧性 ; flexibility in working hours｜工作时间的灵活性
tip_ja: 既可指安排可变通，也可指身体或材料的柔韧性。

meanings_ja: n. 鞭子 | v. 鞭打；迅速抽动 | v. 搅打（奶油等）
definition_en: A flexible strip attached to a handle, used for striking. | To strike with a whip or move something suddenly. | To beat food quickly to make it light and thick.
example1_en: An old leather whip hung beside the stable door.
example1_ja: 马厩门旁挂着一根旧皮鞭。
example2_en: During practical lessons, culinary students learn to whip cream and prepare healthier alternatives to commercial desserts.
example2_ja: 在实操课上，烹饪专业学生学习打发奶油，并制作比市售甜点更健康的替代品。
collocations: a leather whip｜皮鞭 ; whip cream｜打发奶油 ; whip out｜迅速拿出 ; whip up a meal｜迅速做顿饭
tip_ja: whip cream是打发奶油；双写p加-ed或-ing。

meanings_ja: v. 批评；指责
definition_en: express disapproval of someone or something
example1_en: Please don't criticize my cooking before you taste it.
example1_ja: 请别还没尝就批评我的厨艺。
example2_en: Many residents criticize the council for prioritizing road construction over improvements to public transport.
example2_ja: 许多居民批评地方议会优先修建道路，而非改善公共交通。
collocations: strongly criticize｜强烈批评 ; criticize someone for something｜因某事批评某人 ; widely criticized｜受到广泛批评
tip_ja: criticize sb for sth；英式也常拼作criticise。

meanings_ja: n. 完成；竣工
definition_en: The act or state of finishing something.
example1_en: Our kitchen renovation is finally nearing completion this week.
example1_ja: 我们的厨房翻修这周终于接近完工了。
example2_en: The completion of the new railway is expected to improve access to employment in rural communities.
example2_ja: 新铁路的竣工预计将改善农村居民的就业机会。
collocations: on completion｜完成时 ; near completion｜接近完工 ; successful completion｜顺利完成 ; completion date｜完工日期
tip_ja: 常用on completion of表示“在……完成时”。

meanings_ja: n. 胡说；无意义的话 | n. 愚蠢行为；胡闹
definition_en: words or ideas that are absurd or have no meaning | silly or unacceptable behaviour
example1_en: That story about a flying bicycle is complete nonsense.
example1_ja: 那个关于会飞的自行车的故事完全是胡说。
example2_en: Schools should teach students to distinguish reliable evidence from nonsense circulated through social media platforms.
example2_ja: 学校应教学生区分可靠证据和社交媒体平台上传播的无稽之谈。
collocations: talk nonsense｜胡说八道 ; complete nonsense｜一派胡言 ; a load of nonsense｜一堆废话 ; put up with nonsense｜容忍胡闹
tip_ja: 通常不可数；说一派胡言可用 complete nonsense。

meanings_ja: n. 专门学校；学院 | n. 学会；研究院
definition_en: A school providing training in a particular subject or skill. | An organization promoting scholarship, science, or the arts.
example1_en: She attends a dance academy near the station.
example1_ja: 她在车站附近的一所舞蹈学校上学。
example2_en: A well-funded arts academy can provide talented young people with training they could not otherwise afford.
example2_ja: 一所资金充足的艺术学院可以为有才华的年轻人提供他们原本负担不起的培训。
collocations: a music academy｜音乐学院 ; a military academy｜军事学院 ; an academy of sciences｜科学院
tip_ja: 常指专业培训院校或学术机构，不一定是大学。

meanings_ja: v. 估计；估算 | n. 估计；估价
definition_en: To judge an approximate amount, value, or size. | An approximate calculation of an amount, value, or cost.
example1_en: We estimate the repairs will take about three days.
example1_ja: 我们估计维修大约需要三天。
example2_en: Researchers estimate that improved public transport could significantly reduce the number of cars entering city centres.
example2_ja: 研究人员估计，改善公共交通可显著减少进入市中心的汽车数量。
collocations: estimate the cost｜估算费用 ; a rough estimate｜粗略估计 ; a conservative estimate｜保守估计 ; be estimated at｜估计为
tip_ja: 动词末尾读/eɪt/；名词末尾读/ət/。

meanings_ja: n. 评论家；评论员 | n. 批评者；反对者
definition_en: Someone who judges and discusses artistic works professionally. | Someone who expresses disapproval of a person, policy, or idea.
example1_en: The film critic praised the young actor's performance.
example1_ja: 那位影评人赞扬了年轻演员的表演。
example2_en: Critics of urban expansion argue that new developments often destroy valuable habitats and increase car dependence.
example2_ja: 城市扩张的批评者认为，新开发项目往往破坏宝贵的栖息地，并增加人们对汽车的依赖。
collocations: film critic｜影评人 ; literary critic｜文学评论家 ; an outspoken critic｜直言不讳的批评者
tip_ja: critic指人，criticism指批评或评论。

meanings_ja: adj. 显著的；值得注意的 | n. 名人；要人
definition_en: important or unusual enough to deserve attention | a famous or important person, especially in a particular community
example1_en: Her balcony is notable for its bright yellow flowers.
example1_ja: 她家的阳台因鲜艳的黄色花朵而引人注目。
example2_en: The city has achieved a notable reduction in air pollution since introducing stricter vehicle standards.
example2_ja: 自实施更严格的车辆标准以来，该市的空气污染已显著减少。
collocations: a notable achievement｜显著成就 ; a notable exception｜值得注意的例外 ; notable for｜以……而引人注目
tip_ja: notable for表示因……而出名或引人注意。

meanings_ja: n. 硫；硫磺
definition_en: a yellow chemical element used in industry and agriculture
example1_en: The guide showed us yellow sulphur near the volcano.
example1_ja: 导游给我们看了火山附近黄色的硫磺。
example2_en: Burning fuels containing sulphur releases gases that contribute to acid rain and damage natural ecosystems.
example2_ja: 燃烧含硫燃料会释放促成酸雨的气体，破坏自然生态系统。
collocations: sulphur dioxide｜二氧化硫 ; sulphur content｜含硫量 ; sulphur deposits｜硫磺矿床
tip_ja: sulphur是传统英式拼写；科学文献常用sulfur。

meanings_ja: v. 承担；着手进行 | v. 承诺；答应
definition_en: Accept responsibility for a task and begin doing it | Promise to do something
example1_en: We undertook the repairs ourselves to save money.
example1_ja: 我们自己动手维修，以节省开支。
example2_en: Universities should undertake further research before recommending major changes to national education policy.
example2_ja: 大学应在建议对国家教育政策作重大调整之前开展进一步研究。
collocations: undertake research｜开展研究 ; undertake a task｜承担任务 ; undertake to do something｜承诺做某事
tip_ja: 过去式undertook，过去分词undertaken。

meanings_ja: v. 孵化；孵出 | n. 舱口；小开口 | v. 秘密策划
definition_en: to emerge from an egg, or cause this to happen | an opening in a floor, ceiling, or wall | to develop a plan, often secretly
example1_en: We watched three chicks hatch on the farm yesterday.
example1_ja: 昨天我们在农场看着三只小鸡破壳而出。
example2_en: Rising temperatures can affect when turtle eggs hatch, potentially reducing the survival chances of young turtles.
example2_ja: 气温上升会影响海龟卵的孵化时间，可能降低幼龟的存活机会。
collocations: hatch an egg｜孵蛋 ; hatch a plan｜秘密策划 ; escape hatch｜逃生舱口
tip_ja: 表示孵化用动词；名词常指舱口或小开口。

meanings_ja: n. 酸橙；青柠 | n. 石灰 | n. 黄绿色；青柠绿
definition_en: A small citrus fruit with green skin and sour juice. | A white calcium compound used in building and soil treatment. | A bright, pale colour between green and yellow.
example1_en: She squeezed a lime over the warm rice.
example1_ja: 她往热米饭上挤了些青柠汁。
example2_en: Farmers may apply lime to acidic soils to improve growing conditions and increase crop productivity.
example2_ja: 农民可以向酸性土壤施用石灰，以改善生长条件并提高作物产量。
collocations: lime juice｜青柠汁 ; a slice of lime｜一片青柠 ; agricultural lime｜农用石灰 ; lime green｜青柠绿
tip_ja: 水果义可数，石灰义不可数；lemon是柠檬。

meanings_ja: adv. 在海外；到国外 | adj. 海外的；国外的
definition_en: in or to a foreign country | located in, coming from, or relating to foreign countries
example1_en: My cousin moved overseas and calls us every weekend.
example1_ja: 我表亲搬到了国外，每个周末都给我们打电话。
example2_en: Studying overseas can broaden students' perspectives, although adapting to a different culture often takes time.
example2_ja: 出国留学能拓宽学生的视野，不过适应不同文化往往需要时间。
collocations: study overseas｜出国留学 ; work overseas｜在海外工作 ; overseas markets｜海外市场 ; overseas students｜海外留学生
tip_ja: 作副词前不加to：go overseas；也可修饰名词。

meanings_ja: v. 移民入境；移居
definition_en: To move to another country to live there permanently.
example1_en: Her grandparents immigrated to Canada and opened a bakery.
example1_ja: 她的祖父母移居加拿大，开了一家面包店。
example2_en: People who immigrate often contribute valuable skills to their host countries while adapting to unfamiliar social customs.
example2_ja: 移民在适应陌生社会习俗的同时，往往也为移入国贡献宝贵的技能。
collocations: immigrate to a country｜移居某国 ; immigrate from abroad｜从国外移入
tip_ja: immigrate to强调移入；emigrate from强调移出。

meanings_ja: v. 吠叫 | n. 狗叫声 | n. 树皮
definition_en: to make the short, loud sound of a dog | a short, loud sound made by a dog | the outer protective layer of a tree trunk or branch
example1_en: Our dog barks whenever someone knocks on the door.
example1_ja: 每当有人敲门，我们的狗就会叫。
example2_en: The bark of mature trees provides shelter for insects and helps protect the trunk from damage.
example2_ja: 成年树木的树皮为昆虫提供庇护，也有助于保护树干免受损伤。
collocations: bark at someone｜冲某人吠叫 ; a loud bark｜一声响亮的狗叫 ; tree bark｜树皮
tip_ja: 狗叫声可数；树皮通常不可数。

meanings_ja: n. 森林砍伐；毁林
definition_en: The clearing of forests by cutting down trees.
example1_en: Deforestation has left the hillside bare and dusty.
example1_ja: 森林砍伐使山坡变得光秃秃、尘土飞扬。
example2_en: Reducing deforestation can protect wildlife habitats and help limit the effects of climate change.
example2_ja: 减少森林砍伐可以保护野生动物栖息地，并有助于减轻气候变化的影响。
collocations: prevent deforestation｜防止毁林 ; widespread deforestation｜大规模毁林 ; tropical deforestation｜热带森林砍伐
tip_ja: 不可数名词；常用于栖息地丧失和气候变化话题。

meanings_ja: n. 服务员；工作人员 | adj. 伴随的；随之而来的
definition_en: Someone employed to help people in a public place. | Occurring together with something, often as a consequence.
example1_en: The flight attendant brought an extra blanket for my daughter.
example1_ja: 乘务员给我女儿又拿来了一条毯子。
example2_en: Cities must consider population growth and its attendant pressures when planning new public transport networks.
example2_ja: 城市在规划新的公共交通网络时，必须考虑人口增长及其带来的压力。
collocations: flight attendant｜航空乘务员 ; car park attendant｜停车场管理员 ; attendant risks｜随之而来的风险
tip_ja: attendant常指服务人员；参会者通常用attendee。

meanings_ja: n. 悲伤；悲痛
definition_en: deep sadness caused by loss or disappointment
example1_en: She felt deep sorrow when her closest friend moved away.
example1_ja: 最亲密的朋友搬走时，她感到深深的悲伤。
example2_en: Community support can help people cope with sorrow after the loss of a loved one.
example2_ja: 社区支持可以帮助人们应对失去亲人后的悲痛。
collocations: deep sorrow｜深切的悲痛 ; express sorrow｜表达悲伤 ; in sorrow｜悲伤地
tip_ja: 表示悲伤情绪通常不可数；具体伤心事可数。

meanings_ja: n. 短途旅行；远足
definition_en: A short journey made for pleasure, often with a group.
example1_en: We packed sandwiches for our excursion to the lake.
example1_ja: 我们为去湖边的短途旅行准备了三明治。
example2_en: School excursions to nature reserves can deepen students' understanding of local wildlife and conservation.
example2_ja: 学校组织的自然保护区游览能加深学生对当地野生生物及其保护的理解。
collocations: go on an excursion｜去短途旅行 ; a day excursion｜一日游 ; a school excursion｜学校组织的游览
tip_ja: 常指集体休闲短途旅行，搭配go on。

meanings_ja: v. 禁用；使停止运作 | v. 使伤残；使丧失能力
definition_en: to prevent a device or feature from working | to cause a condition that limits someone's activities
example1_en: I disabled notifications so my phone stayed quiet during dinner.
example1_ja: 我关闭了通知，让手机在吃晚饭时保持安静。
example2_en: Users should be able to disable location tracking without losing access to essential digital services.
example2_ja: 用户应当能够禁用位置追踪，而不失去使用基本数字服务的权限。
collocations: disable notifications｜禁用通知 ; disable an alarm｜关闭警报器 ; disable location tracking｜禁用位置追踪
tip_ja: 技术语境常指“禁用”，不表示删除或损坏。

meanings_ja: v. 回想起；记得 | v. 召回；收回 | n. 记忆力；产品召回
definition_en: to remember something from the past | to order someone back or request the return of products | the ability to remember, or an official request for returns
example1_en: I still recall the smell of my grandmother's kitchen.
example1_ja: 我仍然记得祖母厨房里的气味。
example2_en: Manufacturers should recall faulty products promptly to protect consumers and maintain public trust in safety standards.
example2_ja: 制造商应及时召回有缺陷的产品，以保护消费者并维持公众对安全标准的信任。
collocations: recall a detail｜回想起一个细节 ; recall doing something｜记得做过某事 ; product recall｜产品召回 ; total recall｜完整的记忆能力
tip_ja: 表示记得做过某事用 recall doing，不用 to do。

meanings_ja: adj. 壮丽的；宏伟的 | adj. 极出色的
definition_en: Extremely beautiful, grand, or impressive. | Exceptionally good or skilfully done.
example1_en: The balcony offers a magnificent view of snowy mountains.
example1_ja: 从阳台可以欣赏到壮丽的雪山景色。
example2_en: Preserving magnificent historic buildings can strengthen local identity and attract visitors from other regions.
example2_ja: 保护宏伟的历史建筑能增强当地认同感，并吸引其他地区的游客。
collocations: magnificent scenery｜壮丽的景色 ; a magnificent building｜宏伟的建筑 ; a magnificent achievement｜卓越的成就
tip_ja: 多形容景色、建筑或成就，不表示品德高尚。

meanings_ja: n. 感激；感谢 | n. 欣赏；理解 | n. 升值；增值
definition_en: A feeling of gratitude for someone's help or kindness. | Recognition and understanding of something's value, quality, or importance. | An increase in the financial value of something.
example1_en: We baked our neighbour a cake to show our appreciation.
example1_ja: 我们为邻居烤了一个蛋糕，以表达感谢。
example2_en: Arts education can develop students' appreciation of cultural traditions that differ from their own.
example2_ja: 艺术教育能培养学生对不同于自身文化的传统的欣赏能力。
collocations: show appreciation｜表达感激 ; in appreciation of｜为感谢 ; an appreciation of art｜对艺术的欣赏 ; currency appreciation｜货币升值
tip_ja: 通常不可数；an appreciation of可指对某事的理解。

meanings_ja: n. 负担；重担 | v. 使负担；使烦恼
definition_en: a heavy load, difficult duty, or source of worry | to give someone a heavy responsibility or worry
example1_en: Sharing the housework eased the burden on my father.
example1_ja: 分担家务减轻了父亲的负担。
