example1_ja: 她被任命为团队负责人，单位里没有人感到意外。
example2_en: The designation of coastal wetlands as protected areas can help preserve biodiversity and limit inappropriate development.
example2_ja: 将沿海湿地划定为保护区，有助于保护生物多样性并限制不当开发。
collocations: designation as｜指定为；任命为 ; official designation｜正式名称；官方认定 ; job designation｜职位名称
tip_ja: designation as后接身份；也可指正式名称或职称。

meanings_ja: n. 船；舰艇 | n. 血管；脉管 | n. 容器；器皿
definition_en: A ship or large boat. | A tube carrying blood or other fluid through a living body. | A container used to hold liquids.
example1_en: A large fishing vessel sailed slowly into the harbour.
example1_ja: 一艘大型渔船缓缓驶入港口。
example2_en: Commercial vessels can disturb marine ecosystems through underwater noise, fuel leaks, and the introduction of non-native species.
example2_ja: 商船可能通过水下噪声、燃油泄漏和引入外来物种干扰海洋生态系统。
collocations: a fishing vessel｜渔船 ; a cargo vessel｜货船 ; a blood vessel｜血管 ; a pressure vessel｜压力容器
tip_ja: vessel较正式；blood vessel是“血管”，不是船。

meanings_ja: n. 人文学科
definition_en: subjects studying human culture, such as history, literature, and philosophy
example1_en: She chose humanities because she loves history and literature.
example1_ja: 她选择了人文学科，因为她热爱历史和文学。
example2_en: Studying the humanities can develop critical thinking and help students understand perspectives shaped by different cultures.
example2_ja: 学习人文学科能够培养批判性思维，并帮助学生理解不同文化塑造的观点。
collocations: study the humanities｜学习人文学科 ; humanities subjects｜人文学科课程 ; arts and humanities｜艺术与人文学科
tip_ja: 统称学科领域常用the humanities，按复数处理。

meanings_ja: n. 植被；植物群
definition_en: plants growing together in a particular area
example1_en: Thick vegetation hid the narrow path beside the river.
example1_ja: 茂密的植被遮住了河边的狭窄小路。
example2_en: Removing natural vegetation increases soil erosion and reduces the capacity of land to absorb heavy rainfall.
example2_ja: 清除天然植被会加剧水土流失，并降低土地吸收强降雨的能力。
collocations: dense vegetation｜茂密的植被 ; native vegetation｜本土植被 ; vegetation cover｜植被覆盖 ; clear vegetation｜清除植被
tip_ja: 不可数名词，泛指某地区植物，不等于蔬菜。

meanings_ja: v. 给…穿衣；提供衣物
definition_en: To dress someone or provide them with clothes
example1_en: The charity helps feed and clothe families during winter.
example1_ja: 这家慈善机构在冬季帮助家庭解决吃穿问题。
example2_en: Low wages can make it difficult for parents to feed and clothe their children adequately.
example2_ja: 低工资可能使父母难以让孩子吃饱穿暖。
collocations: feed and clothe｜供给衣食 ; clothe someone in wool｜给某人穿上羊毛衣物
tip_ja: 较正式；过去式和过去分词通常为clothed。

meanings_ja: adj. 微小的；不重要的 | adj. 边缘的；非核心的 | adj. 勉强合格的
definition_en: very small in amount, effect, or importance | outside the main or central part of something | only just good enough for a particular purpose
example1_en: The new tyres made only a marginal difference.
example1_ja: 新轮胎带来的变化微乎其微。
example2_en: Despite substantial investment, the programme produced only marginal improvements in public transport reliability across the city.
example2_ja: 尽管投入了大量资金，该项目对全市公共交通可靠性的改善仍十分有限。
collocations: marginal improvement｜微小改善 ; marginal difference｜细微差别 ; marginal role｜次要作用
tip_ja: 表示变化时指幅度很小，不是完全没有变化。

meanings_ja: n. 智力；理解力 | n. 才智出众的人
definition_en: The ability to understand ideas, think logically, and solve problems. | A person with exceptional intelligence and reasoning ability.
example1_en: Her sharp intellect makes difficult puzzles seem surprisingly easy.
example1_ja: 她思维敏锐，解起难题来显得格外轻松。
example2_en: Education should develop students' intellect while also nurturing creativity, emotional awareness, and the ability to collaborate.
example2_ja: 教育应发展学生的智力，同时培养创造力、情感意识和协作能力。
collocations: a sharp intellect｜敏锐的头脑 ; a formidable intellect｜非凡的才智 ; develop the intellect｜发展智力
tip_ja: intellect侧重理解与推理能力，不等同于知识。

meanings_ja: n. 痛苦的经历；严峻考验
definition_en: A difficult or frightening experience that lasts for some time.
example1_en: Getting home through the storm was a real ordeal.
example1_ja: 穿过暴风雨回家真是一次痛苦的经历。
example2_en: For displaced families, finding secure housing can become a prolonged ordeal without adequate public support.
example2_ja: 对于流离失所的家庭，若缺乏充分的公共支持，寻找安全住房可能成为漫长的煎熬。
collocations: go through an ordeal｜经历磨难 ; a traumatic ordeal｜造成心理创伤的经历 ; a prolonged ordeal｜漫长的煎熬
tip_ja: 指令人痛苦或恐惧的经历，不用于普通的小麻烦。

meanings_ja: adj. 根本的；潜在的 | adj. 位于下面的
definition_en: causing or influencing something without being immediately obvious | lying beneath the surface of something
example1_en: The mechanic found the underlying cause of the noise.
example1_ja: 机械师找到了异响的根本原因。
example2_en: Addressing the underlying causes of poverty requires sustained investment in education, healthcare, and secure employment.
example2_ja: 解决贫困的根本原因需要持续投资于教育、医疗和稳定就业。
collocations: underlying cause｜根本原因 ; underlying problem｜潜在问题 ; underlying assumption｜基本假设 ; underlying health condition｜基础疾病
tip_ja: 通常放在名词前，强调表面现象背后的原因或基础。

meanings_ja: n. 变形；形变
definition_en: a change in shape caused by pressure or other forces
example1_en: The heat caused visible deformation of the plastic lid.
example1_ja: 高温使塑料盖出现了明显变形。
example2_en: Engineers test building materials to assess their resistance to deformation under heavy loads and extreme temperatures.
example2_ja: 工程师测试建筑材料，以评估其在重载和极端温度下抵抗变形的能力。
collocations: plastic deformation｜塑性变形 ; elastic deformation｜弹性变形 ; resistance to deformation｜抗变形能力
tip_ja: 强调形状改变，不等同于泛指损坏的damage。

meanings_ja: n. 领域；范围 | n. 领地；管辖范围 | n. 互联网域
definition_en: a particular area of knowledge, activity, or responsibility | an area controlled by a particular ruler or authority | an internet area identified by a shared name
example1_en: Electrical repairs are my brother's domain, not mine.
example1_ja: 电器维修是我哥哥擅长的领域，不是我的。
example2_en: Environmental protection should not be regarded as the exclusive domain of scientists, since public participation is essential.
example2_ja: 环境保护不应被视为科学家独有的领域，因为公众参与至关重要。
collocations: the domain of science｜科学领域 ; public domain｜公有领域 ; domain name｜域名 ; exclusive domain｜专属领域
tip_ja: 领域义近field；in the public domain指公开可用。

meanings_ja: n. 肺炎
definition_en: An infection that inflames the lungs and makes breathing difficult.
example1_en: My grandfather stayed in hospital while recovering from pneumonia.
example1_ja: 我爷爷在肺炎康复期间住在医院里。
example2_en: Improved access to vaccination and timely treatment can reduce deaths from pneumonia, particularly among young children.
example2_ja: 提高疫苗接种的可及性并提供及时治疗，可以减少肺炎死亡，尤其是幼儿的死亡。
collocations: develop pneumonia｜患上肺炎 ; recover from pneumonia｜肺炎康复 ; bacterial pneumonia｜细菌性肺炎
tip_ja: 词首p不发音；通常不可数，不说a pneumonia。

meanings_ja: v. 旋转；使打旋 | n. 旋涡；螺旋状图案
definition_en: To move, or make something move, in flowing circles. | A circular movement or a shape that curves around itself.
example1_en: Dry leaves swirled around my feet in the wind.
example1_ja: 干枯的树叶在风中绕着我的脚打转。
example2_en: Dust can swirl through urban streets during construction, reducing air quality and causing discomfort for nearby residents.
example2_ja: 施工时，灰尘可能在城市街道中盘旋，降低空气质量，并让附近居民感到不适。
collocations: swirl around｜绕着打旋 ; swirl a liquid｜使液体打旋 ; a swirl of smoke｜一缕盘旋的烟
tip_ja: 可作及物或不及物动词，强调流动中的旋转。

meanings_ja: v. 引出；诱发
definition_en: to cause someone to give information or show a reaction
example1_en: Her unexpected question elicited a smile from the normally quiet guide.
example1_ja: 她出人意料的问题让平时寡言的导游露出了笑容。
example2_en: Teachers can use open questions to elicit detailed responses and encourage independent thinking in the classroom.
example2_ja: 教师可以用开放式问题引导学生详细回答，并鼓励他们在课堂上独立思考。
collocations: elicit a response｜引出回应 ; elicit information｜获取信息 ; elicit sympathy｜引起同情
tip_ja: 常接response等宾语；勿与illicit（非法的）混淆。

meanings_ja: n. 桅杆 | n. 天线塔；天线杆
definition_en: A tall upright pole supporting sails on a boat | A tall structure supporting equipment that sends or receives signals
example1_en: A white sail fluttered high on the wooden mast.
example1_ja: 一面白帆在木桅杆高处迎风飘动。
example2_en: Installing a new communications mast could improve mobile coverage in remote villages and support local businesses.
example2_ja: 安装新的通信塔可以改善偏远村庄的移动通信覆盖，并支持当地企业发展。
collocations: main mast｜主桅杆 ; communications mast｜通信塔 ; at half mast｜降半旗
tip_ja: 核心义是支撑帆的桅杆，也可指支撑天线的高杆。

meanings_ja: adj. 不成形的；无明确形状的
definition_en: Having no clear or definite shape
example1_en: My old sweater became shapeless after too many washes.
example1_ja: 我的旧毛衣洗了太多次，已经不成形了。
example2_en: Without careful planning, expanding cities can become shapeless areas lacking distinct neighbourhoods and accessible public spaces.
example2_ja: 如果缺乏周密规划，扩张中的城市可能变得布局杂乱，既没有特色鲜明的街区，也缺乏便利的公共空间。
collocations: a shapeless mass｜不成形的一团 ; a shapeless dress｜宽松无形的连衣裙 ; become shapeless｜变得不成形
tip_ja: 形容衣服时常指松垮、没有明显轮廓。

meanings_ja: v. 遵守；符合 | v. 顺从；随俗
definition_en: to follow rules or meet required standards | to behave as others in a group expect
example1_en: These new helmets conform to the latest safety standards.
example1_ja: 这些新头盔符合最新的安全标准。
example2_en: Pressure to conform can discourage young people from expressing original ideas or questioning established traditions.
example2_ja: 要求随大流的压力可能使年轻人不愿表达独创想法，也不敢质疑既有传统。
collocations: conform to standards｜符合标准 ; conform to regulations｜遵守规定 ; pressure to conform｜要求随大流的压力
tip_ja: 常用conform to rules或standards，不直接接宾语。

meanings_ja: adv. 明显地；可察觉地
definition_en: by an amount that is large enough to notice
example1_en: The room felt appreciably warmer after we closed the window.
example1_ja: 关上窗户后，房间里明显暖和了。
example2_en: Expanding reliable public transport could appreciably reduce traffic congestion and improve air quality in urban areas.
example2_ja: 扩大可靠的公共交通服务可以明显缓解交通拥堵，并改善城市空气质量。
collocations: appreciably higher｜明显更高 ; appreciably reduce｜显著减少 ; differ appreciably｜存在明显差异
tip_ja: 表示变化大到可察觉，不是“感激地”。

meanings_ja: v. 悬垂；悬着摇摆 | v. 以好处诱惑
definition_en: to hang loosely, or make something hang loosely | to offer something attractive to persuade someone to act
example1_en: Her feet dangled above the floor from the high chair.
example1_ja: 她坐在高椅上，双脚悬在地板上方晃荡。
example2_en: Some employers dangle generous bonuses before applicants while offering limited opportunities for long-term career development.
example2_ja: 一些雇主用丰厚奖金吸引求职者，却很少提供长期职业发展机会。
collocations: dangle from｜从……悬垂下来 ; dangle your feet｜悬空晃着双脚 ; dangle a carrot｜以好处诱惑
tip_ja: 核心是悬着，可伴随摇摆；并非所有摇摆都用它。

meanings_ja: n. 裁员；职位撤销 | n. 冗余；多余重复 | n. 备用配置；冗余备份
definition_en: Job loss because an employer no longer needs the position. | Unnecessary repetition or the presence of something not needed. | Extra components that keep a system working if others fail.
example1_en: After the factory closed, Elena faced redundancy and financial uncertainty.
example1_ja: 工厂关闭后，埃琳娜面临裁员和经济上的不确定性。
example2_en: Automation may increase productivity, but employers should offer retraining to workers at risk of redundancy.
example2_ja: 自动化可能提高生产率，但雇主应为面临裁员风险的员工提供再培训。
collocations: redundancy pay｜裁员补偿金 ; compulsory redundancy｜强制裁员 ; voluntary redundancy｜自愿离职裁员 ; built-in redundancy｜内置冗余备份
tip_ja: 英式英语常指裁员；技术语境可指保障运行的备用配置。

meanings_ja: v. 重新捕获；夺回 | v. 重温；再现 | n. 重新捕获；夺回
definition_en: To catch again or regain control of something | To experience or produce a past feeling or quality again | The act of catching something or taking control again
example1_en: The farmer recaptured the goat beside our garden gate.
example1_ja: 农夫在我们花园门旁重新抓住了那只山羊。
example2_en: Restoring historic buildings can help cities recapture their distinctive character while creating new opportunities for tourism.
example2_ja: 修复历史建筑有助于城市重现独特风貌，同时创造新的旅游发展机会。
collocations: recapture an escaped animal｜重新捕获逃走的动物 ; recapture the excitement｜重温激动之情 ; recapture the atmosphere｜再现氛围 ; recapture market share｜夺回市场份额
tip_ja: 既可指重新抓住，也可指重温昔日感受或再现特色。

meanings_ja: n. 理想主义 | n. 唯心主义
definition_en: belief in pursuing perfect standards, even when impractical | the philosophical view that reality depends on mind or consciousness
example1_en: Her idealism inspired us to clean the riverbank.
example1_ja: 她的理想主义鼓舞我们去清理河岸。
example2_en: Youthful idealism can encourage social change, but effective policies also require practical planning and reliable funding.
example2_ja: 年轻人的理想主义能推动社会变革，但有效的政策也需要务实的规划和可靠的资金。
collocations: youthful idealism｜年轻人的理想主义 ; political idealism｜政治理想主义 ; a sense of idealism｜理想主义情怀
tip_ja: 通常不可数；哲学语境译“唯心主义”。

meanings_ja: adj. 液压的；水力的
definition_en: Using liquid pressure to produce movement or power.
example1_en: The mechanic used a hydraulic lift to raise our car.
example1_ja: 修理工用液压升降机抬起了我们的车。
example2_en: Hydraulic systems allow construction equipment to lift heavy loads with greater precision and less manual effort.
example2_ja: 液压系统使建筑设备能够更精准地提升重物，并减少人力投入。
collocations: hydraulic pressure｜液压 ; hydraulic brakes｜液压制动器 ; hydraulic lift｜液压升降机 ; hydraulic system｜液压系统
tip_ja: hydraulic靠液体传压；pneumatic靠气体传压。

meanings_ja: adv. 免费地 | adj. 免费的
definition_en: without any payment being required | provided without requiring payment
example1_en: The hotel lent us two bicycles gratis for the afternoon.
example1_ja: 酒店免费借给我们两辆自行车，供下午使用。
example2_en: Providing museum admission gratis can encourage wider public participation in cultural and educational activities.
example2_ja: 提供免费博物馆门票可以鼓励公众更广泛地参与文化和教育活动。
collocations: provided gratis｜免费提供 ; distributed gratis｜免费分发 ; gratis admission｜免费入场
tip_ja: 可作副词或形容词，较正式；日常通常用free。

meanings_ja: n. 减速；放缓
definition_en: A reduction in the speed of activity or growth
example1_en: Road repairs caused a slowdown on my journey home.
example1_ja: 道路维修让我回家路上的车速慢了下来。
example2_en: An economic slowdown can reduce job opportunities, particularly for young people entering the labour market.
example2_ja: 经济放缓可能减少就业机会，尤其影响初入劳动力市场的年轻人。
collocations: an economic slowdown｜经济放缓 ; a slowdown in growth｜增长放缓 ; a sharp slowdown｜急剧放缓
tip_ja: slowdown是名词；动词短语写作slow down。

meanings_ja: v. 派遣；发送 | n. 发送；派遣 | n. 新闻报道；公文
definition_en: to send someone or something to a destination | the act of sending people or goods somewhere | a report sent by a journalist or official
example1_en: The shop will despatch your parcel tomorrow morning.
example1_ja: 商店明天早上会寄出你的包裹。
example2_en: Emergency services must despatch rescue teams quickly when severe flooding isolates communities from essential supplies.
example2_ja: 当严重洪灾使社区与外界的必需品供应中断时，应急部门必须迅速派遣救援队。
collocations: despatch goods｜发运货物 ; despatch a rescue team｜派遣救援队 ; ready for despatch｜准备好发运
tip_ja: despatch是dispatch的英式变体，后者更常见。

meanings_ja: n. 黑豹 | n. 美洲狮
definition_en: A leopard or jaguar with a black coat. | A cougar, especially in North American usage.
example1_en: The black panther rested quietly on a thick branch.
example1_ja: 那只黑豹静静地趴在一根粗壮的树枝上。
example2_en: Protecting forest corridors allows animals such as the panther to move safely between fragmented habitats.
example2_ja: 保护森林廊道可以让黑豹等动物在破碎的栖息地之间安全迁移。
collocations: black panther｜黑豹 ; Florida panther｜佛罗里达美洲狮
tip_ja: 黑豹通常是黑色的豹或美洲豹，并非独立物种。

meanings_ja: n. 悖论；看似矛盾的事物
definition_en: A statement or situation that seems contradictory but may be true.
example1_en: It seems a paradox that resting helps me accomplish more.
example1_ja: 休息反而能让我完成更多事情，这似乎很矛盾。
example2_en: Modern technology creates a paradox: people can communicate instantly yet still experience deep social isolation.
example2_ja: 现代技术带来一种看似矛盾的现象：人们能即时交流，却仍感到深深的社会孤立。
collocations: apparent paradox｜表面上的矛盾 ; resolve a paradox｜解开悖论 ; present a paradox｜呈现看似矛盾的情况
tip_ja: 强调看似矛盾却可能成立，不等于普通错误。

meanings_ja: v. 再出口；转口出口
definition_en: to export goods that were previously imported
example1_en: They import tea, package it locally, and reexport it.
example1_ja: 他们进口茶叶，在本地包装后再出口。
example2_en: Some ports reexport imported goods to neighbouring countries, creating jobs in storage, transport, and related services.
example2_ja: 一些港口将进口商品再出口到邻国，为仓储、运输及相关服务创造就业机会。
collocations: reexport goods｜再出口商品 ; reexport imported products｜将进口产品再出口 ; reexport to neighbouring markets｜再出口至邻近市场
tip_ja: 也写作re-export，指进口后再出口。

meanings_ja: adj. 限制性的；约束的
definition_en: Limiting what people can do or what is allowed.
example1_en: The club's restrictive rules prevent us from bringing guests.
example1_ja: 俱乐部的限制性规定不允许我们带客人来。
example2_en: Overly restrictive planning regulations can discourage investment and delay the construction of affordable housing.
example2_ja: 过于严格的规划条例可能抑制投资，并拖延经济适用住房的建设。
collocations: restrictive regulations｜限制性条例 ; restrictive measures｜限制性措施 ; overly restrictive｜限制过多的
tip_ja: 是形容词；restrictive强调施加限制。

meanings_ja: v. 润滑；给……加润滑油
definition_en: Apply oil or another substance to reduce friction between surfaces.
example1_en: I lubricated the door hinges to stop that annoying squeak.
example1_ja: 我给门铰链加了润滑油，让那烦人的吱呀声停下来。
example2_en: Regularly lubricating industrial machinery reduces friction, improves energy efficiency, and extends the working life of essential equipment.
example2_ja: 定期润滑工业机械可以减少摩擦、提高能源效率，并延长关键设备的使用寿命。
collocations: lubricate moving parts｜润滑活动部件 ; lubricate machinery｜润滑机械 ; lubricate with oil｜用油润滑
tip_ja: 及物动词，直接接被润滑的部件；用with引出润滑剂。

meanings_ja: n. 商业巨头；大亨
definition_en: a wealthy and powerful person in a particular industry
example1_en: The hotel magnate arrived in a surprisingly small car.
example1_ja: 那位酒店业大亨竟然坐着一辆很小的车来了。
example2_en: A media magnate may influence public debate through ownership of several major news outlets.
example2_ja: 媒体大亨可能通过拥有多家主要新闻机构来影响公共讨论。
collocations: a media magnate｜媒体大亨 ; a shipping magnate｜航运业巨头 ; a business magnate｜商界巨头
tip_ja: 常与行业名连用；注意不要与magnet（磁铁）混淆。

meanings_ja: v. 逐渐积累；逐渐获得
definition_en: To increase gradually, or receive benefits over time
example1_en: Interest accrues monthly on the money in this account.
example1_ja: 这个账户里的钱每月都会产生利息。
example2_en: The benefits of early education accrue over many years, improving both individual opportunities and wider social outcomes.
example2_ja: 早期教育的益处会多年累积，既改善个人发展机会，也带来更广泛的社会效益。
collocations: interest accrues｜利息逐渐累积 ; accrue benefits｜逐渐获得益处 ; accrue to｜归于；惠及 ; accrued income｜应计收入
tip_ja: 常用于利息、收益等逐渐累积；accrue to表示归于。

meanings_ja: v. 根除；彻底消灭
definition_en: To completely remove or destroy something harmful.
example1_en: We removed every root to eradicate weeds from the garden.
example1_ja: 我们清除了每一处草根，以彻底除去花园里的杂草。
example2_en: International vaccination programmes aim to eradicate infectious diseases by ensuring that vulnerable populations receive adequate protection.
example2_ja: 国际疫苗接种计划旨在确保易感人群得到充分保护，从而根除传染病。
collocations: eradicate disease｜根除疾病 ; eradicate poverty｜消除贫困 ; eradicate illiteracy｜扫除文盲
tip_ja: 强调彻底消除，语气强于reduce，常用于疾病或贫困。

meanings_ja: n. 汇集；聚合 | n. 聚集体；集合
definition_en: the process of combining separate items into a larger whole | a group or collection of things brought together
example1_en: Automatic aggregation brings all my spending into one monthly report.
example1_ja: 自动汇总功能把我的所有开销整合成一份月度报告。
example2_en: The aggregation of regional climate data allows researchers to identify broader patterns that individual observations may miss.
example2_ja: 汇集区域气候数据，能让研究人员识别出单次观测可能遗漏的更广泛规律。
collocations: data aggregation｜数据汇总 ; aggregation of results｜结果汇总 ; content aggregation｜内容聚合
tip_ja: 强调把分散项汇成整体；数据处理中常见。

meanings_ja: v. 察觉；辨认出
definition_en: To notice or recognise something that is difficult to detect.
example1_en: Through the fog, I could barely discern the distant bridge.
example1_ja: 隔着浓雾，我几乎辨认不出远处的桥。
example2_en: Without reliable evidence, consumers may find it difficult to discern whether environmental claims are genuinely credible.
example2_ja: 缺乏可靠证据时，消费者可能难以判断环保宣传是否真正可信。
collocations: discern a pattern｜察觉规律 ; discern a difference｜辨别差异 ; barely discern｜勉强辨认出
tip_ja: 较正式，强调费力看出或察觉不明显的事物。

meanings_ja: v. 纪念；缅怀
definition_en: To honour a person or event by remembering them publicly
example1_en: We planted a tree to commemorate our grandfather's life.
example1_ja: 我们种了一棵树，纪念祖父的一生。
example2_en: Public ceremonies commemorate historical events and help younger generations understand the experiences that shaped their communities.
example2_ja: 公共纪念仪式缅怀历史事件，帮助年轻一代理解塑造其社区的经历。
collocations: commemorate an event｜纪念事件 ; commemorate an anniversary｜纪念周年 ; commemorate the victims｜缅怀遇难者
tip_ja: 直接接纪念对象；不一定含有庆祝的喜悦。

meanings_ja: v. 严重破坏；摧毁 | v. 使极度悲痛；使震惊
definition_en: To cause very severe damage to a place or thing | To make someone feel extremely upset or shocked
example1_en: The storm devastated the village, leaving many homes damaged.
example1_ja: 暴风雨重创了村庄，许多房屋受损。
example2_en: Prolonged droughts can devastate agricultural communities by destroying crops and reducing the income available to farming households.
example2_ja: 长期干旱会毁坏庄稼、减少农户收入，给农业社区带来沉重打击。
collocations: devastate a region｜重创一个地区 ; devastate the economy｜严重破坏经济 ; feel devastated｜感到悲痛欲绝 ; devastating impact｜毁灭性的影响
tip_ja: 比damage程度重；也可指使人精神上受到重创。

meanings_ja: n. 围场；围起来的区域 | n. 信函附件 | n. 围住；圈地
definition_en: An area surrounded by a fence, wall, or other barrier. | Something placed inside an envelope together with a letter. | The act of surrounding land with a boundary.
example1_en: The goats rested in their enclosure beside the barn.
example1_ja: 山羊在谷仓旁的围栏里休息。
example2_en: Wildlife parks should provide each enclosure with enough space for animals to display natural behaviour.
example2_ja: 野生动物园应为每个围场提供足够空间，让动物展现自然行为。
collocations: an animal enclosure｜动物围场 ; a secure enclosure｜牢固的围场 ; the enclosure of land｜圈地
tip_ja: 纸质信函附件可用enclosure；邮件附件用attachment。

meanings_ja: v. 减弱；衰退 | v. 月亮渐亏 | n. 衰退；减弱
definition_en: gradually become weaker, smaller, or less important | show a progressively smaller illuminated part of the moon | a gradual decline, especially in the phrase on the wane
example1_en: My enthusiasm waned after another hour in the queue.
example1_ja: 又排了一个小时的队后，我的热情消退了。
example2_en: Public support for environmental policies may wane if their financial costs are distributed unfairly.
example2_ja: 如果环保政策的经济成本分担不公，公众对这些政策的支持可能会减弱。
collocations: waning interest｜逐渐减退的兴趣 ; on the wane｜正在衰退 ; a waning moon｜渐亏的月亮
tip_ja: 动词通常不及物；on the wane表示正在衰退。

meanings_ja: n. 诱因；激励措施
definition_en: something offered to persuade someone to take a particular action
example1_en: Free delivery was enough inducement to order the sofa.
example1_ja: 免费送货这一优惠足以促使我们订购那张沙发。
example2_en: Financial inducements may encourage households to install solar panels, reducing their dependence on fossil fuels.
example2_ja: 经济激励措施可能促使家庭安装太阳能电池板，减少对化石燃料的依赖。
collocations: financial inducement｜经济激励 ; offer an inducement｜提供激励 ; inducement to invest｜投资诱因
tip_ja: 常指外部提供的奖励或好处，后可接to do。

meanings_ja: n. 物质主义；物质至上 | n. 唯物主义
definition_en: The belief that money and possessions matter most | The philosophical view that everything ultimately consists of matter
example1_en: She dislikes materialism and prefers experiences to expensive possessions.
example1_ja: 她不喜欢物质至上的观念，更看重经历而非昂贵的物品。
example2_en: Critics argue that advertising encourages materialism by linking personal happiness to the purchase of consumer goods.
example2_ja: 批评者认为，广告将个人幸福与购买消费品联系起来，从而助长物质主义。
collocations: consumer materialism｜消费物质主义 ; encourage materialism｜助长物质主义 ; philosophical materialism｜哲学唯物主义 ; historical materialism｜历史唯物主义
tip_ja: 消费话题常指物质至上；哲学语境指唯物主义。

meanings_ja: n. 立场；观点
definition_en: a position from which someone considers or judges something
example1_en: From my standpoint, the smaller flat is more practical.
example1_ja: 在我看来，那套较小的公寓更实用。
example2_en: From an environmental standpoint, investing in public transport is preferable to building more roads for private vehicles.
example2_ja: 从环境角度看，投资公共交通比为私家车修建更多道路更可取。
collocations: from a practical standpoint｜从实际角度看 ; from an economic standpoint｜从经济角度看 ; from someone's standpoint｜从某人的立场看
tip_ja: 常用from a ... standpoint表示“从……角度看”。

meanings_ja: adj. 不利的；有害的；恶劣的
definition_en: Harmful or making success and progress more difficult.
example1_en: Our ferry was cancelled because of adverse weather conditions.
example1_ja: 由于天气恶劣，我们的渡轮航班取消了。
example2_en: Prolonged exposure to traffic noise can have adverse effects on residents' sleep and mental health.
example2_ja: 长期接触交通噪声可能对居民的睡眠和心理健康产生不良影响。
collocations: adverse effects｜不良影响 ; adverse weather conditions｜恶劣天气状况 ; an adverse reaction｜不良反应 ; adverse circumstances｜不利处境
tip_ja: adverse指不利的；averse指反感的，常接to。

meanings_ja: adj. 有秩序的；整齐的 | n. 医院护工；勤务兵
definition_en: well arranged or behaving in a controlled, organised way | a hospital worker doing practical tasks, or a soldier's assistant
example1_en: The children formed an orderly queue outside the classroom.
example1_ja: 孩子们在教室外排起了整齐的队伍。
example2_en: Clear evacuation procedures help ensure an orderly departure from public buildings during emergencies, reducing the risk of injury.
example2_ja: 明确的疏散程序有助于人们在紧急情况下有序撤离公共建筑，降低受伤风险。
collocations: orderly queue｜整齐的队伍 ; orderly manner｜有条不紊的方式 ; orderly evacuation｜有序疏散 ; hospital orderly｜医院护工
tip_ja: 虽以-ly结尾，常作形容词；名词可指医院护工。

meanings_ja: n. 白兰地酒
definition_en: A strong alcoholic drink distilled from wine or fermented fruit juice.
example1_en: The recipe includes a little brandy in the fruit cake.
example1_ja: 这个食谱在水果蛋糕中加入了少量白兰地。
example2_en: Traditional brandy production can support rural employment by creating demand for locally grown grapes and specialist skills.
example2_ja: 传统白兰地生产通过创造对本地葡萄和专业技能的需求，可以促进乡村就业。
collocations: a glass of brandy｜一杯白兰地 ; aged brandy｜陈年白兰地 ; brandy production｜白兰地生产
tip_ja: 通常不可数；a brandy可指一杯白兰地。

meanings_ja: adj. 热情友好的；诚挚的 | n. 浓缩果汁饮料
definition_en: Friendly and polite, often in a formal situation. | A sweet concentrated fruit drink usually diluted with water.
example1_en: Our new neighbours gave us a cordial welcome.
example1_ja: 新邻居热情地欢迎了我们。
example2_en: Maintaining cordial relations between neighbouring countries can encourage cooperation on trade and environmental protection.
example2_ja: 邻国之间保持友好关系有助于促进贸易和环境保护方面的合作。
collocations: cordial welcome｜热情的欢迎 ; cordial relations｜友好关系 ; lime cordial｜青柠浓缩饮料
tip_ja: 形容友好态度较正式；名词在英国常指浓缩果饮。

meanings_ja: n. 缰绳 | v. 控制；约束
definition_en: A strap used by a rider to guide a horse. | To limit or control something, usually with in.
example1_en: The rider gently pulled the reins to stop the horse.
example1_ja: 骑手轻轻拉住缰绳，让马停下来。
example2_en: Governments may need to rein in excessive spending while protecting essential services such as education and healthcare.
example2_ja: 政府可能需要控制过度支出，同时保障教育和医疗等基本服务。
collocations: pull on the reins｜拉缰绳 ; rein in spending｜控制支出 ; give someone free rein｜让某人自由发挥 ; take the reins｜接手掌管
tip_ja: 缰绳常用复数 reins；rein in 表示控制、约束。

meanings_ja: n. 鲤鱼 | v. 挑刺；吹毛求疵
definition_en: A freshwater fish with large scales, often kept in ponds. | To complain repeatedly about small or unimportant faults.
example1_en: We watched a large carp swimming beneath the bridge.
example1_ja: 我们看着一条大鲤鱼在桥下游动。
example2_en: Introducing carp into new habitats can disturb aquatic ecosystems by increasing sediment and reducing water clarity.
example2_ja: 将鲤鱼引入新栖息地可能增加水中泥沙、降低水体透明度，从而扰乱水生生态系统。
collocations: common carp｜普通鲤鱼 ; carp pond｜鲤鱼塘 ; carp at minor faults｜挑小毛病
tip_ja: 鱼名复数通常仍为carp；动词常接at。

meanings_ja: n. 秘书处；行政办事机构
definition_en: An office managing administrative work for a large organisation.
example1_en: Please contact the secretariat to confirm your meeting time.
example1_ja: 请联系秘书处确认你的会议时间。
example2_en: The secretariat coordinates international meetings and ensures that all member countries receive relevant information.
example2_ja: 秘书处协调国际会议，并确保所有成员国收到相关信息。
collocations: a permanent secretariat｜常设秘书处 ; the committee secretariat｜委员会秘书处 ; establish a secretariat｜设立秘书处
tip_ja: 指负责行政工作的机构，不是单个秘书。

meanings_ja: v. 使恶化；降低质量 | v. 降解；分解 | v. 贬低；侮辱人格
definition_en: To reduce the quality or condition of something | To break down chemically into simpler substances | To treat someone as though they deserve no respect
example1_en: Strong sunlight can degrade the fabric of outdoor chairs.
example1_ja: 强烈的阳光会损坏户外椅子的面料。
example2_en: Intensive farming can degrade soil quality, making it harder to grow healthy crops in the future.
example2_ja: 集约化农业可能降低土壤质量，使今后更难种出健康的作物。
collocations: degrade soil quality｜降低土壤质量 ; degrade the environment｜破坏环境 ; degrade over time｜随时间降解
tip_ja: 表示质量下降时可及物；化学降解也可不及物。

meanings_ja: v. 吊起；升起 | n. 起重装置
definition_en: lift something heavy, often using ropes or machinery | a device used for lifting heavy objects
example1_en: We hoisted the heavy suitcase onto the luggage rack.
example1_ja: 我们把沉重的行李箱抬上了行李架。
example2_en: Construction workers use specialised equipment to hoist heavy materials safely, reducing physical strain and workplace injuries.
example2_ja: 建筑工人使用专用设备安全吊起重物，以减轻身体负担并减少工伤。
collocations: hoist a flag｜升旗 ; hoist a sail｜扬帆 ; hoist into position｜吊装就位 ; electric hoist｜电动起重装置
tip_ja: 强调费力抬起或借助绳索、机械吊起。

meanings_ja: n. 癫痫等疾病的突然发作 | n. 扣押；没收；夺取
definition_en: A sudden episode of abnormal electrical activity in the brain. | The act of taking something by force or legal authority.
example1_en: When her brother had a seizure, she called an ambulance.
example1_ja: 她哥哥癫痫发作时，她叫了救护车。
example2_en: Public health campaigns can teach people how to respond safely when someone experiences a seizure.
example2_ja: 公共卫生宣传活动可以教人们如何在他人癫痫发作时安全应对。
collocations: have a seizure｜癫痫发作 ; an epileptic seizure｜癫痫发作 ; seizure of assets｜资产扣押 ; seizure of power｜夺取政权
tip_ja: 医学义常搭配have；扣押某物用seizure of。

meanings_ja: adj. 不对称的 | adj. 不均衡的；不对等的
definition_en: having sides or parts that do not match | unequal between people, groups, or sides
example1_en: The jacket has an asymmetric collar and deep pockets.
example1_ja: 这件夹克的领子不对称，口袋很深。
example2_en: Asymmetric access to market information can place small businesses at a disadvantage when negotiating with larger firms.
example2_ja: 市场信息获取的不对等，可能使小企业在与大公司谈判时处于不利地位。
collocations: asymmetric design｜不对称设计 ; asymmetric information｜不对称信息 ; asymmetric distribution｜不对称分布
tip_ja: 既可指形状不对称，也可指信息或力量不对等。

meanings_ja: adj. 允许的；许可的
definition_en: Allowed by a rule, law, or accepted standard
example1_en: Is it permissible to take photographs inside this museum?
example1_ja: 可以在这家博物馆内拍照吗？
example2_en: Governments should establish clear limits on permissible emissions to protect public health in industrial areas.
example2_ja: 政府应明确规定允许的排放限值，以保护工业区的公众健康。
collocations: permissible limits｜允许的限度 ; legally permissible｜法律允许的 ; permissible levels｜允许的水平
tip_ja: 常用句型：It is permissible to do sth.。

meanings_ja: v. 使复兴；重新流行 | v. 苏醒；使恢复活力
definition_en: to become active or popular again, or make something so | to regain consciousness or energy, or help someone do so
example1_en: Our neighbours hope to revive the annual street party.
example1_ja: 我们的邻居希望恢复一年一度的街头聚会。
example2_en: Investment in public transport could revive declining town centres by making local businesses more accessible.
example2_ja: 投资公共交通可以让人们更方便地光顾当地商家，从而振兴衰落的城镇中心。
collocations: revive the economy｜振兴经济 ; revive interest in｜重新激起对……的兴趣 ; revive a tradition｜恢复传统
tip_ja: 既可及物也可不及物：revive a tradition；hopes revive。

meanings_ja: n. 立体主义
definition_en: An art style showing subjects through geometric shapes and multiple viewpoints.
example1_en: We explored cubism by painting faces with overlapping geometric shapes.
example1_ja: 我们用重叠的几何图形画人脸，探索立体主义风格。
example2_en: Cubism challenged traditional artistic representation by presenting multiple viewpoints within a single image rather than imitating natural appearances.
example2_ja: 立体主义在同一幅图像中呈现多个视角，而非模仿自然外观，从而挑战了传统艺术表现方式。
collocations: the development of cubism｜立体主义的发展 ; analytical cubism｜分析立体主义 ; synthetic cubism｜综合立体主义
tip_ja: 通常不可数；cubist 可指立体派艺术家或作形容词。

meanings_ja: n. 参议员
definition_en: A member of a senate, a lawmaking body
example1_en: The senator listened carefully to concerns at our community meeting.
example1_ja: 这位参议员在我们的社区会议上认真听取了大家的担忧。
example2_en: A senator may propose legislation to improve healthcare access, although approval requires support from other lawmakers.
example2_ja: 参议员可以提出改善医疗服务可及性的法案，但法案获批需要其他立法者的支持。
collocations: elect a senator｜选举参议员 ; serve as a senator｜担任参议员 ; a senior senator｜资深参议员
tip_ja: senator是参议员；senate指参议院。

meanings_ja: v. 使湿透；使淋透
definition_en: To make someone or something completely wet
example1_en: A sudden downpour drenched us on the way home.
example1_ja: 回家途中，一场突如其来的大雨把我们淋透了。
example2_en: Intense storms can drench farmland within minutes, increasing surface runoff and carrying valuable topsoil into nearby rivers.
example2_ja: 猛烈的暴风雨能在几分钟内浸透农田，增加地表径流，并将宝贵的表土冲入附近河流。
collocations: get drenched｜被淋透 ; drenched in sweat｜汗流浃背 ; drench someone with water｜用水把某人浇透
tip_ja: 强调完全湿透；常用被动形式be drenched。

meanings_ja: n. 冷杉；冷杉木
definition_en: An evergreen tree with needle-shaped leaves, or its wood.
example1_en: A tall fir shaded the path behind our cottage.
example1_ja: 一棵高大的冷杉为我们小屋后的路遮阴。
example2_en: Fir forests provide habitats for wildlife and help protect mountain slopes from erosion during heavy rainfall.
example2_ja: 冷杉林为野生动物提供栖息地，并有助于保护山坡免受强降雨侵蚀。
collocations: a fir tree｜一棵冷杉 ; a fir forest｜冷杉林 ; fir needles｜冷杉针叶
tip_ja: fir是冷杉；fur才是毛皮，两词同音。

meanings_ja: n. 住处；生活用房
definition_en: Rooms or buildings where people live
example1_en: Our living quarters were small but warm and comfortable.
example1_ja: 我们的住处虽小，却温暖舒适。
example2_en: Employers should provide safe living quarters for seasonal workers, particularly in remote agricultural regions with limited housing.
example2_ja: 雇主应为季节性工人提供安全的住处，尤其是在住房有限的偏远农业地区。
collocations: cramped living quarters｜狭小的住处 ; staff living quarters｜员工宿舍 ; shared living quarters｜合住的生活用房
tip_ja: 表示住处时用复数living quarters，谓语也用复数。

meanings_ja: v. 兑换；兑现 | v. 弥补；挽回 | v. 赎回
definition_en: exchange a voucher or points for goods, services, or money | make up for a failure or restore a good reputation | recover something by paying the money owed on it
example1_en: You can redeem this voucher for a free lunch.
example1_ja: 你可以用这张代金券兑换一份免费午餐。
example2_en: Retailers increasingly allow customers to redeem loyalty points for products made from recycled materials.
example2_ja: 越来越多的零售商允许顾客用会员积分兑换再生材料制成的产品。
collocations: redeem a voucher｜兑换代金券 ; redeem points｜兑换积分 ; redeem yourself｜挽回声誉 ; redeeming feature｜可取之处
tip_ja: redeem A for B 表示用券或积分A兑换B。

meanings_ja: v. 间接提及；暗指
definition_en: to refer to something without mentioning it directly
example1_en: He alluded to a surprise but gave no details.
example1_ja: 他暗示会有个惊喜，但没有透露细节。
example2_en: The report alludes to funding difficulties without explaining how they might affect the proposed transport improvements.
example2_ja: 报告间接提及资金困难，却没有解释这些困难可能如何影响拟议的交通改善项目。
collocations: allude to a problem｜间接提及问题 ; allude to the past｜隐约谈及过去
tip_ja: 固定用allude to，不直接接宾语；勿混elude。

meanings_ja: n. 无记名投票；投票表决 | n. 选票 | v. 组织投票；投票
definition_en: A process of voting, usually in secret. | A paper or electronic form used to record a vote. | To ask people to vote, or to vote yourself.
example1_en: Our club chose its new chair by secret ballot.
example1_ja: 我们俱乐部以无记名投票的方式选出了新主席。
example2_en: A secret ballot allows citizens to express their political preferences without fear of pressure from others.
example2_ja: 无记名投票让公民能够表达政治倾向，而不必担心他人的施压。
collocations: secret ballot｜无记名投票 ; ballot paper｜选票 ; ballot box｜投票箱 ; hold a ballot｜举行投票
tip_ja: ballot侧重投票程序或选票；by secret ballot指无记名投票。

meanings_ja: n. 鱼雷 | v. 彻底破坏；使失败
definition_en: an underwater weapon that propels itself towards a target | to deliberately cause a plan or agreement to fail
example1_en: We saw an old torpedo at the maritime museum.
example1_ja: 我们在海事博物馆看到了一枚旧鱼雷。
example2_en: Unexpected funding cuts could torpedo plans to expand public transport in rapidly growing urban areas.
example2_ja: 意料之外的资金削减可能使快速发展城区的公共交通扩建计划落空。
collocations: launch a torpedo｜发射鱼雷 ; torpedo tube｜鱼雷发射管 ; torpedo a plan｜破坏计划
tip_ja: 鱼雷是torpedo；水雷是mine。复数为torpedoes。

meanings_ja: n. 混乱；杂乱
definition_en: A state of disorder or lack of organisation.
example1_en: The kitchen was in disarray after our baking afternoon.
example1_ja: 我们做了一下午烘焙后，厨房一片狼藉。
example2_en: Without clear leadership, emergency planning can fall into disarray, leaving communities poorly prepared for extreme weather.
example2_ja: 缺乏明确的领导，应急规划就可能陷入混乱，导致社区无法充分应对极端天气。
collocations: in disarray｜处于混乱中 ; throw into disarray｜使陷入混乱 ; complete disarray｜彻底混乱
tip_ja: 常作不可数名词，常用in disarray表示处于混乱。

meanings_ja: n. 输送管道 | n. 供应渠道；开发流程
definition_en: A long pipe carrying liquids or gas between places. | A system through which things are supplied or developed.
example1_en: Workers repaired the water pipeline beneath our street today.
example1_ja: 工人今天修好了我们街道下方的输水管道。
example2_en: A new gas pipeline could improve energy security, but its construction may damage sensitive wildlife habitats.
example2_ja: 新建天然气管道可以增强能源安全，但施工可能破坏脆弱的野生动物栖息地。
collocations: a gas pipeline｜天然气管道 ; an oil pipeline｜输油管道 ; in the pipeline｜在筹备中 ; a development pipeline｜开发流程
tip_ja: in the pipeline常指项目正在筹备或推进中。

meanings_ja: n. 男爵 | n. 行业巨头；大亨
definition_en: A man holding a low-ranking title of nobility. | A wealthy person with great power in a particular industry.
example1_en: The baron welcomed his guests into the castle courtyard.
example1_ja: 男爵迎接客人们来到城堡庭院。
example2_en: Media barons can influence public debate through their ownership of major newspapers and television networks.
example2_ja: 传媒大亨可以凭借对主要报纸和电视网的所有权影响公共讨论。
collocations: a media baron｜传媒大亨 ; a press baron｜报业大亨 ; an oil baron｜石油大亨
tip_ja: 本义为男爵；行业名词加baron可指该行业大亨。

meanings_ja: adj. 微温的；不冷不热的 | adj. 冷淡的；不热心的
definition_en: Only slightly warm, sometimes cooler than desired. | Showing little enthusiasm or support.
example1_en: My soup was lukewarm by the time I sat down.
example1_ja: 等我坐下时，汤已经不怎么热了。
example2_en: The proposal received a lukewarm response from residents, who doubted whether it would improve public transport.
example2_ja: 居民对这项提议反应冷淡，怀疑它能否改善公共交通。
collocations: lukewarm water｜温水 ; lukewarm response｜冷淡的回应 ; lukewarm support｜不积极的支持
tip_ja: 既可形容温度微温，也可形容态度冷淡。

meanings_ja: adv. 傲慢地；自大地
definition_en: In a way that suggests superiority to other people.
example1_en: He arrogantly dismissed my suggestion without even listening.
example1_ja: 他连听都没听，就傲慢地否定了我的建议。
example2_en: Managers who behave arrogantly may discourage employees from sharing ideas that could improve workplace efficiency.
example2_ja: 行为傲慢的管理者可能使员工不愿分享那些能提高工作效率的想法。
collocations: behave arrogantly｜举止傲慢 ; speak arrogantly｜说话傲慢 ; arrogantly dismiss｜傲慢地否定
tip_ja: 带贬义；自信地通常用confidently。

meanings_ja: n. 小丸；小颗粒
definition_en: A small, rounded or cylindrical piece of compressed material.
example1_en: Each rabbit received a few food pellets with fresh vegetables.
example1_ja: 每只兔子都分到了一些颗粒饲料和新鲜蔬菜。
example2_en: Heating systems that burn wood pellets can reduce reliance on fossil fuels when the wood is sustainably sourced.
example2_ja: 如果木材来源可持续，燃烧木颗粒的供暖系统可以减少对化石燃料的依赖。
collocations: wood pellets｜木质颗粒燃料 ; food pellets｜颗粒饲料 ; plastic pellets｜塑料颗粒
tip_ja: 指成形的小颗粒，常见于饲料、燃料等。

meanings_ja: v. 遵守；坚持 | v. 黏附；附着
definition_en: To follow a rule, belief, or agreement closely. | To stick firmly to a surface.
example1_en: Everyone must adhere to the rules in this pool.
example1_ja: 每个人都必须遵守这个游泳池的规定。
example2_en: Researchers must adhere to strict ethical standards when collecting personal information from participants in health studies.
example2_ja: 研究人员在收集健康研究参与者的个人信息时，必须遵守严格的伦理标准。
collocations: adhere to guidelines｜遵循指导原则 ; adhere to principles｜坚持原则 ; adhere to a surface｜黏附于表面
tip_ja: 两种常见义都用adhere to；to是介词。

meanings_ja: adj. 多石的；铺满石头的 | adj. 冷漠的；毫无表情的
definition_en: covered with or containing many stones | showing no warmth, sympathy, or emotion
example1_en: We followed a stony path down to the beach.
example1_ja: 我们沿着一条满是石头的小路走到海滩。
example2_en: Farmers working on stony ground often face higher costs when preparing land for cultivation.
example2_ja: 在多石土地上耕作的农民，整地时往往面临更高的成本。
collocations: stony ground｜多石的土地 ; a stony path｜满是石头的小路 ; stony silence｜冷冰冰的沉默 ; a stony expression｜冷漠的表情
tip_ja: stony silence 指冷漠或不悦的沉默，并非普通安静。

meanings_ja: v. 使瘫痪；使麻痹 | v. 使停摆；使无法行动
definition_en: Make someone unable to move all or part of their body. | Prevent a system from functioning or a person from acting.
example1_en: Some spinal injuries can paralyze both of a person's legs.
example1_ja: 某些脊柱损伤会导致双腿瘫痪。
example2_en: Severe flooding can paralyze urban transport networks, preventing workers from reaching essential services and workplaces.
example2_ja: 严重洪灾会使城市交通网络瘫痪，导致劳动者无法前往基本服务场所和工作地点。
collocations: paralyze transport｜使交通瘫痪 ; paralyzed by fear｜吓得无法动弹 ; partially paralyzed｜部分瘫痪
tip_ja: 美式拼写paralyze；英式通常写paralyse。

meanings_ja: n. 堂区；基层行政区 | n. 堂区全体居民
definition_en: A local church district, or a small administrative area. | The people living in a particular church district.
example1_en: Our parish has a small church beside the river.
example1_ja: 我们堂区有一座小教堂，就在河边。
example2_en: Rural parish councils can help maintain public footpaths and protect green spaces for local residents.
example2_ja: 乡村基层议会可以协助维护公共步道，并为当地居民保护绿地。
collocations: parish church｜堂区教堂 ; parish priest｜堂区神父 ; parish council｜堂区议会
tip_ja: 教会语境指堂区，比主教管辖的diocese小。

meanings_ja: adj. 庞大笨重的；占空间的
definition_en: Large and awkward to carry, move, or store.
example1_en: This bulky suitcase barely fits inside the small cupboard.
example1_ja: 这个大行李箱勉强能塞进那只小柜子。
example2_en: Compact furniture is increasingly popular because bulky items can make small urban apartments feel overcrowded.
example2_ja: 紧凑型家具越来越受欢迎，因为体积庞大的家具会让城市小公寓显得拥挤。
collocations: bulky furniture｜大件家具 ; bulky items｜大件物品 ; bulky equipment｜体积庞大的设备
tip_ja: bulky强调体积大、占空间，不一定很重。

meanings_ja: n. 迷人魅力；华丽气质
definition_en: An exciting attractiveness associated with beauty, wealth, or fame.
example1_en: Her sparkling earrings added glamour to a simple outfit.
example1_ja: 她闪亮的耳环为朴素的衣着增添了华丽气质。
example2_en: The apparent glamour of careers in entertainment can obscure the financial insecurity many performers experience.
example2_ja: 娱乐行业看似光鲜的职业可能掩盖许多表演者面临的经济不稳定。
collocations: add glamour to｜为……增添魅力 ; the glamour of fame｜名声的光环 ; Hollywood glamour｜好莱坞式的华丽魅力
tip_ja: 通常不可数；美式也写glamor。

meanings_ja: n. 马克思主义
definition_en: Marx's theories concerning class conflict, capitalism, and a classless society.
example1_en: Our reading group discussed Marxism at the library yesterday.
example1_ja: 昨天我们的读书小组在图书馆讨论了马克思主义。
example2_en: Marxism has influenced academic debates about economic inequality, ownership of resources, and the relationship between social classes.
example2_ja: 马克思主义影响了关于经济不平等、资源所有权以及社会阶级关系的学术讨论。
collocations: study Marxism｜研究马克思主义 ; classical Marxism｜古典马克思主义 ; Marxism and class struggle｜马克思主义与阶级斗争
tip_ja: 首字母大写，通常为不可数名词；Marxist可指人。

meanings_ja: n. 忧虑；担心 | n. 逮捕；拘捕
definition_en: Worry that something unpleasant may happen. | The act of catching and arresting someone suspected of a crime.
example1_en: She felt some apprehension before her first driving lesson.
example1_ja: 上第一节驾驶课之前，她有些忐忑。
example2_en: Public apprehension about new technologies may decrease when governments explain potential risks and introduce clear safety standards.
example2_ja: 当政府解释潜在风险并制定明确的安全标准时，公众对新技术的忧虑可能会减轻。
collocations: apprehension about｜对……的忧虑 ; a sense of apprehension｜忧虑感 ; with apprehension｜担忧地
tip_ja: 常指对未来的担忧，常接about；逮捕义较正式。

meanings_ja: v. 保护；保障 | n. 保护措施；保障
definition_en: To protect someone or something from harm or loss. | A measure that prevents harm, loss, or unfair treatment.
example1_en: These padded covers safeguard the furniture during the move.
example1_ja: 这些加厚护套在搬家时保护家具。
example2_en: Governments should introduce stronger regulations to safeguard personal information collected by online services and mobile applications.
example2_ja: 政府应出台更严格的法规，保护在线服务和移动应用收集的个人信息。
collocations: safeguard rights｜保障权利 ; safeguard personal information｜保护个人信息 ; a safeguard against fraud｜防范欺诈的措施
tip_ja: 动词常接权益等宾语；名词常接against表示防范对象。

meanings_ja: n. 穿透；渗透 | n. 市场渗透；普及程度
definition_en: The process of entering or passing through something. | The extent to which a product reaches a market.
example1_en: These thick curtains reduce the penetration of sunlight.
example1_ja: 这些厚窗帘减少了阳光的透入。
example2_en: Greater internet penetration in rural areas can improve access to education and support the growth of small businesses.
example2_ja: 提高农村地区的互联网普及率，有助于改善教育获取条件并支持小企业发展。
collocations: water penetration｜水分渗透 ; market penetration｜市场渗透 ; internet penetration｜互联网普及程度
tip_ja: 由penetrate派生；常用penetration of或into。

meanings_ja: n. 垮台；败落 | n. 失败的原因
definition_en: The loss of power, success, or social position. | Something that causes a person or organisation to fail.
example1_en: His refusal to listen eventually led to his downfall.
example1_ja: 他拒绝听取意见，最终导致自己失败。
example2_en: Widespread corruption can trigger the downfall of a government by destroying public trust in its institutions.
example2_ja: 普遍存在的腐败会摧毁公众对政府机构的信任，从而引发政府垮台。
collocations: lead to someone's downfall｜导致某人垮台 ; bring about the downfall of｜促使……败落 ; prove to be someone's downfall｜最终成为某人失败的原因
tip_ja: 指垮台或败因；倾盆大雨应说downpour。

meanings_ja: n. 愤慨；义愤 | v. 使愤慨；激怒 | n. 骇人行径；暴行
definition_en: Intense anger caused by something deeply unfair or wrong | To make someone extremely angry through unacceptable behaviour | An act that is shockingly wrong or unacceptable
example1_en: Residents expressed outrage when workers cut down the ancient tree.
example1_ja: 工人砍倒那棵古树时，居民们表达了强烈愤慨。
example2_en: Public outrage over river pollution prompted the government to introduce stricter controls on industrial waste.
example2_ja: 公众对河流污染的愤慨促使政府对工业废弃物实施更严格的管控。
collocations: public outrage｜公众的愤慨 ; spark outrage｜激起公愤 ; express outrage｜表达愤慨 ; an outrage against humanity｜反人类暴行
tip_ja: 表愤慨通常不可数；an outrage指骇人行径。

meanings_ja: n. 恳求；请求 | n. 认罪或不认罪的答辩
definition_en: An urgent, emotional request for something. | A formal statement admitting or denying guilt in court.
example1_en: They heard our plea for help and stopped immediately.
example1_ja: 他们听见我们的求助声，立刻停了下来。
example2_en: Residents made a plea for better flood protection after repeated storms damaged homes across the region.
example2_ja: 多次暴风雨损坏该地区房屋后，居民恳请加强防洪措施。
collocations: a plea for help｜恳求帮助 ; make a plea｜提出恳求 ; a guilty plea｜认罪答辩 ; enter a plea｜正式作出答辩
tip_ja: plea for后接所求之物；plea to后接请求对象。

meanings_ja: v. 宣布非法；禁止 | n. 逃犯；亡命之徒
definition_en: to make an activity illegal | a criminal who lives outside the law
example1_en: The new rules outlaw dumping rubbish beside the river.
example1_ja: 新规定禁止在河边倾倒垃圾。
example2_en: Governments should outlaw the sale of products made from endangered species to discourage illegal hunting.
example2_ja: 政府应禁止销售用濒危物种制成的产品，以遏制非法捕猎。
collocations: outlaw a practice｜禁止某种做法 ; outlaw discrimination｜宣布歧视行为非法 ; a notorious outlaw｜臭名昭著的逃犯
tip_ja: 作动词时直接接被禁止的行为或事物。

meanings_ja: adj. 麻烦的；令人烦恼的
definition_en: causing problems, difficulty, or annoyance
example1_en: This troublesome lock jams whenever the weather turns cold.
example1_ja: 每当天气变冷，这把烦人的锁就会卡住。
example2_en: Unreliable public transport is particularly troublesome for workers who depend on buses to reach jobs outside city centres.
example2_ja: 对于依赖公交车前往市中心以外地区上班的人来说，公共交通不可靠尤其令人困扰。
collocations: a troublesome issue｜棘手的问题 ; a troublesome cough｜恼人的咳嗽 ; particularly troublesome｜尤其麻烦的
tip_ja: troublesome指造成麻烦；troubled指自身遇到困扰。

meanings_ja: adj. 间歇的；断断续续的
definition_en: Stopping and starting repeatedly rather than continuing without a break.
example1_en: Intermittent rain kept us running indoors throughout the afternoon.
example1_ja: 整个下午，断断续续的雨让我们不时跑回屋里。
example2_en: Intermittent internet access can prevent rural students from participating fully in online learning programmes.
example2_ja: 网络连接时断时续，会妨碍农村学生充分参与在线学习课程。
collocations: intermittent rain｜阵阵降雨 ; intermittent supply｜断续供应 ; intermittent noise｜间歇性噪声
tip_ja: 强调时停时续，不一定按固定周期发生。

meanings_ja: adj. 公正的；不偏不倚的
definition_en: Treating all sides fairly without favouring anyone.
example1_en: We asked an impartial neighbour to settle our disagreement.
example1_ja: 我们请一位公正的邻居来调解我们的分歧。
example2_en: An impartial judicial system is essential for protecting individual rights and maintaining public confidence in government institutions.
example2_ja: 公正的司法体系对于保护个人权利和维持公众对政府机构的信任至关重要。
collocations: impartial advice｜公正的建议 ; impartial judge｜公正的法官 ; remain impartial｜保持公正
tip_ja: partial 可表示偏袒的；impartial 表示不偏袒。

meanings_ja: n. 分歧；差异 | n. 分叉；分离
definition_en: A difference between opinions, approaches, or developments. | Movement apart in different directions from a common point.
example1_en: Our discussion revealed a clear divergence in our priorities.
example1_ja: 我们的讨论表明，双方对于事情的轻重缓急有明显分歧。
example2_en: The growing divergence between urban and rural incomes may require more targeted regional development policies.
example2_ja: 城乡收入差距不断扩大，可能需要更有针对性的区域发展政策。
collocations: divergence of opinion｜意见分歧 ; divergence between｜……之间的差异 ; growing divergence｜不断扩大的差异
tip_ja: 常用between连接差异双方；动词为diverge。

meanings_ja: v. 放大 | v. 夸大；加剧
definition_en: To make something appear larger, especially through a lens. | To make something seem more important or become more serious.
example1_en: This lens magnifies tiny insects so we can examine them.
example1_ja: 这个镜头能放大小昆虫，方便我们观察。
example2_en: Social media can magnify public concerns by repeatedly exposing users to dramatic accounts of rare events.
example2_ja: 社交媒体反复向用户展示对罕见事件的夸张描述，可能放大公众的担忧。
collocations: magnify an image｜放大图像 ; magnify a problem｜加剧问题 ; magnifying glass｜放大镜
tip_ja: 既可指视觉放大，也可指夸大问题或加剧影响。

meanings_ja: adj. 坦率的；直言不讳的 | adj. 抓拍的；非摆拍的
definition_en: Honest and direct, even about uncomfortable subjects. | Photographed naturally without being asked to pose.
example1_en: Please give me your candid opinion of my cooking.
example1_ja: 请坦率地评价一下我的厨艺。
example2_en: Candid discussions between teachers and parents can help identify problems before they affect academic progress.
example2_ja: 教师与家长坦诚交流，有助于在问题影响学业进步之前发现它们。
collocations: a candid assessment｜坦率的评估 ; be candid about｜坦率谈论 ; a candid photograph｜抓拍照片
tip_ja: 谈人或言论指坦率；谈照片指非摆拍。

meanings_ja: v. 悲痛；哀悼 | v. 使悲伤
definition_en: To feel deep sadness, especially after someone's death | To cause someone deep sadness

example1_ja: 我们仍在为去年春天去世的猫难过。
example2_en: Employers should offer compassionate leave so that workers have time to grieve after losing a family member.
example2_ja: 雇主应提供丧假，让员工在失去家人后有时间哀悼。
collocations: grieve for someone｜为某人哀痛 ; grieve over a loss｜为失去而悲伤 ; time to grieve｜哀悼的时间
tip_ja: grieve for常接逝者；grieve over常接损失或不幸。

meanings_ja: n. 检修孔；人孔
definition_en: An opening allowing workers to reach underground pipes or equipment.
example1_en: The worker lifted the heavy cover from the manhole.
example1_ja: 工人掀开了检修孔上沉重的盖子。
example2_en: Regular inspections through manholes help engineers identify damage to urban drainage systems before serious flooding occurs.
example2_ja: 通过检修孔进行定期检查，有助于工程师在严重洪灾发生前发现城市排水系统的损坏。

meanings_ja: adj. 无形的；难以衡量的
definition_en: Not physically touchable or easily measured, but still real or valuable

example1_ja: 她热情的迎接赋予这所房子一种难以言说的魅力。
example2_en: Public parks offer intangible benefits, including a stronger sense of belonging and improved community relationships.
example2_ja: 公共公园带来无形的益处，包括更强的归属感和更融洽的社区关系。
collocations: intangible benefits｜无形的益处 ; intangible assets｜无形资产 ; intangible cultural heritage｜非物质文化遗产
tip_ja: 不仅指摸不到，也指价值等难以量化。

meanings_ja: v. 唤起；引起
definition_en: to bring a feeling, memory or image into someone's mind
example1_en: The smell of fresh bread evokes memories of home.
example1_ja: 新鲜面包的香味唤起了对家的回忆。
example2_en: Traditional music can evoke a strong sense of belonging among people living far from their homeland.
example2_ja: 传统音乐能在远离故土的人们心中唤起强烈的归属感。
collocations: evoke memories｜唤起回忆 ; evoke emotions｜激起情感 ; evoke an image｜唤起画面 ; evoke sympathy｜引起同情
tip_ja: 直接接情感、回忆等宾语，不加of。

meanings_ja: adj. 潜在的；未来可能的
definition_en: Likely or hoping to become something in the future.
example1_en: The agent showed three prospective buyers around our flat.
example1_ja: 房产中介带三位潜在买家参观了我们的公寓。
example2_en: Universities should provide prospective students with clear information about tuition fees, course content, and career opportunities.
example2_ja: 大学应向有意入学的学生提供关于学费、课程内容及就业机会的清晰信息。
collocations: prospective students｜有意入学的学生 ; prospective buyers｜潜在买家 ; prospective employers｜潜在雇主
tip_ja: 常放名词前；勿与perspective“视角”混淆。

meanings_ja: n. 搬家工人；搬家公司 | n. 推动者；发起者
definition_en: A person or company paid to move furniture and belongings. | Someone who actively helps make a change or project happen.
example1_en: The movers carefully carried our sofa down the stairs.
example1_ja: 搬家工人小心地把我们的沙发搬下楼。
example2_en: Local businesses were prime movers in the campaign to improve public spaces and attract visitors.
example2_ja: 当地企业是改善公共空间、吸引游客这一活动的主要推动者。
collocations: hire movers｜雇搬家工人 ; a prime mover｜主要推动者 ; movers and shakers｜有影响力的人物
tip_ja: 搬家工人义多见于美式；prime mover指主要推动者。

meanings_ja: n. 选区居民；选民 | n. 组成部分；成分 | adj. 组成的；构成的
definition_en: a person living in an area represented by an elected official | one of the parts or substances that form something | forming part of a larger whole
example1_en: A constituent asked her local representative about the closed library.
example1_ja: 一位选区居民向当地民意代表询问图书馆关闭的事。
example2_en: Elected representatives should consult their constituents before supporting policies that significantly affect local housing and public transport.
example2_ja: 民选代表在支持对当地住房和公共交通有重大影响的政策之前，应征询选区居民的意见。
collocations: local constituents｜当地选区居民 ; constituent parts｜组成部分 ; a major constituent｜主要成分
tip_ja: 选民义可含未投票的选区居民；成分义近component。

meanings_ja: adj. 大都市的；都市圈的
definition_en: relating to a large city and its surrounding communities
example1_en: Our metropolitan rail network connects the suburbs to downtown.
example1_ja: 我们的都市铁路网连接郊区与市中心。
example2_en: Efficient public transport across metropolitan areas can reduce traffic congestion and improve access to employment opportunities.
example2_ja: 覆盖都市圈的高效公共交通能缓解交通拥堵，并让人们更便捷地获得就业机会。
collocations: metropolitan area｜都市圈 ; metropolitan region｜大都市地区 ; metropolitan population｜都市人口
tip_ja: 不专指首都；metropolitan area通常包括市区和周边郊区。

meanings_ja: prep. 在……之中
definition_en: Surrounded by something, or during a particular situation
example1_en: We found a quiet bench amidst the flowering trees.
example1_ja: 我们在开花的树丛中找到了一张安静的长椅。
example2_en: Amidst growing concerns about air quality, several cities have expanded their networks of protected cycle lanes.
example2_ja: 随着人们日益担忧空气质量，一些城市扩大了设有隔离设施的自行车道网络。
collocations: amidst uncertainty｜在不确定的局势中 ; amidst growing concerns｜在日益加剧的担忧中 ; amidst the chaos｜在混乱之中
tip_ja: 与amid同义，语气较正式；后接名词或名词短语。

meanings_ja: adj. 熟悉的；通晓的
definition_en: Familiar with a subject and able to discuss it
example1_en: Our new guide is conversant with the area's history.
example1_ja: 我们的新导游熟悉这一地区的历史。
example2_en: Graduates entering the technology sector should be conversant with current debates about privacy and data protection.
example2_ja: 进入科技行业的毕业生应熟悉当前有关隐私与数据保护的讨论。
collocations: conversant with｜熟悉……的 ; fully conversant with｜完全熟悉……的 ; conversant with procedures｜熟悉流程的
tip_ja: 常用be conversant with，表示熟悉某领域，并非有交情。

meanings_ja: n. 语音学
definition_en: The study of speech sounds and how people produce them.
example1_en: We studied phonetics to understand how speech sounds are produced.
example1_ja: 我们学习语音学，以了解语音是如何产生的。
example2_en: Training in phonetics can help language teachers explain pronunciation differences that learners may struggle to hear.
example2_ja: 语音学训练能帮助语言教师解释学习者可能难以听辨的发音差异。
collocations: study phonetics｜学习语音学 ; articulatory phonetics｜发音语音学 ; acoustic phonetics｜声学语音学
tip_ja: 虽以-s结尾，作学科名时通常接单数谓语。

meanings_ja: n. 仔细考虑；商议 | n. 从容审慎；不慌不忙
definition_en: Careful thought or discussion before making a decision. | A slow, careful, and intentional way of doing something.

example1_ja: 经过反复考虑，我们选择了那套较小的公寓。
example2_en: Decisions about major transport projects require careful deliberation because their effects can last for decades.
example2_ja: 重大交通项目的决策需要慎重考虑，因为其影响可能持续数十年。
collocations: after much deliberation｜经过反复考虑 ; careful deliberation｜慎重考虑 ; with deliberation｜从容审慎地
tip_ja: 表商议过程可用复数deliberations；勿一律译为故意。

meanings_ja: n. 限制；制约因素 | n. 拘束；克制
definition_en: Something that limits what you can do. | Control that prevents free or natural behaviour.
example1_en: Our main constraint is the size of the kitchen.
example1_ja: 我们的主要限制是厨房的大小。
example2_en: Financial constraints prevent many local authorities from investing adequately in reliable public transport.
example2_ja: 财政限制使许多地方政府无法充分投资于可靠的公共交通。
collocations: time constraints｜时间限制 ; financial constraints｜财务限制 ; a constraint on growth｜对增长的制约 ; within budget constraints｜在预算限制内
tip_ja: 常用复数constraints；对……的限制用on。

meanings_ja: n. 繁殖；增殖 | n. 传播；扩散 | n. 波的传播
definition_en: The production of new plants or other living organisms. | The spreading of ideas, information, or beliefs. | The movement of waves or signals through a medium.
example1_en: Plant propagation is easier with healthy cuttings and clean tools.
example1_ja: 使用健康的插条和干净的工具，繁殖植物会更容易。
example2_en: The rapid propagation of misleading information online can undermine public trust in reliable scientific evidence.
example2_ja: 误导性信息在网上迅速传播，会削弱公众对可靠科学证据的信任。
collocations: plant propagation｜植物繁殖 ; propagation by cuttings｜扦插繁殖 ; wave propagation｜波的传播 ; propagation of ideas｜思想传播
tip_ja: 通常不可数；可用于植物繁殖、信息传播及波传播。

meanings_ja: v. 阻止；使打消念头
definition_en: To discourage an action by making it seem difficult or risky.
example1_en: The heavy rain did not deter our determined hikers.
example1_ja: 大雨没有让我们坚定的徒步者打退堂鼓。
example2_en: Higher parking fees may deter commuters from driving into city centres during peak hours.
example2_ja: 提高停车费可能使通勤者不愿在高峰时段开车进入市中心。
collocations: deter someone from doing something｜阻止某人做某事 ; deter crime｜遏制犯罪 ; deter potential customers｜使潜在顾客却步
tip_ja: 用deter sb from doing；过去式为deterred。

meanings_ja: v. 搁置；暂缓 | v. 把…放上架子
definition_en: to stop considering or working on something for now | to put something on a shelf
example1_en: We shelved our holiday plans when the car broke down.
example1_ja: 汽车坏了，我们便暂时搁置了度假计划。
example2_en: The council decided to shelve the road expansion project because of concerns about air pollution.
example2_ja: 由于担心空气污染，地方议会决定暂缓道路扩建项目。
collocations: shelve a plan｜搁置计划 ; shelve a proposal｜暂缓考虑提案 ; shelve books｜把书放上书架
tip_ja: shelve作动词；shelf是名词，复数为shelves。

meanings_ja: v. 大量侵扰；成群寄生于
definition_en: To live in a place in large, harmful or unwanted groups.
example1_en: Tiny insects have infested the flour in our cupboard.
example1_ja: 我们橱柜里的面粉生了许多小虫。
example2_en: Rats can infest poorly maintained housing, creating serious health risks for residents in densely populated areas.
example2_ja: 老鼠可能在维护不善的住房中大量出没，给人口密集地区的居民带来严重健康风险。
collocations: be infested with rats｜老鼠成灾 ; infest crops｜侵害庄稼 ; insect-infested buildings｜虫害严重的建筑
tip_ja: 常用be infested with，主语是受虫鼠侵扰处。

meanings_ja: v. 是……的特征 | v. 描述……的特点
definition_en: To be a typical or distinguishing feature of something. | To describe the main qualities of someone or something.
example1_en: Bright colours and bold patterns characterize her handmade bags.
example1_ja: 鲜艳的色彩和醒目的图案是她手工包的特色。
example2_en: High housing costs and limited public space characterize many large cities, affecting residents' quality of life.
example2_ja: 住房成本高、公共空间有限是许多大城市的特点，影响着居民的生活质量。
collocations: be characterized by｜以……为特征 ; characterize something as｜将某事物描述为
tip_ja: 英式也拼characterise；被动式常接by。

meanings_ja: n. 附近；周边地区
definition_en: The area near a particular place.
example1_en: There are several quiet cafés in the vicinity.
example1_ja: 附近有几家安静的咖啡馆。
example2_en: Building new housing in the vicinity of railway stations can reduce car dependence and shorten daily commutes.
example2_ja: 在火车站周边新建住房，可以减少对汽车的依赖并缩短日常通勤时间。
collocations: in the vicinity of｜在……附近 ; the immediate vicinity｜紧邻地区
tip_ja: 常用in the vicinity of，比near更正式。

meanings_ja: adj. 不足的；少得可怜的
definition_en: barely enough, or less than is needed
example1_en: We had scant time to pack before the taxi arrived.
example1_ja: 出租车到达前，我们几乎没时间收拾行李。
example2_en: There is scant evidence that longer working hours consistently lead to higher productivity across different industries.
example2_ja: 几乎没有证据表明，延长工时能在不同行业中持续带来更高的生产率。
collocations: scant evidence｜少得可怜的证据 ; scant attention｜极少的关注 ; scant regard for｜对……几乎不重视
tip_ja: 强调少到不够，多用于名词前，如scant evidence。

meanings_ja: adj. 不稳固的；摇摇欲坠的 | adj. 不稳定的；岌岌可危的
definition_en: not securely positioned and likely to fall | uncertain and likely to become dangerous or unsuccessful
example1_en: The ladder looked precarious on the wet, uneven ground.
example1_ja: 梯子架在湿滑不平的地面上，看起来摇摇欲坠。
example2_en: Workers on short-term contracts often face precarious financial circumstances, making it difficult to plan for the future.
example2_ja: 短期合同工往往面临不稳定的经济状况，难以规划未来。
collocations: a precarious position｜岌岌可危的处境 ; precarious employment｜不稳定的就业 ; a precarious balance｜不稳固的平衡 ; precarious finances｜不稳定的财务状况
tip_ja: 不仅表示“不稳定”，还暗含随时出问题的风险。

meanings_ja: v. 施加；运用 | v. 使自己努力；尽力
definition_en: To apply force, influence, or authority. | To make a strong physical or mental effort.
example1_en: You must exert steady pressure to open this lid.
example1_ja: 你得持续用力才能打开这个盖子。
example2_en: Parents can exert considerable influence on children's eating habits by preparing balanced meals at home.
example2_ja: 父母可以通过在家准备营养均衡的饭菜，对孩子的饮食习惯产生很大影响。
collocations: exert pressure on｜向……施加压力 ; exert influence over｜对……施加影响 ; exert yourself｜使自己努力
tip_ja: 常接pressure、influence；exert oneself意为尽力。

meanings_ja: v. 回忆起；记起
definition_en: remember something from the past, sometimes with effort
example1_en: I clearly recollect meeting her outside the village bakery.
example1_ja: 我清楚地记得曾在村里的面包店外遇见她。
example2_en: Older residents often recollect a time when public spaces played a greater role in community life.
example2_ja: 年长居民常常回忆起公共空间在社区生活中发挥更大作用的年代。
collocations: clearly recollect｜清楚地记得 ; recollect doing something｜记得做过某事 ; as far as I recollect｜据我回忆
tip_ja: 比remember正式；用recollect doing，不用to do。

meanings_ja: n. 吊唁；慰问
definition_en: Sympathy expressed to someone whose relative or friend has died.
example1_en: Our neighbours sent a heartfelt message of condolence.
example1_ja: 邻居们送来了真挚的慰问。
example2_en: Public expressions of condolence can help bereaved families feel supported by their wider community.
example2_ja: 公开表达哀思可以让丧亲家庭感受到整个社区的支持。
collocations: offer condolences｜表示慰问 ; a message of condolence｜慰问信息 ; sincere condolences｜诚挚的哀悼
tip_ja: 常用复数：offer condolences to someone。

meanings_ja: adj. 休眠的；暂不活跃的
definition_en: temporarily inactive but able to become active again
example1_en: These plants stay dormant until the weather becomes warmer.
example1_ja: 这些植物会保持休眠状态，直到天气转暖。
example2_en: Although the volcano has remained dormant for centuries, scientists continue to monitor it for signs of renewed activity.
example2_ja: 尽管这座火山已经休眠了数百年，科学家仍持续监测它是否有再次活动的迹象。
collocations: dormant volcano｜休眠火山 ; lie dormant｜处于休眠状态 ; dormant seeds｜休眠种子 ; dormant account｜长期未使用的账户
tip_ja: 指暂不活动但可能恢复；休眠火山不等于死火山。

meanings_ja: n. 志业；使命感 | n. 职业
definition_en: work you feel strongly suited or called to do | a particular occupation, especially one requiring training
example1_en: Caring for injured animals became her vocation early in life.
example1_ja: 照顾受伤动物很早就成为她立志从事的事业。
example2_en: Career guidance should help young people discover a vocation that matches their abilities and values.
example2_ja: 职业指导应帮助年轻人找到符合自身能力和价值观的志业。
collocations: find one's vocation｜找到自己的志业 ; a sense of vocation｜职业使命感 ; a vocation for teaching｜从事教学的志向
tip_ja: 常含使命感或天职之意；勿与vacation（假期）混淆。

meanings_ja: v. 使倒置；使颠倒
definition_en: To turn something upside down or reverse its order.
example1_en: Invert the bowl carefully to release the jelly.
example1_ja: 小心地把碗倒扣过来，让果冻脱模。
example2_en: Researchers can invert the usual teaching sequence by asking students to explore problems before receiving formal explanations.
example2_ja: 研究人员可以颠倒通常的教学顺序，让学生先探究问题，再接受正式讲解。
collocations: invert a container｜倒置容器 ; invert the order｜颠倒顺序 ; invert an image｜翻转图像
tip_ja: 通常是及物动词；倒置的用inverted。

meanings_ja: v. 促使发生；引发 | n. 沉淀物 | adj. 仓促的；鲁莽的
definition_en: To cause something to happen suddenly or sooner than expected. | A solid that forms in a liquid during a chemical reaction. | Done too quickly and without enough thought.
example1_en: A broken pipe precipitated an emergency visit from the plumber.
example1_ja: 水管破裂，水管工因此紧急上门维修。
example2_en: A sharp increase in food prices could precipitate a wider economic crisis in vulnerable regions.
example2_ja: 食品价格大幅上涨可能在脆弱地区引发更广泛的经济危机。
collocations: precipitate a crisis｜引发危机 ; precipitate change｜促成变化 ; form a precipitate｜形成沉淀物 ; precipitate action｜仓促的行动
tip_ja: 动词末尾读/teɪt/，名词、形容词读/tət/。

meanings_ja: adj. 怀疑他人动机的；愤世嫉俗的 | adj. 损人利己的；不顾道义的
definition_en: believing people act selfishly rather than honestly or generously | using others selfishly without concern for fairness or honesty
example1_en: Leah is cynical about shops offering supposedly free gifts.
example1_ja: 莉娅对商店所谓的免费赠礼持怀疑态度。
example2_en: Repeatedly broken promises can make citizens cynical about whether political leaders genuinely intend to improve public services.
example2_ja: 一再失信会让公民怀疑政治领导人是否真心打算改善公共服务。
collocations: cynical about｜对……的动机持怀疑态度 ; a cynical attitude｜愤世嫉俗的态度 ; a cynical attempt｜不顾道义的企图
tip_ja: 常接about，侧重怀疑善意，并非单纯悲观。

meanings_ja: v. 盛行；普遍存在 | v. 获胜；占上风 | v. 说服
definition_en: to be common or widespread in a place or time | to win or become stronger than an opposing force | to persuade someone to do something
example1_en: A relaxed atmosphere prevails in our kitchen on Sundays.
example1_ja: 每逢星期日，我们的厨房里总洋溢着轻松的气氛。
example2_en: Where traditional attitudes prevail, public education campaigns may be needed to encourage more equal opportunities for women.
example2_ja: 在传统观念盛行的地方，可能需要开展公众教育活动，为女性争取更平等的机会。
collocations: prevailing conditions｜普遍状况 ; prevail over｜战胜 ; prevail upon someone to do｜说服某人做
tip_ja: 获胜用prevail over；说服用prevail upon sb to do。

meanings_ja: n. 人类学
definition_en: the study of humans, their societies, cultures, and development
example1_en: My cousin studies anthropology and collects stories about family traditions.
example1_ja: 我的表姐学习人类学，并收集有关家庭传统的故事。
example2_en: Anthropology helps researchers understand how cultural traditions influence attitudes towards health, education, and family life.
example2_ja: 人类学帮助研究者理解文化传统如何影响人们对健康、教育和家庭生活的态度。
collocations: cultural anthropology｜文化人类学 ; social anthropology｜社会人类学 ; study anthropology｜学习人类学
tip_ja: 通常为不可数名词；研究者称anthropologist。

meanings_ja: v. 加速；促使提前 | v. 赶紧；急忙做
definition_en: To make something happen sooner or develop more quickly. | To move or act quickly, often because something is urgent.
example1_en: The warm sunshine hastened the melting of the snow.
example1_ja: 温暖的阳光加快了积雪融化。
example2_en: Investment in renewable energy could hasten the transition towards a more sustainable and resilient economy.
example2_ja: 对可再生能源的投资可以加快向更可持续、更具韧性的经济转型。
collocations: hasten recovery｜加快康复 ; hasten the process｜加快进程 ; hasten to add｜连忙补充说
tip_ja: t不发音；hasten to do表示赶紧做某事。

meanings_ja: v. 四肢摊开地坐或躺 | v. 无序扩展；蔓延 | n. 无序扩展的区域
definition_en: Sit or lie with your arms and legs spread out. | Spread over a large area in an unplanned way. | A large area of buildings spreading out without clear planning.
example1_en: After the hike, we sprawled on the soft grass.
example1_ja: 徒步结束后，我们四肢舒展地躺在柔软的草地上。
example2_en: Urban sprawl can increase dependence on private cars and put pressure on surrounding farmland.
example2_ja: 城市无序扩张会增加对私家车的依赖，并给周边农田带来压力。
collocations: sprawl on the sofa｜摊躺在沙发上 ; sprawl out｜伸开四肢躺着 ; urban sprawl｜城市无序扩张 ; a sprawling city｜向外蔓延的城市
tip_ja: 人作主语常指摊坐或摊躺；urban sprawl指城市扩张。

meanings_ja: n. 润滑
definition_en: The use of oil or similar substances to reduce friction
example1_en: The bicycle chain needs lubrication after all that rain.
example1_ja: 下了那么多雨，自行车链条需要润滑了。
example2_en: Regular lubrication reduces friction in industrial machinery, improving energy efficiency and extending the lifespan of moving components.
example2_ja: 定期润滑可以减少工业机械中的摩擦，提高能源效率，并延长运动部件的使用寿命。
collocations: regular lubrication｜定期润滑 ; adequate lubrication｜充分润滑 ; lubrication system｜润滑系统 ; lack of lubrication｜缺乏润滑
tip_ja: lubrication指润滑过程；lubricant指润滑剂。

meanings_ja: adj. 顽强的；坚持不懈的
definition_en: Continuing with determination despite difficulties or setbacks.
example1_en: His dogged efforts finally brought the old garden back.
example1_ja: 他坚持不懈的努力终于让老花园恢复了生机。
example2_en: Dogged determination enables many researchers to continue investigating important questions despite repeated failures and limited funding.
example2_ja: 顽强的决心让许多研究人员在屡次失败、经费有限的情况下仍能继续探索重要问题。
collocations: dogged determination｜顽强的决心 ; dogged persistence｜不懈的坚持 ; dogged pursuit｜执着的追求
tip_ja: 作形容词读两个音节，通常强调不轻言放弃。

meanings_ja: v. 浸没；潜入水中；淹没
definition_en: To go below a liquid's surface or put something there
example1_en: Submerge the dirty jar in warm water before washing it.
example1_ja: 清洗脏罐子前，先把它浸没在温水中。
example2_en: Rising sea levels could submerge low-lying coastal settlements, forcing residents to relocate and placing pressure on nearby cities.
example2_ja: 海平面上升可能淹没地势低洼的沿海聚居区，迫使居民迁移，并给附近城市带来压力。
collocations: fully submerge｜完全浸没 ; submerge in water｜浸入水中 ; partially submerged｜部分被淹没
tip_ja: 可及物或不及物；强调进入水面或液面以下。

meanings_ja: n. 声望；威望
definition_en: Respect and admiration gained through achievement, quality, or high status.
example1_en: Winning the award brought considerable prestige to her small bakery.
example1_ja: 获奖为她的小面包店带来了很高的声誉。
example2_en: Some students choose universities for their international prestige rather than the suitability of individual courses.
example2_ja: 一些学生选择大学看重的是其国际声望，而非具体课程是否适合自己。
collocations: international prestige｜国际声望 ; gain prestige｜获得声望 ; social prestige｜社会声望 ; a matter of prestige｜关乎声望的事
tip_ja: prestige不可数；形容词用prestigious。

meanings_ja: v. 使隶属；加入组织 | n. 附属机构；关联公司
definition_en: To officially connect a person or group with an organisation. | An organisation officially connected with a larger organisation.
example1_en: Our local cycling club is affiliated with a national organisation.
example1_ja: 我们当地的自行车俱乐部隶属于一个全国性组织。
example2_en: Small research institutes often affiliate with universities to gain access to specialist equipment and academic expertise.
example2_ja: 小型研究机构常与大学建立隶属关系，以获得使用专业设备和借助学术专长的机会。
collocations: affiliate with｜加入；隶属于 ; be affiliated with｜与……有隶属关系 ; a local affiliate｜地方附属机构
tip_ja: 名词词尾读 /ət/，动词词尾读 /eɪt/。

meanings_ja: n. 问候语；书信称呼语 | n. 致意；致敬
definition_en: Words used to greet someone, especially at a letter's beginning | A gesture or action expressing greeting or respect
example1_en: He raised his hand in salutation as we approached.
example1_ja: 我们走近时，他举手向我们致意。
example2_en: Choosing an appropriate salutation in formal correspondence helps establish a respectful relationship between the writer and the recipient.
example2_ja: 在正式通信中选择恰当的称呼语，有助于写信人与收信人建立相互尊重的关系。
collocations: formal salutation｜正式称呼语 ; opening salutation｜开头问候语 ; in salutation｜以示致意
tip_ja: 书信开头的Dear…是salutation；敬礼常用salute。

meanings_ja: adj. 极其细致的；煞费苦心的
definition_en: Done with great care, effort, and attention to detail.
example1_en: She made painstaking repairs to her grandmother's old quilt.
example1_ja: 她极其细致地修补了祖母的旧被子。
example2_en: The preservation of historic buildings requires painstaking research into original materials and traditional construction methods.
example2_ja: 保护历史建筑需要对原有材料和传统建造方法进行细致深入的研究。
collocations: painstaking research｜细致深入的研究 ; painstaking attention to detail｜对细节的极度关注 ; painstaking work｜精细费力的工作
tip_ja: 是形容词，强调费心且细致，不只是辛苦。

meanings_ja: n. 传教士 | adj. 传教的；传教士的
definition_en: someone sent to teach a religion, often in another country | relating to people or activities that spread a religion
example1_en: The missionary discussed her faith with interested local families.
example1_ja: 这位传教士与感兴趣的当地家庭交流了自己的信仰。
example2_en: Historians examine how missionary schools influenced education and cultural traditions in different regions during the nineteenth century.
example2_ja: 历史学家研究十九世纪传教学校如何影响不同地区的教育和文化传统。
collocations: missionary work｜传教工作 ; a missionary school｜传教学校 ; missionary activity｜传教活动
tip_ja: 可作名词或形容词；复数为missionaries。

meanings_ja: n. 显著；重要；知名
definition_en: The state of being noticeable, important, or widely known.
example1_en: The gallery gave her painting prominence near the entrance.
example1_ja: 画廊把她的画摆在入口附近的显眼位置。
example2_en: Environmental issues have gained prominence in public debate as communities experience more frequent extreme weather events.
example2_ja: 随着各地遭遇极端天气事件的频率上升，环境议题在公共讨论中日益受到关注。
collocations: gain prominence｜日益受到关注 ; rise to prominence｜崭露头角 ; give prominence to｜突出；重视
tip_ja: 通常不可数；rise to prominence指崭露头角。

meanings_ja: adj. 明确的；直言的
definition_en: expressed clearly and directly, leaving no doubt about the meaning
example1_en: Please give me explicit instructions for assembling this wooden shelf.
example1_ja: 请给我明确的说明，告诉我如何组装这个木架。
example2_en: Schools should establish explicit rules about online behaviour to help students use digital platforms responsibly.
example2_ja: 学校应制定明确的网络行为规范，帮助学生负责任地使用数字平台。

example1_ja: 我们的度假预算有限，所以要仔细选择。
example2_en: Governments must recognise that natural resources are finite and encourage industries to reduce unnecessary consumption.
example2_ja: 政府必须认识到自然资源是有限的，并鼓励各行业减少不必要的消耗。

tip_ja: 读音重音在首音节；勿按finish的元音读。

meanings_ja: n. 狭长切口；狭缝 | v. 切开狭长口子

example1_ja: 阳光透过窗帘间的一条狭缝照了进来。
example2_en: A narrow slit in the laboratory screen allows researchers to observe how light behaves when passing through small openings.
example2_ja: 实验室屏障上的一道狭缝让研究人员能够观察光穿过小开口时的表现。

meanings_ja: n. 夹具；夹钳 | v. 夹紧；固定

example1_ja: 涂胶时用夹具固定木头。
example2_en: During laboratory tests, researchers clamp each sample securely to prevent movement from affecting the accuracy of measurements.
example2_ja: 在实验室测试中，研究人员将每个样本夹紧固定，防止移动影响测量准确性。

meanings_ja: n. 配额；限额
definition_en: an officially fixed amount allowed, required, or assigned

example1_ja: 我们团队昨天下午完成了本月的销售指标。
example2_en: Fishing quotas can protect marine populations, provided that governments monitor catches and enforce the limits consistently.
example2_ja: 只要政府监测捕捞量并始终严格执行限额，捕捞配额就能保护海洋生物种群。
collocations: an import quota｜进口配额 ; a fishing quota｜捕捞配额 ; meet a quota｜完成配额指标 ; impose a quota｜设定配额
tip_ja: 既可指允许的上限，也可指必须完成的指标。

meanings_ja: v. 激起；引起 | v. 唤醒
definition_en: To cause a feeling, interest, or reaction. | To wake someone from sleep.
example1_en: The locked wooden box aroused my curiosity immediately.
example1_ja: 那个上锁的木盒立刻引起了我的好奇。
example2_en: Proposals to replace public parks with commercial buildings are likely to arouse strong opposition among local residents.
example2_ja: 用商业建筑取代公共公园的提案很可能激起当地居民的强烈反对。
collocations: arouse curiosity｜激起好奇心 ; arouse suspicion｜引起怀疑 ; arouse interest｜引起兴趣 ; arouse opposition｜激起反对

meanings_ja: v. 猛推；猛塞；插入 | n. 推力；猛推 | n. 要旨；重点
definition_en: to push something suddenly and forcefully | a strong push or force that moves something forward | the main idea or purpose of an argument or activity
example1_en: He thrust his hands deep into his coat pockets.
example1_ja: 他猛地把双手插进大衣口袋深处。
example2_en: The main thrust of the proposal is to improve public transport rather than build additional roads.
example2_ja: 这项提案的重点是改善公共交通，而非增建道路。
collocations: thrust something into｜把某物猛塞进 ; engine thrust｜发动机推力 ; the main thrust of｜……的主要重点

meanings_ja: n. 赞助人；资助者 | n. 顾客；常客
definition_en: Someone who supports an artist, organisation, or activity, often financially. | A customer of a restaurant, theatre, or similar place.
example1_en: A local patron paid for the young artist's materials.
example1_ja: 一位当地赞助人出钱为这位年轻艺术家购买了材料。
example2_en: Private patrons can fund experimental art that might otherwise struggle to attract public financial support.
example2_ja: 私人赞助人能够资助那些可能难以获得公共资金支持的实验艺术。
collocations: patron of the arts｜艺术赞助人 ; wealthy patron｜富有的资助者 ; regular patron｜常客
tip_ja: patron既指资助者，也可正式地指餐馆等的顾客。

meanings_ja: adj. 有偿债能力的 | n. 溶剂
definition_en: Able to pay all the money that is owed. | A substance, usually liquid, that dissolves another substance.
example1_en: Careful budgeting kept our small shop solvent this year.
example1_ja: 精打细算使我们的小店今年保持了偿债能力。
example2_en: Businesses must remain solvent during economic downturns while continuing to meet their obligations to employees and suppliers.
example2_ja: 经济低迷期间，企业必须保持偿债能力，同时继续履行对员工和供应商的义务。
collocations: remain solvent｜保持偿债能力 ; a solvent company｜有偿债能力的公司 ; an organic solvent｜有机溶剂 ; a powerful solvent｜强效溶剂
tip_ja: 形容词指能偿债，不等于盈利；名词指溶剂。

meanings_ja: n. 肿瘤
definition_en: an abnormal mass of cells growing in the body

example1_ja: 医生解释说，这个肿瘤并非恶性的。
example2_en: Early detection of a tumour can improve treatment options, although outcomes depend on its type and location.
example2_ja: 尽早发现肿瘤可增加治疗选择，但疗效取决于肿瘤的类型和位置。

tip_ja: 英式拼写tumour，美式tumor；肿瘤不一定是癌。

meanings_ja: adj. 恰当的；相称的 | n. 配件；装置 | n. 试衣；试穿
definition_en: suitable for a particular occasion, purpose, or person | a small part attached to furniture, equipment, or a building | an appointment to check and adjust how clothes fit
example1_en: Flowers seemed a fitting gift for our gardening teacher.
example1_ja: 送鲜花给我们的园艺老师似乎很合适。
example2_en: A public library would be a fitting memorial to someone who dedicated their life to education.
example2_ja: 对于一位毕生奉献教育的人，公共图书馆会是恰当的纪念设施。

tip_ja: 形容词强调场合上恰当；衣服合身通常用fit。

meanings_ja: n. 先知 | n. 预言者
definition_en: Someone believed to communicate messages from a god. | Someone who predicts future events or developments.

example1_ja: 这幅古画描绘了一位先知向人群讲话的情景。
example2_en: Throughout history, religious communities have preserved the teachings of prophets through oral traditions and written accounts.
example2_ja: 纵观历史，宗教群体通过口述传统和书面记载保存了先知的教诲。

tip_ja: 与profit（利润）同音；动词为prophesy。

meanings_ja: v. 违反；违背 | v. 侵犯；侵害

example1_ja: 把车停在这里违反了这栋楼的停车规定。

meanings_ja: v. 耕作；栽培 | v. 培养；发展

example2_en: Schools should cultivate curiosity by encouraging students to ask questions and explore different solutions to practical problems.
example2_ja: 学校应鼓励学生提问并探索实际问题的不同解决方法，以培养好奇心。

meanings_ja: n. 详细阐述；补充说明

meanings_ja: adj. 苗条的；细长的 | adj. 微小的；微薄的

meanings_ja: n. 怀旧；对往昔的眷恋

meanings_ja: n. 对手；敌对者 | n. 故事中的对立角色

meanings_ja: v. 使失去法律效力 | v. 抵消；使无效

meanings_ja: n. 解剖学 | n. 身体构造

meanings_ja: adj. 难以想象的；不可接受的

meanings_ja: v. 擅自进入；非法侵入 | n. 擅自进入；非法侵入行为

meanings_ja: adj. 可行的；能成功的 | adj. 能存活的；能发育的

meanings_ja: adj. 临时的；过渡期间的 | n. 过渡期间；间隔时期

meanings_ja: n. 繁殖；育种 | n. 教养

meanings_ja: adj. 贫瘠的；不毛的 | adj. 无成果的；缺乏的

meanings_ja: n. 袭击；侵犯人身 | v. 袭击；殴打

meanings_ja: v. 使有活力；使生动 | v. 把…制作成动画

example1_ja: 她的趣事总能让家庭聚餐活跃起来。

meanings_ja: adj. 暂定的；初步的 | adj. 犹豫的；试探性的

example2_en: Researchers have drawn tentative conclusions, but further studies are needed before the treatment can be widely recommended.
example2_ja: 研究人员得出了初步结论，但在广泛推荐这种疗法之前，还需要进一步研究。
