example2_en: Regular access to green spaces can act as a tonic for residents facing the pressures of urban life.
example2_ja: 经常接触绿地能让承受城市生活压力的居民感到振奋。
collocations: a herbal tonic｜草本滋补剂 ; a tonic for the mind｜振奋精神的事物 ; tonic water｜汤力水
tip_ja: 比喻用法常见a tonic for，指让人振奋的事物。

meanings_ja: n. 雄伟；壮丽；威严 | n. 陛下
definition_en: Impressive beauty, grandeur, or dignity that inspires admiration. | A title used when addressing or referring to a monarch.
example1_en: We stood silently, amazed by the majesty of the mountains.
example1_ja: 我们静静地站着，为群山的雄伟所震撼。
example2_en: Visitors drawn by the majesty of ancient temples can generate income for local conservation projects.
example2_ja: 被古寺的庄严壮丽吸引而来的游客能为当地保护项目带来收入。
collocations: the majesty of nature｜大自然的壮丽 ; Your Majesty｜陛下（当面称呼） ; His Majesty｜国王陛下
tip_ja: 表示“陛下”的称号时首字母大写：Majesty。

meanings_ja: adj. 振奋人心的；激动人心的 | n. 萌动；初现的迹象
definition_en: Causing strong feelings, especially excitement, courage, or admiration. | An early sign of a feeling, idea, or activity.
example1_en: The orchestra ended the concert with a stirring march.
example1_ja: 管弦乐团以一首振奋人心的进行曲结束了音乐会。
example2_en: A stirring speech can inspire community action, but lasting change also requires practical support and adequate funding.
example2_ja: 振奋人心的演讲可以激发社区行动，但持久的改变还需要实际支持和充足资金。
collocations: a stirring speech｜振奋人心的演讲 ; a stirring performance｜激动人心的演出 ; the first stirrings of hope｜希望的最初萌动
tip_ja: 名词表“萌动”常用复数，如stirrings of hope。

meanings_ja: n. 强烈谴责 | n. 判刑；宣告不宜使用
definition_en: An expression of strong disapproval | An official judgment imposing punishment or declaring something unsafe
example1_en: His cruel remarks drew condemnation from everyone at dinner.
example1_ja: 他刻薄的话遭到了所有同桌用餐者的谴责。
example2_en: The destruction of protected forests has attracted widespread condemnation from environmental groups and local communities.
example2_ja: 破坏受保护森林的行为引起了环保团体和当地社区的广泛谴责。
collocations: widespread condemnation｜广泛谴责 ; strong condemnation｜强烈谴责 ; draw condemnation｜招致谴责 ; condemnation of violence｜对暴力的谴责
tip_ja: 常用condemnation of sth；比criticism语气更强。

meanings_ja: v. 随后发生；因而发生
definition_en: To happen after something, often as its result.
example1_en: A lively discussion ensued after dinner at our house.
example1_ja: 晚饭后，我们家展开了一场热烈的讨论。
example2_en: If public services fail to meet growing demand, widespread dissatisfaction may ensue among local residents.
example2_ja: 如果公共服务无法满足不断增长的需求，当地居民可能随之产生普遍的不满。
collocations: chaos ensues｜随之陷入混乱 ; a debate ensues｜随后展开辩论 ; ensue from｜因……而发生
tip_ja: 正式用语，不及物；不表示“追求”。

meanings_ja: n. 气象学
definition_en: The scientific study of weather and the atmosphere.
example1_en: My sister studies meteorology and loves watching storm clouds.
example1_ja: 我姐姐学习气象学，喜欢观察暴风雨云。
example2_en: Advances in meteorology allow coastal communities to prepare more effectively for severe storms and flooding.
example2_ja: 气象学的进步使沿海社区能够更有效地应对强风暴和洪灾。
collocations: study meteorology｜学习气象学 ; a degree in meteorology｜气象学学位 ; advances in meteorology｜气象学的进展
tip_ja: 通常为不可数名词；研究天气，不是研究流星。

meanings_ja: n. 搜查令；逮捕令 | v. 使有必要；足以支持 | n. 正当理由；依据
definition_en: An official document allowing police to take a particular action. | To make a particular action necessary or reasonable. | A good reason or justification for something.
example1_en: The officers obtained a warrant before searching the apartment.
example1_ja: 警员在搜查这套公寓前取得了搜查令。
example2_en: The potential environmental risks warrant further investigation before the government approves construction of the new industrial facility.
example2_ja: 在政府批准建设新的工业设施之前，潜在的环境风险值得进一步调查。
collocations: a search warrant｜搜查令 ; an arrest warrant｜逮捕令 ; warrant further investigation｜值得进一步调查 ; without warrant｜没有正当理由
tip_ja: 动词常指值得或有必要，如warrant attention。

meanings_ja: adj. 全景的；视野开阔的
definition_en: showing a wide view of a large surrounding area
example1_en: Our balcony offers panoramic views of the harbour.
example1_ja: 从我们的阳台可以俯瞰港口全景。
example2_en: Hotels with panoramic coastal views can attract tourists while increasing pressure on sensitive marine environments.
example2_ja: 拥有海岸全景的酒店能吸引游客，但也会增加脆弱海洋环境承受的压力。
collocations: panoramic view｜全景 ; panoramic photograph｜全景照片 ; panoramic windows｜全景窗
tip_ja: 常修饰view，强调能看到广阔的周围景色。

meanings_ja: adj. 军事的；战争的
definition_en: Related to war, soldiers, or military life.
example1_en: The band played martial music as soldiers marched past.
example1_ja: 士兵列队走过时，乐队奏起了军乐。
example2_en: Although martial arts originated as fighting techniques, many people now practise them for fitness and self-discipline.
example2_ja: 虽然武术起源于格斗技巧，如今许多人练习武术是为了健身和培养自律。
collocations: martial arts｜武术 ; martial law｜戒严 ; martial music｜军乐
tip_ja: martial是军事的；marital是婚姻的，勿混。

meanings_ja: adj. 可通航的 | adj. 易于浏览的；可穿行的
definition_en: Deep and wide enough for boats or ships to travel through. | Possible or easy to find your way through.
example1_en: The river is only navigable during the rainy season.
example1_ja: 这条河只有在雨季才能通航。
example2_en: A clearly organised and easily navigable website can improve access to essential public services.
example2_ja: 结构清晰、易于浏览的网站可以让公众更方便地获取基本公共服务。
collocations: navigable river｜可通航的河流 ; navigable waterways｜可通航水道 ; easily navigable website｜易于浏览的网站
tip_ja: 常形容河流或水道；船舶“适航”用seaworthy。

meanings_ja: v. 获得；收获成果 | v. 收割庄稼
definition_en: to receive results or rewards from previous actions | to cut and gather a crop when it is ready
example1_en: After months of practice, she finally reaped the rewards.
example1_ja: 经过几个月的练习，她终于收获了回报。
example2_en: Countries that invest consistently in early education often reap long-term economic and social benefits.
example2_ja: 持续投资幼儿教育的国家往往能获得长期的经济和社会效益。
collocations: reap the benefits｜获得益处 ; reap the rewards｜收获回报 ; reap a harvest｜收获庄稼
tip_ja: 抽象义常搭配benefits或rewards，强调付出后的收获。

meanings_ja: n. 矿石
definition_en: rock containing metal or other valuable substances that can be extracted
example1_en: The truck carried iron ore down the dusty road.
example1_ja: 卡车沿着尘土飞扬的道路运送铁矿石。
example2_en: Extracting metals from ore requires substantial energy and can cause serious damage to surrounding ecosystems.
example2_ja: 从矿石中提取金属需要大量能源，并可能严重破坏周边生态系统。
collocations: iron ore｜铁矿石 ; copper ore｜铜矿石 ; ore deposits｜矿床 ; extract metal from ore｜从矿石中提取金属
tip_ja: ore是含有可提取物质的矿石，不等于metal。

meanings_ja: adj. 殖民的；殖民地的
definition_en: relating to a territory controlled by a foreign country
example1_en: Our guide showed us several buildings from the colonial period.
example1_ja: 导游带我们参观了几座殖民时期的建筑。
example2_en: Colonial rule often reshaped local economies by directing agricultural production towards the needs of distant markets.
example2_ja: 殖民统治常使农业生产转而满足遥远市场的需求，从而重塑当地经济。
collocations: colonial rule｜殖民统治 ; colonial period｜殖民时期 ; colonial powers｜殖民列强 ; colonial legacy｜殖民遗产
tip_ja: colony是殖民地；colonial是对应形容词。

meanings_ja: v. 环绕；包围
definition_en: To form a circle around someone or something.
example1_en: Tall trees encircle the small pond behind our house.
example1_ja: 高大的树木环绕着我们屋后的小池塘。
example2_en: Green belts that encircle urban areas can protect wildlife habitats and limit uncontrolled development.
example2_ja: 环绕城区的绿化带可以保护野生动物栖息地，并限制无序开发。
collocations: be encircled by mountains｜被群山环绕 ; encircle the city｜环绕城市 ; encircle with a fence｜用围栏围住
tip_ja: 及物动词；被环绕常用be encircled by。

meanings_ja: adj. 待定的；待处理的 | prep. 在等待…期间；直到…为止
definition_en: Waiting for a decision or for something to happen | Until something happens or while waiting for it
example1_en: Our application is still pending, so we cannot book flights.
example1_ja: 我们的申请仍在审批中，所以还不能订机票。
example2_en: Construction should remain suspended pending a thorough assessment of its potential impact on the surrounding environment.
example2_ja: 在全面评估施工对周边环境的潜在影响之前，工程应继续暂停。
collocations: pending approval｜等待批准 ; a pending application｜待处理的申请 ; pending investigation｜等待调查
tip_ja: 核心是尚未决定或完成，不要误当作urgent（紧迫的）。

meanings_ja: v. 安慰；慰藉 | n. 控制台；游戏机
definition_en: To comfort someone who feels sad or disappointed. | A control unit for equipment, or a machine for video games.
example1_en: Lena tried to console her brother after his team lost.
example1_ja: 弟弟的球队输了比赛后，莉娜试着安慰他。
example2_en: Teachers should console disappointed students while helping them develop practical strategies for improving their academic performance.
example2_ja: 教师应安慰失落的学生，同时帮助他们制定切实可行的策略来提高学习成绩。
collocations: console someone｜安慰某人 ; console yourself with｜用……安慰自己 ; games console｜游戏机 ; control console｜控制台
tip_ja: 动词重音在后；名词重音在前，英音/ˈkɒnsəʊl/。

meanings_ja: v. 终止；结束 | v. 到达终点
definition_en: To end something, or to come to an end. | For a transport service, to reach its final stop.
example1_en: We decided to terminate our gym membership last month.
example1_ja: 我们上个月决定终止健身房会员资格。
example2_en: Employers should not terminate contracts without providing clear reasons and allowing workers sufficient time to respond.
example2_ja: 雇主终止合同时，应提供明确理由，并给予员工充足的回应时间。
collocations: terminate a contract｜终止合同 ; terminate employment｜终止雇佣关系 ; terminate at a station｜在某站终到
tip_ja: 正式用词；可及物或不及物，列车终到用at。

meanings_ja: n. 标本；样本 | n. 检验样本
definition_en: An individual animal, plant, or object collected for scientific study. | A small amount of bodily material taken for medical testing.
example1_en: The museum keeps this butterfly specimen behind glass.
example1_ja: 博物馆将这件蝴蝶标本保存在玻璃罩内。
example2_en: Researchers examined each plant specimen to assess how prolonged drought had affected its growth.
example2_ja: 研究人员检查了每份植物样本，以评估长期干旱对其生长的影响。
collocations: collect a specimen｜采集标本 ; a plant specimen｜植物标本 ; a urine specimen｜尿液样本
tip_ja: specimen多指供研究或检验的样本，不泛指任何例子。

meanings_ja: adj. 冷酷无情的；残忍的
definition_en: Determined to succeed without caring about harm caused to others.
example1_en: The ruthless landlord evicted the family without any warning.
example1_ja: 那个冷酷无情的房东毫无预警地赶走了这家人。
example2_en: Ruthless competition may encourage companies to cut labour costs at the expense of employee welfare.
example2_ja: 残酷的竞争可能促使企业以牺牲员工福利为代价来削减用工成本。
collocations: ruthless competition｜残酷的竞争 ; ruthless ambition｜不择手段的野心 ; a ruthless leader｜冷酷无情的领导者
tip_ja: 比strict更强，强调为达目的而不顾他人感受或利益。

meanings_ja: n. 征税；税制
definition_en: The system or process of collecting money through taxes.
example1_en: Taxation helps pay for our local schools and roads.
example1_ja: 税收为我们当地的学校和道路提供资金。
example2_en: Progressive taxation can reduce income inequality by requiring wealthier citizens to contribute a larger proportion of their earnings.
example2_ja: 累进税制要求较富裕的公民缴纳更高比例的收入，有助于缩小收入差距。
collocations: progressive taxation｜累进税制 ; direct taxation｜直接征税 ; double taxation｜双重征税 ; taxation policy｜税收政策
tip_ja: taxation通常不可数，侧重征税制度或过程。

meanings_ja: n. 涡轮机；透平
definition_en: A machine whose blades turn when pushed by moving fluid.
example1_en: We watched the wind turbine turning slowly above the fields.
example1_ja: 我们看着风力涡轮机在田野上方缓缓转动。
example2_en: Installing offshore wind turbines can increase renewable electricity generation, although potential impacts on marine ecosystems require careful assessment.
example2_ja: 安装海上风力涡轮机可以增加可再生能源发电量，不过其对海洋生态系统的潜在影响需要仔细评估。
collocations: wind turbine｜风力涡轮机 ; steam turbine｜蒸汽轮机 ; gas turbine｜燃气轮机 ; turbine blade｜涡轮叶片
tip_ja: 重音在首音节；wind turbine指风力涡轮机。

meanings_ja: n. 赤字；亏空 | n. 不足；缺额
definition_en: the amount by which spending exceeds income | a shortage of something needed
example1_en: Our club faces a deficit after buying new equipment.
example1_ja: 购买新设备后，我们俱乐部出现了资金缺口。
example2_en: Governments may reduce a budget deficit by raising taxes, but this can slow economic growth.
example2_ja: 政府可以通过增税减少预算赤字，但这可能减缓经济增长。
collocations: budget deficit｜预算赤字 ; trade deficit｜贸易逆差 ; reduce the deficit｜减少赤字
tip_ja: 赤字用deficit；债务用debt，二者不同。

meanings_ja: n. 进口；输入
definition_en: the process of bringing goods into a country from abroad
example1_en: The importation of fresh fruit requires careful temperature control.
example1_ja: 进口新鲜水果需要严格控制温度。
example2_en: Restrictions on the importation of agricultural products may protect local farmers but increase food prices for consumers.
example2_ja: 限制农产品进口可能保护本地农民，却也会提高消费者购买食品的价格。
collocations: importation of goods｜商品进口 ; restrict importation｜限制进口 ; illegal importation｜非法进口
tip_ja: 较正式，通常不可数；常用the importation of。

meanings_ja: n. 意图；目的 | adj. 专注的；全神贯注的 | adj. 决意的；坚决的
definition_en: What someone plans or means to do. | Giving all your attention to something. | Firmly determined to do or achieve something.
example1_en: My intent was to help, not to interrupt you.
example1_ja: 我本意是帮忙，而不是打断你。
example2_en: Many governments are intent on reducing traffic congestion through investment in reliable public transport.
example2_ja: 许多政府决心通过投资可靠的公共交通来减少交通拥堵。
collocations: with the intent of｜怀着……的目的 ; intent on doing something｜决意做某事 ; an intent gaze｜专注的凝视 ; a statement of intent｜意向声明
tip_ja: intent on后接名词或动名词，表示专注或决意。

meanings_ja: adj. 任意的；无明确依据的 | adj. 专断的；武断的
definition_en: based on chance or personal choice rather than clear reasons | using power according to personal wishes rather than fair rules
example1_en: Her choice felt arbitrary: she picked without even looking.
example1_ja: 她的选择显得很随意：她连看都没看就选了。
example2_en: Arbitrary restrictions on university admissions can prevent capable students from accessing education and may reinforce existing social inequalities.
example2_ja: 大学招生中缺乏合理依据的限制可能让有能力的学生无法入学，并加剧现有的社会不平等。
collocations: an arbitrary decision｜武断的决定 ; an arbitrary limit｜随意设定的限制 ; arbitrary power｜专断权力
tip_ja: 重点是缺乏合理依据，不只是“可以自由选择”。

meanings_ja: n. 独奏会；独唱会 | n. 详述；逐一列举
definition_en: A musical performance given by one person or a small group. | A spoken account describing a series of facts or events.
example1_en: Her first piano recital drew a small but enthusiastic audience.
example1_ja: 她的首场钢琴独奏会吸引了人数不多却十分热情的观众。
example2_en: Regular opportunities to give a recital can help music students develop confidence and improve their performance skills.
example2_ja: 定期举办独奏会的机会可以帮助音乐专业学生建立信心并提高演奏技巧。
collocations: a piano recital｜钢琴独奏会 ; give a recital｜举办独奏会 ; a recital of facts｜事实的逐一陈述
tip_ja: 音乐语境多指独奏或独唱，不等于大型演唱会。

meanings_ja: v. 跛行；一瘸一拐地走 | n. 跛行 | adj. 无力的；软塌塌的
definition_en: To walk unevenly because one leg or foot is hurt | An uneven way of walking caused by an affected leg | Not firm or stiff; lacking strength or support
example1_en: I had to limp home after twisting my ankle.
example1_ja: 扭伤脚踝后，我只好一瘸一拐地走回家。
example2_en: Athletes who continue to limp after an injury should receive professional assessment before returning to competitive sport.
example2_ja: 受伤后仍然跛行的运动员应先接受专业评估，再重返竞技运动。
collocations: walk with a limp｜一瘸一拐地走 ; limp along｜跛行前进 ; go limp｜变得软弱无力 ; a limp handshake｜无力的握手
tip_ja: 作动词指跛行；作形容词指无力或软塌塌。

meanings_ja: n. 回归线 | n. 热带地区
definition_en: Either of two imaginary circles marking Earth's tropical boundaries. | The hot region between these circles, called the tropics.
example1_en: Our guide pointed to the northern tropic on a globe.
example1_ja: 导游指了指地球仪上的北回归线。
example2_en: Communities in the tropics often depend on seasonal rainfall to sustain agriculture and maintain reliable freshwater supplies.
example2_ja: 热带地区的社区往往依赖季节性降雨来维持农业生产和稳定的淡水供应。
collocations: Tropic of Cancer｜北回归线 ; Tropic of Capricorn｜南回归线 ; in the tropics｜在热带地区
tip_ja: 回归线用单数；热带地区固定用the tropics。

meanings_ja: v. 欺骗；使产生错觉
definition_en: Make someone believe something that is not true.
example1_en: Don't delude yourself into thinking the work is finished.
example1_ja: 别自欺欺人地以为工作已经完成了。
example2_en: Policymakers should not delude themselves into believing that economic growth alone will eliminate poverty and social inequality.
example2_ja: 政策制定者不应自欺欺人地认为，仅靠经济增长就能消除贫困和社会不平等。
collocations: delude yourself｜自欺欺人 ; delude someone into believing｜使某人误信
tip_ja: 常用delude oneself into doing，指自欺欺人地做某事。

meanings_ja: v. 笨拙地摸索；乱摸 | v. 失手漏接；笨拙处理
definition_en: To search for or handle something with awkward hand movements. | To fail to hold something or deal with something smoothly.
example1_en: I fumbled for my keys in the dark hallway.
example1_ja: 我在漆黑的走廊里摸索着找钥匙。
example2_en: Users often fumble with unfamiliar controls, highlighting the importance of intuitive design in public transport systems.
example2_ja: 使用者操作不熟悉的控制装置时常常手忙脚乱，这凸显了公共交通系统中直观设计的重要性。
collocations: fumble for keys｜摸索着找钥匙 ; fumble with a lock｜笨手笨脚地摆弄锁 ; fumble the ball｜失手漏接球
tip_ja: fumble for表示摸索寻找；with表示笨拙摆弄。

meanings_ja: adj. 凶猛的；残酷的 | adj. 严厉的；猛烈的 | v. 猛烈攻击；严厉批评
definition_en: Extremely violent, fierce, or cruel. | Extremely harsh or severe. | To attack violently or criticize someone very harshly.
example1_en: The documentary showed a savage fight between two wolves.
example1_ja: 这部纪录片展现了两只狼之间的激烈搏斗。
example2_en: The proposed reduction in education funding attracted savage criticism from teachers and parents across the country.
example2_ja: 削减教育经费的提议遭到了全国教师和家长的严厉批评。
collocations: savage attack｜凶猛的攻击 ; savage criticism｜严厉的批评 ; savage cuts｜大幅削减
tip_ja: 勿用作名词称呼族群，有贬损和冒犯意味。

meanings_ja: adj. 极有用的；极宝贵的
definition_en: Extremely useful or valuable.
example1_en: Your advice was invaluable when I bought my first bicycle.
example1_ja: 我买第一辆自行车时，你的建议帮了大忙。
example2_en: Practical work experience provides students with invaluable insights into the skills employers expect from new graduates.
example2_ja: 实际工作经验能帮助学生深入了解雇主对新毕业生技能的期望，这种了解十分宝贵。
collocations: invaluable advice｜宝贵的建议 ; an invaluable resource｜极有用的资源 ; prove invaluable｜证明极有价值
tip_ja: invaluable意为极宝贵，不是没有价值。

meanings_ja: v. 停止；终止
definition_en: to stop happening or doing something
example1_en: The bells finally ceased ringing just before midnight.
example1_ja: 临近午夜时，钟声终于停了。
example2_en: Factories should cease discharging untreated wastewater into rivers to protect aquatic ecosystems and safeguard public health.
example2_ja: 工厂应停止向河流排放未经处理的废水，以保护水生生态系统和公众健康。
collocations: cease operations｜停止运营 ; cease to exist｜不复存在 ; cease production｜停止生产 ; cease trading｜停止营业
tip_ja: 较正式；后可接动名词或to do，均表示停止。

meanings_ja: v. 使高兴；使满意 | v. 满足欲望或需求
definition_en: to give someone pleasure or satisfaction | to satisfy a desire or need
example1_en: Your kind words will gratify everyone who helped today.
example1_ja: 你的暖心话会让今天所有帮忙的人感到欣慰。
example2_en: Policies that gratify immediate consumer desires may conflict with the need to protect resources for future generations.
example2_ja: 满足消费者眼前欲望的政策，可能与为后代保护资源的需要相冲突。
collocations: gratify a desire｜满足欲望 ; gratify curiosity｜满足好奇心 ; be gratified by｜因……而欣慰
tip_ja: 较正式；常用be gratified by表示因某事欣慰。

meanings_ja: adj. 多事的；经历丰富的
definition_en: Full of important, interesting, or unexpected events.
example1_en: After an eventful morning, we finally sat down for lunch.
example1_ja: 经历了状况不断的一上午后，我们终于坐下来吃午饭。
example2_en: An eventful period of political reform transformed the country's education system and expanded access to schooling.
example2_ja: 一段大事频发的政治改革时期改变了该国的教育体系，并扩大了入学机会。
collocations: an eventful day｜事情很多的一天 ; an eventful journey｜状况不断的旅程 ; an eventful life｜经历丰富的一生
tip_ja: 指发生许多值得注意的事，不一定都是坏事。

meanings_ja: n. 大羽毛；羽饰 | n. 柱状烟雾或水流
definition_en: a large feather, especially one used for decoration | a rising mass of smoke, water, or dust
example1_en: A bright plume decorated the dancer's tall hat.
example1_ja: 舞者的高帽上装饰着一根鲜艳的大羽毛。
example2_en: A thick plume of smoke rose above the factory, raising concerns about local air quality.
example2_ja: 工厂上方升起一股浓烟，引发了人们对当地空气质量的担忧。
collocations: a plume of smoke｜一股浓烟 ; a plume of feathers｜一簇羽毛 ; a volcanic plume｜火山喷出的烟柱
tip_ja: 既指大羽毛，也指形似羽毛的烟柱、水柱。

meanings_ja: adj. 怀疑的；拿不准的 | adj. 可疑的；不可靠的
definition_en: feeling uncertain or doubtful about something | probably dishonest, unsafe, or not worth trusting
example1_en: I felt dubious about buying a bicycle without brakes.
example1_ja: 对于买一辆没有刹车的自行车，我心存疑虑。
example2_en: Consumers should remain dubious about health claims that are not supported by reliable scientific evidence.
example2_ja: 消费者应对没有可靠科学证据支持的健康功效宣称保持怀疑。
collocations: dubious about｜对……存疑 ; dubious claims｜可疑的说法 ; of dubious value｜价值存疑的 ; dubious practices｜可疑的做法
tip_ja: 人感到怀疑用dubious about；事物可疑也可用dubious。

meanings_ja: n. 单调；枯燥乏味
definition_en: boring sameness caused by a lack of variety or change
example1_en: A short walk broke the monotony of my afternoon.
example1_ja: 短暂的散步打破了我下午的单调乏味。
example2_en: Rotating tasks can reduce the monotony of factory work while helping employees develop a wider range of skills.
example2_ja: 轮换任务可以减少工厂工作的单调感，同时帮助员工培养更多样的技能。
collocations: break the monotony｜打破单调 ; the monotony of daily life｜日常生活的单调 ; relieve the monotony｜缓解枯燥
tip_ja: 通常为不可数名词，强调缺少变化带来的乏味。

meanings_ja: n. 螺旋桨
definition_en: a rotating device with blades that drives boats or aircraft
example1_en: The boat's propeller churned the water into white foam.
example1_ja: 船的螺旋桨把水搅成了白色泡沫。
example2_en: Engineers are developing quieter propeller designs to reduce the impact of shipping noise on marine wildlife.
example2_ja: 工程师正在开发更安静的螺旋桨设计，以减少航运噪声对海洋野生动物的影响。
collocations: aircraft propeller｜飞机螺旋桨 ; ship's propeller｜船用螺旋桨 ; propeller blade｜螺旋桨叶片
tip_ja: propel是推进；propeller是提供推力的螺旋桨。

meanings_ja: n. 马力（功率单位）
definition_en: A unit used to measure the power of an engine.
example1_en: This tractor has enough horsepower to pull the heavy trailer.
example1_ja: 这辆拖拉机的马力足以拉动那辆沉重的拖车。
example2_en: Although greater horsepower can improve vehicle performance, fuel efficiency remains a major consideration for many consumers.
example2_ja: 虽然更大的马力可以提升车辆性能，但燃油效率仍是许多消费者的重要考量。
collocations: engine horsepower｜发动机马力 ; brake horsepower｜制动马力 ; high horsepower｜大马力
tip_ja: 数量后horsepower不加s；它衡量功率而非速度。

meanings_ja: n. 差异；不一致 | n. 方差
definition_en: A difference or disagreement between things. | A statistical measure of how widely values differ from their mean.
example1_en: His cheerful smile was at variance with his complaints.
example1_ja: 他愉快的笑容与他的抱怨很不相称。
example2_en: The proposed housing policy is at variance with the government's commitment to protecting green spaces.
example2_ja: 拟议的住房政策与政府保护绿地的承诺相矛盾。
collocations: at variance with｜与……不一致 ; variance between groups｜组间差异 ; population variance｜总体方差
tip_ja: at variance with 表示不一致；统计学中指方差。

meanings_ja: n. 民兵组织
definition_en: A military group whose members are not full-time professional soldiers.
example1_en: The museum displayed uniforms once worn by the local militia.
example1_ja: 博物馆展出了当地民兵曾经穿过的制服。
example2_en: Historical records show that the militia consisted mainly of farmers who trained alongside their regular work.
example2_ja: 历史记录显示，这支民兵主要由农民组成，他们在日常劳作之余参加训练。
collocations: a local militia｜地方民兵组织 ; form a militia｜组建民兵组织 ; militia members｜民兵成员
tip_ja: 指组织；单个成员用a militia member。

meanings_ja: n. 忠告；建议 | v. 提供咨询；劝告 | n. 律师；法律顾问
definition_en: advice, especially from someone experienced or knowledgeable | to give someone advice or professional support | a lawyer or lawyers representing someone in a legal case
example1_en: I sought my aunt's counsel before accepting the job.
example1_ja: 接受这份工作前，我征求了姑姑的意见。
example2_en: Schools should employ trained professionals to counsel students who experience anxiety about examinations or future careers.
example2_ja: 学校应聘用受过培训的专业人士，为因考试或未来职业而焦虑的学生提供咨询。
collocations: seek counsel｜征求意见 ; legal counsel｜法律顾问 ; counsel someone against something｜劝某人不要做某事 ; wise counsel｜明智的忠告
tip_ja: counsel指忠告或律师；council指委员会。

meanings_ja: n. 丰富；充裕；大量
definition_en: a very large quantity of something
example1_en: Our garden produces an abundance of tomatoes every summer.
example1_ja: 我们的花园每年夏天都结出大量番茄。
example2_en: An abundance of natural resources does not necessarily guarantee sustainable economic growth or improved living standards.
example2_ja: 丰富的自然资源并不一定能保证可持续的经济增长或生活水平的提高。
collocations: an abundance of｜大量的 ; in abundance｜大量；充裕地 ; an abundance of wildlife｜丰富的野生动物
tip_ja: 常用an abundance of＋名词，或in abundance。

meanings_ja: n. 竖井；升降机井 | n. 杆；轴；柄 | n. 一束光
definition_en: A vertical passage through a building or into the ground. | A long narrow part of a tool or machine. | A narrow beam of light.
example1_en: The lift stopped halfway up the narrow shaft.
example1_ja: 电梯在狭窄井道的中途停了下来。
example2_en: Engineers installed a ventilation shaft to improve air quality throughout the underground transport station.
example2_ja: 工程师安装了通风井，以改善整个地下交通站点的空气质量。
collocations: lift shaft｜电梯井 ; ventilation shaft｜通风井 ; drive shaft｜传动轴 ; a shaft of sunlight｜一束阳光
tip_ja: 井道用shaft；英式lift shaft对应美式elevator shaft。

meanings_ja: adv. 相应地 | adv. 因此；于是
definition_en: in a way that suits the particular situation | as a result of something
example1_en: The forecast predicted rain, so we dressed accordingly.
example1_ja: 天气预报说有雨，所以我们相应地穿好了衣服。
example2_en: Schools should identify individual learning needs and adjust their teaching methods accordingly to support every student.
example2_ja: 学校应识别每个学生的学习需求，并相应调整教学方法，以支持所有学生。
collocations: adjust accordingly｜相应调整 ; act accordingly｜据此行事 ; plan accordingly｜据此规划
tip_ja: 表“相应地”常放句末；表“因此”较正式。

meanings_ja: n. 步行商业区（英） | n. 警区；选区（美） | n. 建筑物周围的区域
definition_en: A shopping area where vehicles are usually not allowed. | A district used for policing or elections. | The grounds surrounding a building, especially a religious building.
example1_en: We met outside the bakery in the shopping precinct.
example1_ja: 我们在步行商业区的面包店外碰面。
example2_en: Creating a pedestrian precinct can encourage local shopping while reducing traffic pollution in city centres.
example2_ja: 设立步行商业区既能鼓励本地消费，又能减少市中心的交通污染。
collocations: shopping precinct｜步行商业区 ; pedestrian precinct｜步行区 ; police precinct｜警区 ; cathedral precincts｜大教堂周围区域
tip_ja: 指建筑物周围的区域时，通常用复数precincts。

meanings_ja: n. 获得；习得 | n. 收购；购得物
definition_en: the process of obtaining something or developing knowledge and skills | the purchase of a business, or something that has been obtained
example1_en: Daily conversations helped with her acquisition of new vocabulary.
example1_ja: 日常交谈帮助她掌握了新词汇。
example2_en: Early exposure to varied speech can support language acquisition and strengthen children's ability to communicate effectively.
example2_ja: 尽早接触多样的语言表达能促进语言习得，增强儿童有效沟通的能力。
collocations: language acquisition｜语言习得 ; acquisition of skills｜技能的掌握 ; mergers and acquisitions｜企业并购 ; make an acquisition｜进行收购
tip_ja: 习得过程通常不可数；收购交易或购得物可数。

meanings_ja: v. 减轻；缓和
definition_en: To make something harmful, unpleasant, or serious less severe
example1_en: Thick curtains helped mitigate the noise from the street.
example1_ja: 厚窗帘帮助减轻了街上传来的噪声。
example2_en: Planting trees in urban areas can mitigate the effects of extreme heat and improve residents' quality of life.
example2_ja: 在城市地区植树可以减轻酷热的影响，并改善居民的生活质量。
collocations: mitigate the effects of｜减轻……的影响 ; mitigate risks｜降低风险 ; mitigate climate change｜缓解气候变化 ; mitigating circumstances｜可减轻处罚的情节
tip_ja: 正式用词，直接接风险、损害或影响，不表示彻底消除。

meanings_ja: n. 心智成熟；稳重 | n. 发育成熟 | n. 金融产品到期
definition_en: The ability to behave responsibly and make sensible judgments. | The state of being fully grown or developed. | The time when an investment or debt becomes repayable.
example1_en: Lena showed maturity by calmly admitting her mistake.
example1_ja: 莉娜冷静地承认自己的错误，表现得很成熟。
example2_en: Schools can foster emotional maturity by encouraging students to resolve disagreements respectfully and consider different perspectives.
example2_ja: 学校可以鼓励学生尊重他人地解决分歧并考虑不同观点，从而促进其情绪成熟。
collocations: emotional maturity｜情绪成熟 ; reach maturity｜达到成熟期 ; a maturity date｜到期日 ; show maturity｜表现出成熟稳重
tip_ja: 通常不可数；金融语境中at maturity表示到期时。

meanings_ja: v. 妥善存放；收好
definition_en: put something safely away, especially for a journey
example1_en: Please stow your bag under the seat in front.
example1_ja: 请把包放好，置于前方座位下。
example2_en: Passengers must stow their luggage securely so that loose items do not cause injuries during unexpected turbulence.
example2_ja: 乘客必须妥善放好行李，以免松散物品在突发颠簸中造成人员受伤。
collocations: stow luggage｜放好行李 ; stow something away｜把某物收好 ; stow securely｜牢固存放
tip_ja: stow away可指收好；人作主语时也可指藏匿偷乘。

meanings_ja: n. 入职培训；正式就任 | n. 归纳推理 | n. 电磁感应
definition_en: training or formal introduction when someone joins an organisation | forming general conclusions from particular observations | production of electrical effects by a changing magnetic field
example1_en: Our induction included a tour of the whole office.
example1_ja: 我们的入职培训包括参观整个办公室。
example2_en: A structured induction programme can help new employees understand workplace expectations and adapt to their roles.
example2_ja: 系统的入职培训可以帮助新员工了解工作要求并适应岗位。
collocations: induction programme｜入职培训计划 ; induction into office｜正式就任 ; electromagnetic induction｜电磁感应 ; inductive reasoning｜归纳推理
tip_ja: 入职常用induction；归纳与deduction演绎相对。

meanings_ja: n. 歌手；演唱者
definition_en: A singer, especially one performing with a musical group.
example1_en: The band's vocalist sang softly while the guitarist played.
example1_ja: 吉他手弹奏时，乐队的歌手轻声演唱。
example2_en: A skilled vocalist can help traditional music reach younger audiences without losing its distinctive cultural character.
example2_ja: 技艺娴熟的歌手能让传统音乐吸引年轻听众，同时保留其独特的文化特色。
collocations: lead vocalist｜主唱 ; backing vocalist｜伴唱歌手 ; jazz vocalist｜爵士歌手
tip_ja: 常指乐队中的歌手；lead vocalist意为主唱。

meanings_ja: adj. 不严格的；松懈的 | adj. 松弛的；不紧的
definition_en: Not strict or careful enough about rules or responsibilities. | Not firm, tight, or tense.
example1_en: The club is lax about checking membership cards.
example1_ja: 这家俱乐部对会员卡的检查很松懈。
example2_en: Lax enforcement of environmental regulations allows some factories to discharge untreated waste into nearby rivers.
example2_ja: 环境法规执行不严，使一些工厂得以向附近河流排放未经处理的废物。
collocations: lax security｜松懈的安保 ; lax enforcement｜执法不严 ; lax standards｜宽松的标准 ; lax about rules｜对规则要求不严
tip_ja: 常指规则执行不严；不要用它表示日常的腹泻。

meanings_ja: adj. 易于遭受的；有倾向的 | adj. 俯卧的
definition_en: Likely to experience something undesirable or behave a certain way | Lying flat with the face pointing downwards
example1_en: My skin is prone to dryness in cold weather.
example1_ja: 我的皮肤在寒冷天气里容易干燥。
example2_en: Coastal settlements are increasingly prone to flooding as sea levels rise and extreme storms become more frequent.
example2_ja: 随着海平面上升和极端风暴日益频繁，沿海居民区越来越容易遭受洪灾。
collocations: prone to injury｜容易受伤 ; prone to flooding｜易遭洪灾 ; accident-prone｜易出事故的 ; lie prone｜俯卧
tip_ja: prone to后接名词或动名词，通常指不好的情况。

meanings_ja: v. 使习惯于
definition_en: To make someone familiar or comfortable with something through experience.
example1_en: I slowly accustomed myself to sleeping with the window open.
example1_ja: 我慢慢让自己习惯了开窗睡觉。
example2_en: Schools can accustom students to collaborative work by regularly assigning tasks that require shared responsibility.
example2_ja: 学校可以定期布置需要共同承担责任的任务，让学生习惯合作。
collocations: accustom yourself to｜使自己习惯于 ; become accustomed to｜逐渐习惯于 ; be accustomed to｜习惯于
tip_ja: accustom oneself to中to是介词，后接名词或动名词。

meanings_ja: n. 独立实体；机构
definition_en: something that exists independently, especially an organization
example1_en: Our small bakery now operates as a separate entity.
example1_ja: 我们的小面包店现在作为独立实体运营。
example2_en: Each university should remain an independent entity while cooperating with other institutions on important research projects.
example2_ja: 各大学在与其他机构合作开展重要研究项目的同时，应保持独立。
collocations: a separate entity｜独立的实体 ; a legal entity｜法律实体 ; a commercial entity｜商业实体
tip_ja: 强调独立存在的单位，常用于机构、法律或商业语境。

meanings_ja: adj. 繁重的；造成负担的
definition_en: causing difficulty through excessive work, worry, or expense
example1_en: The extra paperwork became burdensome during our busiest week.
example1_ja: 在我们最忙的那一周，额外的文书工作成了沉重负担。
example2_en: Overly burdensome regulations may discourage small businesses from expanding, even when demand for their products is strong.
example2_ja: 过于繁重的监管规定可能阻碍小企业扩张，即使其产品需求旺盛也是如此。
collocations: burdensome regulations｜繁重的监管规定 ; burdensome task｜繁重的任务 ; financially burdensome｜造成经济负担的
tip_ja: 多形容任务、费用或规定，不指物体重量。

meanings_ja: n. 事件的时间顺序；年表 | n. 年代学
definition_en: The order of events in time, or a record showing it. | The study of when past events happened.
example1_en: These family photos helped us establish the chronology.
example1_ja: 这些家庭照片帮助我们确定了事情发生的先后顺序。
example2_en: Establishing an accurate chronology allows historians to examine how environmental changes influenced the development of early settlements.
example2_ja: 建立准确的事件时间序列，有助于历史学家研究环境变化如何影响早期聚落的发展。
collocations: establish a chronology｜确定时间顺序 ; a chronology of events｜事件年表 ; an accurate chronology｜准确的时间序列
tip_ja: chronology是名词；按时间顺序用chronologically。

meanings_ja: n. 奢侈；挥霍 | n. 奢侈品；奢侈之举
definition_en: Spending more money than is necessary or sensible. | Something expensive bought or done for pleasure rather than necessity.
example1_en: Buying fresh flowers every week is my only extravagance.
example1_ja: 每周买鲜花是我唯一的奢侈享受。
example2_en: Public criticism of government extravagance often increases when essential services face severe budget cuts.
example2_ja: 当基本公共服务面临大幅预算削减时，公众对政府铺张浪费的批评往往会增加。
collocations: personal extravagance｜个人挥霍 ; an unnecessary extravagance｜不必要的奢侈之举 ; a taste for extravagance｜对奢华的偏爱
tip_ja: 指挥霍行为通常不可数；指某项奢侈享受时可数。

meanings_ja: n. 开除；驱逐 | n. 排出；喷出
definition_en: The act of officially forcing someone to leave a place. | The process of forcing something out of a space or body.
example1_en: Repeated cheating led to his expulsion from the club.
example1_ja: 反复作弊导致他被俱乐部开除。
example2_en: Schools should consider supportive interventions before expulsion, as exclusion can seriously damage a young person's educational prospects.
example2_ja: 学校在开除学生之前应考虑采取支持性干预措施，因为排斥可能严重损害年轻人的教育前景。
collocations: expulsion from school｜被学校开除 ; face expulsion｜面临开除 ; expulsion of air｜空气的排出
tip_ja: 常用expulsion from；对应动词为expel。

meanings_ja: n. 标准；正常水平 | n. 票面价值 | n. 高尔夫标准杆数
definition_en: The usual or expected standard of quality or performance. | The stated value of a share or bond. | The expected strokes needed for a golf hole or course.
example1_en: I'm feeling below par, so I'll stay home tonight.
example1_ja: 我感觉状态不佳，所以今晚会待在家里。
example2_en: Investment in teacher training could bring educational outcomes in disadvantaged areas up to par with wealthier districts.
example2_ja: 投资教师培训可使弱势地区的教育成效达到较富裕地区的水平。
collocations: below par｜低于正常水平 ; on a par with｜与……不相上下 ; at par｜按票面价值 ; par value｜票面价值
tip_ja: on a par with表示不相上下；below par指状态欠佳。

meanings_ja: adv. 不论；不顾
definition_en: Without considering or being affected by something, used with of.
example1_en: Everyone can join the walk, irrespective of their age.
example1_ja: 无论年龄大小，人人都可以参加这次步行活动。
example2_en: Quality education should be available to all children, irrespective of their family income or social background.
example2_ja: 所有儿童都应能获得优质教育，无论其家庭收入或社会背景如何。
collocations: irrespective of age｜不论年龄 ; irrespective of income｜不论收入 ; irrespective of the outcome｜不论结果如何
tip_ja: 通常用irrespective of＋名词，意为“不论”。

meanings_ja: v. 招致；产生费用或损失
definition_en: to experience costs or something unpleasant because of your actions
example1_en: Late returns may incur an extra charge at this library.
example1_ja: 在这家图书馆，逾期归还可能产生额外费用。
example2_en: Businesses may incur substantial costs when replacing outdated equipment, but modern technology can improve productivity over time.
example2_ja: 企业更换过时设备时可能产生大量费用，但现代技术能逐步提高生产效率。
collocations: incur costs｜产生费用 ; incur losses｜遭受损失 ; incur debt｜背上债务 ; incur a penalty｜招致处罚
tip_ja: 过去式 incurred，现在分词 incurring，均双写 r。

meanings_ja: v. 筛；筛分 | v. 仔细检查；筛选
definition_en: To pass material through a sieve to separate its parts. | To examine material carefully to find what is useful.
example1_en: Sift the flour before adding it to the bowl.
example1_ja: 把面粉筛过后再加入碗中。
example2_en: Researchers must sift through large amounts of evidence before drawing reliable conclusions about the causes of unemployment.
example2_ja: 研究人员必须仔细筛查大量证据，才能对失业原因得出可靠的结论。
collocations: sift flour｜筛面粉 ; sift through evidence｜仔细审查证据 ; sift out｜筛除；筛选出
tip_ja: sift through表示仔细查看，寻找有用信息。

meanings_ja: n. 木材；锯好的木料 | v. 笨重地缓慢移动
definition_en: Wood cut into pieces for building, especially in American English. | To move slowly and awkwardly because of weight or size.
example1_en: We bought some lumber to build a garden bench.
example1_ja: 我们买了些木料，准备做一张花园长椅。
example2_en: Demand for sustainably sourced lumber can encourage forest owners to adopt more responsible management practices.
example2_ja: 对可持续来源木材的需求可以促使林场主采取更负责任的管理方式。
collocations: a lumber yard｜木材场 ; a stack of lumber｜一堆木料 ; lumber along｜笨重地缓慢前行
tip_ja: 木材义多用于美式英语，英式通常用timber。

meanings_ja: n. 红树；红树林
definition_en: A tropical coastal tree with roots growing in salty water
example1_en: Small fish sheltered among the roots of a mangrove.
example1_ja: 小鱼躲在一棵红树的根部之间。
example2_en: Mangrove forests protect coastal communities from storms while providing essential habitats for numerous marine species.
example2_ja: 红树林既能保护沿海社区免受风暴侵袭，也为众多海洋物种提供重要栖息地。
collocations: mangrove forest｜红树林 ; mangrove roots｜红树根系 ; mangrove conservation｜红树林保护
tip_ja: 可指一棵红树；红树林常说mangrove forest。

meanings_ja: v. 喷射；使喷出 | n. 一股喷出的液体
definition_en: Force liquid out through a small opening in a narrow stream. | A small amount of liquid released in a narrow stream.
example1_en: She squirted some lemon juice over the grilled fish.
example1_ja: 她往烤鱼上挤了些柠檬汁。
example2_en: Water-saving irrigation systems squirt small amounts of water directly onto roots, reducing waste in dry regions.
example2_ja: 节水灌溉系统将少量水直接喷向根部，减少干旱地区的水资源浪费。
collocations: squirt water｜喷水 ; squirt juice over something｜往某物上挤果汁 ; a squirt of sauce｜挤出的一点酱汁
tip_ja: 常用squirt液体onto/into某处，强调细流喷出。

meanings_ja: adj. 依赖的；依靠的
definition_en: needing someone or something for support or success
example1_en: Without a car, we are reliant on local buses.
example1_ja: 没有汽车，我们只能依靠当地公交车。
example2_en: Countries heavily reliant on imported fuel are particularly vulnerable to sudden changes in global energy prices.
example2_ja: 严重依赖进口燃料的国家尤其容易受到全球能源价格突变的影响。
collocations: reliant on｜依赖于 ; heavily reliant on｜严重依赖 ; increasingly reliant on｜越来越依赖
tip_ja: 固定搭配reliant on；“自立的”是self-reliant。

meanings_ja: v. 无视；不理会 | n. 漠视；不顾
definition_en: To ignore something or treat it as unimportant. | A lack of attention or respect for something.
example1_en: Please disregard my earlier message; the picnic is still happening.
example1_ja: 请忽略我之前的消息，野餐仍会照常举行。
example2_en: Companies that disregard environmental regulations may reduce short-term costs but create lasting damage to local ecosystems.
example2_ja: 无视环保法规的企业可能降低短期成本，却会对当地生态系统造成持久损害。
collocations: disregard advice｜不理会建议 ; disregard the rules｜无视规则 ; complete disregard for｜对……的完全漠视 ; disregard for safety｜对安全的漠视
tip_ja: 动词直接接宾语；名词常用disregard for。

meanings_ja: n. 正式讨论；论述 | n. 话语；语篇
definition_en: Serious spoken or written discussion of a particular subject. | Spoken or written language studied in its social context.
example1_en: Her lecture encouraged thoughtful discourse about local history.
example1_ja: 她的讲座引发了对当地历史的深入讨论。
example2_en: Public discourse on climate change increasingly focuses on practical solutions rather than distant predictions.
example2_ja: 关于气候变化的公共讨论越来越关注实际解决方案，而非遥远的预测。
collocations: public discourse｜公共讨论 ; political discourse｜政治话语 ; discourse analysis｜话语分析
tip_ja: 语体正式；语言学中指话语或语篇，不等于论文。

meanings_ja: v. 紧邻；与……毗连
definition_en: to be directly next to or share a boundary with something
example1_en: Our garden adjoins a quiet park with tall oak trees.
example1_ja: 我们的花园紧挨着一座长着高大橡树的安静公园。
example2_en: Residential areas that adjoin industrial sites may require additional measures to protect residents from noise and pollution.
example2_ja: 与工业区相邻的住宅区可能需要额外措施，以保护居民免受噪声和污染影响。
collocations: adjoin a park｜紧邻公园 ; adjoining rooms｜相邻的房间 ; adjoining properties｜毗连的房产
tip_ja: adjoin后直接接地点，不加to；强调直接相邻。

meanings_ja: n. 巅峰；顶点 | n. 尖峰；尖塔
definition_en: The highest level of success, achievement or development. | A tall pointed rock or pointed structure on a building.
example1_en: Winning the tournament was the pinnacle of her career.
example1_ja: 赢得那场锦标赛是她职业生涯的巅峰。
example2_en: For many researchers, international recognition represents the pinnacle of a career devoted to scientific discovery.
example2_ja: 对许多研究人员而言，获得国际认可代表着献身科学探索的职业生涯达到顶峰。
collocations: the pinnacle of success｜成功的巅峰 ; reach the pinnacle｜达到巅峰 ; a rocky pinnacle｜岩石尖峰
tip_ja: 比喻义常用the pinnacle of，表示成就的顶峰。

meanings_ja: v. 消散；使消散 | v. 挥霍；浪费
definition_en: To gradually disappear or cause something to spread and disappear. | To waste money, energy, or resources through careless use.
example1_en: The morning mist began to dissipate as sunlight warmed the valley.
example1_ja: 阳光温暖了山谷，晨雾开始消散。
example2_en: Urban green spaces help dissipate heat, reducing the discomfort caused by high temperatures in densely populated areas.
example2_ja: 城市绿地有助于散热，减轻人口密集地区高温带来的不适。
collocations: dissipate heat｜散热 ; tension dissipates｜紧张气氛消散 ; dissipate energy｜耗散能量
tip_ja: 可及物也可不及物：雾自行消散或风使雾消散。

meanings_ja: n. 严重危险；险境
definition_en: serious danger or a situation involving serious danger
example1_en: The sudden storm put the small boat in peril.
example1_ja: 突如其来的暴风雨使小船陷入险境。
example2_en: Coastal communities face increasing peril as rising sea levels threaten their homes and essential infrastructure.
example2_ja: 随着海平面上升威胁到住宅和关键基础设施，沿海社区面临的危险日益加剧。
collocations: in peril｜处于险境 ; put someone in peril｜使某人陷入险境 ; the perils of｜……的种种危险
tip_ja: 比danger更正式，常用in peril表示身处险境。

meanings_ja: adj. 审美的；美感的 | n. 美学风格；审美理念
definition_en: Relating to beauty or the appreciation of beautiful things. | A particular style or set of ideas about beauty.
example1_en: The wooden shelves give this room greater aesthetic appeal.
example1_ja: 这些木架让这个房间更有美感。
example2_en: Urban planners should consider both the practical function and aesthetic quality of public spaces.
example2_ja: 城市规划者应同时考虑公共空间的实用功能和审美品质。
collocations: aesthetic appeal｜美感吸引力 ; aesthetic value｜审美价值 ; aesthetic considerations｜审美方面的考量
tip_ja: aesthetic指审美的；aesthetics常指美学。

meanings_ja: n. 开始；开端 | n. 毕业典礼（美式）
definition_en: The beginning of something, especially an official activity | A ceremony celebrating students completing their studies in the United States
example1_en: We heard a whistle at the commencement of play.
example1_ja: 比赛开始时，我们听到了一声哨响。
example2_en: Environmental assessments should be completed before the commencement of construction to minimise potential damage to local ecosystems.
example2_ja: 施工开始前应完成环境评估，以尽量减少对当地生态系统的潜在破坏。
collocations: the commencement of work｜工作的开始 ; a commencement date｜开始日期 ; a commencement ceremony｜毕业典礼
tip_ja: 表示“开始”较正式；美式英语中也指毕业典礼。

meanings_ja: adj. 一流的；极好的
definition_en: Of excellent quality or exceptionally high ability.
example1_en: The small restaurant serves first-rate food at reasonable prices.
example1_ja: 这家小餐馆的菜品一流，价格也合理。
example2_en: Access to first-rate training enables young workers to develop skills that employers increasingly value.
example2_ja: 获得一流培训的机会能让年轻劳动者培养雇主日益看重的技能。
collocations: first-rate service｜一流的服务 ; a first-rate education｜一流的教育 ; a first-rate performance｜精彩的表现
tip_ja: first-rate表示质量一流，不是“第一次评价”。

meanings_ja: adj. 后部的；后面的 | n. 雌鹿
definition_en: At the back of an animal's body, especially its legs. | An adult female deer, especially a red deer.
example1_en: The rabbit pushed off with its powerful hind legs.
example1_ja: 兔子用有力的后腿一蹬，跳了出去。
example2_en: Kangaroos rely on their strong hind legs to travel efficiently across large areas in search of food.
example2_ja: 袋鼠依靠强壮的后腿高效穿越广阔区域，寻找食物。
collocations: hind legs｜后腿 ; hind feet｜后脚 ; hind limbs｜后肢
tip_ja: 作形容词主要修饰动物后肢，不泛指后面的事物。

meanings_ja: adj. 最适宜的；最佳的 | n. 最佳状态；最适量
definition_en: best suited to achieving a particular result | the most favourable level or condition for a particular purpose
example1_en: This sunny windowsill provides optimum conditions for my herbs.
example1_ja: 这个阳光充足的窗台为我种的香草提供了最适宜的条件。
example2_en: Maintaining the optimum classroom temperature can help students concentrate and reduce the energy required for heating.
example2_ja: 保持最适宜的教室温度有助于学生集中注意力，并减少供暖能耗。
collocations: optimum conditions｜最佳条件 ; optimum temperature｜最适温度 ; optimum performance｜最佳表现
tip_ja: 强调最适合目标，并非越多越好；通常不用most修饰。

meanings_ja: adj. 心情矛盾的；态度摇摆的
definition_en: having conflicting feelings about someone or something
example1_en: I feel ambivalent about moving away from my family.
example1_ja: 对于搬离家人这件事，我的心情很矛盾。
example2_en: Many consumers remain ambivalent about online shopping because convenience must be balanced against concerns about privacy.
example2_ja: 许多消费者对网购仍持矛盾态度，因为便利与隐私方面的担忧需要权衡。
collocations: feel ambivalent about｜对……心情矛盾 ; ambivalent attitude｜矛盾的态度 ; remain ambivalent｜仍然举棋不定
tip_ja: 常接about；指好坏感受并存，不是毫不在意。

meanings_ja: n. 竞争力 | n. 好胜心
definition_en: The ability to succeed against others in a market or activity. | A strong desire to win or outperform others.
example1_en: Fresh ingredients help our bakery maintain its competitiveness locally.
example1_ja: 新鲜食材帮助我们这家面包店保持本地竞争力。
example2_en: Investment in workforce training can improve national competitiveness by increasing productivity and encouraging innovation across industries.
example2_ja: 投资员工培训可以提高生产率并促进各行业创新，从而增强国家竞争力。
collocations: international competitiveness｜国际竞争力 ; enhance competitiveness｜增强竞争力 ; price competitiveness｜价格竞争力 ; economic competitiveness｜经济竞争力
tip_ja: 不可数；既可指市场竞争力，也可指个人好胜心。

meanings_ja: adj. 完整无损的；未改变的
definition_en: Complete and not damaged, altered, or missing any parts
example1_en: The box was crushed, but the cups remained intact.
example1_ja: 盒子被压坏了，但杯子依然完好无损。
example2_en: Careful restoration allows historic buildings to remain intact while meeting the safety requirements of modern urban life.
example2_ja: 精心修复可以使历史建筑保持完整，同时满足现代城市生活的安全要求。
collocations: remain intact｜保持完整 ; leave intact｜保留原状 ; fully intact｜完好无损
tip_ja: 常用于remain或leave之后，强调完整且未受损。

meanings_ja: adj. 易受影响的；易患病的
definition_en: easily affected or harmed by something
example1_en: These young plants are particularly susceptible to frost damage.
example1_ja: 这些幼苗特别容易遭受霜冻损害。
example2_en: Children may be more susceptible to online advertising because they lack experience in evaluating commercial claims.
example2_ja: 儿童可能更容易受到网络广告影响，因为他们缺乏评估商业宣传的经验。
collocations: susceptible to infection｜容易感染的 ; susceptible to influence｜易受影响的 ; highly susceptible｜极易受影响的
tip_ja: 常用susceptible to，to后接名词。

meanings_ja: v. 突然转向；急转弯 | n. 突然转向；急转弯
definition_en: To change direction suddenly, especially to avoid hitting something. | A sudden change of direction by a vehicle or person.
example1_en: The cyclist swerved to avoid a branch on the road.
example1_ja: 骑车人突然转向，避开了路上的树枝。
example2_en: Poorly maintained roads may force drivers to swerve unexpectedly, increasing the risk of collisions with other vehicles.
example2_ja: 养护不善的道路可能迫使司机突然转向，增加与其他车辆相撞的风险。
collocations: swerve to avoid something｜突然转向避开某物 ; swerve off the road｜突然偏离道路 ; a sudden swerve｜突然转向
tip_ja: 强调突然改变方向；普通转弯通常用turn。

meanings_ja: adj. 较小的；较不重要的
definition_en: Smaller in amount, degree, or importance
example1_en: We chose the lesser expense of repairing our sofa.
example1_ja: 我们选择了费用较低的方案，把沙发修好。
example2_en: Although funding matters, class size also influences educational outcomes, but usually to a lesser degree.
example2_ja: 虽然资金很重要，但班级规模也会影响教育成效，只是影响程度通常较小。
collocations: to a lesser extent｜在较小程度上 ; of lesser importance｜较不重要的 ; the lesser of two evils｜两害相权取其轻
tip_ja: 通常放在名词前；不用于直接表示物体尺寸更小。

meanings_ja: v. 犯错；判断失误
definition_en: To make a mistake or an incorrect judgement.
example1_en: I erred by leaving the cake in too long.
example1_ja: 我把蛋糕烤得太久，失误了。
example2_en: Policymakers may err when they assume that economic growth automatically improves everyone's quality of life.
example2_ja: 政策制定者若认为经济增长会自动改善所有人的生活质量，可能会判断失误。
collocations: err in judgement｜判断失误 ; err on the side of caution｜宁可谨慎一些 ; err in assuming｜错误地假定
tip_ja: 较正式的不及物动词；常用err on the side of caution。

meanings_ja: adj. 下级的；次要的 | n. 下属；部下
definition_en: Lower in rank, authority, or importance. | Someone with a lower position under another person's authority.
example1_en: She accepted a subordinate role on the project.
example1_ja: 她接受了在这个项目中担任辅助角色。
example2_en: In effective organisations, subordinate staff should feel comfortable raising concerns with senior managers without fear.
example2_ja: 在运作良好的组织中，下级员工应能放心地向高级管理人员提出疑虑。
collocations: subordinate to｜从属于；次于 ; a subordinate role｜次要角色 ; subordinate staff｜下级员工 ; a subordinate clause｜从句
tip_ja: 表示“从属于”用subordinate to，不用than。

meanings_ja: adj. 衷心的；真挚的
definition_en: Deeply and sincerely felt.
example1_en: She gave her neighbour a heartfelt hug before leaving.
example1_ja: 离开前，她真挚地拥抱了邻居。
example2_en: A heartfelt apology can help restore public trust, but institutions must also demonstrate a genuine commitment to change.
example2_ja: 真诚的道歉有助于恢复公众信任，但机构还必须展现真正致力于改变的决心。
collocations: heartfelt thanks｜衷心的感谢 ; a heartfelt apology｜真诚的道歉 ; heartfelt sympathy｜由衷的同情
tip_ja: 常修饰thanks、apology、sympathy，强调发自内心。

meanings_ja: v. 罢黜；赶下台；驱逐
definition_en: To force someone out of a position or place.
example1_en: Club members voted to oust their unpopular chair.
example1_ja: 俱乐部成员投票罢免了不受欢迎的主席。
example2_en: Shareholders may seek to oust company directors who repeatedly fail to meet environmental commitments or financial targets.
example2_ja: 股东可能寻求罢免那些屡次未能履行环保承诺或实现财务目标的公司董事。
collocations: oust a leader｜罢黜领导人 ; oust someone from office｜将某人赶下台 ; be ousted as chair｜被罢免主席职务
tip_ja: 常用oust someone from office，强调被迫离职。

meanings_ja: n. 评价；评估 | n. 估价
definition_en: a careful judgment of quality, performance, or a situation | an expert estimate of how much something is worth
example1_en: My manager praised my progress during today's performance appraisal.
example1_ja: 经理在今天的绩效评估中表扬了我的进步。
example2_en: A thorough appraisal of environmental risks should take place before any major construction project begins.
example2_ja: 任何大型建设项目启动之前，都应对环境风险进行全面评估。
collocations: performance appraisal｜绩效评估 ; critical appraisal｜审慎评估 ; property appraisal｜房产估价 ; appraisal process｜评估流程
tip_ja: appraisal是评估；别与approval（批准）混淆。

meanings_ja: adj. 兼容的；可并存的 | adj. 合得来的
definition_en: Able to work or exist together without problems | Having personalities or interests that allow a good relationship
example1_en: This charger is compatible with both of our tablets.
example1_ja: 这个充电器兼容我们的两台平板电脑。
example2_en: Economic growth can be compatible with environmental protection if governments encourage cleaner production and responsible resource use.
example2_ja: 如果政府鼓励更清洁的生产方式和负责任的资源利用，经济增长就能与环境保护并行。
collocations: compatible with｜与……兼容 ; fully compatible｜完全兼容 ; compatible software｜兼容的软件
tip_ja: 固定搭配是compatible with，不用compatible to。

meanings_ja: adj. 反复发生的；频繁的 | adj. 持续不断的
definition_en: Happening repeatedly, often with short breaks. | Continuing over a period without stopping.
example1_en: The continual interruptions made it hard to finish cooking.
example1_ja: 接二连三的打扰让人很难把饭做好。
example2_en: Continual changes in education policy can prevent teachers from developing effective long-term approaches to classroom learning.
example2_ja: 教育政策频繁变动可能妨碍教师制定有效的长期课堂教学方法。
collocations: continual interruptions｜频繁的打扰 ; continual improvement｜持续改进 ; continual changes｜不断的变化
tip_ja: continual常指反复发生；continuous强调不中断。

meanings_ja: n. 物品清单；财产清册 | n. 库存；存货 | v. 为……编制清单
definition_en: A detailed list of items owned or stored somewhere. | The goods a business keeps available for sale. | To make a detailed list of items.
example1_en: We made an inventory of everything in the garage.
example1_ja: 我们把车库里的所有东西列成了清单。
example2_en: Digital systems help retailers manage inventory more efficiently, reducing waste and preventing shortages of essential products.
example2_ja: 数字系统帮助零售商更高效地管理库存，减少浪费并防止必需品短缺。
collocations: make an inventory｜编制清单 ; inventory management｜库存管理 ; inventory levels｜库存水平

meanings_ja: adj. 食草的；以植物为食的

example2_ja: 食草动物通过吃掉幼苗和利用粪便传播种子来影响森林生长。

meanings_ja: adj. 无害的；无伤大雅的

example2_ja: 看似无害的家用产品如果随废水大量进入河流，也可能破坏水生生态系统。

example2_ja: 数字技术将教育领域拓展到课堂之外，让学生几乎可以在任何地方学习。

meanings_ja: adj. 燃烧着的；明亮的 | v. 下车；降落

meanings_ja: adj. 琐碎的；不重要的

collocations: trivial matter｜小事 ; trivial detail｜无关紧要的细节 ; trivial complaint｜对小事的抱怨

example2_ja: 居民要求地方议会保证，新开发项目不会影响公众前往公园。

tip_ja: 表示具体保证时可数；表示自信时通常不可数。

example2_en: Supportive teaching can help students develop latent abilities that conventional examinations may fail to identify.

collocations: latent talent｜潜在天赋 ; latent potential｜潜能 ; latent infection｜潜伏感染 ; latent demand｜潜在需求

meanings_ja: v. 激励；促进 | n. 刺激；推动力 | n. 马刺

meanings_ja: v. 迫害 | v. 纠缠；不断困扰

collocations: religiously persecuted｜因宗教而受迫害 ; persecute minorities｜迫害少数群体 ; persecuted for their beliefs｜因信仰而受迫害
tip_ja: persecute指迫害；prosecute指依法起诉。

meanings_ja: n. 融合；结合 | n. 核聚变
definition_en: the joining of different things into a single whole | the joining of light atomic nuclei, releasing energy

example2_en: Scientists are investigating nuclear fusion as a potential source of abundant energy with low carbon emissions.
example2_ja: 科学家正在研究核聚变，将其视为一种潜在的、供应充足且碳排放低的能源。
collocations: a fusion of styles｜多种风格的融合 ; fusion cuisine｜融合菜 ; nuclear fusion｜核聚变
tip_ja: 核聚变用fusion；核裂变用fission，注意区分。

meanings_ja: n. 广度；范围 | n. 宽度
definition_en: The wide range of things something includes. | The distance from one side of something to the other.

example1_ja: 她的兴趣之广总让朋友们感到惊讶。
example2_en: Universities should balance breadth of knowledge with opportunities for students to develop expertise in a chosen field.

tip_ja: breadth强调广度；depth强调深度，二者常并列。

meanings_ja: v. 稀释；冲淡 | v. 削弱；减弱 | adj. 稀释的；浓度低的
definition_en: To make a liquid weaker by adding water or another liquid. | To reduce the strength, quality, or influence of something. | Containing a relatively small amount of a substance in liquid.

collocations: dilute with water｜用水稀释 ; a dilute solution｜稀溶液 ; dilute the impact｜削弱影响

meanings_ja: n. 囚犯；服刑人员

example2_en: Providing inmates with vocational training may improve their employment prospects and reduce the risk of reoffending.

collocations: prison inmate｜监狱服刑人员 ; inmate rehabilitation｜服刑人员改造 ; former inmate｜曾服刑者

meanings_ja: n. 轻蔑；鄙视 | n. 藐视法庭
definition_en: A strong feeling that someone or something deserves no respect | Behaviour that disobeys a court or disrespects its authority
example1_en: He showed contempt for my suggestion by laughing.
example1_ja: 他用嘲笑来表示对我建议的轻蔑。
example2_en: When officials treat public concerns with contempt, trust in democratic institutions can decline significantly.
example2_ja: 当官员轻视公众的关切时，人们对民主制度的信任可能显著下降。
collocations: contempt for｜对……的鄙视 ; treat someone with contempt｜轻蔑地对待某人 ; contempt of court｜藐视法庭
tip_ja: contempt for指鄙视某人或某事；通常不可数。

meanings_ja: adj. 诱人得难以抗拒的 | adj. 无法抵挡的
definition_en: so attractive that you cannot refuse or avoid it | too strong or powerful to resist
example1_en: The smell of freshly baked bread was irresistible.
example1_ja: 刚烤好的面包香气让人无法抗拒。
example2_en: Online retailers use personalised recommendations to make certain products seem irresistible to potential customers.
example2_ja: 网络零售商利用个性化推荐，让某些商品对潜在顾客显得极具吸引力。

tip_ja: 常形容魅力、诱惑或冲动强烈得令人无法抗拒。

meanings_ja: n. 效率低下；低效现象
definition_en: failure to use time, money, or resources well

example2_en: Investment in modern equipment can reduce inefficiency and improve productivity across the manufacturing sector.
example2_ja: 投资现代化设备能够减少低效现象，提高整个制造业的生产率。
collocations: operational inefficiency｜运营效率低下 ; reduce inefficiency｜减少低效现象 ; administrative inefficiency｜行政效率低下
tip_ja: 指浪费时间或资源，不等于个人完全无能。

meanings_ja: n. 通信；往来信件 | n. 一致；对应关系
definition_en: Written communication between people, or the messages they exchange. | A close similarity or connection between two things.

example1_ja: 她把与表亲的往来信件放在抽屉里。
example2_en: Historical correspondence can reveal how ordinary families experienced social changes that official records describe only briefly.
example2_ja: 历史上的往来信件能揭示普通家庭如何经历官方记录仅简略提及的社会变迁。
collocations: correspondence with someone｜与某人的通信 ; business correspondence｜商务信函 ; correspondence between｜……之间的对应关系
tip_ja: 表示往来信件时不可数；与某人通信用with。

meanings_ja: v. 厌恶；憎恨
definition_en: to dislike someone or something very strongly

example1_ja: 我非常讨厌在冰冷的雨中站在外面等候。
example2_en: Many commuters detest overcrowded trains, yet they have few affordable alternatives for travelling to work.
example2_ja: 许多通勤者十分厌恶拥挤的列车，却很少有其他负担得起的上班出行方式。
collocations: detest doing something｜厌恶做某事 ; detest violence｜憎恶暴力 ; absolutely detest｜极其厌恶
tip_ja: 后接名词或动名词：detest doing，不接to do。

meanings_ja: n. 背叛；出卖

example1_ja: 把我的私人日记给别人看，让我觉得遭到了严重的背叛。
example2_en: Many voters regard broken election promises as a betrayal of the trust they place in political leaders.
example2_ja: 许多选民把不兑现竞选承诺视为对他们给予政治领导人的信任的背叛。
collocations: a betrayal of trust｜辜负信任 ; a sense of betrayal｜被背叛的感觉 ; an act of betrayal｜背叛行为
tip_ja: 通常指辜负信任；并非一般意义上的“暴露”。

meanings_ja: n. 摇篮 | n. 发源地；发祥地 | v. 轻轻抱着；托住
definition_en: A small bed for a baby that can rock. | The place where something important first developed. | Hold someone or something gently and protectively.

example2_ja: 由于拥有早期的农耕聚落，这一地区常被称为农业的发源地。

tip_ja: the cradle of 可比喻某种文明或活动的发源地。

meanings_ja: v. 发出尖叫；发出刺耳声 | n. 尖叫声；刺耳长声 | v. 告密

meanings_ja: adj. 爱国的

meanings_ja: adj. 粗俗的；下流的 | adj. 俗气的；庸俗的

meanings_ja: adj. 不识字的；文盲的 | adj. 缺乏某领域知识的

tip_ja: 名词用法易显贬义，宜用形容词客观描述。

meanings_ja: adj. 过度痴迷的；执念的

example2_en: Obsessive concern about academic performance can prevent students from maintaining healthy friendships and enjoying leisure activities.
example2_ja: 过度关注学业表现可能会妨碍学生维持健康的友谊和享受休闲活动。

meanings_ja: v. 使疏远；使失去支持

meanings_ja: v. 悬停；盘旋 | v. 在附近徘徊 | v. 在某水平上下浮动

meanings_ja: n. 熟练；精通

example1_en: The office still relies on an antiquated heating system.
example1_ja: 这间办公室仍然依赖一套陈旧过时的供暖系统。
example2_en: Replacing antiquated railway infrastructure could improve passenger safety and reduce delays across the national transport network.
example2_ja: 更换陈旧的铁路基础设施，可以提高乘客安全水平，并减少全国交通网络的延误。
collocations: antiquated equipment｜陈旧的设备 ; antiquated system｜过时的系统 ; antiquated laws｜过时的法律
tip_ja: 含贬义，强调旧到不合时宜；antique可指珍贵古物。

meanings_ja: n. 军团；兵种部队 | n. 专业工作团体
definition_en: a large military unit or branch with particular duties | an organized group of people doing the same specialized work
example1_en: My cousin joined the medical corps after finishing university.
example1_ja: 我表亲大学毕业后加入了军队医疗部队。
example2_en: The diplomatic corps can support international cooperation by maintaining communication between governments during periods of tension.
example2_ja: 外交使团可以在紧张时期维持政府之间的沟通，从而支持国际合作。
collocations: medical corps｜军队医疗部队 ; diplomatic corps｜外交使团 ; press corps｜记者团
tip_ja: 单复数拼写相同；单数不读ps，复数词尾读/z/。

meanings_ja: n. 楔子；楔形物 | v. 楔住；塞入
definition_en: An object thick at one end and thin at the other. | To push something tightly into a narrow space.
example1_en: He slid a wooden wedge under the heavy door.
example1_ja: 他把一个木楔塞到沉重的门下面。
example2_en: Disagreements over resource allocation can drive a wedge between neighbouring communities and weaken regional cooperation.
example2_ja: 资源分配上的分歧可能导致相邻社区失和，并削弱区域合作。
collocations: a wooden wedge｜木楔 ; a wedge of cheese｜一块楔形奶酪 ; wedge the door open｜用楔子撑住门 ; drive a wedge between｜使……之间产生隔阂
tip_ja: drive a wedge between 比喻挑起隔阂或分裂。

meanings_ja: n. 啤酒厂
definition_en: A place where beer is produced commercially.
example1_en: The old brewery has become a popular local museum.
example1_ja: 那座旧啤酒厂已成为当地一座受欢迎的博物馆。
example2_en: Converting a historic brewery into a cultural centre can preserve industrial heritage while creating new employment opportunities.
example2_ja: 将历史悠久的啤酒厂改建为文化中心，既能保护工业遗产，也能创造新的就业机会。
collocations: local brewery｜当地啤酒厂 ; craft brewery｜精酿啤酒厂 ; brewery tour｜啤酒厂参观
tip_ja: 通常指啤酒厂；葡萄酒庄是winery。

meanings_ja: v. 发起；启动 | v. 使入门；接纳入会
definition_en: To cause a process or activity to begin. | To introduce someone to an activity or admit them to a group.
example1_en: Someone needs to initiate a conversation about the noise.
example1_ja: 得有人先开口谈谈噪声问题。
example2_en: Local authorities should initiate programmes that encourage residents to recycle household waste more effectively.
example2_ja: 地方政府应启动相关项目，鼓励居民更有效地回收生活垃圾。
collocations: initiate negotiations｜发起谈判 ; initiate a project｜启动项目 ; initiate someone into｜使某人入门
tip_ja: 作动词较正式；initiate sb into指使入门。

meanings_ja: n. 学位论文；专题论文
definition_en: A long research paper written as part of a university degree
example1_en: My sister is writing her dissertation at the library.
example1_ja: 我姐姐正在图书馆写学位论文。
example2_en: Writing a dissertation requires students to evaluate existing research and develop a clear argument supported by evidence.
example2_ja: 撰写学位论文要求学生评估已有研究，并提出有证据支持的清晰论点。
collocations: write a dissertation｜撰写学位论文 ; submit a dissertation｜提交学位论文 ; a doctoral dissertation｜博士论文 ; a dissertation on education｜关于教育的学位论文
tip_ja: 主题用on引出；美式常指博士论文，英式范围较广。

meanings_ja: v. 哀悼；为失去而悲痛
definition_en: To feel or express deep sadness after a death or loss.
example1_en: Neighbours gathered quietly to mourn their much-loved friend.
example1_ja: 邻居们静静地聚在一起，悼念他们深爱的朋友。
example2_en: Public memorials provide spaces where communities can mourn those they have lost and reflect on shared history.
example2_ja: 公共纪念场所让社区居民得以悼念逝者，并回顾共同的历史。
collocations: mourn someone's death｜哀悼某人的去世 ; mourn the loss of｜为失去……而悲痛 ; mourn for someone｜悼念某人
tip_ja: 可直接接逝者或损失，也可用mourn for sb。

meanings_ja: n. 局；处；办事机构 | n. 翻盖书桌；五斗柜
definition_en: an office or organisation providing information or managing particular activities | a desk with a folding cover, or an American chest of drawers
example1_en: The tourist bureau gave us a free city map.
example1_ja: 旅游咨询处给了我们一张免费的城市地图。
example2_en: A national statistics bureau collects reliable data that governments use to plan public services.
example2_ja: 国家统计局收集可靠数据，供政府规划公共服务之用。
collocations: tourist bureau｜旅游咨询处 ; statistics bureau｜统计局 ; news bureau｜新闻分社
tip_ja: 复数可用bureaux或bureaus；家具义有英美差异。

meanings_ja: n. 航空；航空业
definition_en: The activity or industry of flying and operating aircraft.
example1_en: Her interest in aviation began with a flying lesson.
example1_ja: 她对航空的兴趣始于一堂飞行课。
example2_en: The aviation industry faces pressure to reduce emissions while meeting growing demand for international travel.
example2_ja: 航空业面临着既要减少排放，又要满足不断增长的国际旅行需求的压力。
collocations: civil aviation｜民用航空 ; aviation industry｜航空业 ; aviation safety｜航空安全
tip_ja: 不可数名词，常指飞行活动或整个航空业。

meanings_ja: n. 退款；退税；返还款
definition_en: Money returned after you pay for something or pay tax
example1_en: We received a rebate after buying our new fridge.
example1_ja: 我们买了新冰箱后收到了一笔返款。
example2_en: Governments can offer a tax rebate to encourage households to install insulation and reduce energy consumption.
example2_ja: 政府可以通过退税，鼓励家庭安装隔热材料并减少能源消耗。
collocations: a tax rebate｜退税 ; claim a rebate｜申请退款 ; receive a rebate｜收到返款 ; offer a rebate｜提供返款优惠
tip_ja: rebate通常是付款后返还，discount通常是付款时减价。

meanings_ja: n. 阀；阀门 | n. 瓣膜
definition_en: a device controlling the flow of liquid or gas | a body structure keeping fluid moving in one direction
example1_en: Turn this valve to stop water entering the tank.
example1_ja: 转动这个阀门，阻止水流入水箱。
example2_en: Replacing damaged heart valves can improve patients' quality of life and reduce the risk of serious complications.
example2_ja: 更换受损的心脏瓣膜可以改善患者的生活质量，并降低严重并发症的风险。
collocations: open a valve｜打开阀门 ; a safety valve｜安全阀 ; a heart valve｜心脏瓣膜 ; a pressure relief valve｜泄压阀
tip_ja: 工程中指阀门，人体中可指心脏等部位的瓣膜。

meanings_ja: n. 铰链；合页 | v. 取决于
definition_en: a joint that allows a door or lid to swing | to depend entirely on something, used with on or upon
example1_en: The rusty hinge squeaks whenever I open the cupboard.
example1_ja: 每次我打开橱柜，生锈的合页都会吱吱作响。
example2_en: The success of public transport reforms may hinge on reliable funding and sustained support from local residents.
example2_ja: 公共交通改革的成功可能取决于可靠的资金来源和当地居民的持续支持。
collocations: door hinge｜门合页 ; rusty hinge｜生锈的铰链 ; hinge on｜取决于
tip_ja: hinge on 后接名词或从句，表示“取决于”。

meanings_ja: v. 飘动；振翅；颤动 | n. 颤动；心悸
definition_en: Move with quick, light movements, especially through air | A quick, light movement or brief uneven heartbeat
example1_en: The curtains fluttered gently beside the open kitchen window.
example1_ja: 窗帘在敞开的厨房窗边轻轻飘动。
example2_en: Butterflies flutter among native flowers in urban gardens, demonstrating how small green spaces can support biodiversity.
example2_ja: 蝴蝶在城市花园的本土花卉间翩翩飞舞，展示了小型绿地如何支持生物多样性。
collocations: flutter in the breeze｜在微风中飘动 ; flutter its wings｜振动翅膀 ; a flutter of excitement｜一阵激动
tip_ja: 强调轻而快的反复运动，可用于翅膀、布料或心跳。

meanings_ja: n. 等级制度；层级结构 | n. 统治集团；领导层
definition_en: A system arranging people or things by rank or importance | The people holding the highest positions in an organisation
example1_en: There is a clear hierarchy among the restaurant staff.
example1_ja: 这家餐厅的员工之间有明确的等级关系。
example2_en: A rigid workplace hierarchy may discourage junior employees from sharing ideas that could improve organisational performance.
example2_ja: 僵化的职场等级制度可能使基层员工不愿分享有助于改善组织绩效的想法。
collocations: a rigid hierarchy｜严格的等级制度 ; organisational hierarchy｜组织层级结构 ; a hierarchy of needs｜需求层次 ; the top of the hierarchy｜等级体系的顶层
tip_ja: 既可指等级结构，也可指组织的最高领导层。

meanings_ja: adj. 放射状的；径向的
definition_en: Arranged along lines spreading out from a central point.
example1_en: The wheel's radial spokes gleamed in the afternoon sun.
example1_ja: 车轮上呈放射状的辐条在午后的阳光下闪闪发亮。
example2_en: A radial road network connects outer residential districts directly to the city centre.
example2_ja: 放射状道路网将外围住宅区直接连接到市中心。
collocations: radial pattern｜放射状图案 ; radial symmetry｜辐射对称 ; radial road network｜放射状道路网
tip_ja: 强调从中心向外延伸，不泛指与光线有关。

meanings_ja: v. 放大声音或信号 | v. 增强；扩大影响 | v. 详述；补充说明
definition_en: to make a sound or electrical signal stronger | to increase the strength or effect of something | to explain something further by adding details
example1_en: This small speaker amplifies music from my phone.
example1_ja: 这个小音箱把我手机播放的音乐放大了。
example2_en: Social media can amplify public concerns about pollution, encouraging local authorities to respond more quickly.
example2_ja: 社交媒体能够放大公众对污染的担忧，促使地方政府更迅速地回应。
collocations: amplify sound｜放大声音 ; amplify a signal｜放大信号 ; amplify the effect｜增强效果
tip_ja: 既可放大实际声音，也可增强影响或情绪。

meanings_ja: n. 积压的工作；待处理订单
definition_en: work or orders waiting to be dealt with
example1_en: I stayed late to clear a backlog of emails.
example1_ja: 我加班到很晚，清理积压的邮件。
example2_en: Hiring additional staff could help hospitals reduce the backlog of patients waiting for routine operations.
example2_ja: 增聘工作人员可以帮助医院减少等候常规手术的积压患者人数。
collocations: clear a backlog｜清理积压 ; a backlog of orders｜积压的订单 ; reduce the backlog｜减少积压 ; a growing backlog｜不断增加的积压
tip_ja: 常用a backlog of，指本应处理却积压的事项。

meanings_ja: n. 清除；清理 | n. 正式许可；批准 | n. 清仓甩卖
definition_en: The removal of unwanted objects or material from a place | Official permission to do something or enter a place | The sale of remaining goods at reduced prices
example1_en: The garden clearance took us most of Saturday.
example1_ja: 清理花园花了我们周六大半天的时间。
example2_en: Large-scale forest clearance can destroy wildlife habitats and increase the risk of soil erosion.
example2_ja: 大规模森林清除会破坏野生动物栖息地，并增加水土流失的风险。
collocations: forest clearance｜森林清除 ; security clearance｜安全审查许可 ; customs clearance｜清关 ; clearance sale｜清仓甩卖
tip_ja: clearance sale是清仓促销；清关用customs clearance。

meanings_ja: n. 起义；暴动
definition_en: An organised attempt by a population to resist those in power.
example1_en: The museum displays objects from a local uprising.
example1_ja: 博物馆展出了当地一次起义留下的物品。
example2_en: Historians argue that food shortages and political exclusion contributed to the uprising against the ruling authorities.
example2_ja: 历史学家认为，粮食短缺和政治排斥促成了反抗统治当局的起义。
collocations: a popular uprising｜民众起义 ; an armed uprising｜武装起义 ; suppress an uprising｜镇压起义
tip_ja: 通常指反抗统治者的起义，不用于日常的起床或上升。

meanings_ja: adj. 温馨舒适的；家常的 | adj. 相貌平平的；不好看的
definition_en: simple and comfortable in a way that feels like home | not physically attractive, especially in American English
example1_en: The little café felt homely, with cushions on every chair.
example1_ja: 这家小咖啡馆很温馨，每把椅子上都有软垫。
example2_en: A homely atmosphere in residential care facilities may help older people feel more comfortable and secure.
example2_ja: 养老照护机构中温馨的氛围可能让老年人感到更舒适、更安心。
collocations: homely atmosphere｜温馨的氛围 ; homely surroundings｜舒适如家的环境 ; homely face｜平凡的面容
tip_ja: 英式常指温馨；美式常指不好看，形容人要谨慎。

meanings_ja: n. 精密；复杂程度 | n. 老练；世故；高雅
definition_en: the quality of being advanced or carefully developed | knowledge of social situations, culture, and fashionable tastes
example1_en: I was surprised by the sophistication of her camera.
example1_ja: 她的相机如此精密，让我很惊讶。
example2_en: The growing sophistication of medical equipment allows doctors to identify certain diseases at an earlier stage.
example2_ja: 医疗设备日益精密，使医生能够在更早阶段发现某些疾病。
collocations: technological sophistication｜技术先进程度 ; a high degree of sophistication｜高度精密 ; social sophistication｜社交上的老练
tip_ja: 不可数名词；既指技术精密，也指处世老练。

meanings_ja: v. 復讐する、仇を討つ
definition_en: to punish someone in return for harm done to yourself or someone else
example1_en: Our team hopes to avenge last year's defeat.
example1_ja: 私たちのチームは昨年の敗北の雪辱を果たしたいと思っている。
example2_en: Historical narratives often portray leaders seeking to avenge past defeats rather than negotiate lasting peace.
example2_ja: 歴史の語りでは、指導者が恒久的な平和を交渉するよりも過去の敗北への復讐を求める姿がよく描かれる。
collocations: avenge a defeat｜敗北の雪辱を果たす ; avenge a wrong｜不当な仕打ちに報復する
tip_ja: avengeは動詞で受けた害を目的語にとる。revengeは名詞が中心。
forms: 三人称単数現在: avenges | 過去形: avenged | 過去分詞: avenged | 現在分詞: avenging

meanings_ja: v. 授ける、贈る
definition_en: to give something valuable or important to someone, such as an honour
example1_en: The club bestowed a special award on our coach.
example1_ja: クラブは私たちのコーチに特別な賞を贈った。
example2_en: Universities often bestow honorary degrees on individuals who have made outstanding contributions to society.
example2_ja: 大学は、社会に傑出した貢献をした人物に名誉学位を授与することがよくある。
collocations: bestow an honour on｜〜に栄誉を授ける ; bestow a gift on｜〜に贈り物をする ; bestow a title upon｜〜に称号を与える
tip_ja: 改まった語。bestow 物 on/upon 人の形で使う。
forms: 三人称単数現在: bestows | 過去形: bestowed | 過去分詞: bestowed | 現在分詞: bestowing

meanings_ja: v. 強く非難する、遺憾に思う
definition_en: to feel or express strong disapproval or deep regret about something
example1_en: Our neighbours deplore the dumping of rubbish beside the river.
example1_ja: 近所の人たちは、川のそばにごみが捨てられることを嘆かわしく思っている。
example2_en: Many educators deplore funding cuts that limit access to music and art lessons in public schools.
example2_ja: 多くの教育者は、公立学校で音楽や美術の授業を受ける機会を狭める予算削減を遺憾に思っている。
collocations: deplore violence｜暴力を強く非難する ; deplore the lack of｜〜の欠如を遺憾に思う ; deplore the decision｜その決定を強く批判する
tip_ja: 改まった他動詞。非難や嘆きの対象を直接目的語にとる。
forms: 三人称単数現在: deplores | 過去形: deplored | 過去分詞: deplored | 現在分詞: deploring

meanings_ja: n. 添え木、副木 | v. 添え木で固定する
definition_en: a rigid support strapped to an injured limb to keep it still | to support a broken or injured body part with a rigid support
example1_en: The nurse fitted a splint to my injured finger.
example1_ja: 看護師は私のけがをした指に添え木を当てた。
example2_en: Using a splint to stabilise an injured limb can prevent further damage while patients await medical treatment.
example2_ja: 添え木で負傷した手足を固定すれば、患者が治療を待つ間に悪化するのを防げる。
collocations: wear a splint｜添え木をつけている ; apply a splint｜添え木を当てる ; a wrist splint｜手首用の添え木
tip_ja: splint は取り外せることが多い固定具。ギプスは cast と言う。
forms: 複数形: splints | 三人称単数現在: splints | 過去形: splinted | 過去分詞: splinted | 現在分詞: splinting

meanings_ja: n. 歩兵、歩兵部隊
definition_en: soldiers who fight on foot rather than in vehicles or on horses
example1_en: The infantry marched past our village early this morning.
example1_ja: 歩兵部隊が今朝早く私たちの村を行進していった。
example2_en: Although military technology has changed considerably, infantry still play an important role in many countries' defence forces.
example2_ja: 軍事技術は大きく変わったが、歩兵は今も多くの国の防衛力で重要な役割を果たしている。
collocations: infantry unit｜歩兵部隊 ; infantry division｜歩兵師団 ; infantry training｜歩兵の訓練
tip_ja: 集合名詞なので an infantry で1人を指さない。1人は infantryman。

meanings_ja: n. 葡萄球菌
definition_en: A round bacterium forming clusters, sometimes causing infections.
example1_en: The laboratory found staphylococcus in the skin sample.
example1_ja: 实验室在皮肤样本中发现了葡萄球菌。
example2_en: Some strains of staphylococcus resist common antibiotics, making hospital infections more difficult to treat.
example2_ja: 某些葡萄球菌菌株对常用抗生素具有耐药性，使医院感染更难治疗。
collocations: staphylococcus infection｜葡萄球菌感染 ; strains of staphylococcus｜葡萄球菌菌株 ; antibiotic-resistant staphylococcus｜耐抗生素葡萄球菌
tip_ja: 复数为staphylococci；常见简称为staph。

meanings_ja: v. 委派；授权
definition_en: to appoint someone to act or perform a task for you
example1_en: The manager deputed her assistant to attend the meeting.
example1_ja: 经理委派她的助理去参加会议。
example2_en: Local authorities may depute trained officers to inspect buildings and ensure compliance with safety regulations.
example2_ja: 地方政府可以委派受过培训的官员检查建筑，确保其符合安全规定。
collocations: depute someone to do something｜委派某人做某事 ; depute a representative｜委派代表
tip_ja: 正式用词，常用depute sb to do sth。

meanings_ja: v. 环绕；笼罩
definition_en: to surround or cover something, especially with smoke or mist
example1_en: Thin wisps of steam wreathed her face above the bowl.
example1_ja: 碗里升起的缕缕蒸汽缭绕在她脸庞周围。
example2_en: Smoke from nearby factories can wreathe residential buildings, highlighting the need for stricter industrial emission controls.
example2_ja: 附近工厂排出的烟雾可能笼罩住宅楼，凸显加强工业排放管控的必要性。
collocations: be wreathed in smoke｜被烟雾笼罩 ; mist wreathes the hills｜薄雾环绕山丘 ; a face wreathed in smiles｜满面笑容
tip_ja: 偏文学用语；wreathe尾音/ð/，wreath尾音/θ/。

meanings_ja: n. 旋涡；涡流 | n. 困境的旋涡
definition_en: A spinning mass of fluid drawing things towards its centre | A situation that pulls people into increasing confusion or difficulty
example1_en: Leaves spun in a vortex beside the riverbank.
example1_ja: 树叶在河岸旁的旋涡中打转。
example2_en: Without access to affordable credit, some households become trapped in a vortex of debt and financial insecurity.
example2_ja: 如果无法获得利率可负担的贷款，一些家庭就会陷入债务与财务不稳定的旋涡。
collocations: a swirling vortex｜盘旋的涡流 ; a vortex of debt｜债务旋涡 ; be sucked into a vortex｜被卷入旋涡
tip_ja: 复数可用vortices或vortexes；也可比喻困境。

meanings_ja: v. 使不可能；阻止；排除
definition_en: to prevent something or make it impossible
example1_en: The heavy rain precluded our planned picnic by the lake.
example1_ja: 大雨让我们原定的湖边野餐无法进行。
